macroforecast: function reference

Every module, class and function of the project, generated from the code, its docstrings and the latest runs. This page is rebuilt automatically when the code changes (at the end of each run, by python tools/make_docs.py --watch, or by the git pre-commit hook), so it cannot drift from the code.

941items
754with docstrings
316/908functions with a run example
85files

How to read a card

  • Signature and arguments: from the code; meanings from the docstring.
  • Config settings read: the config keys the function uses, e.g. sample.horizon.
  • Calls / Called by: links both ways; run marks calls seen in a run but not visible in the code (like model.fit).
  • Example from the last run: what the function actually received and returned, with a table preview. Steps loaded from the cache are not called, so run with --force once to collect examples for everything.
  • The model interface: every competing model has panel(ctx, mdf), fit(P, start, end), forecast(P, origin, H), spec() and drivers(), plus name, family and note; any class with these can be added to the zoo.

How a run flows

_tmp_diff.yaml (run 2026-11-26 11:00, 79 s)

Entry point ; the steps it ran, in order:

  1. StepCache.__init__ ×1, 0.0 s — Create the cache.
  2. Context.__init__ ×1, 0.1 s — Load and align everything a run needs: target, organic growth, scenarios, metadata, literature table, dummies and the estimation window.
  3. hash_frame ×6, 0.0 s — Content hash of data: values and index. For a DataFrame the column labels count too (they are the variable mnemonics); a Series' own name do
  4. hash_obj ×68, 0.0 s — Stable hash of config-like objects (dicts, lists, numbers, strings).
  5. StepCache.run ×26, 61.8 s — Return fn()'s result, from cache when the fingerprint is unchanged.
  6. hash_code ×7, 0.2 s — Hash of source files under src/ (so editing the code re-runs the step). Docstrings, comments and formatting are ignored: improving the docum
  7. write_tables ×8, 2.7 s — Write each table as CSV and all of them as sheets of tables.xlsx (with sized columns).
  8. chart_stability ×1, 0.2 s — Bar chart of Elastic Net stability-selection frequencies.
  9. selection_info ×5, 0.0 s — What the zoo needs from one approach's result (kept small so it can be cached at every OOS origin).
  10. build ×1, 0.1 s — sel: {approach: selection_info(...)}. Returns (models, notes table, extra tables).
  11. ARDL.spec ×7, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): the settings that define the model (used in cache keys).
  12. AutoARDL.spec ×1, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): settings that define the model (for the cache).
  13. LevelsARDL.spec ×1, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py).
  14. MLModel.spec ×8, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): kind, features and settings.
  15. ARIMAX.spec ×1, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): features and order.
  16. Theta.spec ×1, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): no settings.
  17. AutoARDL.drivers ×3, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): the drivers with their chosen lags.
  18. AutoARDL.lag_summary ×1, 0.0 s — The chosen lags in EViews notation, e.g. ARDL(2, 1, 0, 3).
  19. LevelsARDL.drivers ×3, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): the long-run variables with their chosen lags.
  20. LevelsARDL.lag_summary ×1, 0.0 s — EViews notation of the chosen lags, e.g. ARDL(2, 0, 1, 1).
  21. combine ×1, 3.4 s — Horizon combinations on a set of test forecast paths (backtest or out of sample).
  22. buckets ×1, 0.0 s — The horizon buckets, clipped to the horizon and extended to cover every quarter up to it.
  23. by_horizon ×1, 0.0 s — Errors by quarters ahead, in the format of the backtest table (balance error, COVID windows left out).
  24. final_choice ×1, 0.1 s — The choice for the real forecast: every realised test error counts.
  25. scenarios ×1, 0.0 s — Scenario forecasts of the horizon combinations, spliced from the chosen models' scenario paths.
  26. describe ×2, 0.0 s — Model-list text and driver-table rows for a horizon combination.
  27. horizon_summary ×1, 0.0 s — One row per model: average error over 1..h and error at exactly h, for each h in `horizons`.
  28. chart_family_bars ×1, 0.6 s — Average balance error over 1..h quarters for every model, grouped by family; one panel per horizon.
  29. best_per_family ×1, 0.0 s — AR(1) plus the most accurate model of every other family (for charts that cannot show 20 lines).
  30. chart_horizon ×1, 0.1 s — Line chart of balance error by quarters ahead, one line per model, coloured by family.
  31. scenario_models ×1, 0.0 s — Models shown in the scenario chart: the data-driven ones and the best literature and hybrid models.
  32. chart_scenarios ×1, 0.6 s — Balance paths under each scenario, one panel per model.
  33. summary_md ×1, 0.0 s — Write the run summary (summary.md): settings, chosen drivers, comparison and diagnostics.
  34. save_all ×1, 0.1 s — Everything estimated in a run, next to models.pkl (fitted/):
  35. ARDL.drivers ×15, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): the model's drivers for tables.
  36. MLModel.drivers ×17, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): driver features.
  37. ARIMAX.drivers ×2, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): driver features.
  38. Theta.drivers ×2, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): "(own history only)".
  39. MLModel.panel ×96, 0.8 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): panel with target, drivers and dummies.
  40. MLModel.forecast ×96, 4.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): predict one quarter at a time, feeding each prediction back as lagged growth.
  41. path ×2004, 0.0 s — Level after each quarter, starting from L0 and adding up the changes.
  42. is_log ×1012, 0.0 s — True for dlog targets (levels in logs, errors in percent).
  43. ARDL.panel ×59, 0.5 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): build the model's data panel (target, drivers, dummies) from a macro scenario.
  44. ARDL.forecast ×1852, 0.7 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate the estimated equation forward from an origin.
  45. vif ×1, 0.0 s — Variance inflation factors of the columns of F (multicollinearity check).
  46. feature_sign ×3, 0.0 s — sign_of() for a feature name.
  47. AutoARDL.panel ×4, 0.1 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): target, dummies and every candidate lag.
  48. AutoARDL.forecast ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate the equation, own forecasts replacing lagged growth.
  49. LevelsARDL.panel ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): target, dummies, y* = ln(L*/P), the long-run levels.
  50. LevelsARDL.forecast ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate y* forward; growth = change in y* plus inflation.
  51. Theta.panel ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): panel with target and dummies.
  52. Theta.forecast ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): fit Theta on start..origin and forecast H quarters.
  53. load_metadata ×1, 0.0 s — Load the variable metadata (description, geography, theme, expected sign) and rename columns.
  54. outcome_themes ×1, 0.0 s — Themes not allowed as controls because they are other outcomes of the same economy (credit aggregates, deposits, ...): they carry part of th
  55. has_formula ×38, 0.0 s — True when the model is an explicit equation (ARDL, error-correction model, same-growth rule).
  56. write ×1, 0.3 s — Pick the recommended formula model, write the equation, the next quarters and the Excel calculator.
  57. StepCache.write_manifest ×1, 0.0 s — Save this run's fingerprints and report which components changed since the previous run.
  58. snapshot ×1, 0.0 s — Copy the run's current results into saved_runs/<date_time>_<script>/ and keep the newest save.keep_runs.

  31. scenario_models ×1, 0.0 s — Models shown in the scenario chart: the data-driven ones and the best literature and hybrid models.
  32. chart_scenarios ×1, 0.4 s — Balance paths under each scenario, one panel per model.
  33. summary_md ×1, 0.5 s — Write the run summary (summary.md): settings, chosen drivers, comparison and diagnostics.
  34. save_all ×1, 0.1 s — Everything estimated in a run, next to models.pkl (fitted/):
  35. ARDL.drivers ×16, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): the model's drivers for tables.
  36. MLModel.drivers ×16, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): driver features.
  37. ARIMAX.drivers ×2, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): driver features.
  38. Theta.drivers ×2, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): "(own history only)".
  39. ARDL.panel ×67, 0.5 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): build the model's data panel (target, drivers, dummies) from a macro scenario.
  40. ARDL.forecast ×1860, 0.8 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate the estimated equation forward from an origin.
  41. path ×1988, 0.0 s — Level after each quarter, starting from L0 and adding up the changes.
  42. is_log ×1004, 0.0 s — True for dlog targets (levels in logs, errors in percent).
  43. AutoARDL.panel ×12, 0.2 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): target, dummies and every candidate lag.
  44. AutoARDL.forecast ×12, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate the equation, own forecasts replacing lagged growth.
  45. MLModel.panel ×72, 0.6 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): panel with target, drivers and dummies.
  46. MLModel.forecast ×72, 3.2 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): predict one quarter at a time, feeding each prediction back as lagged growth.
  47. vif ×1, 0.0 s — Variance inflation factors of the columns of F (multicollinearity check).
  48. feature_sign ×3, 0.0 s — sign_of() for a feature name.
  49. LevelsARDL.panel ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): target, dummies, y* = ln(L*/P), the long-run levels.
  50. LevelsARDL.forecast ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate y* forward; growth = change in y* plus inflation.
  51. Theta.panel ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): panel with target and dummies.
  52. Theta.forecast ×4, 0.0 s — Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): fit Theta on start..origin and forecast H quarters.
  53. load_metadata ×1, 0.0 s — Load the variable metadata (description, geography, theme, expected sign) and rename columns.
  54. outcome_themes ×1, 0.0 s — Themes not allowed as controls because they are other outcomes of the same economy (credit aggregates, deposits, ...): they carry part of th
  55. has_formula ×38, 0.0 s — True when the model is an explicit equation (ARDL, error-correction model, same-growth rule).
  56. write ×1, 0.2 s — Pick the recommended formula model, write the equation, the next quarters and the Excel calculator.
  57. StepCache.write_manifest ×1, 0.0 s — Save this run's fingerprints and report which components changed since the previous run.
  58. snapshot ×1, 0.0 s — Copy the run's current results into saved_runs/<date_time>_<script>/ and keep the newest save.keep_runs.

module run_pipeline · 2 items
Macro-driver forecasting pipeline - entry point.

    python run_pipeline.py                                   # uses config/example_config.yaml
    python run_pipeline.py --config config/my_portfolio.yaml
    python run_pipeline.py --config config/my_portfolio.yaml --approach en_first

Everything specific to a data set (file names, sheet names, column names, dates, settings) is in the
config file, so the same code runs on any portfolio by pointing it at another config.

Folders
  config/            run configurations (one YAML per data set)
  data/              input files (simulated example data)
  src/utils/         config loading, package set-up, reading files
  src/features/      transformations, stationarity, candidate features
  src/selection/     univariate screen, clustering, Elastic Net (+ stability selection)
  src/modelling/     ARDL model, shared final search, backtest / diagnostics / scenarios
  src/pipelines/     screen_first.py (approach A), en_first.py (approach B)
  src/reporting/     tables, charts, summary
  tools/             simulate_data.py (makes the example data)
  outputs/<run_name>/screen_first, en_first, comparison

def main():
    """Command line entry: parse arguments, load the config, start the trace and run the pipeline."""
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Macro-driver forecasting pipeline")
    ap.add_argument("--config", default=os.path.join(HERE, "config", "example_config.yaml"))
    ap.add_argument("--approach", choices=["both", "all", "screen_first", "en_first", "bayes_first", "focus_first", "factors_first", "stable_first"], default=None,
                    help="overrides 'approaches' in the config")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="recompute every step (ignore the cache)")
    ap.add_argument("--force-step", action="append", default=[],
                    help="recompute one step: features, screen_first, en_first or evaluate (repeatable)")
    ap.add_argument("--no-cache", action="store_true", help="do not read or write the cache")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-check", action="store_true", help="do not stop on errors found by the pre-flight check")
    ap.add_argument("--no-trace", action="store_true", help="do not write the detailed trace (outputs/<run>/trace/)")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(args.config)
    preflight(cfg, log, strict=not args.skip_check)         # names, files and dates checked in seconds
    tracer = trace.start(cfg, "run_pipeline.py", globals(), enabled=not args.no_trace)
    try:
        run(cfg, args)
    finally:
        trace.finish(tracer, {"config": os.path.relpath(cfg["config_file"], HERE), "run_name": cfg["run_name"]}, log)
        docs.refresh(cfg, log)                       # function reference, if the code changed

def run(cfg, args):
    """The full pipeline: data -> features -> both selection approaches -> model zoo -> backtest,
    diagnostics and scenarios for every model -> tables, charts and summary.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration. args: parsed command-line arguments.
    """
    if args.approach is None:
        approaches = list(cfg["approaches"])
    else:
        approaches = ["screen_first", "en_first"] if args.approach == "both" else \
            list(APPROACHES) if args.approach == "all" else [args.approach]
    out = cfg["out_dir"]
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    log(f"Run '{cfg['run_name']}' -> {out}")

    c = cfg["cache"]
    cache = StepCache(c["dir"], enabled=c["enabled"] and not args.no_cache, force=args.force,
                      force_steps=args.force_step)

    log("Loading data ...")
    ctx = Context(cfg)
    log(f"  target: {cfg['data']['bank']['target_column']}, {ctx.idx[0]}–{ctx.idx[-1]} ({len(ctx.idx)} quarters); "
        f"{ctx.base.shape[1]} macro columns; {len(ctx.macro)} scenarios")

    # ---- fingerprints of the inputs (content, not file names) ----
    h_y, h_level, h_meta = hash_frame(ctx.y), hash_frame(ctx.level), hash_frame(ctx.meta)
    h_hist = hash_frame(ctx.hist)
    h_scen = {k: hash_frame(v) for k, v in ctx.macro.items()}
    cs = {k: hash_obj(cfg[k]) for k in ("sample", "features", "screen_first", "en_first", "bayes_first", "final_model")}
    cs["factors_first"] = hash_obj(cfg["factors"])
    cs["stable_first"] = hash_obj(cfg["stability"])
    cs["focus_first"] = hash_obj({k: cfg["impact"].get(k) for k in ("focus", "max_controls", "control_corr", "controls_same_theme", "excluded_control_themes", "control_t")}
                                 | {"literature": cfg["literature"].get("models")})
    log("Steps (cached = loaded because nothing it depends on changed):")
    cache.run("data", {"target": h_y, "balance": h_level, "metadata": h_meta, "macro_history": h_hist,
                       "scenarios": hash_obj(h_scen)}, lambda: True, log)

    def build_features():
        forms_ = candidate_forms(cfg, ctx.hist, ctx.meta)
        if forms_.empty:
            raise RuntimeError("No candidate variables left: check allowed_geographies / excluded_themes / metadata")
        return forms_, all_features(cfg, ctx, forms_)
    feat_comp = {"macro_history": h_hist, "metadata": h_meta, "config.features": cs["features"],
                 "config.sample": cs["sample"], "code": hash_code("features/transforms.py", "utils/io.py")}
    forms, F = cache.run("features", feat_comp, build_features, log)
    h_feat = hash_obj(feat_comp)
    log(f"  {forms['mnemonic'].nunique()} variables, {int(forms['stationary'].sum())} stationary forms, "
        f"{F.shape[1]} features (with lags)")
    report.write_tables(os.path.join(out, "common"), {"stationarity_tests": forms})

    code_files = {
        "screen_first": ["selection/screening.py", "selection/clustering.py", "modelling/search.py",
                         "modelling/ardl.py", "pipelines/screen_first.py"],
        "en_first": ["selection/elastic_net.py", "selection/screening.py", "selection/clustering.py",
                     "modelling/search.py", "modelling/ardl.py", "pipelines/en_first.py"],
        "bayes_first": ["selection/bayes.py", "selection/screening.py", "selection/clustering.py",
                        "modelling/search.py", "modelling/ardl.py", "pipelines/bayes_first.py"],
        "focus_first": ["selection/double_selection.py", "pipelines/focus_first.py"],
        "factors_first": ["features/factors.py", "selection/small_search.py", "pipelines/factors_first.py"],
        "stable_first": ["selection/stability.py", "selection/small_search.py", "pipelines/stable_first.py"],
    }
    results = []
    for a in approaches:
        comp_a = {"features": h_feat, "target": h_y, "metadata": h_meta, f"config.{a}": cs[a],
                  "config.final_model": cs["final_model"], "config.sample": cs["sample"],
                  "code": hash_code(*code_files[a])}
        r = cache.run(a, comp_a, lambda a=a: APPROACHES[a].run(cfg, ctx, F, forms), log)
        log(f"  {a}: drivers {r['features']}")
        report.write_tables(os.path.join(out, a), r["tables"])
        if "B2_en_stability" in r["tables"]:
            report.chart_stability(os.path.join(out, a, "en_stability.png"), r["tables"]["B2_en_stability"],
                                   cfg["en_first"]["stability"]["threshold"])
        results.append(r)

    log("Building the competing models (benchmarks, data-driven, literature, hybrid, machine learning, AI) ...")
    sel = {r_a: zoo.selection_info(r_a, r) for r_a, r in zip(approaches, results)}
    models, notes, extra = zoo.build(cfg, ctx, sel, log)
    log(f"  {len(models)} models: " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in notes["family"].value_counts(sort=False).items()))
    ev_code = hash_code("modelling/ardl.py", "modelling/evaluate.py", "modelling/search.py", "features/transforms.py",
                        "models/ecm.py", "models/ml.py", "models/combination.py", "models/foundation.py",
                        "models/deep.py", "models/regime.py", "models/simple.py", "models/autoardl.py")
    ev = {}
    for m in models:
        comp_m = {"model": hash_obj(m.spec()), "target": h_y, "balance": h_level, "metadata": h_meta,
                  "scenarios": hash_obj(h_scen), "config.sample": cs["sample"],
                  "config.deflator": hash_obj(cfg["features"]["deflator"]), "code": ev_code}
        ev[m.name] = cache.run(f"evaluate:{m.name}", comp_m, lambda m=m: evaluate(ctx, m), log)
    for k, v in ev.items():                     # lags chosen during estimation (auto-ARDL): update the model list
        if v.get("fitted") is not None and k in set(notes["model"]):
            try:
                m_ = pickle.loads(v["fitted"])
            except Exception:
                continue
            if hasattr(m_, "lag_summary"):
                i_ = notes.index[notes["model"] == k][0]
                notes.loc[i_, "drivers"] = ", ".join(m_.drivers())
                notes.loc[i_, "how it is specified"] = f"{notes.loc[i_, 'how it is specified']}. Chosen on all the " \
                                                       f"data: {m_.lag_summary()}"
    by_h = pd.concat([v["by_horizon"] for v in ev.values()])
    H = cfg["sample"]["horizon"]
    hz = cfg["sample"]["report_horizons"]
    tests = pd.concat([v["test_forecasts"] for v in ev.values() if isinstance(v.get("test_forecasts"), pd.DataFrame)],
                      ignore_index=True)
    # horizon combinations: the best model for each forecast horizon, chosen from errors already known at each origin
    hc_rows, hc_choices = horizon.combine(tests, cfg, H, lambda n: zoo.wanted(cfg, n, horizon.FAMILY))
    hc_extra = {}
    if hc_rows is not None:
        log(f"Horizon combinations ({', '.join(f'{a}-{z}' for a, z in horizon.buckets(cfg, H))} quarters ahead) ...")
        by_h = pd.concat([by_h, horizon.by_horizon(hc_rows)], ignore_index=True)
        tests = pd.concat([tests, hc_rows.drop(columns=["error", "chosen"])], ignore_index=True)
        B, fch = horizon.final_choice(tests, cfg, H)
        scen_all = pd.concat([v["scenarios"] for v in ev.values()])
        hc_extra["scen"] = horizon.scenarios(scen_all, B, fch, lambda n: zoo.wanted(cfg, n, horizon.FAMILY))
        for k, nm in horizon.NAMES.items():
            if nm in set(hc_rows["model"]):
                txt, drows = horizon.describe(B, fch, k)
                notes = pd.concat([notes, pd.DataFrame([{
                    "model": nm, "family": horizon.FAMILY, "drivers": txt,
                    "how it is specified": ("For each block of quarters ahead, the model with the smallest growth error "
                                            if k == "best" else "For each block of quarters ahead, the best "
                                            f"{cfg['models']['horizon_combination'].get('top_k', 3)} models weighted by "
                                            "1/error ") + "on forecasts already realised at each origin (no look-ahead)",
                    "source": ""}])], ignore_index=True)
                hc_extra.setdefault("drivers", []).append(pd.DataFrame(drows))
                hc_extra.setdefault("diag", []).append({"model": nm, "family": horizon.FAMILY, "note": "combination: "
                                                        "residual tests do not apply; see each member model"})
                log(f"  {nm}: {txt}")
    comp = horizon_summary(by_h, hz)
    comp = comp.merge(notes[["model", "drivers", "how it is specified", "source"]], on="model", how="left")
    comp["avg_bias_1_%d_pct" % H] = by_h.groupby("model", sort=False)["bias_exCOVID_pct"].mean().reindex(comp["model"]).values
    comp = comp.round(3)
    diag = pd.DataFrame([v["diagnostics"] for v in ev.values()] + hc_extra.get("diag", []))
    drivers = pd.concat([v["drivers"] for v in ev.values()] + hc_extra.get("drivers", []))
    scen = pd.concat([v["scenarios"] for v in ev.values()] + ([hc_extra["scen"]] if len(hc_extra.get("scen", [])) else []))
    yearend = scen[scen["date"].str.endswith("Q4")].pivot_table(index=["model", "date"], columns="scenario",
                                                                 values="balance_forecast", sort=False).round(1).reset_index()
    coef_paths = pd.concat([v["coef_path"].assign(model=k).reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "origin"})
                            for k, v in ev.items()])
    overlap = None
    if len(results) == 2:
        overlap = ", ".join(sorted(set(results[0]["features"]) & set(results[1]["features"])))

    cdir = os.path.join(out, "comparison")
    tables = {"1_model_comparison": comp, "2_backtest_by_horizon": by_h.round(4), "3_drivers": drivers,
              "4_diagnostics": diag, "5_scenario_yearend": yearend, "6_scenario_forecasts": scen,
              "7_coefficient_paths": coef_paths, "9_model_list": notes, "12_backtest_forecasts": tests.round(6)}
    if hc_choices is not None:
        tables["13_horizon_choices"] = hc_choices
    for k, v in extra.items():
        tables[f"10_{k}"] = v
    regimes = [v["regimes"] for v in ev.values() if isinstance(v.get("regimes"), pd.DataFrame)]
    if regimes:
        tables["11_regimes"] = pd.concat(regimes).round(4)
    report.write_tables(cdir, tables)
    if regimes:
        report.chart_regimes(os.path.join(cdir, "regimes.png"), tables["11_regimes"], ctx.level)
    report.chart_family_bars(os.path.join(cdir, "model_comparison.png"), comp, hz)
    report.chart_horizon(os.path.join(cdir, "backtest_by_horizon.png"), by_h, report.best_per_family(comp, H))
    report.chart_scenarios(os.path.join(cdir, "scenarios.png"), scen, ctx.level, report.scenario_models(comp, H))
    report.summary_md(os.path.join(out, "summary.md"), cfg, results, comp, diag, overlap)
    trace.add_story(lambda: story.build(cfg, ctx, forms, F, results, models, notes, ev, comp), log)

    log(f"\nResults (balance error, dummy quarters excluded; average over 1–h quarters):")
    log(f"  {'model':<44s} {'family':<20s} " + " ".join(f"{'1-' + str(h):>7s}" for h in hz))
    for _, r in comp.sort_values(f"avg_1_{H}_pct").iterrows():
        log(f"  {r['model']:<44s} {r['family']:<20s} " + " ".join(f"{r[f'avg_1_{h}_pct']:6.2f}%" for h in hz))
    if cfg["save"].get("fitted_models", True):
        saved.save_all(out, ev, ctx, log)
    all_fitted = {}
    for k, v in ev.items():
        if v.get("fitted") is not None:
            try:
                all_fitted[k] = pickle.loads(v["fitted"])
            except Exception:
                pass
    if (cfg.get("impact") or {}).get("enabled", True):
        log("\nHow the economy affects the target (impact/) ...")
        try:
            from src.impact import analysis as impact
            impact.run(cfg, ctx, all_fitted, out, log)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(f"  impact analysis not written ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex})")
    log("\nThe recommended model: every model scored on forecasting, interpretation and sensitivity ...")
    order, why_rec = None, None
    try:
        from src.selection import scorecard
        S = scorecard.score(cfg, all_fitted, comp, out, "backtest", log)
        if S is not None:
            order, why_rec = list(S["model"]), scorecard.why_text(S.iloc[0], S.attrs["weights"], S.attrs["col"])
    except Exception as ex:
        log(f"  scorecard not written ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex})")
    fitted = {k: m_ for k, m_ in all_fitted.items() if formula.has_formula(m_)}
    try:
        formula.write(cfg, ctx, fitted, comp, "backtest", log, order=order, why_rec=why_rec)
    except Exception as ex:
        log(f"  formula: not written ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex})")
    steps = cache.write_manifest(out, log)
    report.write_tables(os.path.join(out, "comparison"), {"8_run_steps": steps})
    saved.snapshot(cfg, "pipeline", log)
    log(f"\nDone. Outputs in {out}")

At each forecast origin the full selection is re-run with data up to that origin only, then the chosen
model forecasts the next quarters. Compared with: the same approach using the drivers chosen on the full
sample (look-ahead), and the AR(1) benchmark. Settings are in the `oos:` section of the config.
Results go to outputs/<run_name>/oos/. Each origin's selection is cached, so re-runs are fast.

def main():
    """Command line entry for the out-of-sample test."""
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Out-of-sample test with re-selection at each origin")
    ap.add_argument("--config", default=os.path.join(HERE, "config", "example_config.yaml"))
    ap.add_argument("--approach", choices=["both", "all", "screen_first", "en_first", "bayes_first", "focus_first", "factors_first", "stable_first"], default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="recompute every origin")
    ap.add_argument("--no-cache", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--skip-check", action="store_true", help="do not stop on errors found by the pre-flight check")
    ap.add_argument("--no-trace", action="store_true", help="do not write the detailed trace")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config(args.config)
    cfg["trace"]["folder"] = "trace_oos"
    preflight(cfg, log, strict=not args.skip_check)         # names, files and dates checked in seconds
    tracer = trace.start(cfg, "run_oos.py", globals(), enabled=not args.no_trace)
    try:
        run(cfg, args)
    finally:
        trace.finish(tracer, {"config": os.path.relpath(cfg["config_file"], HERE), "run_name": cfg["run_name"]}, log)
        docs.refresh(cfg, log)                       # function reference, if the code changed

def run(cfg, args):
    """Out-of-sample test with re-selection at every origin, Diebold-Mariano tests, holdout and charts.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration. args: parsed command-line arguments.
    """
    names = list(cfg["approaches"]) if args.approach is None else \
        (["screen_first", "en_first"] if args.approach == "both" else list(APPROACHES) if args.approach == "all"
         else [args.approach])
    approaches = {n: APPROACHES[n] for n in names}
    out = os.path.join(cfg["out_dir"], "oos")
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    cache = StepCache(cfg["cache"]["dir"], enabled=cfg["cache"]["enabled"] and not args.no_cache, force=args.force)

    log("Loading data ...")
    ctx = Context(cfg)

    # full-sample drivers (the ones the normal pipeline reports), for the look-ahead comparison
    log("Full-sample selection (for comparison) ...")
    full = {}
    for n, mod in approaches.items():
        full[n] = oos.select_at(cfg, ctx, mod, ctx.end, cache, n)["features"]
        log(f"  {n}: {full[n]}")

    store = {} if (cfg.get("save") or {}).get("origin_models", True) else None
    vout, wout = {}, {}
    E, picks, H = oos.run_oos(cfg, ctx, approaches, full, cache, store, vintage_out=vout, window_out=wout)
    if store:                                    # every model as estimated at every origin
        coefs = store.pop("__coefficients__", [])
        saved.save_origin_models(os.path.join(out, "fitted_models"), store, log)
        if coefs:
            pd.DataFrame(coefs).to_csv(os.path.join(out, "fitted_coefficients_by_origin.csv"), index=False)
    hc_rows, hc_choices = horizon.combine(E, cfg, H, lambda n: zoo.wanted(cfg, n, horizon.FAMILY))
    if hc_rows is not None:                       # horizon combinations, chosen from errors realised at each origin
        E = pd.concat([E, hc_rows.drop(columns=["chosen"]).assign(drivers=hc_rows["chosen"])], ignore_index=True)
    hz = sorted({h for h in cfg["sample"]["report_horizons"] if h <= H} or {H})
    by_h, summ, dm, stab = oos.summarise(E, picks, H, hz)
    log("Holdout ...")
    hold = oos.holdout(cfg, ctx, approaches, cache)

    tables = {"1_oos_summary": summ.round(4), "2_oos_by_horizon": by_h.round(4), "3_dm_tests_vs_benchmark": dm.round(4),
              "4_drivers_by_origin": picks, "5_driver_stability": stab.round(3), "6_all_forecast_errors": E}
    if hold is not None:
        tables["7_holdout"] = hold.round(4)
    if hc_choices is not None:
        tables["8_horizon_choices"] = hc_choices
    summ_fc = None
    EV = vout.get("errors")
    if EV is not None and len(EV):                # the same test with the macro forecast of each origin's time
        hv, _ = horizon.combine(EV, cfg, H,
                                lambda n: zoo.wanted(cfg, n, horizon.FAMILY))
        if hv is not None:
            EV = pd.concat([EV, hv.drop(columns=["chosen"]).assign(drivers=hv["chosen"])], ignore_index=True)
        by_h_fc, summ_fc, dm_fc, _ = oos.summarise(EV, picks, H, hz)
        col = f"avg_1_{max(hz)}_pct"
        cmp_ = summ[["model", "family", col]].merge(summ_fc[["model", col]], on="model",
                                                     suffixes=("_realised_macro", "_forecast_macro"))
        cmp_["macro_forecast_cost_pct"] = cmp_[f"{col}_forecast_macro"] - cmp_[f"{col}_realised_macro"]
        cmp_ = cmp_.sort_values(f"{col}_forecast_macro")
        cov = vout.get("coverage")
        tables.update({"9_oos_summary_forecast_macro": summ_fc.round(4),
                       "10_oos_by_horizon_forecast_macro": by_h_fc.round(4),
                       "11_dm_tests_forecast_macro": dm_fc.round(4),
                       "12_realised_vs_forecast_macro": cmp_.round(4),
                       "13_vintage_coverage": cov, "14_all_forecast_errors_forecast_macro": EV})
        log(f"\nWith the macro forecast available at each origin (vintages {', '.join(sorted(EV['vintage'].dropna().unique())[:3])}"
            f"...): average error over 1-{max(hz)} quarters, realised macro -> forecast macro")
        for _, r in cmp_.head(12).iterrows():
            log(f"  {r['model']:<46s} {r[f'{col}_realised_macro']:6.2f}% -> {r[f'{col}_forecast_macro']:6.2f}%")
        if cov is not None and len(cov) and (cov["drivers_from_vintage"] < 1).any():
            low = cov[cov["drivers_from_vintage"] < 1]
            log(f"  note: {low['model'].nunique()} model(s) use series missing from the vintages "
                f"({', '.join(sorted(set(', '.join(low['drivers_not_in_vintage']).split(', ')) - {''})[:6])}); "
                f"those take their {vintages.settings(cfg)['missing']} path (see 13_vintage_coverage)")
    WD, WS = oos.window_check(E, wout.get("errors"), cfg, hz)
    if WD is not None:                            # does the older history help or hurt?
        tables.update({"15_window_check": WD.round(4), "16_window_check_summary": WS.round(4),
                       "17_all_forecast_errors_other_windows": wout["errors"]})
        log(f"\nWindow check: {oos.base_window_label(cfg)} vs a shorter, more recent window "
            f"(same drivers, same origins; average error over 1-{max(hz)} quarters):")
        for _, r in WS.iterrows():
            log(f"  {r['other_window']} ({r['origins_compared']} origins with enough history): better for "
                f"{r[f'other_window_better_1_{max(hz)}']} of {r['models']} models, "
                f"median change {r['median_change_pct']:+.1f}%, significant (10%) for {r['significant_either_way']}; "
                f"best model {r['best_error_main_pct']:.2f}% ({r['main_window']}) vs {r['best_error_other_pct']:.2f}%")
        top = WD.loc[WD["model"].isin(summ.nsmallest(8, f"avg_1_{max(hz)}_pct")["model"])]
        for _, r in top.iterrows():
            log(f"    {r['model']:<44s} {r[f'main_avg_1_{max(hz)}_pct']:6.2f}% -> {r[f'other_avg_1_{max(hz)}_pct']:6.2f}%"
                f"  [{r['other_window']}] {r['verdict']}")
        report.chart_window_check(os.path.join(out, "window_check.png"), WD, max(hz))
    report.write_tables(out, tables)
    if summ_fc is not None:
        report.chart_family_bars(os.path.join(out, "oos_model_comparison_forecast_macro.png"),
                                 summ_fc[summ_fc["family"] != "Look-ahead check"], hz)
    report.chart_oos(os.path.join(out, "oos_mape_by_horizon.png"), by_h, summ, H)
    report.chart_family_bars(os.path.join(out, "oos_model_comparison.png"),
                             summ[summ["family"] != "Look-ahead check"], hz)
    report.chart_driver_timeline(os.path.join(out, "drivers_by_origin.png"),
                                 picks[picks["model"].isin([oos.PRETTY[a] for a in approaches])])
    if hold is not None:
        report.chart_holdout(os.path.join(out, "holdout.png"), hold, ctx.level, report.best_per_family(summ, max(hz)))

    trace.add_story(lambda: story.build_oos(cfg, picks, summ, dm, hold, H), log)
    log(f"\nOut-of-sample results (re-selected at every origin; dummy quarters excluded; "
        f"{len(picks['origin'].unique()) if len(picks) else 0} origins; average error over 1–h quarters):")
    log(f"  {'model':<46s} {'family':<20s} " + " ".join(f"{'1-' + str(h):>7s}" for h in hz) + "  Theil U")
    for _, r in summ.sort_values(f"avg_1_{max(hz)}_pct").iterrows():
        log(f"  {r['model']:<46s} {r['family']:<20s} " + " ".join(f"{r[f'avg_1_{h}_pct']:6.2f}%" for h in hz)
            + f"  {r[f'theil_U_1_{H}']:.2f}")
    if hold is not None:
        last = hold.groupby("model", sort=False).tail(1).sort_values("error_pct", key=abs)
        log(f"\nHoldout (selected and estimated to {hold['train_end'].iloc[0]}, error after {cfg['oos']['holdout_quarters']} quarters):")
        for _, r in last.iterrows():
            log(f"  {r['model']:<46s} {r['error_pct']:+.2f}%")
    all_fitted = saved.load_models(cfg["out_dir"])
    order, why_rec = None, None
    use_fc = summ_fc is not None and vintages.settings(cfg)["rank_on"] == "forecast"
    try:
        from src.selection import scorecard
        log("\nThe recommended model, scored out of sample (forecasting, interpretation, sensitivity):")
        S = scorecard.score(cfg, all_fitted, summ_fc if use_fc else summ, cfg["out_dir"],
                            "out of sample, with the macro forecasts of the time" if use_fc else "out of sample", log)
        if S is not None:
            order, why_rec = list(S["model"]), scorecard.why_text(S.iloc[0], S.attrs["weights"], S.attrs["col"])
    except Exception as ex:
        log(f"  scorecard not written ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex})")
    fitted = {k: m for k, m in all_fitted.items() if formula.has_formula(m)}
    if fitted:
        try:
            formula.write(cfg, ctx, fitted, summ_fc if use_fc else summ,
                          "out of sample, macro forecasts of the time" if use_fc else "out of sample", log,
                          order=order, why_rec=why_rec)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(f"  formula: not written ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex})")
    else:
        log("  formula: run run_pipeline.py first (it saves the fitted models the formula is taken from)")
    saved.snapshot(cfg, "oos", log)
    log(f"\nDone. Outputs in {out}")

def _fix_switches(cfg, base=None, path=()):
    """Read true/false/yes/no written where a list or a block is expected the way it is meant.

    YAML turns the words true, yes, on (and ON, the Ontario code) into True, and false, no, off into False. A switch
    written in place of a list or block (e.g. statistical: yes, deep: false) would otherwise stop the run with
    "'bool' object is not iterable". True keeps the default list or block (switched on), False switches it off.

    Args:
        cfg: merged configuration (changed in place). base: the defaults at the same level. path: keys so far.

    Returns:
        list of "path: value -> meaning" notes, for the log.
    """
    base = DEFAULTS if base is None else base
    notes = []
    for k, d in base.items():
        if k not in cfg:
            continue
        v, where = cfg[k], ".".join(path + (k,))
        if isinstance(v, bool) and isinstance(d, list):
            cfg[k] = copy.deepcopy(d) if v else []
            notes.append(f"{where}: {v} read as {'the default list ' + str(d) if v else 'switched off ([])'}")
        elif isinstance(v, bool) and isinstance(d, dict):
            cfg[k] = copy.deepcopy(d)
            if "enabled" in d:
                cfg[k]["enabled"] = v if not v else d["enabled"]
            elif "models" in d and not v:
                cfg[k]["models"] = []
            notes.append(f"{where}: {v} read as {'the default settings' if v else 'switched off'}")
        elif isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(d, dict):
            notes += _fix_switches(v, d, path + (k,))
    return notes

def _merge(base, over):
    """Recursively merge a user config over the defaults (user values win).

    Args:
        base: defaults. over: user values.

    Returns:
        new dict.
    """
    out = copy.deepcopy(base)
    for k, v in (over or {}).items():
        out[k] = _merge(out[k], v) if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(out.get(k), dict) else v
    return out

def _path(p):
    """Resolve a path relative to the project folder.

    Args:
        p: path or None.

    Returns:
        absolute path or None.
    """
    if p is None:
        return None
    return p if os.path.isabs(p) else os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, p)

def load_config(path):
    """Read a YAML config, fill defaults, check required keys and normalise values.

    Args:
        path: config file.

    Returns:
        dict (also holds out_dir and config_file).

    Raises:
        KeyError / ValueError on missing keys or invalid settings.
    """
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        user = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
    d_ = user.get("data") or {}
    if isinstance(d_.get("target"), dict):               # data.target is another name for data.bank
        d_["bank"] = {**(d_.get("bank") or {}), **d_.pop("target")}
    cfg = _merge(DEFAULTS, user)
    SWITCH_NOTES[:] = _fix_switches(cfg)             # reported by the pre-flight check
    if cfg["literature"].get("master") and not cfg["data"]["metadata"].get("file"):
        cfg["data"]["metadata"]["file"] = cfg["literature"]["master"]   # the master holds the metadata too
    missing = []
    for keys in REQUIRED:
        node = cfg
        for k in keys:
            node = node.get(k) if isinstance(node, dict) else None
        if node in (None, "", {}):
            missing.append(".".join(keys))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Config {path} is missing: {', '.join(missing)}")
    d = cfg["data"]
    d["bank"]["file"] = _path(d["bank"]["file"])
    d["events"]["file"] = _path(d["events"]["file"])
    d["metadata"]["file"] = _path(d["metadata"]["file"])
    lit = cfg["literature"]
    for k in ("master", "workbook", "names"):
        if lit.get(k):
            lit[k] = _path(lit[k])
    from .master import apply as apply_master     # one master file for many targets: take this target's rows
    used = apply_master(cfg, os.path.join(_path(cfg["output_dir"]), cfg["run_name"], "inputs", "master"))
    if used:
        lit["target"] = used
    d["macro"]["scenarios"] = {k: _path(v) for k, v in d["macro"]["scenarios"].items()}
    if d["macro"]["base_scenario"] not in d["macro"]["scenarios"]:
        raise ValueError(f"base_scenario '{d['macro']['base_scenario']}' is not one of the scenarios")
    for label, f in [("bank", d["bank"]["file"]), ("metadata", d["metadata"]["file"])] + \
            [(f"scenario {k}", v) for k, v in d["macro"]["scenarios"].items()]:
        if not os.path.exists(f):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"{label} file not found: {f}")
    for k in ("hist_end", "estimation_start", "backtest_start"):
        cfg["sample"][k] = str(cfg["sample"][k])
    if cfg["sample"].get("backtest_end"):
        cfg["sample"]["backtest_end"] = str(cfg["sample"]["backtest_end"])
    for k in ("backtest_step", "reestimate_every", "reestimate_quarter"):
        cfg["sample"][k] = int(cfg["sample"][k])
    if not 1 <= cfg["sample"]["reestimate_quarter"] <= 4:
        raise ValueError("sample.reestimate_quarter must be 1, 2, 3 or 4")
    cfg["sample"]["dummy_quarters"] = [str(q) for q in cfg["sample"]["dummy_quarters"]]
    H = int(cfg["sample"]["horizon"])                      # the full horizon is always one of the comparison points
    cfg["sample"]["report_horizons"] = sorted({int(h) for h in cfg["sample"]["report_horizons"] if int(h) <= H} | {H})
    cfg["out_dir"] = os.path.join(_path(cfg["output_dir"]), cfg["run_name"])
    cfg["cache"]["dir"] = _path(cfg["cache"]["dir"])
    if cfg["literature"].get("workbook"):                  # the workbook replaces literature.models and .table
        cfg["literature"]["workbook"] = _path(cfg["literature"]["workbook"])
        if os.path.exists(cfg["literature"]["workbook"]):
            from ..models.literature import apply_settings, read_workbook
            wb = read_workbook(cfg["literature"]["workbook"], full=True)
            cfg["literature"]["models"] = wb["models"]
            cfg["literature"]["table"] = cfg["literature"]["workbook"]
            apply_settings(cfg, wb["settings"])
    if cfg["literature"].get("table"):
        cfg["literature"]["table"] = _path(cfg["literature"]["table"])
    if not cfg["oos"]["first_origin"]:                    # default: 3 years after the backtest start
        cfg["oos"]["first_origin"] = str(pd.Period(cfg["sample"]["backtest_start"], freq="Q") + 12)
    cfg["oos"]["first_origin"] = str(cfg["oos"]["first_origin"])
    if cfg["oos"]["window"] not in ("expanding", "rolling"):
        raise ValueError("oos.window must be 'expanding' or 'rolling'")
    for key, ap in (("factors", "factors_first"), ("stability", "stable_first")):   # new approaches, on by default
        if cfg[key].get("enabled", True) and ap not in cfg["approaches"]:
            cfg["approaches"] = list(cfg["approaches"]) + [ap]
        if not cfg[key].get("enabled", True):
            cfg["approaches"] = [a for a in cfg["approaches"] if a != ap]
    imp = cfg["impact"]                                    # the explanatory model is one more approach
    if imp.get("enabled", True) and "focus_first" not in cfg["approaches"]:
        cfg["approaches"] = list(cfg["approaches"]) + ["focus_first"]
    if not imp.get("enabled", True):
        cfg["approaches"] = [a for a in cfg["approaches"] if a != "focus_first"]
    cfg["config_file"] = os.path.abspath(path)
    return cfg

def ensure_packages():
    """Install missing required packages with pip (tries normal, --user and --break-system-packages)."""
    missing = [pip for mod, pip in REQUIRED.items() if importlib.util.find_spec(mod) is None]
    if not missing:
        return
    print(f"Installing missing packages {missing} into {sys.executable} ...", flush=True)
    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet"]
    for extra in ([], ["--user"], ["--user", "--break-system-packages"]):
        if subprocess.call(base + extra + missing) == 0:
            user_site = site.getusersitepackages()
            if user_site not in sys.path:
                sys.path.append(user_site)
            importlib.invalidate_caches()
            return
    sys.exit(f"Automatic install failed. Run in a terminal:\n  {sys.executable} -m pip install {' '.join(missing)}")

def read_table(path, sheet=None):
    """Read a CSV or Excel file.

    Args:
        path: file. sheet: Excel sheet name or index (None = first).

    Returns:
        DataFrame.
    """
    ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()
    if ext in (".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".xls"):
        return pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet if sheet is not None else 0)
    return pd.read_csv(path)

def to_quarters(values):
    """'2020Q1', '2020 Q1', '2020-03-31', datetime ... -> quarterly PeriodIndex.

    Args:
        values: dates or quarter labels.
    """
    s = pd.Series(values).astype(str).str.strip()
    if s.str.match(r"^\d{4}\s*[Qq]\d$").all():
        return pd.PeriodIndex(s.str.replace(" ", "").str.upper(), freq="Q")
    return pd.PeriodIndex(pd.to_datetime(s), freq="Q")

def _need(df, cols, label):
    """Raise a clear error if columns are missing from an input file.

    Args:
        df: table. cols: required columns. label: file description for the message.
    """
    miss = [c for c in cols if c not in df.columns]
    if miss:
        raise KeyError(f"{label}: column(s) {miss} not found. Available: {list(df.columns)[:15]} ...")

def load_bank(cfg):
    """Load the target as a quarterly series (monthly data: last month of each quarter).

    Args:
        cfg: configuration (data.bank, sample.hist_end).

    Returns:
        Series indexed by quarter.
    """
    b = cfg["data"]["bank"]
    df = read_table(b["file"], b["sheet"])
    _need(df, [b["date_column"], b["target_column"]], "bank file")
    s = pd.to_numeric(df[b["target_column"]], errors="coerce")
    s.index = to_quarters(df[b["date_column"]])
    s = s.groupby(level=0).last() if b["frequency"].upper() == "M" else s[~s.index.duplicated(keep="last")]
    return s.sort_index().loc[:pd.Period(cfg["sample"]["hist_end"], freq="Q")].dropna()

def organic_growth(cfg, level):
    """y_t = ln((L_t - A_t) / L_{t-1}) for a dlog target, (L_t - A_t) - L_{t-1} for a diff target;
    A_t = inorganic events in quarter t."""
    from . import target as tg
    y = tg.growth(level)
    e = cfg["data"]["events"]
    if e["file"] and os.path.exists(e["file"]):
        ev = read_table(e["file"], e["sheet"])
        _need(ev, [e["date_column"], e["series_column"], e["amount_column"]], "events file")
        ev = ev[ev[e["series_column"]].astype(str) == cfg["data"]["bank"]["target_column"]]
        for q, a in zip(to_quarters(ev[e["date_column"]]), ev[e["amount_column"]]):
            if q in level.index and q != level.index[0]:
                y.loc[q] = tg.change(level.loc[q] - float(a), level.shift(1).loc[q])
    return y

def load_macro(cfg):
    """Load every scenario file.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration (data.macro).

    Returns:
        dict scenario name -> DataFrame (quarters x mnemonics).
    """
    m = cfg["data"]["macro"]
    out = {}
    for name, f in m["scenarios"].items():
        df = read_table(f, m["sheet"])
        _need(df, [m["date_column"]], f"macro file '{name}'")
        idx = to_quarters(df[m["date_column"]])
        df = df.drop(columns=m["date_column"]).apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
        df.index = idx
        out[name] = df.sort_index()
    return out

def load_metadata(cfg):
    """Load the variable metadata (description, geography, theme, expected sign) and rename columns.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration (data.metadata).

    Returns:
        DataFrame indexed by mnemonic.
    """
    md = cfg["data"]["metadata"]
    df = read_table(md["file"], md["sheet"])
    cmap = md["columns"]
    _need(df, list(cmap.values()), "metadata file")
    df = df.rename(columns={v: k for k, v in cmap.items()})[list(cmap.keys())]
    df["mnemonic"] = df["mnemonic"].astype(str)
    df["expected_sign"] = pd.to_numeric(df["expected_sign"], errors="coerce").fillna(0).astype(int)
    df["transform"] = df["transform"].astype(str).str.lower().str.strip()
    for c in ("description", "geography", "theme"):
        df[c] = df[c].fillna("").astype(str)
    return df.set_index("mnemonic")

def add_constructed(cfg, macro, meta):
    """Build the variables listed under data.constructed in every scenario.

    Args:
        macro: dict scenario -> DataFrame (updated).
    """
    for c in cfg["data"].get("constructed") or []:
        try:
            for name in macro:
                env = {"log": np.log, "exp": np.exp}
                macro[name][c["name"]] = macro[name].eval(c["expression"], local_dict=env, engine="python")
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"  constructed variable {c.get('name')} skipped: {e}")
            continue
        meta.loc[c["name"]] = {"description": c.get("description", c["name"]), "geography": c.get("geography", ""),
                               "theme": c.get("theme", "Constructed"), "transform": c.get("transform", "diff"),
                               "expected_sign": int(c.get("expected_sign", 0))}
    return macro, meta

class Context:
    """Everything both approaches need: target, macro data, metadata, sample indices."""

    def __init__(self, cfg):
        """Load and align everything a run needs: target, organic growth, scenarios, metadata, literature
        table, dummies and the estimation window.

        Args:
            cfg: configuration from load_config.
        """
        self.cfg = cfg
        level = load_bank(cfg)
        self.level = level
        from . import target as tg
        tcfg = cfg.setdefault("target", {})
        tcfg["form"] = tg.resolve(tcfg.get("transform", "auto"), level)
        tg.set_form(tcfg["form"])
        self.target_form = tcfg["form"]
        self.y = organic_growth(cfg, level)
        # organic level in the space where changes add up: ln(L) for dlog targets, L for diff targets
        self.logL = tg.state(level.iloc[0]) + self.y.fillna(0).cumsum()
        self.macro = load_macro(cfg)
        self.meta = load_metadata(cfg)
        self.macro, self.meta = add_constructed(cfg, self.macro, self.meta)
        from ..models import literature as lit          # the literature table: names, signs, include flags
        self.lit_table = lit.load(cfg)
        if self.lit_table is not None and (cfg.get("literature") or {}).get("apply_signs_to_metadata", True):
            self.meta = lit.apply_signs(self.meta, self.lit_table, log)
        self.base = self.macro[cfg["data"]["macro"]["base_scenario"]]
        unknown = [c for c in self.base.columns if c not in self.meta.index]
        if unknown:
            log(f"  {len(unknown)} macro columns have no metadata row and are ignored (e.g. {unknown[:3]})")
        hist_end = pd.Period(cfg["sample"]["hist_end"], freq="Q")
        self.idx = self.y.index                      # history quarters
        self.hist = self.base.reindex(self.idx)
        self.est0 = int(np.where(self.idx == pd.Period(cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], freq="Q"))[0][0])
        self.end = int(np.where(self.idx == hist_end)[0][0]) if hist_end in self.idx else len(self.idx) - 1
        self.dummies = pd.DataFrame({f"D_{q}": (self.idx == pd.Period(q, freq="Q")).astype(float)
                                     for q in cfg["sample"]["dummy_quarters"]}, index=self.idx)
        from ..features import factors                  # theme factors: one index per theme (FAC.<THEME>)
        self.factor_table, self.factor_loadings = factors.attach(cfg, self, log)
        if len(self.factor_table):
            log(f"  theme factors: {len(self.factor_table)} ({', '.join(self.factor_table['mnemonic'])})")

src/features/factors.py

module src.features.factors · 12 items
Theme factors: one index per theme from all its series (targeted diffusion indexes).

With 200+ macro series, many measure the same thing (house prices in a dozen cities). Picking one of them is partly
luck, and the pick changes from quarter to quarter. A factor summarises a theme's series into one index:

1. Members: every series of the theme with full history in the estimation window, in one form by type: growth
   (log change) for levels, change for rates. Themes that are other outcomes of the economy (credit, deposits) are
   left out unless factors.exclude_outcomes is false.
2. Targeted (Bai & Ng 2008, "Forecasting economic time series using targeted predictors", Journal of
   Econometrics 146): only members that are related to the target are kept - |t| above factors.t_threshold when
   added (at their best lag, 0..max_lag) to  y_t = a + rho*y_{t-1} + b*x_{t-k} + dummies.
   If fewer than factors.min_members pass, the strongest min_members are used.
3. Principal component (Stock & Watson 2002, "Macroeconomic forecasting using diffusion indexes", Journal of
   Business & Economic Statistics 20): the members are standardised over the estimation window and the first
   principal component is the factor (factors.n_factors > 1 adds the next ones). Its sign is set so it rises when
   the member with the largest loading rises; its expected sign comes from the members' expected signs.

A factor is a series named FAC.<THEME> (FAC.<THEME>_2 for the second) added to every macro scenario, with a
metadata row, so every approach and model can use it like any other series. Its value is always recomputed from
its members with the fixed weights, means and standard deviations, so a shock to a member (what-if, scenarios)
moves the factor too. In the out-of-sample test the weights are re-estimated at every origin with data up to it.

Writes outputs/<run>/factors/: 1_factors.csv (one row per factor), 2_loadings.csv (one row per member).

def register(specs):
    """Store a set of factor definitions; returns its short key."""
    import hashlib
    import json
    key = hashlib.sha1(json.dumps(specs, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    REGISTRY[key] = specs
    return key

def settings(cfg):
    d = {"enabled": True, "targeted": True, "t_threshold": 1.65, "min_members": 3, "n_factors": 1,

def member_values(mdf, code, kind):
    x = mdf[code].astype(float)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        v = np.log(x).diff() if kind == "dlog" else x.diff()
    return v.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

def values(mdf, spec):
    """The factor on mdf's quarters, from its members (NaN where a member is missing)."""
    z = None
    for m in spec["members"]:
        if m["code"] not in mdf.columns:
            return pd.Series(np.nan, index=mdf.index)
        v = (member_values(mdf, m["code"], m["kind"]) - m["mean"]) / m["sd"] * m["weight"]
        z = v if z is None else z + v
    return z if z is not None else pd.Series(np.nan, index=mdf.index)

def _t_best_lag(ctx, x, max_lag):
    """Largest |t| (and its signed value and lag) of x at lags 0..max_lag added to y ~ const + y_lag1 + dummies."""
    rows = slice(ctx.est0, ctx.end + 1)
    y = ctx.y.iloc[rows].values
    W = [np.ones(len(y)), ctx.y.shift(1).iloc[rows].values]
    for c in ctx.dummies.columns:
        d = ctx.dummies[c].iloc[rows].values
        if d.std() > 0:
            W.append(d)
    W = np.column_stack(W)
    best = (0.0, 0.0, 0)
    for k in range(max_lag + 1):
        v = x.shift(k).reindex(ctx.idx).iloc[rows].values
        ok = np.isfinite(v) & np.isfinite(W).all(axis=1) & np.isfinite(y)
        if ok.sum() < 20 or np.std(v[ok]) == 0:
            continue
        X = np.column_stack([W[ok], v[ok]])
        try:
            b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y[ok], rcond=None)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            continue
        e = y[ok] - X @ b
        s2 = e @ e / max(ok.sum() - X.shape[1], 1)
        se = np.sqrt(max(np.linalg.pinv(X.T @ X)[-1, -1] * s2, 1e-30))
        t = b[-1] / se
        if abs(t) > abs(best[0]):
            best = (abs(t), t, k)
    return best

def build(cfg, ctx, log=print):
    """Factor definitions from the data up to ctx.end.

    Returns:
        (specs dict, metadata rows DataFrame, loadings DataFrame).
    """
    st = settings(cfg)
    meta, hist = ctx.meta, ctx.base.reindex(ctx.idx)
    blocked = set()
    if st["exclude_outcomes"]:
        from ..selection.double_selection import outcome_themes
        blocked = outcome_themes(cfg, ctx)
    excluded = set((cfg.get("features") or {}).get("excluded_themes") or [])
    max_lag = int(cfg["features"]["max_lag"])
    win = slice(ctx.est0, ctx.end + 1)
    specs, mrows, lrows = {}, [], []
    geos = (cfg.get("features") or {}).get("allowed_geographies") or []
    codes = [c for c in hist.columns if c in meta.index and not str(c).startswith("FAC.")
             and (not geos or any(str(meta.loc[c, "geography"]).startswith(g) for g in geos))]
    for theme, grp in meta.loc[codes].groupby("theme"):
        if theme in blocked or theme in excluded or not str(theme).strip():
            continue
        try:
            _theme(ctx, st, meta, hist, win, max_lag, theme, grp, specs, mrows, lrows)
        except Exception as ex:                       # one theme's numerical trouble never stops the run
            log(f"  theme factor for '{theme}' skipped ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex})")
    return specs, pd.DataFrame(mrows), pd.DataFrame(lrows)

def _theme(ctx, st, meta, hist, win, max_lag, theme, grp, specs, mrows, lrows):
    """Build the factor(s) of one theme into specs / mrows / lrows."""
    cand = []
    for code in grp.index:
        kind = member_kind(meta, hist, code)
        v = member_values(hist, code, kind)
        w = v.iloc[win]
        if w.isna().any() or not np.isfinite(w.values).all() or w.std() == 0 or len(w) < 20:
            continue
        at, t, k = _t_best_lag(ctx, v, max_lag) if st["targeted"] else (1.0, 1.0, 0)
        cand.append({"code": code, "kind": kind, "abs_t": at, "t": t, "lag": k, "mean": float(w.mean()),
                     "sd": float(w.std()), "expected_sign": int(np.sign(meta.loc[code, "expected_sign"] or 0))})
    if len(cand) < st["min_members"]:
        return
    cand.sort(key=lambda r: -r["abs_t"])
    keep = [r for r in cand if r["abs_t"] >= st["t_threshold"]] if st["targeted"] else cand
    how = "targeted" if st["targeted"] else "all members"
    if len(keep) < st["min_members"]:
        keep, how = cand[:st["min_members"]], f"the {st['min_members']} strongest (too few above the threshold)"
    Z = np.column_stack([((member_values(hist, r["code"], r["kind"]).iloc[win] - r["mean"]) / r["sd"]).values
                         for r in keep])
    if not np.isfinite(Z).all():
        return
    U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Z - Z.mean(axis=0), full_matrices=False)
    share = S ** 2 / np.sum(S ** 2)
    for j in range(min(int(st["n_factors"]), len(keep) - 1 if len(keep) > 1 else 1)):
        if j > 0 and share[j] < float(st["min_share"] or 0):
            break
        w = Vt[j].copy()
        if w[np.argmax(np.abs(w))] < 0:                # rises when its main member rises
            w = -w
        code = f"FAC.{slug(theme)}" + ("" if j == 0 else f"_{j + 1}")
        es = sum(wi * r["expected_sign"] for wi, r in zip(w, keep))
        tot = sum(abs(wi) for wi, r in zip(w, keep) if r["expected_sign"])
        sign = int(np.sign(es)) if tot and abs(es) >= 0.5 * tot else 0
        members = [{"code": r["code"], "kind": r["kind"], "mean": r["mean"], "sd": r["sd"], "weight": float(wi)}
                   for wi, r in zip(w, keep)]
        specs[code] = {"theme": theme, "members": members, "share": float(share[j]), "how": how}
        top = sorted(zip(w, keep), key=lambda p: -abs(p[0]))[:3]
        lead = ", ".join(str(meta.loc[r["code"], "description"])[:40] if "description" in meta.columns
                         else r["code"] for _, r in top)
        mrows.append({"mnemonic": code, "description": f"{theme} index ({len(keep)} series"
                                                       + (")" if j == 0 else f", component {j + 1})"),
                      "main_series": lead,
                      "theme": theme, "geography": "All", "transform": "factor", "expected_sign": sign,
                      "members": len(keep), "of": len(cand), "variance_share": float(share[j]), "how": how})
        for wi, r in zip(w, keep):
            lrows.append({"factor": code, "theme": theme, "member": r["code"],
                          "description": meta.loc[r["code"], "description"] if "description" in meta.columns
                          else r["code"], "form": "growth" if r["kind"] == "dlog" else "change",
                          "loading": float(wi), "t_alone": r["t"], "best_lag": r["lag"],
                          "expected_sign": r["expected_sign"]})

def attach(cfg, ctx, log=print):
    """Build the factors on ctx's window and add them to ctx (scenarios, base, history, metadata); activate them.

    Returns:
        (metadata rows, loadings) for reporting.
    """
    if not settings(cfg)["enabled"]:
        activate({})
        ctx.factor_specs = {}
        return pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame()
    try:
        specs, mrows, lrows = build(cfg, ctx, log)
    except Exception as ex:
        log(f"  theme factors skipped ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex})")
        specs, mrows, lrows = {}, pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame()
    activate(specs)
    ctx.factor_specs = specs
    drop = [c for c in ctx.base.columns if str(c).startswith("FAC.")]
    key = register(specs)
    macro = {}
    for k, df in ctx.macro.items():
        df = df.drop(columns=drop, errors="ignore").copy()
        for code, sp in specs.items():
            df[code] = values(df, sp)
        df.attrs = {k: v for k, v in df.attrs.items() if k != "factor_specs"}
        df.attrs["factor_key"] = key            # travels with the frame (copies, slices, reindex)
        macro[k] = df
    ctx.macro = macro
    ctx.base = macro[cfg["data"]["macro"]["base_scenario"]]
    ctx.hist = ctx.base.reindex(ctx.idx)
    meta = ctx.meta.drop(index=[i for i in ctx.meta.index if str(i).startswith("FAC.")], errors="ignore")
    if len(mrows):
        add = mrows.set_index("mnemonic")[["description", "theme", "geography", "transform", "expected_sign"]]
        for c in meta.columns:
            if c not in add.columns:
                add[c] = "" if meta[c].dtype == object else np.nan
        meta = pd.concat([meta, add[meta.columns]])
    ctx.meta = meta
    return mrows, lrows

    w = window(tr)

def transform(mdf, code, tr, deflator=None):
    """Apply one stationary transform to one macro series.

    Args:
        mdf: macro DataFrame (quarters x macro mnemonics).
        code: mnemonic of the series, e.g. "FHPI.ION".
        tr: transform code: diff, diff2, diff4, lvl, rgap, dlog, yoy, dlog2, acc, gap, rdlog (real growth).
        deflator: mnemonic of the price index, used by the real transforms.

    Returns:
        Series on the same quarterly index (NaN where the transform needs more history).
    """
    if str(code).startswith("FAC."):                  # theme factor: always rebuilt from its members
        from . import factors
        sp = factors.spec_for(mdf, code)
        x = factors.values(mdf, sp) if sp else mdf[code]
    else:
        x = mdf[code]
    w = window(tr)
    if w:
        rate, kind, k = w
        g = x.diff() if rate else np.log(x).diff()
        return g.rolling(k, min_periods=k).mean() if kind == "ma" else g.rolling(k, min_periods=k).std()
    if tr == "diff":
        return x.diff()
    if tr == "diff2":
        return x.diff(2)
    if tr == "diff4":
        return x.diff(4)
    if tr == "lvl":
        return x
    if tr == "rgap":
        return x - x.rolling(12, min_periods=12).mean()
    lx = np.log(x)
    if tr == "dlog":
        return lx.diff()
    if tr == "yoy":
        return lx.diff(4)
    if tr == "dlog2":
        return lx.diff(2)
    if tr == "acc":
        return lx.diff(4) - lx.diff(4).shift(4)
    if tr == "gap":
        return lx - lx.rolling(12, min_periods=12).mean()
    if tr in ("rdlog", "ryoy"):
        k = 1 if tr == "rdlog" else 4
        return lx.diff(k) - np.log(mdf[deflator]).diff(k)
    raise ValueError(f"unknown transform {tr}")

def parse_feature(name):
    """Split a feature name into its parts (inverse of feature_name).

    Args:
        name: "code|transform|Llag".

    Returns:
        (code, transform, lag) with lag as int.
    """
    code, tr, lag = name.rsplit("|", 2)
    return code, tr, int(lag[1:])

def feature_series(mdf, name, deflator=None):
    """Compute one feature: transform the series, then lag it.

    Args:
        mdf: macro DataFrame. name: feature name. deflator: price index mnemonic for real transforms.

    Returns:
        Series indexed by quarter.
    """
    code, tr, lag = parse_feature(name)
    s = transform(mdf, code, tr, deflator)
    # log of a zero or negative value gives -inf/inf: treat it as missing so every later check sees it
    return s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).shift(lag)

def feature_matrix(mdf, names, deflator=None):
    """Compute several features side by side.

    Args:
        mdf: macro DataFrame (history or a scenario). names: list of feature names. deflator: see transform.

    Returns:
        DataFrame, one column per feature, on mdf's index.
    """
    return pd.DataFrame({n: feature_series(mdf, n, deflator) for n in names}, index=mdf.index)

def describe(name, meta):
    """Plain-language label of a feature for tables and charts.

    Args:
        name: feature name. meta: metadata table indexed by mnemonic (column "description").

    Returns:
        str, e.g. "House prices, Ontario (quarterly log change, lag 1Q)".
    """
    code, tr, lag = parse_feature(name)
    d = meta.loc[code, "description"] if code in meta.index else code
    if str(code).startswith("FAC.") and tr == "lvl":
        return f"{d} ({'same quarter' if lag == 0 else f'lag {lag}Q'})"
    return f"{d} ({tr_desc(tr)}, {'same quarter' if lag == 0 else f'lag {lag}Q'})"

def candidate_forms(cfg, hist, meta):
    """Relevance filter + every transformation of every variable + ADF test. One row per (variable, transform).

    Args:
        hist: macro history (DataFrame).
    """
    f = cfg["features"]
    configure(cfg)
    rows = []
    for code in hist.columns:
        if code not in meta.index:
            continue
        geo, theme = meta.loc[code, "geography"], meta.loc[code, "theme"]
        is_factor = meta.loc[code, "transform"] == "factor"       # members already filtered by geography
        if f["allowed_geographies"] and not is_factor and not any(str(geo).startswith(g) for g in f["allowed_geographies"]):
            continue
        if theme in (f["excluded_themes"] or []):
            continue
        if f["require_sign_prior"] and meta.loc[code, "expected_sign"] == 0:
            continue
        x = hist[code].dropna()
        is_level = meta.loc[code, "transform"] == "dlog" and len(x) and (x > 0).all()
        if meta.loc[code, "transform"] == "factor":          # theme factors are already growth/change indexes
            trs = ["lvl"]
        elif f.get("form_rule", "all") == "by_type":          # one form per variable: growth or change
            trs = ["dlog"] if is_level else ["diff"]
        else:
            trs = list(f["transforms_level"]) if is_level else list(f["transforms_rate"])
        # moving windows: features.moving_average / features.volatility = lists of windows, e.g. [8] and [4, 8]
        pre = "" if is_level else "d"
        trs += [f"{pre}ma{k}" for k in (f.get("moving_average") or [])]
        trs += [f"{pre}vol{k}" for k in (f.get("volatility") or [])]
        if meta.loc[code, "transform"] == "factor":
            trs = ["lvl"]
        elif is_level and theme in (f["real_themes"] or []) and f["deflator"] in hist.columns:
            trs += ["rdlog"] if f.get("form_rule", "all") == "by_type" else ["rdlog", "ryoy"]
        for tr in trs:
            s = transform(hist, code, tr, f["deflator"]).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
            try:
                p = adfuller(s, autolag="AIC")[1] if (len(s) >= 30 and s.std() > 0) else 1.0
            except Exception:
                p = 1.0
            rows.append({"mnemonic": code, "transform": tr, "adf_p": p, "stationary": p < f["adf_p"],
                         "theme": theme, "geography": geo, "expected_sign": sign_of(meta, code, tr)})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def all_features(cfg, ctx, forms):
    """All stationary (variable, transform) pairs at every lag, with no gaps in the estimation window."""
    lags = cfg["features"].get("lags") or range(cfg["features"]["max_lag"] + 1)    # features.lags: e.g. [0, 1, 4]
    names = [feature_name(r.mnemonic, r.transform, int(l)) for r in forms[forms["stationary"]].itertuples()
             for l in lags]
    F = feature_matrix(ctx.hist, names, cfg["features"]["deflator"])
    window = F.iloc[ctx.est0:ctx.end + 1]
    keep = window.columns[window.notna().all() & (window.std() > 0)]
    return F[keep]

def run(cfg, ctx, F, forms):
    """Bayesian first approach: BMA inclusion probabilities -> group correlated picks -> exhaustive search with the
    same rules as the other approaches.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration. ctx: Context. F: all candidate features. forms: transforms per series.

    Returns:
        dict with the final features, the search table, the BMA tables (written to bayes_first/) and the
        averaged models.
    """
    b = cfg["bayes_first"]
    log(f"[bayes_first] Bayesian model averaging (MC3, {b['iterations']} draws) ...")
    r = bma_select(cfg, ctx, F)
    inc = r["inclusion"]
    m = r["meta"].iloc[0]
    log(f"[bayes_first] {int(m['candidates'])} candidates, {int(m['models_visited'])} models visited, "
        f"posterior mean size {m['posterior_mean_model_size']:.1f}")
    sel = inc[inc["inclusion_probability"] >= b["threshold"]].copy()
    if len(sel) < 2:
        log(f"[bayes_first] fewer than 2 drivers with probability >= {b['threshold']} - using the 3 most probable")
        sel = inc.head(3).copy()
    sel["score"] = sel["inclusion_probability"]
    Fs = F[sel["feature"]].iloc[ctx.est0:ctx.end + 1]
    sel["cluster"] = cluster(Fs, b["group_corr"]).reindex(sel["feature"]).values
    grp = representatives(sel.set_index("feature", drop=False), "score", b["primary_geography"], b["rep_tolerance"])
    cands = grp[grp["is_representative"]].sort_values("score", ascending=False)
    log(f"[bayes_first] {len(sel)} probable drivers -> {len(cands)} groups; searching ...")
    R, chosen = exhaustive_search(cfg, ctx, F[cands["feature"]], cands.reset_index(drop=True).set_index("feature"),
                                  "bayes_first")
    log(f"[bayes_first] chosen: {chosen}")
    tables = {"C1_bma_settings": r["meta"], "C2_bma_inclusion": inc, "C3_bma_top_models": r["top_models"],
              "C4_groups": grp.reset_index(drop=True), "C5_search": R,
              "C6_search_rules": pd.DataFrame(list(R.attrs.get("rules", {}).items()), columns=["step", "combinations"])}
    funnel = [("Candidate variables", forms["mnemonic"].nunique()),
              ("Features (forms x lags)", F.shape[1]),
              ("Candidates in the BMA (one per variable)", int(m["candidates"])),
              (f"Inclusion probability >= {b['threshold']}", int((inc["inclusion_probability"] >= b["threshold"]).sum())),
              ("Groups after correlation check", len(cands)), ("Final drivers", len(chosen))]
    return {"name": "Bayesian first", "features": chosen, "tables": tables, "funnel": funnel,
            "bma_models": r["models"]}

def run(cfg, ctx, F, forms):
    """Elastic Net first approach: Elastic Net (glmnet-style) -> stability selection -> group correlated
    picks -> exhaustive search with the same rules as screen first.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration. ctx: Context. F: all candidate features (DataFrame). forms: transforms per series.

    Returns:
        dict with the final features, the search table and every intermediate table (written to en_first/).
    """
    e = cfg["en_first"]
    log(f"[en_first] Elastic Net on {F.shape[1]} features (target {e['target_n']}) ...")
    full = elastic_net_select(cfg, ctx, F)
    log(f"[en_first] full-sample selection: {list(full['feature'])}")
    tables = {"B1_en_full_sample": full}
    if e["stability"]["enabled"]:
        log(f"[en_first] stability selection on {e['stability']['n_subsamples']} subsamples ...")
        freq = stability_selection(cfg, ctx, F)
        tables["B2_en_stability"] = freq
        sel = freq[freq["selection_frequency"] >= e["stability"]["threshold"]].copy()
        if len(sel) < 2:
            log("[en_first] fewer than 2 features above the stability threshold - using the most frequent ones")
            sel = freq.head(max(3, e["target_n"] // 2)).copy()
        sel["score"] = sel["selection_frequency"]
    else:
        sel = full.copy()
        sel["score"] = sel["std_coef"].abs()
    sel["mnemonic"] = sel["feature"].map(lambda f: parse_feature(f)[0])
    sel["theme"] = sel["mnemonic"].map(ctx.meta["theme"])
    sel["geography"] = sel["mnemonic"].map(ctx.meta["geography"])
    sel["expected_sign"] = [int(feature_sign(ctx.meta, f)) for f in sel["feature"]]
    sel["description"] = sel["mnemonic"].map(ctx.meta["description"])
    Fs = F[sel["feature"]].iloc[ctx.est0:ctx.end + 1]
    sel["cluster"] = cluster(Fs, e["group_corr"]).reindex(sel["feature"]).values
    grp = representatives(sel.set_index("feature", drop=False), "score", e["primary_geography"], e["rep_tolerance"])
    cands = grp[grp["is_representative"]].sort_values("score", ascending=False)
    tables["B3_groups"] = grp.reset_index(drop=True)
    log(f"[en_first] {len(sel)} selected -> {len(cands)} groups; searching ...")
    R, chosen = exhaustive_search(cfg, ctx, F[cands["feature"]], cands.reset_index(drop=True).set_index("feature"), "en_first")
    tables["B4_search"] = R
    tables["B5_search_rules"] = pd.DataFrame(list(R.attrs.get("rules", {}).items()), columns=["step", "combinations"])
    log(f"[en_first] chosen: {chosen}")
    funnel = [("Candidate variables", forms["mnemonic"].nunique()),
              ("Features into the Elastic Net", F.shape[1]),
              ("Selected by Elastic Net" + (" (stable)" if e["stability"]["enabled"] else ""), len(sel)),
              ("Groups after correlation check", len(cands)), ("Final drivers", len(chosen))]
    return {"name": "Elastic Net first", "features": chosen, "tables": tables, "funnel": funnel}

Approach E - 'Factors first': the model is built from the theme factors (src/features/factors.py) only.

Every series takes part through its theme's index, so the drivers are stable concepts ("the housing index", "the labour-market index") rather than one of many near-identical series. Each factor gets its best lag; the subset of up to factors.max_vars factors with the lowest BIC and the expected signs is the model.

def run(cfg, ctx, F, forms):
    """Theme factors -> best lag each -> lowest-BIC subset with the expected signs.

    Returns:
        dict with the features and the tables written to factors_first/.
    """
    st = cfg.get("factors") or {}
    facs = sorted({c.split("|")[0] for c in F.columns if c.startswith("FAC.")})
    if not facs:
        log("[factors_first] no theme factors in this run (factors.enabled: false, or too few series per theme)")
        return {"name": "Factors first", "features": [], "tables": {}, "funnel": []}
    bf = best_forms(ctx, F, facs, float(st.get("t_min", 1.0)))
    best, T = subset_search(ctx, F, [f for f, _ in bf.values()], int(st.get("max_vars", 4)))
    log(f"[factors_first] {len(facs)} factors, {len(bf)} with a usable lag; chosen: {best}")
    ft = getattr(ctx, "factor_table", pd.DataFrame())
    tables = {"E1_factors": ft, "E2_loadings": getattr(ctx, "factor_loadings", pd.DataFrame()),
              "E3_best_lag": pd.DataFrame([{"factor": k, "feature": f, "t": t} for k, (f, t) in bf.items()]),
              "E4_search": T}
    funnel = [("Series in the factors", int(ft["members"].sum()) if len(ft) else 0), ("Theme factors", len(facs)),
              ("Factors with a usable lag", len(bf)), ("Chosen", len(best))]
    return {"name": "Factors first", "features": best, "tables": tables, "funnel": funnel}

Approach D - 'Focus first' (the explanatory model): the drivers whose effect the user wants to know (impact.focus) are always in; the controls around them are chosen by double selection (src/selection/double_selection.py).
