def driver_table(ctx, model, P=None):
    """How each driver enters the model, for the driver tables.

    ARDL: coefficient, Newey-West t-statistic, expected sign and long-run multiplier; ML: importance or
    standardised coefficient; combinations: member weights.

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: an estimated model.

    Returns:
        DataFrame, one row per term.
    """
    rows = _driver_rows(ctx, model, P)
    D = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if P is not None:                                            # scenario effect of each driver, for every model
        sens = driver_sensitivity(ctx, model, P)
        if sens:
            if "term" not in D:
                D["term"] = None
            for f in sens:
                if f not in set(D["term"]):
                    D = pd.concat([D, pd.DataFrame([{"model": model.name, "term": f, "reading": ""}])], ignore_index=True)
            D["growth_effect_pp_per_year"] = D["term"].map(lambda t: sens.get(t, (np.nan, np.nan))[0])
            D["balance_effect_pct_8q"] = D["term"].map(lambda t: sens.get(t, (np.nan, np.nan))[1])
            D["description"] = D.get("description", pd.Series(index=D.index, dtype=object))
            D["description"] = [d if isinstance(d, str) and d else _describe_term(t, ctx.meta)
                                for d, t in zip(D["description"], D["term"])]
    return D

def _expected_sign(ctx, model, f):
    """Expected sign of a driver: the model's own (literature workbook, sheet models) or the metadata's.

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: the model. f: feature name.

    Returns:
        -1, 0 or 1.
    """
    s_ = (getattr(model, "signs", None) or {}).get(f)
    if s_ is not None:
        return int(s_)
    from ..features.transforms import feature_sign
    try:
        return int(feature_sign(ctx.meta, f))
    except ValueError:                      # not a feature name (e.g. a long-run term)
        return int(ctx.meta.loc[f, "expected_sign"]) if f in ctx.meta.index else 0

def _describe_term(t, meta):
    """Plain description of a driver-table term when it is a feature name; None for other terms (regime labels,
    member models, "long run: ...").

    Args:
        t: term. meta: variable metadata.

    Returns:
        str or None.
    """
    if not isinstance(t, str) or t.count("|") != 2 or " " in t:
        return None
    try:
        return describe(t, meta)
    except Exception:
        return None

def _driver_rows(ctx, model, P):
    """Rows of the driver table before the scenario-effect columns: coefficients, importances or weights.

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: an estimated model. P: its panel (or None).

    Returns:
        list of dict rows.
    """
    rows = []
    if hasattr(model, "driver_rows"):                            # regime-switching models describe themselves
        return list(model.driver_rows())
    if hasattr(model, "detail_rows") and P is not None:          # ARIMAX, Theta, deep learning
        return list(model.detail_rows(ctx, P))
    if not isinstance(model, ARDL):
        if hasattr(model, "importance") and model.importance() is not None:
            imp = model.importance()
            for c, v in imp.items():
                if str(c).startswith("D_"):
                    continue
                rows.append({"model": model.name, "term": c, "coef": v,
                             "reading": ("importance in the trees" if model.kind != "ridge" else "standardised ridge coefficient")})
        elif getattr(model, "weights", None) is not None:
            for m, w in zip(model.members, model.weights):
                rows.append({"model": model.name, "term": m.name, "coef": w,
                             "reading": f"weight {w:.0%}; drivers {', '.join(m.drivers()) or '(none)'}"})
        else:
            rows.append({"model": model.name, "term": ", ".join(model.drivers()), "reading": model.note or ""})
        return rows
    r = model.res
    rho = sum(v for k, v in r.params.items() if str(k).startswith("y_lag"))
    for c in r.params.index:
        if c == "const" or c.startswith("D_"):
            continue
        b = r.params[c]
        row = {"model": model.name, "term": c, "coef": b, "se_hac": r.bse[c], "t": r.tvalues[c], "p": r.pvalues[c]}
        if c.count("|") == 2 and not hasattr(model, "bases"):   # auto-ARDL: judged on the long-run effect below
            es = _expected_sign(ctx, model, c)
            row["expected_sign"] = es
            row["sign_ok"] = "no rule" if es == 0 else ("yes" if np.sign(b) == es else "no")
        if c.startswith("y_lag"):
            k_ = int(c[5:])
            row.update(description=f"Target {'growth' if tg.is_log() else 'change'} {k_} quarter{'s' if k_ > 1 else ''} earlier (momentum)",
                       reading=f"{b:.2f} of the growth {k_} quarter{'s' if k_ > 1 else ''} earlier carries into this quarter")
        elif c == "ect_lag1":
            row.update(description="Gap between the target and its long-run level, last quarter",
                       reading=f"{abs(b):.1%} of the gap to the long-run level closes each quarter" if b < 0
                       else "no pull back to the long-run level (wrong sign)")
        else:
            code, tr, lag = parse_feature(c)
            per_unit = b * (1 if is_rate_tr(tr) else 0.01) * (100 if tg.is_log() else 1)
            unit = "1 pp" if is_rate_tr(tr) else "1%"
            when = "in the same quarter" if lag == 0 else f"{lag} quarter{'s' if lag > 1 else ''} later"
            lr = f"; long-run effect {abs(per_unit) / (1 - rho):.3f} {'pp' if tg.is_log() else 'units'}" if rho < 1 else ""
            row.update(description=describe(c, ctx.meta),
                       reading=(f"A {unit} rise in {ctx.meta.loc[code, 'description']} [{tr_desc(tr)}] "
                                f"{'raises' if b > 0 else 'lowers'} the q/q {'growth' if tg.is_log() else 'change'} "
                                f"of the target by {abs(per_unit):.3f} {'pp' if tg.is_log() else 'units'} {when}{lr}"))
        rows.append(row)
    if hasattr(model, "bases"):                                 # auto-ARDL: lag orders and long-run effects
        rows.append({"model": model.name, "term": "lag orders", "reading": model.lag_summary()
                     + f"; {model.selection['models_tried'] if model.selection else '?'} combinations compared"})
        for b_, v in model.long_run().items():
            code, tr = b_.split("|")
            es = _expected_sign(ctx, model, f"{b_}|L0")
            rows.append({"model": model.name, "term": f"long run: {b_}", "coef": v, "expected_sign": es,
                         "sign_ok": "no rule" if es == 0 else ("yes" if np.sign(v) == es else "no"),
                         "reading": "sum of its lag coefficients / (1 - sum of the growth lags): the total effect "
                                    "once the dynamics have played out"})
    if getattr(model, "beta", None) is not None and hasattr(model, "lr_names"):    # ECM: the long-run relation
        rows.append({"model": model.name, "term": "long run: constant", "coef": float(model.beta[0]),
                     "reading": "long-run relation of the real target level (Engle-Granger step 1)"})
        for n, b in zip(model.lr_names, model.beta[1:]):
            rows.append({"model": model.name, "term": f"long run: {n[3:]}", "coef": float(b),
                         "reading": f"a 1% higher {n[3:].split(':')[0]} goes with a {b:.2f}% higher real target level in the long run"
                         if n.endswith(("log", "log_real")) else "long-run coefficient"})
    return rows

def scenario_forecasts(ctx, model):
    """Forecast every scenario with the model estimated on all history.

    Args:
        ctx: Context (ctx.macro holds the scenarios). model: any model.

    Returns:
        long DataFrame: model, family, scenario, date, dlog_forecast, balance_forecast.
    """
    start = pd.Period(ctx.cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], freq="Q")
    last = ctx.level.iloc[-1]
    out = []
    for name, mdf in ctx.macro.items():
        P = model.panel(ctx, mdf)
        model.fit(P, start, ctx.idx[ctx.end])
        fc = model.forecast(P, ctx.idx[ctx.end], len(P))
        dates = P.index[P.index.get_loc(ctx.idx[ctx.end]) + 1:][:len(fc)]
        lvl = tg.path(last, fc)
        out += [{"model": model.name, "family": model.family, "scenario": name, "date": str(d), "dlog_forecast": f,
                 "balance_forecast": l} for d, f, l in zip(dates, fc, lvl)]
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

def evaluate(ctx, model):
    """Everything the comparison needs for one model: backtest, diagnostics, drivers, scenarios.

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: any model following the model interface.

    Returns:
        dict with by_horizon, coef_path, diagnostics, drivers and scenarios (DataFrames / dict).
    """
    save = ctx.cfg.get("save") or {}
    P = model.panel(ctx, ctx.base)
    keep, at_origin = [], ({} if save.get("origin_models", True) else None)
    by_h, coef_path = backtest(ctx, model, P, keep, at_origin)
    tests = keep[0]
    diag = diagnostics(ctx, model, P)                          # also estimates the model on all history
    fv = fitted_values(ctx, model, P) if save.get("fitted_values", True) else None
    coefs, stats_ = coefficient_table(model)
    drivers = driver_table(ctx, model, P)
    scen = scenario_forecasts(ctx, model)
    out = {"by_horizon": by_h, "coef_path": coef_path, "diagnostics": diag, "drivers": drivers, "scenarios": scen,
           "test_forecasts": tests, "fitted_values": fv, "coefficients": coefs, "fit_statistics": stats_,
           "origin_models": at_origin, "panel": P if save.get("panels", True) else None}
    if hasattr(model, "regime_path"):                         # regime-switching models: regime over history
        out["regimes"] = regime_history(ctx, model, P)
    out["fitted"] = freeze(ctx, model)                         # the model estimated on all history, for reuse
    return out

def fitted_values(ctx, model, P):
    """In-sample one-step-ahead fit of a model estimated on all history, for every quarter of the estimation window.

    Uses only the model interface (forecast one quarter from each quarter t-1 with the actual data), so it works
    for every model type; for a regression it equals X·b.

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: model already estimated on all history. P: its panel.

    Returns:
        DataFrame: model, family, date, actual, fitted, residual (the target's change in the model's form) and
        the level implied by the fitted change from the previous actual level; None if the model cannot do it.
    """
    Ph = P.loc[:ctx.idx[ctx.end]]
    prm = getattr(model, "params", None)
    prm = prm if isinstance(prm, pd.Series) else pd.Series(dtype=float)
    rows, failed = [], 0
    for t in range(ctx.est0 + 1, ctx.end + 1):
        q = str(ctx.idx[t])
        try:                                         # a quarter the model cannot start from (e.g. too little
            f = float(np.asarray(model.forecast(Ph, ctx.idx[t - 1], 1))[0])   # history for a filter) is left empty
        except Exception:
            failed += 1
            f = np.nan
        d = float(prm.get(f"D_{q}", 0.0))               # forecasts set one-off dummies to 0: add their effect back
        a = float(ctx.y.iloc[t])
        prev = float(ctx.level.iloc[t - 1])
        rows.append({"model": model.name, "family": model.family, "date": q, "actual": a,
                     "fitted": f + d, "residual": a - f - d, "dummy_quarter": f"D_{q}" in ctx.dummies,
                     "level_actual": float(ctx.level.iloc[t]), "level_fitted": float(tg.level_after(prev, f + d))})
    if not rows or failed == len(rows):
        return None
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def _coefficient_table(model):
    """coefficient_table() without the safety net."""
    r = getattr(model, "res", None)
    params = getattr(model, "params", None)
    if r is not None and hasattr(r, "params"):
        rp = r.params
        if not isinstance(rp, pd.Series):          # numpy results: names from the model or the design
            names = (list(params.index) if isinstance(params, pd.Series) and len(params) == len(np.ravel(rp))
                     else list(getattr(getattr(r, "model", None), "exog_names", None) or range(len(np.ravel(rp)))))
            rp = pd.Series(np.ravel(np.asarray(rp, float)), index=names[:len(np.ravel(rp))])

        def get(a):
            try:
                v = getattr(r, a, None)
            except Exception:
                return None
            if v is None:
                return None
            v = np.ravel(np.asarray(v, float))
            return pd.Series(v, index=rp.index) if len(v) == len(rp) else None
        b, se, t, pv = rp, get("bse"), get("tvalues"), get("pvalues")
        T = pd.DataFrame({"model": model.name, "family": model.family, "term": b.index, "coef": b.values,
                          "std_err": se.values if se is not None else np.nan, "t": t.values if t is not None else np.nan,
                          "p_value": pv.values if pv is not None else np.nan})
        st = {"model": model.name, "family": model.family, "n_obs": float(getattr(r, "nobs", np.nan))}
        for k in ("rsquared", "rsquared_adj", "aic", "bic", "llf", "ssr"):
            v = getattr(r, k, None)
            if v is not None:
                try:
                    st[k] = float(v)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        st["cov_type"] = str(getattr(r, "cov_type", ""))
        st["residual_std"] = float(np.std(np.asarray(r.resid), ddof=1)) if hasattr(r, "resid") else np.nan
        if getattr(model, "beta", None) is not None and getattr(model, "long_run", None):   # ECM long run
            names = ["long run: constant"] + [f"long run: {i['mnemonic']}" for i in model.long_run]
            T = pd.concat([T, pd.DataFrame({"model": model.name, "family": model.family, "term": names,
                                            "coef": np.asarray(model.beta, float)[:len(names)]})], ignore_index=True)
        return T, st
    if isinstance(params, pd.Series) and len(params):
        return pd.DataFrame({"model": model.name, "family": model.family, "term": params.index,
                             "coef": params.values.astype(float)}), {"model": model.name, "family": model.family}
    w = getattr(model, "weights", None)
    if w is not None and getattr(model, "members", None):
        return pd.DataFrame({"model": model.name, "family": model.family,
                             "term": [f"weight: {m.name}" for m in model.members], "coef": np.asarray(w, float)}), \
            {"model": model.name, "family": model.family}
    return None, {"model": model.name, "family": model.family,
                  "note": "no coefficients (machine-learning, deep or pretrained model): see models.pkl"}

def freeze(ctx, model, max_mb=200):
    """The model as estimated on all history (call after scenario_forecasts), as pickle bytes; None if it cannot
    be pickled or is too large.

    Pretrained foundation models are not stored (they are downloaded again when needed).

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: any model. max_mb: size limit.

    Returns:
        bytes or None.
    """
    import pickle
    if getattr(model, "no_pickle", False) or type(model).__name__ == "FoundationModel":
        return None
    try:                       # evaluate() has just estimated it on all history (scenario forecasts)
        b = pickle.dumps(model)
        return b if len(b) <= max_mb * 1e6 else None
    except Exception:
        return None

def regime_history(ctx, model, P):
    """The regime indicator of a regime-switching model over history, estimated on all data.

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: a model with regime_path(). P: its panel on the history.

    Returns:
        DataFrame: model, family, date, value, meaning.
    """
    start = pd.Period(ctx.cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], freq="Q")
    model.fit(P, start, ctx.idx[ctx.end])
    r = model.regime_path(P).loc[:ctx.idx[ctx.end]].dropna()
    return pd.DataFrame({"model": model.name, "family": model.family, "date": r.index.astype(str), "value": r.values,
                         "meaning": getattr(model, "regime_label", "")})

def backtest_origins(ctx):
    """Forecast origins: from sample.backtest_start to sample.backtest_end (default: the last quarter that
    still has an actual to compare with), every sample.backtest_step quarters."""
    s = ctx.cfg["sample"]
    start = pd.Period(s["backtest_start"], freq="Q")
    end = pd.Period(s["backtest_end"], freq="Q") if s.get("backtest_end") else None
    out = [i for i, p in enumerate(ctx.idx) if p >= start and i < ctx.end and (end is None or p <= end)]
    return out[::max(1, int(s.get("backtest_step", 1)))]

def refit_flags(ctx, origins, every=None):
    """True where the coefficients are re-estimated. With sample.reestimate_every = 4 and
    reestimate_quarter = 1 the model is estimated once a year, at the first origin in Q1-Q4 of each year
    counted from Q1; at the other origins the same coefficients are kept and only the forecast is redone
    from the latest actual data. With reestimate_every = 1 (default) every origin re-estimates.

    Args:
        every: quarters between re-estimations (None = sample.reestimate_every).
    """
    s = ctx.cfg["sample"]
    every = max(1, int(every or s.get("reestimate_every", 1)))
    anchor = pd.Period(f"2000Q{int(s.get('reestimate_quarter', 1))}", freq="Q").ordinal
    flags, last = [], None
    for o in origins:
        w = (ctx.idx[o].ordinal - anchor) // every
        flags.append(w != last)
        last = w
    return np.array(flags, dtype=bool)

def covid_mask(ctx, origins, H):
    """Mark backtest errors whose forecast window touches the COVID dummy quarters.

    Args:
        ctx: Context. origins: positions of the forecast origins. H: horizon.

    Returns:
        bool array (origins x H); True = left out of the error metrics.
    """
    dq = [pd.Period(q, freq="Q") for q in ctx.cfg["sample"]["dummy_quarters"]]
    M = np.zeros((len(origins), H), dtype=bool)
    if not dq:
        return M
    a, b = min(dq), max(dq)
    for i, o in enumerate(origins):
        for h in range(1, H + 1):
            if o + h < len(ctx.idx):
                win = ctx.idx[o + 1:o + h + 1]
                M[i, h - 1] = ((win >= a) & (win <= b)).any()
    return M

def fast_backtest(F, y, D, est0, origins, H, refit=None):
    """Level % errors of iterated ARDL forecasts. F: features (T x k), y: target, D: dummies (T x d).
    refit: boolean per origin (see refit_flags); False keeps the previous coefficients.

    Args:
        y: target vector. D: dummies matrix. est0: position of the first estimation quarter. refit: bool per
        origin (None = every origin).
    """
    T = len(y)
    E = np.full((len(origins), H), np.nan)
    for i, o in enumerate(origins):
        if refit is None or refit[i] or i == 0:
            rows = np.arange(est0, o + 1)
            Dk = D[rows][:, D[rows].std(axis=0) > 0] if D.shape[1] else np.zeros((len(rows), 0))
            X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(rows)), y[rows - 1], Dk, F[rows]])
            b = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y[rows], rcond=None)[0]
            c, rho, beta = b[0], b[1], b[2 + Dk.shape[1]:]
        yprev, cp, ca = y[o], 0.0, 0.0
        for h in range(1, H + 1):
            t = o + h
            if t >= T:
                break
            yh = c + rho * yprev + F[t] @ beta
            cp += yh
            ca += y[t]
            E[i, h - 1] = tg.error(cp, ca)
            yprev = yh
    return E

def exhaustive_search(cfg, ctx, F, info, label):
    """F: candidate features on the history index; info: DataFrame indexed by feature with theme, expected_sign.

    Args:
        info: DataFrame indexed by feature with theme and expected_sign. label: name used in the log and the
        tables.
    """
    fm = cfg["final_model"]
    feats = list(F.columns)
    themes = info.loc[feats, "theme"].values
    signs = info.loc[feats, "expected_sign"].values
    last = ctx.end + 1                     # never use data after the estimation end (matters in the OOS test)
    y = ctx.y.values[:last]
    D = ctx.dummies.values[:last]
    rows = np.arange(ctx.est0, ctx.end + 1)
    Fv = F.values[:last]
    Dr = D[rows][:, D[rows].std(axis=0) > 0] if D.shape[1] else np.zeros((len(rows), 0))
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(rows)), y[rows - 1], Dr])
    n = len(rows)
    res = []
    stats = dict.fromkeys(["combinations", "same theme twice", "required theme missing", f"a driver with |t| < {fm['t_min']}",
                           "a driver with the wrong sign", f"VIF above {fm['vif_max']}", "passed every rule"], 0)
    for k in range(fm["min_vars"], fm["max_vars"] + 1):
        for combo in itertools.combinations(range(len(feats)), k):
            stats["combinations"] += 1
            th = themes[list(combo)]
            if fm["one_per_theme"] and len(set(th)) < k:
                stats["same theme twice"] += 1
                continue
            if fm["required_themes"] and not set(fm["required_themes"]) <= set(th):
                stats["required theme missing"] += 1
                continue
            Fk = Fv[rows][:, combo]
            X = np.column_stack([base, Fk])
            b, se, e = ols_np(X, y[rows])
            bk, tk = b[-k:], b[-k:] / se[-k:]
            if np.any(np.abs(tk) < fm["t_min"]):
                stats[f"a driver with |t| < {fm['t_min']}"] += 1
                continue
            sg = signs[list(combo)]
            if np.any((sg != 0) & (np.sign(bk) != sg)):
                stats["a driver with the wrong sign"] += 1
                continue
            v = vif(Fk)
            if np.max(v) > fm["vif_max"]:
                stats[f"VIF above {fm['vif_max']}"] += 1
                continue
            stats["passed every rule"] += 1
            ssr = e @ e
            res.append({"combo": combo, "k": k, "bic": n * np.log(ssr / n) + X.shape[1] * np.log(n),
                        "min_abs_t": float(np.min(np.abs(tk))), "max_vif": float(np.max(v))})
    if not res:
        raise RuntimeError(f"[{label}] no combination passed the rules: relax t_min / vif_max / one_per_theme "
                           f"or give the search more candidates.")
    R = pd.DataFrame(res).sort_values("bic").head(fm["n_oos_candidates"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    H = cfg["sample"]["horizon"]
    origins = backtest_origins(ctx)
    flags = refit_flags(ctx, origins)
    M = covid_mask(ctx, origins, H)
    err = []
    for c in R["combo"]:
        E = fast_backtest(Fv[:, list(c)], y, D, ctx.est0, origins, H, flags)
        err.append(np.nanmean(np.abs(np.where(M, np.nan, E))) * 100)
    R["oos_mape_pct"] = err
    R["features"] = R["combo"].apply(lambda c: [feats[i] for i in c])
    R = R.sort_values("oos_mape_pct").reset_index(drop=True)
    best = R["oos_mape_pct"].iloc[0]
    pick = R[R["oos_mape_pct"] <= best * (1 + fm["selection_tolerance"])].sort_values(
        ["k", "min_abs_t"], ascending=[True, False]).index[0]
    R["selected"] = R.index == pick
    R = pd.concat([R.loc[[pick]], R.drop(index=pick)]).reset_index(drop=True)
    R["features"] = R["features"].apply(", ".join)
    R = R.drop(columns="combo")
    stats["backtested (best by BIC)"] = len(R)
    stats["within the tolerance of the best error"] = int((R["oos_mape_pct"] <= best * (1 + fm["selection_tolerance"])).sum())
    R.attrs["rules"] = stats                      # how many combinations each rule removed (for the data story)
    return R, R.loc[0, "features"].split(", ")

src/models/autoardl.py

module src.models.autoardl · 28 items
Auto-ARDL models, as in EViews' ARDL estimator: the lag lengths are chosen by an information criterion.

AutoARDL (growth form)
    g_t = c + sum_{i=1..p} rho_i g_{t-i} + sum_j sum_{k=0..q_j} b_jk x_{j,t-k} + dummies + e_t
    g = quarterly log growth of the organic target level; x_j = each driver in its stationary form (the literature
    core, or the drivers chosen by screen first). p in 1..max_p and every q_j in 0..max_q are chosen together by AIC
    or BIC on one common sample (the same rule as EViews), and chosen again at every re-estimation, so the backtest
    and the out-of-sample test only use lags that could have been chosen at the time.

LevelsARDL (levels form, with the bounds test)
    y*_t = c + sum_{i=1..p} a_i y*_{t-i} + sum_j sum_{k=0..q_j} b_jk z_{j,t-k} + dummies + e_t
    y* = ln(real organic target) = ln(L*/P); z_j = the long-run variables of the literature error-correction model
    (log house prices, log income, real mortgage rate, ...). Written as an error-correction model it gives the
    long-run coefficients theta_j = sum_k b_jk / (1 - sum_i a_i) and the adjustment speed -(1 - sum_i a_i).
    The Pesaran, Shin & Smith (2001) bounds test checks whether a long-run relation exists at all: F (all lagged
    levels zero) and t (lagged y* zero), case III (unrestricted constant, no trend), against the I(0) and I(1)
    critical bounds. F above the I(1) bound: a long-run relation; below the I(0) bound: none; in between: inconclusive.
    Forecasts: y* is iterated forward and target growth is g_t = y*_t - y*_{t-1} + ln(P_t / P_{t-1}).

    The same class also gives the levels counterpart of each growth-form AutoARDL (levels_counterpart()):
    the target and every driver are "un-differenced" (nominal, no deflator):
        target  dlog -> y* = ln L        diff -> y* = L
        driver  dlog, yoy, dlog2, gap -> ln x     rdlog, ryoy -> ln(x / P)     diff, diff2, diff4, lvl, rgap -> x
    and y*_{t-1}, ..., y*_{t-p} are the autoregressive terms (an ARDL(1, ...) has the AR(1) in levels).

def _ic(ssr, n, k, ic):
    """Information criterion of an OLS fit (EViews' per-observation form; only the ranking matters).

    Args:
        ssr: sum of squared residuals. n: observations. k: estimated coefficients. ic: "aic", "bic" or "hq".
    """
    ll = -n / 2 * (1 + np.log(2 * np.pi) + np.log(ssr / n))
    pen = {"aic": 2 * k, "bic": k * np.log(n), "hq": 2 * k * np.log(np.log(n))}[ic]
    return (-2 * ll + pen) / n

def select_orders(y, X, fixed, max_p, max_q, ic="bic", min_p=1, max_models=20000):
    """Choose the lag of y and of every regressor together by an information criterion, EViews style.

    All candidate models are estimated on the same sample (the one the longest lags allow), so their criteria are
    comparable.

    Args:
        y: Series, the dependent variable. X: DataFrame of regressors (lag 0). fixed: DataFrame always included
        (dummies) or None. max_p: most lags of y. max_q: most lags of each regressor (0 = same quarter only).
        ic: "aic", "bic" or "hq". min_p: fewest lags of y. max_models: cap on the grid (max_q is lowered to fit).

    Returns:
        dict with p, q (dict regressor -> lag), ic value, models tried.
    """
    cols = list(X.columns)
    while max_q > 0 and (max_p - min_p + 1) * (max_q + 1) ** len(cols) > max_models:
        max_q -= 1
    L = max(max_p, max_q)
    D = pd.DataFrame({"y": y})
    for i in range(1, max_p + 1):
        D[f"y.L{i}"] = y.shift(i)
    for c in cols:
        for k in range(0, max_q + 1):
            D[f"{c}.L{k}"] = X[c].shift(k)
    if fixed is not None and fixed.shape[1]:
        D = D.join(fixed)
    D = D.iloc[L:].dropna()
    n = len(D)
    yv = D["y"].values
    base = [np.ones(n)] + ([D[c].values for c in fixed.columns if D[c].std() > 0] if fixed is not None else [])
    best = None
    tried = 0
    for p in range(min_p, max_p + 1):
        for qs in itertools.product(range(0, max_q + 1), repeat=len(cols)):
            M = np.column_stack(base + [D[f"y.L{i}"].values for i in range(1, p + 1)]
                                + [D[f"{c}.L{k}"].values for c, q in zip(cols, qs) for k in range(0, q + 1)])
            b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(M, yv, rcond=None)
            e = yv - M @ b
            v = _ic(float(e @ e), n, M.shape[1], ic)
            tried += 1
            if best is None or v < best[0]:
                best = (v, p, dict(zip(cols, qs)))
    return {"p": best[1], "q": best[2], "ic": best[0], "models_tried": tried, "n_obs": n}

class AutoARDL(ARDL):
    """ARDL in growth form whose lags are chosen by AIC/BIC at every estimation (EViews' automatic selection)."""
    kind = "AutoARDL"

    def __init__(self, name, base, max_p=4, max_q=4, ic="bic", family=FAMILY, note="", signs=None):
        """Create the model (nothing is estimated yet).

        Args:
            name: display name. base: driver features; their lag is ignored (lags 0..max_q are candidates).
            max_p: most lags of target growth. max_q: most lags of each driver. ic: "aic", "bic" or "hq".
            family, note: as for ARDL. signs: expected sign per base variable "code|transform" (optional).
        """
        self.bases = list(dict.fromkeys(f.rsplit("|", 1)[0] for f in base))
        self.max_p, self.max_q, self.ic = int(max_p), int(max_q), str(ic).lower()
        self.cands = [f"{b}|L{k}" for b in self.bases for k in range(0, self.max_q + 1)]
        super().__init__(name, [f"{b}|L0" for b in self.bases], ar=True, family=family, note=note)
        self.p, self.q, self.selection = 1, {b: 0 for b in self.bases}, None
        self.base_signs = dict(signs or {})
        self.frozen = False

    def panel(self, ctx, mdf):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): target, dummies and every candidate lag."""
        return make_panel(ctx, mdf, self.cands)

    def spec(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): settings that define the model (for the cache)."""
        return {"class": "AutoARDL", "bases": self.bases, "max_p": self.max_p, "max_q": self.max_q, "ic": self.ic}

    def drivers(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): the drivers with their chosen lags."""
        return list(self.features)

    def _X(self, P):
        """Constant, the chosen lags of target growth, the chosen driver lags and the dummies."""
        X = pd.DataFrame({"const": 1.0}, index=P.index)
        for i in range(1, self.p + 1):
            X[f"y_lag{i}"] = P["y"].shift(i)
        for f in self.features:
            X[f] = P[f]
        for c in [c for c in P.columns if c.startswith("D_")]:
            X[c] = P[c]
        return X

    def fit(self, P, start, end, fast=False):
        """Choose the lags on start..end (unless frozen), then estimate by OLS with HAC standard errors.

        Args:
            P: panel. start, end: estimation window. fast: plain least squares (inside combinations).

        Returns:
            self.
        """
        if not self.frozen:
            W = P.loc[start:end]
            X0 = pd.DataFrame({b: W[f"{b}|L0"] for b in self.bases})
            D = W[[c for c in W.columns if c.startswith("D_")]]
            sel = select_orders(W["y"], X0, D, self.max_p, self.max_q, self.ic)
            self.p, self.q, self.selection = sel["p"], sel["q"], sel
            self.features = [f"{b}|L{k}" for b in self.bases for k in range(0, self.q[b] + 1)]
            self.signs = {f: self.base_signs[f.rsplit("|", 1)[0]] for f in self.features
                          if f.rsplit("|", 1)[0] in self.base_signs}
        return super().fit(P, start, end, fast=fast)

    def forecast(self, P, origin, H):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate the equation, own forecasts replacing
        lagged growth.

        Returns:
            array of up to H forecasts of quarterly log growth.
        """
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        H = min(H, len(P) - pos - 1)
        past = list(P["y"].iloc[max(0, pos - self.p + 1):pos + 1].values)    # g(origin-p+1) .. g(origin)
        out = np.zeros(H)
        for h in range(1, H + 1):
            row = P.iloc[pos + h]
            v = self.params.get("const", 0.0)
            for i in range(1, self.p + 1):
                v += self.params.get(f"y_lag{i}", 0.0) * past[-i]
            v += sum(self.params[f] * row[f] for f in self.features if f in self.params)
            out[h - 1] = v
            past.append(v)
        return out

    def long_run(self):
        """Long-run effect of each driver: sum of its lag coefficients / (1 - sum of the growth lags).

        Returns:
            dict base variable -> long-run effect (nan if the growth lags sum to 1 or more).
        """
        rho = sum(self.params.get(f"y_lag{i}", 0.0) for i in range(1, self.p + 1))
        out = {}
        for b in self.bases:
            s = sum(self.params.get(f"{b}|L{k}", 0.0) for k in range(0, self.q.get(b, 0) + 1))
            out[b] = s / (1 - rho) if rho < 1 else np.nan
        return out

    def lag_summary(self):
        """The chosen lags in EViews notation, e.g. ARDL(2, 1, 0, 3).

        Returns:
            str.
        """
        return f"ARDL({self.p}, " + ", ".join(str(self.q[b]) for b in self.bases) + f"), chosen by {self.ic.upper()}"

class LevelsARDL:
    """ARDL in levels of the real organic target and the long-run variables, with lags chosen by AIC/BIC and the
    Pesaran-Shin-Smith bounds test. Same interface as the other models."""
    kind = "LevelsARDL"

    def __init__(self, name, long_run, deflator, max_p=4, max_q=4, ic="bic", family=FAMILY, note="", real=True):
        """Create the model.

        Args:
            name: display name. long_run: list of {mnemonic, form} (forms as in the error-correction model: log,
            log_real, level, real_rate). deflator: price index mnemonic. max_p, max_q, ic: lag search.
            real: True: y* = ln(L/P) (the literature error-correction form); False: y* = ln L for a dlog target,
            L for a diff target (the levels counterpart of the growth models).
        """
        self.name, self.family, self.note = name, family, note
        self.real = bool(real)
        self.long_run, self.deflator = list(long_run), deflator
        self.lr_names = [f"lr:{i['mnemonic']}:{i.get('form', 'log')}" for i in self.long_run]
        self.max_p, self.max_q, self.ic = int(max_p), int(max_q), str(ic).lower()
        self.p, self.q, self.params, self.bounds, self.res = 1, {n: 0 for n in self.lr_names}, None, None, None
        self.frozen = False
        self.features = []

    def panel(self, ctx, mdf):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): target, dummies, y* = ln(L*/P), the long-run levels."""
        P = make_panel(ctx, mdf, [])
        P["__logL"] = ctx.logL.reindex(P.index)
        P["__lcpi"] = tg.target_deflator(mdf, self.deflator, P.index) if self.real else pd.Series(0.0, index=P.index)
        P["__ys"] = P["__logL"] - P["__lcpi"]
        for item, n in zip(self.long_run, self.lr_names):
            P[n] = long_run_column(mdf, item, self.deflator).reindex(P.index)
        return P.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)             # log of a zero or negative value: missing

    def spec(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py)."""
        return {"class": "LevelsARDL", "long_run": self.long_run, "deflator": self.deflator, "max_p": self.max_p,
                "max_q": self.max_q, "ic": self.ic, "real": self.real}

    def drivers(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): the long-run variables with their chosen lags."""
        return [f"{n[3:]} (lags 0-{self.q.get(n, 0)})" for n in self.lr_names]

    def _design(self, P):
        """Regressors: constant, lags of y*, lags of each long-run variable, dummies."""
        X = pd.DataFrame({"const": 1.0}, index=P.index)
        for i in range(1, self.p + 1):
            X[f"ys_lag{i}"] = P["__ys"].shift(i)
        for n in self.lr_names:
            for k in range(0, self.q[n] + 1):
                X[f"{n}|L{k}"] = P[n].shift(k)
        for c in [c for c in P.columns if c.startswith("D_")]:
            X[c] = P[c]
        return X

    def fit(self, P, start, end, fast=False):
        """Choose the lags (unless frozen), estimate by OLS (HAC), and run the bounds test.

        Args:
            P: panel. start, end: estimation window. fast: skip the bounds test.

        Returns:
            self.
        """
        W = P.loc[start:end]
        if not self.frozen:
            X0 = W[self.lr_names]
            D = W[[c for c in W.columns if c.startswith("D_")]]
            sel = select_orders(W["__ys"], X0, D, self.max_p, self.max_q, self.ic)
            self.p, self.q, self.selection = sel["p"], sel["q"], sel
        X = self._design(P).loc[start:end]
        yv = W["__ys"]
        X = X.loc[:, (X.std() > 0) | (X.columns == "const")]
        ok = X.notna().all(axis=1) & yv.notna()
        self.res = sm.OLS(yv[ok], X[ok]).fit(cov_type="HAC", cov_kwds={"maxlags": 4})
        self.params = self.res.params
        if not fast:
            self.bounds = bounds_test(W, self.lr_names, self.p, self.q)
        return self

    def forecast(self, P, origin, H):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate y* forward; growth = change in y* plus
        inflation.

        Returns:
            array of up to H forecasts of quarterly log growth of the organic balance.
        """
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        H = min(H, len(P) - pos - 1)
        p = self.params
        ys = list(P["__ys"].iloc[max(0, pos - self.p + 1):pos + 1].values)
        out = np.zeros(H)
        for h in range(1, H + 1):
            t = pos + h
            v = p.get("const", 0.0) + sum(p.get(f"ys_lag{i}", 0.0) * ys[-i] for i in range(1, self.p + 1))
            for n in self.lr_names:
                for k in range(0, self.q[n] + 1):
                    v += p.get(f"{n}|L{k}", 0.0) * P[n].iloc[t - k]
            out[h - 1] = v - ys[-1] + (P["__lcpi"].iloc[t] - P["__lcpi"].iloc[t - 1])
            ys.append(v)
        return out

    def long_run_coefs(self):
        """Long-run coefficients theta_j = sum_k b_jk / (1 - sum_i a_i), and the adjustment speed.

        Returns:
            (dict long-run name -> theta, adjustment speed = -(1 - sum a_i), long-run constant).
        """
        p = self.params
        a = sum(p.get(f"ys_lag{i}", 0.0) for i in range(1, self.p + 1))
        th = {n: sum(p.get(f"{n}|L{k}", 0.0) for k in range(0, self.q[n] + 1)) / (1 - a) for n in self.lr_names}
        return th, -(1 - a), p.get("const", 0.0) / (1 - a)

    def target_label(self):
        """What y* is, in words."""
        if self.real:
            return "ln(real organic target)" if tg.is_log() else "organic target (level)"
        return "ln(organic target)" if tg.is_log() else "organic target (level)"

    def lag_summary(self):
        """EViews notation of the chosen lags, e.g. ARDL(2, 0, 1, 1)."""
        return f"ARDL({self.p}, " + ", ".join(str(self.q[n]) for n in self.lr_names) + f"), chosen by {self.ic.upper()}"

    def detail_rows(self, ctx, P):
        """Rows for the model detail page: coefficients, long-run relation, adjustment speed and the bounds test."""
        rows = []
        r = self.res
        for t in r.params.index:
            if t.startswith("D_"):
                continue
            rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": t, "coef": float(r.params[t]), "se_hac": float(r.bse[t]),
                         "t": float(r.tvalues[t]), "p": float(r.pvalues[t]),
                         "reading": ("constant" if t == "const" else
                                     f"{self.target_label()}, {t[-1]} quarter(s) earlier" if t.startswith("ys_lag") else
                                     f"{t.split(':')[1]} ({t.split(':')[2].split('|')[0]}), lag {t.rsplit('L', 1)[-1]}")})
        th, speed, c0 = self.long_run_coefs()
        rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": "lag orders", "reading": self.lag_summary()})
        rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": "adjustment speed", "coef": speed,
                     "reading": f"{abs(speed):.1%} of a gap from the long-run level closes each quarter"
                     if speed < 0 else "no adjustment towards a long-run level (speed is not negative)"})
        for n, v in th.items():
            rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": f"long run: {n[3:]}", "coef": float(v),
                         "reading": f"in the long run, 1 unit higher {n.split(':')[1]} ({n.split(':')[2]}) goes with "
                                    f"{v:+.3f} in {self.target_label()}"})
        b = self.bounds or {}
        if b:
            rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": "bounds test: F", "coef": b["F"],
                         "reading": f"5% bounds I(0) {b['F_I0_5']:.2f}, I(1) {b['F_I1_5']:.2f}; p-value "
                                    f"{b['F_p_I0']:.3f} (I(0)) / {b['F_p_I1']:.3f} (I(1)): {b['decision']}"})
            rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": "bounds test: t", "coef": b["t"],
                         "reading": f"5% bounds I(0) {b['t_I0_5']:.2f}, I(1) {b['t_I1_5']:.2f} (more negative than the "
                                    "I(1) bound: long-run relation)"})
        return rows

    def __init__(self, name, long_run, deflator, max_p=4, max_q=4, ic="bic", family=FAMILY, note="", real=True):
        """Create the model.

        Args:
            name: display name. long_run: list of {mnemonic, form} (forms as in the error-correction model: log,
            log_real, level, real_rate). deflator: price index mnemonic. max_p, max_q, ic: lag search.
            real: True: y* = ln(L/P) (the literature error-correction form); False: y* = ln L for a dlog target,
            L for a diff target (the levels counterpart of the growth models).
        """
        self.name, self.family, self.note = name, family, note
        self.real = bool(real)
        self.long_run, self.deflator = list(long_run), deflator
        self.lr_names = [f"lr:{i['mnemonic']}:{i.get('form', 'log')}" for i in self.long_run]
        self.max_p, self.max_q, self.ic = int(max_p), int(max_q), str(ic).lower()
        self.p, self.q, self.params, self.bounds, self.res = 1, {n: 0 for n in self.lr_names}, None, None, None
        self.frozen = False
        self.features = []

    def panel(self, ctx, mdf):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): target, dummies, y* = ln(L*/P), the long-run levels."""
        P = make_panel(ctx, mdf, [])
        P["__logL"] = ctx.logL.reindex(P.index)
        P["__lcpi"] = tg.target_deflator(mdf, self.deflator, P.index) if self.real else pd.Series(0.0, index=P.index)
        P["__ys"] = P["__logL"] - P["__lcpi"]
        for item, n in zip(self.long_run, self.lr_names):
            P[n] = long_run_column(mdf, item, self.deflator).reindex(P.index)
        return P.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)             # log of a zero or negative value: missing

    def _design(self, P):
        """Regressors: constant, lags of y*, lags of each long-run variable, dummies."""
        X = pd.DataFrame({"const": 1.0}, index=P.index)
        for i in range(1, self.p + 1):
            X[f"ys_lag{i}"] = P["__ys"].shift(i)
        for n in self.lr_names:
            for k in range(0, self.q[n] + 1):
                X[f"{n}|L{k}"] = P[n].shift(k)
        for c in [c for c in P.columns if c.startswith("D_")]:
            X[c] = P[c]
        return X

    def fit(self, P, start, end, fast=False):
        """Choose the lags (unless frozen), estimate by OLS (HAC), and run the bounds test.

        Args:
            P: panel. start, end: estimation window. fast: skip the bounds test.

        Returns:
            self.
        """
        W = P.loc[start:end]
        if not self.frozen:
            X0 = W[self.lr_names]
            D = W[[c for c in W.columns if c.startswith("D_")]]
            sel = select_orders(W["__ys"], X0, D, self.max_p, self.max_q, self.ic)
            self.p, self.q, self.selection = sel["p"], sel["q"], sel
        X = self._design(P).loc[start:end]
        yv = W["__ys"]
        X = X.loc[:, (X.std() > 0) | (X.columns == "const")]
        ok = X.notna().all(axis=1) & yv.notna()
        self.res = sm.OLS(yv[ok], X[ok]).fit(cov_type="HAC", cov_kwds={"maxlags": 4})
        self.params = self.res.params
        if not fast:
            self.bounds = bounds_test(W, self.lr_names, self.p, self.q)
        return self

    def forecast(self, P, origin, H):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): iterate y* forward; growth = change in y* plus
        inflation.

        Returns:
            array of up to H forecasts of quarterly log growth of the organic balance.
        """
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        H = min(H, len(P) - pos - 1)
        p = self.params
        ys = list(P["__ys"].iloc[max(0, pos - self.p + 1):pos + 1].values)
        out = np.zeros(H)
        for h in range(1, H + 1):
            t = pos + h
            v = p.get("const", 0.0) + sum(p.get(f"ys_lag{i}", 0.0) * ys[-i] for i in range(1, self.p + 1))
            for n in self.lr_names:
                for k in range(0, self.q[n] + 1):
                    v += p.get(f"{n}|L{k}", 0.0) * P[n].iloc[t - k]
            out[h - 1] = v - ys[-1] + (P["__lcpi"].iloc[t] - P["__lcpi"].iloc[t - 1])
            ys.append(v)
        return out

def uecm_design(W, lr_names, p, q):
    """The conditional error-correction form of ARDL(p, q): the same model as the levels ARDL, rewritten.

    dy*_t = c + pi_y y*_{t-1} + sum_j pi_j z_{j,t-1} + sum_{i=1..p-1} phi_i dy*_{t-i}
            + sum_j sum_{k=0..max(q_j-1,0)} theta_jk dz_{j,t-k} + dummies

    Args:
        W: panel window (with __ys, the long-run columns and the dummies). lr_names: long-run columns.
        p, q: lag orders of the levels ARDL.

    Returns:
        (dependent series, regressor DataFrame) with complete rows only.
    """
    ys = W["__ys"]
    X = pd.DataFrame({"const": 1.0, "ys.L1": ys.shift(1)}, index=W.index)
    for n in lr_names:
        X[f"{n}.L1"] = W[n].shift(1)
    for i in range(1, p):
        X[f"D.ys.L{i}"] = ys.diff().shift(i)
    for n in lr_names:
        for k in range(0, max(q.get(n, 0) - 1, 0) + 1):
            X[f"D.{n}.L{k}"] = W[n].diff().shift(k)
    for c in [c for c in W.columns if c.startswith("D_") and W[c].std() > 0]:
        X[c] = W[c]
    d = pd.concat([ys.diff().rename("dy"), X], axis=1).dropna()
    return d["dy"], d.drop(columns="dy")

def bounds_test(W, lr_names, p, q):
    """Pesaran, Shin & Smith (2001) bounds test for a long-run relation, case III (unrestricted constant, no trend),
    as in EViews: F-test that all lagged levels are zero, and t-test on lagged y*, in the conditional
    error-correction form of the chosen ARDL (dummies included).

    Critical values: F from PSS Table CI(iii) (statsmodels' copy, by number of regressors k), with asymptotic
    p-values; t from PSS Table CII(iii).

    Args:
        W: estimation window of the panel. lr_names: long-run columns. p, q: chosen lags.

    Returns:
        dict: F, t, the 10/5/1% I(0) and I(1) bounds of each, F p-values, decision, k, n_obs.
    """
    from statsmodels.tsa.ardl import pss_critical_values as pss
    k = len(lr_names)
    try:
        y, X = uecm_design(W, lr_names, max(int(p), 1), q)
        r = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
        lv = ["ys.L1"] + [f"{n}.L1" for n in lr_names]
        R = np.zeros((len(lv), X.shape[1]))
        for i, c in enumerate(lv):
            R[i, list(X.columns).index(c)] = 1
        F = float(np.squeeze(r.f_test(R).fvalue))
        t = float(r.tvalues["ys.L1"])
        out = {"F": F, "t": t, "k": k, "n_obs": int(r.nobs)}
        lo, up = pss.crit_vals[(k, 3, False)], pss.crit_vals[(k, 3, True)]
        for j, lev in enumerate((10, 5, 1)):
            out[f"F_I0_{lev}"], out[f"F_I1_{lev}"] = float(lo[j]), float(up[j])
            tt = PSS_T.get(k)
            out[f"t_I0_{lev}"], out[f"t_I1_{lev}"] = (tt[2 * j], tt[2 * j + 1]) if tt else (np.nan, np.nan)
        try:
            from statsmodels.tsa.ardl.model import _pss_pvalue
            out["F_p_I0"], out["F_p_I1"] = float(_pss_pvalue(F, k, 3, False)), float(_pss_pvalue(F, k, 3, True))
        except Exception:
            out["F_p_I0"] = out["F_p_I1"] = np.nan
        out["decision"] = ("long-run relation (F above the 5% I(1) bound)" if F > out["F_I1_5"] else
                           "no long-run relation (F below the 5% I(0) bound)" if F < out["F_I0_5"] else
                           "inconclusive (F between the 5% bounds)")
        return out
    except Exception as ex:
        return {"F": np.nan, "t": np.nan, "k": k, "decision": f"bounds test failed: {type(ex).__name__}: {ex}",
                "F_p_I0": np.nan, "F_p_I1": np.nan, **{f"{s_}_{b_}_{lev}": np.nan for s_ in ("F", "t")
                                                       for b_ in ("I0", "I1") for lev in (10, 5, 1)}}

def levels_counterpart(features, mdf, deflator):
    """The long-run (levels) items of a growth-form driver set: each driver un-differenced, once per series.

    Args:
        features: driver features "code|transform|Llag" of a growth-form model. mdf: macro history (to check that
        a log is possible). deflator: price index mnemonic (for log_real).

    Returns:
        (items [{mnemonic, form, from}], left out [(feature, reason)]).
    """
    items, out, seen = [], [], set()
    for f in features:
        code, tr, _ = parse_feature(f)
        form = LEVEL_FORM.get(tr, "level" if tr not in LEVEL_FORM else None)
        if code not in mdf.columns:
            out.append((f, "not a raw macro series (e.g. a factor)"))
            continue
        if form is None:
            out.append((f, f"{tr} has no level form"))
            continue
        if form in ("log", "log_real") and not (mdf[code].dropna() > 0).all():
            form = "level"                                 # a log needs positive values
        if form == "log_real" and (not deflator or deflator not in mdf.columns):
            form = "log"
        if (code, form) in seen:
            continue
        seen.add((code, form))
        items.append({"mnemonic": code, "form": form, "from": tr})
    return items, out

def base_of(feature):
    """'FHPI.ION|dlog|L1' -> 'FHPI.ION|dlog'."""
    code, tr, _ = parse_feature(feature)
    return f"{code}|{tr}"

Forecast combinations: an average of member models' forecasts.

weighting = "equal"    : simple average (robust; Stock & Watson 2004, Timmermann 2006).
weighting = "inv_mse"  : Bates-Granger weights proportional to 1 / MSE of each member's recent forecasts
                         (made only with data up to the estimation end), shrunk half-way towards equal weights,
                         which guards against chasing noise with ~100 observations.

class Combination:
    """Forecast combination: a weighted average of member models' forecasts.

    weighting "equal" gives equal weights; "inv_mse" gives Bates-Granger weights from each member's recent
    out-of-sample errors (last `window` origins, horizons 1..hmax), shrunk by `shrink` towards equal weights.
    """
    family = "Hybrid"

    def __init__(self, name, members, weighting="equal", family="Hybrid", note="", window=16, hmax=4, shrink=0.5,
                 weights=None):
        """Create a combination.

        Args:
            name: display name. members: list of models. weighting: "equal" or "inv_mse".
            family, note: as for ARDL. window: origins used for the weights. hmax: horizons used.
            shrink: share of the way back to equal weights (0 = pure inverse-MSE).
        """
        self.name, self.members, self.weighting = name, list(members), weighting
        self.family, self.note = family, note
        self.window, self.hmax, self.shrink = window, hmax, shrink
        self.weights = np.full(len(self.members), 1 / len(self.members))
        if weighting == "fixed" and weights is not None:     # given weights (e.g. posterior model probabilities)
            w = np.asarray(weights, float)
            self.weights = w / w.sum()
        self.params, self.res = None, None

    @property
    def features(self):
        """All drivers of the members, without duplicates.

        Returns:
            list of feature names.
        """
        return list(dict.fromkeys(f for m in self.members for f in m.features))

    def spec(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): settings of the combination and of every member.

        Returns:
            dict.
        """
        return {"class": "Combination", "weighting": self.weighting, "members": [m.spec() for m in self.members],
                "window": self.window, "hmax": self.hmax, "shrink": self.shrink,
                "weights": [round(float(w), 6) for w in self.weights] if self.weighting == "fixed" else None}

    def drivers(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): members with their current weights.

        Returns:
            list of str like "Screen first (40%)".
        """
        if self.weighting == "fixed":               # averaged models: show each one's drivers
            return [f"{' + '.join(m.features) or 'no macro driver'} ({w:.0%})" for m, w in zip(self.members, self.weights)]
        return [f"{m.name} ({w:.0%})" for m, w in zip(self.members, self.weights)]

    def panel(self, ctx, mdf):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): one panel holding the columns every member needs.

        Args:
            ctx: Context. mdf: macro DataFrame.

        Returns:
            DataFrame.
        """
        P = None
        for m in self.members:
            Pm = m.panel(ctx, mdf)
            P = Pm if P is None else P.join(Pm[[c for c in Pm.columns if c not in P.columns]])
        return P

    def fit(self, P, start, end):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): estimate the weights (inv_mse only) and every member.

        Args:
            P: panel. start, end: estimation window (Periods).

        Returns:
            self.
        """
        if self.weighting == "inv_mse":
            self.weights = self._weights(P, start, end)
        for m in self.members:
            m.fit(P, start, end)
        return self

    def _weights(self, P, start, end):
        """Members' squared errors of cumulative growth, 1..hmax quarters ahead, over the last `window` origins."""
        e_pos = P.index.get_loc(end)
        s_pos = P.index.get_loc(start)
        origins = [o for o in range(e_pos - self.window - self.hmax + 1, e_pos - self.hmax + 1) if o - s_pos >= 40]
        if len(origins) < 4:
            return np.full(len(self.members), 1 / len(self.members))
        y = P["y"].values
        dummy_cols = [c for c in P.columns if c.startswith("D_")]
        busy = P[dummy_cols].sum(axis=1).values > 0 if dummy_cols else np.zeros(len(P), bool)
        mse = []
        for m in self.members:
            err = []
            for o in origins:
                if busy[o + 1:o + 1 + self.hmax].any():
                    continue
                m.fit(P, start, P.index[o], fast=True)
                fc = m.forecast(P, P.index[o], self.hmax)
                err.append(np.cumsum(fc) - np.cumsum(y[o + 1:o + 1 + len(fc)]))
            mse.append(np.mean(np.square(err)) if err else np.nan)
        mse = np.array(mse)
        if np.isnan(mse).any() or (mse <= 0).any():
            return np.full(len(self.members), 1 / len(self.members))
        w = (1 / mse) / (1 / mse).sum()
        eq = np.full(len(w), 1 / len(w))
        return self.shrink * eq + (1 - self.shrink) * w

    def forecast(self, P, origin, H):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): weighted average of the members' forecasts.

        Args:
            P: panel. origin: last known quarter. H: quarters ahead.

        Returns:
            array of forecasts.
        """
        fcs = [m.forecast(P, origin, H) for m in self.members]
        n = min(len(f) for f in fcs)
        return np.sum([w * f[:n] for w, f in zip(self.weights, fcs)], axis=0)

    def forecast(self, P, origin, H):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): weighted average of the members' forecasts.

        Args:
            P: panel. origin: last known quarter. H: quarters ahead.

        Returns:
            array of forecasts.
        """
        fcs = [m.forecast(P, origin, H) for m in self.members]
        n = min(len(f) for f in fcs)
        return np.sum([w * f[:n] for w, f in zip(self.weights, fcs)], axis=0)

src/models/deep.py

module src.models.deep · 31 items
Deep-learning and classic statistical time-series challengers.

Deep learning (needs `pip install darts`, which installs PyTorch; skipped with a message if missing)
  TiDE   (Das et al. 2023, Google)       MLP encoder-decoder; uses the drivers' future (scenario) values
  N-HiTS (Challu et al. 2023)            hierarchical interpolation; drivers enter as past covariates (their
                                         scenario path is used only beyond the first 4 quarters)
  TFT    (Lim et al. 2021)               temporal fusion transformer (attention + LSTM); uses future covariates
  N-BEATS (Oreshkin et al. 2020)         optional; target growth history only
  TSMixer (Chen et al. 2023, Google)     optional; uses future covariates
All are trained on our ~100 quarters, so they are kept SMALL (a few thousand parameters), trained for a fixed
number of epochs, and refitted on the same yearly calendar as the other models. Training one takes seconds on a
CPU. With so little data they are noisy: `n_models` averages several random seeds.

Statistical
  ARIMAX  ARMA(1,1) errors with the literature drivers and the dummies as regressors (statsmodels SARIMAX);
          coefficients kept between re-estimations, the state is updated with the latest data
  Theta   the M3-competition winner (Assimakopoulos & Nikolopoulos 2000) on target growth alone

class DeepModel:
    """Small neural forecaster from darts (TiDE, N-HiTS, TFT, N-BEATS or TSMixer) trained on this data.

    The target and drivers are standardised with training-window statistics; several random seeds are averaged;
    the 12-quarter path is built from 4-quarter blocks. A fit is skipped when the training data are unchanged.
    """
    family = "Deep learning"

    def __init__(self, name, kind, features, settings=None, note=""):
        """Create a deep-learning model.

        Args:
            name: display name. kind: tide, nhits, tft, nbeats or tsmixer. features: driver features (covariates).
            settings: epochs, input_chunk, output_chunk, n_models, batch_size, learning_rate, refit_every, and
            per-model overrides such as {"tft": {"epochs": 50}}. note: free text.
        """
        self.name, self.kind, self.features = name, kind, list(features)
        self.family, self.note = "Deep learning", note
        settings = dict(settings or {})
        own = {k: settings.pop(k) for k in list(settings) if isinstance(settings[k], dict)}   # per-model overrides
        self.s = {**DEEP_DEFAULTS, **(PER_MODEL.get(kind, {})), **settings, **own.get(kind, {})}
        self.refit_every = int(self.s.pop("refit_every", 4))
        self.params, self.res = None, None
        self._fit_key, self._models = None, []

    def spec(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): kind, features and settings.

        Returns:
            dict.
        """
        return {"class": "Deep", "kind": self.kind, "features": self.features, "settings": self.s,
                "refit_every": self.refit_every}

    def drivers(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): covariates, or "(own history only)" for N-BEATS.

        Returns:
            list of str.
        """
        return list(self.features) if self.kind not in NO_COV else ["(own history only)"]

    def panel(self, ctx, mdf):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): panel with target, drivers and dummies.

        Args:
            ctx: Context. mdf: macro DataFrame.

        Returns:
            DataFrame.
        """
        return make_panel(ctx, mdf, self.features)

    # ---- data
    def _cov_cols(self, P):
        """Covariate columns used: drivers plus dummies (none for N-BEATS).

        Args:
            P: panel.

        Returns:
            list of str.
        """
        return [] if self.kind in NO_COV else self.features + _dummies(P)

    def _first_valid(self, P):
        """Position of the first quarter where the target and all covariates are known.

        Args:
            P: panel.

        Returns:
            int.
        """
        cols = ["y"] + self._cov_cols(P)
        ok = P[cols].notna().all(axis=1).values
        return int(np.argmax(ok))

    def _series(self, values, start):
        """Convert an array to a darts TimeSeries on an integer time index.

        Args:
            values: 1-D or 2-D array. start: first index.

        Returns:
            darts.TimeSeries (float32).
        """
        from darts import TimeSeries
        v = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float32)
        if v.ndim == 1:
            v = v[:, None]
        return TimeSeries.from_times_and_values(pd.RangeIndex(start, start + len(v)), v)

    def _build(self, seed):
        """Create one untrained darts network with the configured size.

        Args:
            seed: random seed.

        Returns:
            darts model.
        """
        import torch
        from darts.models import NBEATSModel, NHiTSModel, TFTModel, TiDEModel, TSMixerModel
        s = self.s
        common = dict(input_chunk_length=int(s["input_chunk"]), output_chunk_length=int(s["output_chunk"]),
                      n_epochs=int(s["epochs"]), batch_size=int(s["batch_size"]), random_state=seed,
                      optimizer_kwargs={"lr": float(s["learning_rate"])},
                      pl_trainer_kwargs={"accelerator": "cpu", "enable_progress_bar": False,
                                         "enable_model_summary": False, "logger": False, "enable_checkpointing": False})
        if self.kind == "tide":
            return TiDEModel(hidden_size=32, num_encoder_layers=1, num_decoder_layers=1, decoder_output_dim=8,
                             temporal_decoder_hidden=16, dropout=0.1, **common)
        if self.kind == "nhits":
            return NHiTSModel(num_stacks=2, num_blocks=1, num_layers=2, layer_widths=32, dropout=0.1, **common)
        if self.kind == "tft":
            return TFTModel(hidden_size=16, lstm_layers=1, num_attention_heads=2, hidden_continuous_size=8,
                            dropout=0.1, likelihood=None, loss_fn=torch.nn.MSELoss(), **common)
        if self.kind == "nbeats":
            return NBEATSModel(generic_architecture=True, num_stacks=4, num_blocks=1, num_layers=2, layer_widths=32,
                               **common)
        if self.kind == "tsmixer":
            return TSMixerModel(hidden_size=16, ff_size=32, num_blocks=2, dropout=0.1, **common)
        raise ValueError(f"unknown deep model {self.kind}")

    # ---- fit / forecast
    def fit(self, P, start, end):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): train n_models networks on start..end (skipped if the data are unchanged).

        Args:
            P: panel. start, end: training window.

        Returns:
            self.
        """
        import logging
        logging.getLogger("pytorch_lightning").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
        logging.getLogger("lightning.pytorch").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
        f0 = max(self._first_valid(P), P.index.get_loc(start))
        e = P.index.get_loc(end)
        cols = self._cov_cols(P)
        Y = P["y"].values[f0:e + 1]
        X = P[cols].values[f0:e + 1] if cols else None
        key = hashlib.sha1(np.r_[Y, X.ravel() if X is not None else []].astype(np.float64).tobytes()).hexdigest()
        if key == self._fit_key:                      # same training data (e.g. another scenario): reuse
            return self
        self.mu, self.sd = np.nanmean(Y), np.nanstd(Y) or 1.0
        if X is not None:
            self.xmu, self.xsd = X.mean(axis=0), np.where(X.std(axis=0) > 0, X.std(axis=0), 1.0)
        ys = self._series((Y - self.mu) / self.sd, f0)
        kw = {}
        if X is not None:
            xs = self._series((X - self.xmu) / self.xsd, f0)
            kw = {"future_covariates": xs} if self.kind in FUTURE_COV else {"past_covariates": xs}
        self._models = []
        for seed in range(int(self.s["n_models"])):
            m = self._build(seed)
            m.fit(ys, verbose=False, **kw)
            self._models.append(m)
        self._fit_key, self._f0, self._fit_end = key, f0, e
        return self

    def detail_rows(self, ctx, P):
        """Driver table rows: for TFT, the importance its variable-selection networks give each input (darts
        TFTExplainer, average over the seeds); other networks have no built-in importance, so their table relies on
        the scenario-sensitivity columns added for every model.

        Args:
            ctx: Context. P: the panel the model was fitted on.

        Returns:
            list of dict rows.
        """
        if self.kind != "tft" or not self._models:
            return [{"model": self.name, "term": f, "reading": "see the scenario effect: networks have no coefficients"}
                    for f in self.features] or [{"model": self.name, "term": "(own history only)", "reading": self.note}]
        try:
            from darts.explainability import TFTExplainer
            cols = self._cov_cols(P)
            e, f0 = self._fit_end, self._f0
            ys = self._series((P["y"].values[f0:e + 1] - self.mu) / self.sd, f0)
            X = P[cols].values[f0:e + 1 + 16].astype(float)
            X = np.vstack([X, np.repeat(X[-1:], 16, axis=0)])
            xs = self._series((X - self.xmu) / self.xsd, f0)
            enc, dec = [], []
            for m in self._models:
                r = TFTExplainer(m, background_series=ys, background_future_covariates=xs).explain()
                enc.append(r.get_encoder_importance().iloc[0])
                dec.append(r.get_decoder_importance().iloc[0])
            enc, dec = pd.concat(enc, axis=1).mean(axis=1), pd.concat(dec, axis=1).mean(axis=1)
            name = lambda k: "target growth (own history)" if k.endswith("_target") else cols[int(k.split("_")[0])]
            rows = []
            for k in sorted(set(enc.index) | set(dec.index), key=lambda k: -(enc.get(k, 0) + dec.get(k, 0))):
                t = name(k)
                if t.startswith("D_"):
                    continue
                rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": t, "coef": float(enc.get(k, np.nan)),
                             "importance_decoder_pct": float(dec.get(k, np.nan)),
                             "reading": f"TFT variable selection: {enc.get(k, 0):.1f}% of the weight looking back (encoder), "
                                        f"{dec.get(k, 0):.1f}% looking ahead (decoder)"})
            return rows
        except Exception as ex:                                  # explainability is optional
            return [{"model": self.name, "term": f, "reading": f"TFT importance not available ({type(ex).__name__})"}
                    for f in self.features]

    def forecast(self, P, origin, H):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): average of the networks' forecasts, back in growth units.

        Args:
            P: panel (future covariates come from it). origin: last known quarter. H: quarters ahead.

        Returns:
            array of forecasts.
        """
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        H = min(H, len(P) - pos - 1)
        if H <= 0:
            return np.zeros(0)
        f0 = self._first_valid(P)
        ys = self._series((P["y"].values[f0:pos + 1] - self.mu) / self.sd, f0)
        cols = self._cov_cols(P)
        kw = {}
        if cols:
            X = P[cols].values[f0:pos + 1 + H].astype(float)
            pad = int(self.s["output_chunk"]) * 2 + H          # darts may ask for covariates beyond n: repeat the last row
            X = np.vstack([X, np.repeat(X[-1:], pad, axis=0)])
            X[pos + 1 - f0:, [i for i, c in enumerate(cols) if c.startswith("D_")]] = 0.0
            xs = self._series((X - self.xmu) / self.xsd, f0)
            kw = {"future_covariates": xs} if self.kind in FUTURE_COV else {"past_covariates": xs}
        preds = [m.predict(n=H, series=ys, verbose=False, **kw).values()[:, 0] for m in self._models]
        return np.mean(preds, axis=0) * self.sd + self.mu

        if self.kind == "tide":
            return TiDEModel(hidden_size=32, num_encoder_layers=1, num_decoder_layers=1, decoder_output_dim=8,
                             temporal_decoder_hidden=16, dropout=0.1, **common)
        if self.kind == "nhits":
            return NHiTSModel(num_stacks=2, num_blocks=1, num_layers=2, layer_widths=32, dropout=0.1, **common)
        if self.kind == "tft":
            return TFTModel(hidden_size=16, lstm_layers=1, num_attention_heads=2, hidden_continuous_size=8,
                            dropout=0.1, likelihood=None, loss_fn=torch.nn.MSELoss(), **common)
        if self.kind == "nbeats":
            return NBEATSModel(generic_architecture=True, num_stacks=4, num_blocks=1, num_layers=2, layer_widths=32,
                               **common)
        if self.kind == "tsmixer":
            return TSMixerModel(hidden_size=16, ff_size=32, num_blocks=2, dropout=0.1, **common)
        raise ValueError(f"unknown deep model {self.kind}")

    def fit(self, P, start, end):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): train n_models networks on start..end (skipped if the data are unchanged).

        Args:
            P: panel. start, end: training window.

        Returns:
            self.
        """
        import logging
        logging.getLogger("pytorch_lightning").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
        logging.getLogger("lightning.pytorch").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
        f0 = max(self._first_valid(P), P.index.get_loc(start))
        e = P.index.get_loc(end)
        cols = self._cov_cols(P)
        Y = P["y"].values[f0:e + 1]
        X = P[cols].values[f0:e + 1] if cols else None
        key = hashlib.sha1(np.r_[Y, X.ravel() if X is not None else []].astype(np.float64).tobytes()).hexdigest()
        if key == self._fit_key:                      # same training data (e.g. another scenario): reuse
            return self
        self.mu, self.sd = np.nanmean(Y), np.nanstd(Y) or 1.0
        if X is not None:
            self.xmu, self.xsd = X.mean(axis=0), np.where(X.std(axis=0) > 0, X.std(axis=0), 1.0)
        ys = self._series((Y - self.mu) / self.sd, f0)
        kw = {}
        if X is not None:
            xs = self._series((X - self.xmu) / self.xsd, f0)
            kw = {"future_covariates": xs} if self.kind in FUTURE_COV else {"past_covariates": xs}
        self._models = []
        for seed in range(int(self.s["n_models"])):
            m = self._build(seed)
            m.fit(ys, verbose=False, **kw)
            self._models.append(m)
        self._fit_key, self._f0, self._fit_end = key, f0, e
        return self

    def detail_rows(self, ctx, P):
        """Driver table rows: for TFT, the importance its variable-selection networks give each input (darts
        TFTExplainer, average over the seeds); other networks have no built-in importance, so their table relies on
        the scenario-sensitivity columns added for every model.

        Args:
            ctx: Context. P: the panel the model was fitted on.

        Returns:
            list of dict rows.
        """
        if self.kind != "tft" or not self._models:
            return [{"model": self.name, "term": f, "reading": "see the scenario effect: networks have no coefficients"}
                    for f in self.features] or [{"model": self.name, "term": "(own history only)", "reading": self.note}]
        try:
            from darts.explainability import TFTExplainer
            cols = self._cov_cols(P)
            e, f0 = self._fit_end, self._f0
            ys = self._series((P["y"].values[f0:e + 1] - self.mu) / self.sd, f0)
            X = P[cols].values[f0:e + 1 + 16].astype(float)
            X = np.vstack([X, np.repeat(X[-1:], 16, axis=0)])
            xs = self._series((X - self.xmu) / self.xsd, f0)
            enc, dec = [], []
            for m in self._models:
                r = TFTExplainer(m, background_series=ys, background_future_covariates=xs).explain()
                enc.append(r.get_encoder_importance().iloc[0])
                dec.append(r.get_decoder_importance().iloc[0])
            enc, dec = pd.concat(enc, axis=1).mean(axis=1), pd.concat(dec, axis=1).mean(axis=1)
            name = lambda k: "target growth (own history)" if k.endswith("_target") else cols[int(k.split("_")[0])]
            rows = []
            for k in sorted(set(enc.index) | set(dec.index), key=lambda k: -(enc.get(k, 0) + dec.get(k, 0))):
                t = name(k)
                if t.startswith("D_"):
                    continue
                rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": t, "coef": float(enc.get(k, np.nan)),
                             "importance_decoder_pct": float(dec.get(k, np.nan)),
                             "reading": f"TFT variable selection: {enc.get(k, 0):.1f}% of the weight looking back (encoder), "
                                        f"{dec.get(k, 0):.1f}% looking ahead (decoder)"})
            return rows
        except Exception as ex:                                  # explainability is optional
            return [{"model": self.name, "term": f, "reading": f"TFT importance not available ({type(ex).__name__})"}
                    for f in self.features]

    def forecast(self, P, origin, H):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): average of the networks' forecasts, back in growth units.

        Args:
            P: panel (future covariates come from it). origin: last known quarter. H: quarters ahead.

        Returns:
            array of forecasts.
        """
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        H = min(H, len(P) - pos - 1)
        if H <= 0:
            return np.zeros(0)
        f0 = self._first_valid(P)
        ys = self._series((P["y"].values[f0:pos + 1] - self.mu) / self.sd, f0)
        cols = self._cov_cols(P)
        kw = {}
        if cols:
            X = P[cols].values[f0:pos + 1 + H].astype(float)
            pad = int(self.s["output_chunk"]) * 2 + H          # darts may ask for covariates beyond n: repeat the last row
            X = np.vstack([X, np.repeat(X[-1:], pad, axis=0)])
            X[pos + 1 - f0:, [i for i, c in enumerate(cols) if c.startswith("D_")]] = 0.0
            xs = self._series((X - self.xmu) / self.xsd, f0)
            kw = {"future_covariates": xs} if self.kind in FUTURE_COV else {"past_covariates": xs}
        preds = [m.predict(n=H, series=ys, verbose=False, **kw).values()[:, 0] for m in self._models]
        return np.mean(preds, axis=0) * self.sd + self.mu

class ARIMAX:
    """Regression on the literature drivers and dummies with ARMA errors (statsmodels SARIMAX)."""
    family = "Statistical time series"

    def __init__(self, name, features, order=(1, 0, 1), note=""):
        """Create an ARIMAX.

        Args:
            name: display name. features: driver features. order: (p, d, q) of the errors. note: free text.
        """
        self.name, self.features, self.order = name, list(features), tuple(order)
        self.family, self.note = "Statistical time series", note
        self.params, self.res = None, None

    def spec(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): features and order.

        Returns:
            dict.
        """
        return {"class": "ARIMAX", "features": self.features, "order": self.order}

    def drivers(self):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): driver features.

        Returns:
            list of str.
        """
        return list(self.features)

    def panel(self, ctx, mdf):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): panel with target, drivers and dummies.

        Args:
            ctx: Context. mdf: macro DataFrame.

        Returns:
            DataFrame.
        """
        return make_panel(ctx, mdf, self.features)

    def _exog(self, P):
        """Exogenous regressors: drivers and dummies.

        Args:
            P: panel.

        Returns:
            DataFrame.
        """
        return P[self.features + _dummies(P)]

    def fit(self, P, start, end):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): maximum-likelihood estimate on start..end.

        Args:
            P: panel. start, end: estimation window.

        Returns:
            self.
        """
        import warnings
        from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX
        W = P.loc[start:end]
        X = self._exog(W)
        X = X.loc[:, X.std() > 0]
        self.cols = list(X.columns)
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
            self.res = SARIMAX(W["y"].values, exog=X.values, order=self.order, trend="c").fit(disp=False)
        self.sm_params, self.start = self.res.params, start
        return self

    def detail_rows(self, ctx, P):
        """Coefficients of the regression part and of the ARMA errors, with maximum-likelihood standard errors.

        Args:
            ctx: Context. P: panel.

        Returns:
            list of dict rows.
        """
        r = self.res
        names = ["const"] + self.cols + [n for n in r.model.param_names if n.startswith(("ar.", "ma.", "sigma2"))]
        rows = []
        for i, n in enumerate(r.model.param_names):
            label = names[i] if i < len(names) else n
            if label.startswith("D_") or label == "sigma2":
                continue
            what = {"const": "constant", "ar.L1": "AR(1) term of the errors", "ma.L1": "MA(1) term of the errors"}.get(label, "")
            rows.append({"model": self.name, "term": label, "coef": float(r.params[i]), "se_hac": float(r.bse[i]),
                         "t": float(r.tvalues[i]), "p": float(r.pvalues[i]),
                         "reading": what or "effect on q/q target growth (ML estimate; errors follow ARMA(1,1))"})
        return rows

    def forecast(self, P, origin, H):
        """Part of the model interface (see src/models/zoo.py): run the Kalman filter with the stored coefficients up to the origin, then forecast with the
        macro path (dummies zero).

        Args:
            P: panel. origin: last known quarter. H: quarters ahead.

        Returns:
            array of forecasts.
        """
        import warnings
        from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        H = min(H, len(P) - pos - 1)
        if H <= 0:
            return np.zeros(0)
        W = P.loc[self.start:origin]
        Xf = P[self.cols].iloc[pos + 1:pos + 1 + H].copy()
        Xf[[c for c in self.cols if c.startswith("D_")]] = 0.0
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
            r = SARIMAX(W["y"].values, exog=W[self.cols].values, order=self.order, trend="c").filter(self.sm_params)
        return np.asarray(r.forecast(H, exog=Xf.values))
