def run_oos(cfg, ctx, approaches, full_sample_drivers, cache, store=None, vintage_out=None, window_out=None):
    """Out-of-sample test: at each origin, re-run selection and re-estimate every model with data up to
    the origin only, then forecast 1..H quarters.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration (oos). ctx: Context. approaches: name -> pipeline module.
        full_sample_drivers: drivers chosen with all data (for the look-ahead check). cache: StepCache.
        store: optional dict, filled with {origin: {model name: pickle bytes}} (each model as estimated at that
            origin) and store["__coefficients__"]: list of coefficient rows by origin.
        vintage_out: optional dict; with oos.macro_vintages it receives "errors" (the same rows forecast with the
            macro forecast of each origin's time) and "coverage" (vintage used and drivers not covered).
        window_out: optional dict; receives "errors": every model re-estimated at each origin on the other
            estimation windows of oos.window_check (same drivers, so only the length of history differs).

    Returns:
        (errors by model/origin/horizon, drivers picked at each origin, horizon).
    """
    o = cfg["oos"]
    H = int(o["horizon"] or cfg["sample"]["horizon"])
    first = pd.Period(o["first_origin"], freq="Q")
    origins = [i for i, p in enumerate(ctx.idx) if p >= first and i < ctx.end][::int(o["step"])]
    if not origins:
        raise RuntimeError("oos.first_origin is after the last usable quarter")
    dq = [pd.Period(q, freq="Q") for q in cfg["sample"]["dummy_quarters"]]
    a, b = (min(dq), max(dq)) if dq else (None, None)
    rows, picks, failed = [], [], {}
    from . import vintages as vt
    vints = vt.load(cfg, log) if vintage_out is not None else {}
    vrows, vcov, wrows = [], [], []
    alts = window_alternatives(cfg, ctx) if window_out is not None else []
    log(f"Out-of-sample: {len(origins)} origins {ctx.idx[origins[0]]}..{ctx.idx[origins[-1]]}, step {o['step']}, "
        f"horizon {H}, {o['window']} window" +
        (f"; window check: {base_window_label(cfg)} vs {', '.join(a[0] for a in alts)}" if alts else ""))
    for k, op in enumerate(origins):
        lab = ctx.idx[op]
        models, sel, est = models_at(cfg, ctx, approaches, op, cache, full_sample_drivers)
        est_full = cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"] if o["window"] == "expanding" else est
        # macro frame with the theme factors as estimated at this origin (their weights use data up to it)
        base_at = truncated(ctx, op, cfg).base if getattr(ctx, "factor_specs", None) else ctx.base
        V, vinfo = vt.frame_at(ctx if base_at is ctx.base else _with_base(ctx, base_at), vints, lab, cfg) \
            if vints else (None, {"vintage": None})
        for m in models:
            try:
                e, fc, act = forecast_errors(ctx, m, op, H, est_full, detail=True, mdf=base_at)
            except Exception as ex:                          # one model failing must not stop the test
                failed[m.name] = f"{type(ex).__name__}: {ex}"
                continue
            if V is not None:                                # the same model, forecasting with the macro forecast
                try:
                    e2, fc2, _ = forecast_with(ctx, m, op, H, V)
                    L0_ = float(ctx.level.loc[lab]) if lab in ctx.level.index else np.nan
                    cov, out_ = vt.coverage(m, vinfo)
                    vcov.append({"origin": str(lab), "model": m.name, "vintage": vinfo["vintage"],
                                 "age_quarters": vinfo["age_quarters"], "drivers_from_vintage": cov,
                                 "drivers_not_in_vintage": ", ".join(out_)})
                    for h, v in enumerate(e2, 1):
                        win = ctx.idx[op + 1:op + h + 1]
                        vrows.append({"origin": str(lab), "model": m.name, "family": m.family, "horizon_q": h,
                                      "error": v, "error_pct": v * 100, "date": str(ctx.idx[op + h]),
                                      "covid_window": bool(a is not None and ((win >= a) & (win <= b)).any()),
                                      "vintage": vinfo["vintage"], "drivers": ", ".join(m.drivers()),
                                      "forecast_growth_pct": float(tg.growth_display(fc2[h - 1])),
                                      "actual_growth_pct": float(tg.growth_display(act[h - 1])),
                                      "balance_at_origin": L0_,
                                      "forecast_balance": tg.level_after(L0_, np.cumsum(fc2)[h - 1]),
                                      "actual_balance_organic": tg.level_after(L0_, np.cumsum(act)[h - 1]),
                                      "actual_balance_reported": float(ctx.level.get(ctx.idx[op + h], np.nan))})
                except Exception as ex:
                    failed[f"{m.name} (macro forecast)"] = f"{type(ex).__name__}: {ex}"
            if store is not None:
                from ..modelling.evaluate import freeze
                store.setdefault(str(lab), {})[m.name] = freeze(ctx, m)
                prm = getattr(m, "params", None)
                if isinstance(prm, pd.Series):
                    store.setdefault("__coefficients__", []).extend(
                        {"origin": str(lab), "model": m.name, "family": m.family, "term": t_, "coef": float(v_)}
                        for t_, v_ in prm.items())
            if m.family in ("Data-driven", "Hybrid"):
                picks.append({"origin": str(lab), "model": m.name, "family": m.family, "drivers": ", ".join(m.drivers())})
            L0 = float(ctx.level.loc[lab]) if lab in ctx.level.index else np.nan
            cf, ca = np.cumsum(fc), np.cumsum(act)
            for h, v in enumerate(e, 1):
                win = ctx.idx[op + 1:op + h + 1]
                covid = bool(a is not None and ((win >= a) & (win <= b)).any())
                d = ctx.idx[op + h]
                rows.append({"origin": str(lab), "model": m.name, "family": m.family, "horizon_q": h, "error": v,
                             "covid_window": covid, "date": str(d), "drivers": ", ".join(m.drivers()),
                             "forecast_growth_pct": float(tg.growth_display(fc[h - 1])),
                             "actual_growth_pct": float(tg.growth_display(act[h - 1])),
                             "balance_at_origin": L0, "forecast_balance": tg.level_after(L0, cf[h - 1]),
                             "actual_balance_organic": tg.level_after(L0, ca[h - 1]),
                             "actual_balance_reported": float(ctx.level.get(d, np.nan)), "error_pct": v * 100})
            if m.family in WINDOW_SKIP:
                continue
            for wlab, n in alts:                     # the same model and drivers, estimated on another window
                start = ctx.est0 if n is None else op - n + 1
                if start < ctx.est0 or pd.Period(ctx.idx[start]) == pd.Period(est_full, freq="Q"):
                    continue                         # not enough history yet, or the same window as the main one
                try:
                    e3 = forecast_errors(ctx, copy.deepcopy(m), op, H, str(ctx.idx[start]), mdf=base_at)
                except Exception as ex:
                    failed[f"{m.name} ({wlab})"] = f"{type(ex).__name__}: {ex}"
                    continue
                for h, v in enumerate(e3, 1):
                    win = ctx.idx[op + 1:op + h + 1]
                    wrows.append({"origin": str(lab), "model": m.name, "family": m.family, "window": wlab,
                                  "est_start": str(ctx.idx[start]), "horizon_q": h, "error": v, "error_pct": v * 100,
                                  "covid_window": bool(a is not None and ((win >= a) & (win <= b)).any())})
        log(f"  origin {lab} ({k + 1}/{len(origins)}): " +
            "; ".join(f"{PRETTY[ap]}: {', '.join(s['features'])}" for ap, s in sel.items()))
    for m, why in failed.items():
        log(f"  {m}: left out of the test ({why[:200]})")
    if vintage_out is not None:
        vintage_out["errors"], vintage_out["coverage"] = pd.DataFrame(vrows), pd.DataFrame(vcov)
        if vints and not vrows:
            log("  macro vintages: no origin had a vintage within oos.macro_vintages.max_age quarters")
    if window_out is not None:
        window_out["errors"] = pd.DataFrame(wrows)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows), pd.DataFrame(picks), H

def window_check(E, W, cfg, horizons):
    """Does the older history help or hurt? Compares, model by model, the errors with the configured estimation
    window against the same model re-estimated on the other windows, at the same origins only.

    Args:
        E: main errors (run_oos). W: window_out["errors"]. cfg: configuration. horizons: report horizons.

    Returns:
        (one row per model and alternative window, one summary row per alternative window), or (None, None).
    """
    if W is None or not len(W):
        return None, None
    base = base_window_label(cfg)
    hmax = max(horizons)
    Ex = E[~E["covid_window"]][["origin", "model", "horizon_q", "error"]]
    rows = []
    for (m, fam, wl), g in W[~W["covid_window"]].groupby(["model", "family", "window"], sort=False):
        j = g.merge(Ex[Ex["model"] == m], on=["origin", "model", "horizon_q"], suffixes=("_alt", "_base"))
        if j.empty:
            continue
        r = {"model": m, "family": fam, "main_window": base, "other_window": wl,
             "origins_compared": j["origin"].nunique()}
        for h in horizons:
            s = j[j["horizon_q"] <= h]
            r[f"main_avg_1_{h}_pct"] = s["error_base"].abs().mean() * 100
            r[f"other_avg_1_{h}_pct"] = s["error_alt"].abs().mean() * 100
        r["change_pct"] = (r[f"other_avg_1_{hmax}_pct"] / r[f"main_avg_1_{hmax}_pct"] - 1) * 100 \
            if r[f"main_avg_1_{hmax}_pct"] else np.nan
        # test on each origin's root-mean-square error over 1..hmax; origins overlap for ceil(hmax/step) of them
        po = j[j["horizon_q"] <= hmax].groupby("origin")[["error_alt", "error_base"]].apply(
            lambda x: np.sqrt((x ** 2).mean()))
        lag = max(1, int(np.ceil(hmax / max(int(cfg["oos"]["step"]), 1))))
        s_, p_, _ = dm_test(po["error_alt"], po["error_base"], lag)
        r["DM_stat"], r["p_value"] = s_, p_
        winner = wl if r["change_pct"] < 0 else base
        if not np.isnan(p_) and p_ < 0.10:
            r["verdict"] = f"{winner} better (significant)"
        elif abs(r["change_pct"]) < 5:
            r["verdict"] = "about the same"
        else:
            r["verdict"] = f"{winner} better (not significant)"
        rows.append(r)
    D = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if D.empty:
        return None, None
    summ = []
    for wl, d in D.groupby("other_window", sort=False):
        summ.append({"main_window": base, "other_window": wl, "models": len(d),
                     "origins_compared": int(d["origins_compared"].max()),
                     f"other_window_better_1_{hmax}": int((d["change_pct"] < 0).sum()),

                     "best_error_other_pct": float(d[f"other_avg_1_{hmax}_pct"].min())})
    return D.sort_values(["other_window", "change_pct"]), pd.DataFrame(summ)

def summarise(E, picks, H, horizons):
    """Summarise out-of-sample errors: MAPE, RMSE, bias and Theil's U by horizon, and the averages
    over 1..h for each comparison horizon.

    Args:
        E: errors from run_oos. picks: drivers by origin. H: horizon. horizons: comparison horizons.

    Returns:
        (summary per model, errors by horizon).
    """
    Ex = E[~E["covid_window"]]
    g = Ex.groupby(["model", "family", "horizon_q"], sort=False)["error"]
    by_h = pd.DataFrame({"MAPE_pct": g.apply(lambda x: x.abs().mean() * 100),
                         "RMSE_pct": g.apply(lambda x: np.sqrt((x ** 2).mean()) * 100),
                         "bias_pct": g.mean() * 100, "n": g.size()}).reset_index()
    bench = by_h[by_h["model"] == "AR(1) benchmark"].set_index("horizon_q")["RMSE_pct"]
    by_h["theil_U_vs_AR"] = by_h.apply(lambda r: r["RMSE_pct"] / bench.get(r["horizon_q"], np.nan), axis=1)
    rows = []
    for (m, fam), d in by_h.groupby(["model", "family"], sort=False):
        d = d.set_index("horizon_q")
        r = {"model": m, "family": fam}
        for h in horizons:
            r[f"avg_1_{h}_pct"] = d["MAPE_pct"].loc[:h].mean()
        for h in horizons:
            r[f"at_{h}q_pct"] = d["MAPE_pct"].get(h, np.nan)
        r[f"theil_U_1_{H}"] = d["theil_U_vs_AR"].mean()
        r[f"bias_1_{H}_pct"] = d["bias_pct"].mean()
        r[f"origins_at_{max(horizons)}q"] = int(d["n"].get(max(horizons), 0))
        rows.append(r)
    summ = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    b = summ.set_index("model").loc["AR(1) benchmark"] if "AR(1) benchmark" in set(summ["model"]) else None
    if b is not None:
        for h in horizons:
            summ[f"vs_AR_1_{h}_pct"] = (1 - summ[f"avg_1_{h}_pct"] / b[f"avg_1_{h}_pct"]) * 100
    summ[f"rank_1_{max(horizons)}"] = summ[f"avg_1_{max(horizons)}_pct"].rank(method="min").astype("Int64")
    # Diebold-Mariano vs benchmark at the report horizons
    dm = []
    piv = Ex.pivot_table(index=["origin", "horizon_q"], columns="model", values="error")
    for m in summ["model"]:
        if m == "AR(1) benchmark" or "AR(1) benchmark" not in piv:
            continue
        for h in horizons:
            if h not in piv.index.get_level_values("horizon_q"):
                continue
            sub = piv.xs(h, level="horizon_q")[[m, "AR(1) benchmark"]].dropna()
            s, p, n = dm_test(sub[m], sub["AR(1) benchmark"], h)
            dm.append({"model": m, "horizon_q": h, "n_origins": n, "DM_stat": s, "p_value": p,
                       "better_than_benchmark_at_5pct": bool(s < 0 and p < 0.05) if not np.isnan(s) else False})
    dm = pd.DataFrame(dm)
    # driver stability
    stab = []
    for m, g in picks.groupby("model", sort=False):
        sets = [set(x.split(", ")) - {""} for x in g["drivers"]]
        jac = [len(s1 & s2) / max(len(s1 | s2), 1) for s1, s2 in zip(sets[:-1], sets[1:])]
        stab.append({"model": m, "family": g["family"].iloc[0], "distinct_driver_sets": len({frozenset(s) for s in sets}),
                     "avg_overlap_with_previous_origin": float(np.mean(jac)) if jac else np.nan,
                     "most_common_drivers": ", ".join(pd.Series([d for s in sets for d in s]).value_counts().head(4).index)})
    return by_h, summ, dm, pd.DataFrame(stab)

def holdout(cfg, ctx, approaches, cache):
    """Select and estimate every model on data up to hist_end - holdout_quarters; forecast the held-out quarters."""
    q = int(cfg["oos"]["holdout_quarters"])
    if q <= 0:
        return None
    op = ctx.end - q
    models, _, est = models_at(cfg, ctx, approaches, op, cache)
    est_full = cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"] if cfg["oos"]["window"] == "expanding" else est
    level0 = ctx.level.iloc[op]
    act = ctx.y.values[op + 1:op + 1 + q]
    out = []
    for m in models:
        try:
            P = m.panel(ctx, ctx.base).loc[:ctx.idx[ctx.end]]
            m.fit(P, pd.Period(est_full, freq="Q"), ctx.idx[op])
            fc = m.forecast(P, ctx.idx[op], q)
        except Exception as ex:
            log(f"  holdout: {m.name} left out ({type(ex).__name__}: {str(ex)[:150]})")
            continue
        for h in range(len(fc)):
            out.append({"model": m.name, "family": m.family, "drivers": ", ".join(m.drivers()) or "(none)",
                        "train_end": str(ctx.idx[op]), "date": str(ctx.idx[op + 1 + h]),
                        "forecast": tg.level_after(level0, np.cumsum(fc)[h]),
                        "actual_organic": tg.level_after(level0, np.cumsum(act)[h]),
                        "error_pct": float(tg.error(np.cumsum(fc)[h], np.cumsum(act)[h])) * 100})
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

src/validation/vintages.py

module src.validation.vintages · 7 items
Macro forecast vintages for a realistic out-of-sample test.

The standard out-of-sample test forecasts with the macro values that actually happened (a conditional forecast):
it measures the model's error but not the error of the macro forecast it would have had to use. With vintages -
the macro forecasts that were available at past dates (for example the baseline scenario published each quarter) -
each origin also forecasts with the forecast of its time, so the test shows what the forecast would really have been.

    oos:
      macro_vintages:
        file: data/vintages/               # a folder of files, one per vintage, the quarter in the file name
                                           #   (baseline_2018Q1.csv, 2018Q1.xlsx, 2018-03.csv ...); or one csv/xlsx
                                           #   file with a vintage column; or one xlsx with a sheet per vintage
        vintage_column: vintage            # in a single long file: the quarter each forecast was made
        date_column: null                  # null = data.macro.date_column
        max_age: 2                         # use a vintage at most this many quarters older than the origin
        splice: true                       # apply the vintage's growth (levels) or changes (rates) from the actual
                                           #   value at the origin, so revisions to history do not create jumps
        missing: actual                    # series not in the vintages: actual (their realised path, reported) or
                                           #   hold (flat at the last actual value)
        rank_on: forecast                  # the recommended model is scored on these errors (forecast) or on the
                                           #   realised-macro ones (realised)

Each vintage table has the date column and the macro series as columns (the same layout as the scenario files);
quarters up to the vintage date are its history, later quarters its forecast.

def _quarter(text):
    """'baseline_2018Q1.csv' -> Period 2018Q1; '2018-03' -> 2018Q1; None if no date."""
    s = str(text)
    m = re.search(r"(19|20)(\d{2})[\s_\-]?[Qq]([1-4])", s)
    if m:
        return pd.Period(f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}Q{m.group(3)}", freq="Q")
    m = re.search(r"(19|20)(\d{2})[\s_\-./]?(0[1-9]|1[0-2])", s)
    if m:
        return pd.Period(f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}-{m.group(3)}", freq="M").asfreq("Q")
    return None

def _table(df, date_col):
    """A vintage table indexed by quarter, numeric columns only."""
    if date_col not in df.columns:
        date_col = df.columns[0]
    q = to_quarters(df[date_col])
    out = df.drop(columns=[date_col]).apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
    out.index = q
    out = out.groupby(level=0).last().sort_index()
    return out.dropna(axis=1, how="all")

def load(cfg, log=print):
    """{vintage quarter: table} from oos.macro_vintages.file, or {} when not set."""
    st = settings(cfg)
    path = st["file"]
    if not path:
        return {}
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"oos.macro_vintages.file not found: {path}")
    dcol = st["date_column"] or cfg["data"]["macro"]["date_column"]
    out = {}
    if os.path.isdir(path):
        for f in sorted(os.listdir(path)):
            if not f.lower().endswith((".csv", ".xlsx", ".xls")):
                continue
            v = _quarter(os.path.splitext(f)[0])
            if v is None:
                log(f"  vintages: {f} has no quarter in its name - skipped")
                continue
            out[v] = _table(read_table(os.path.join(path, f)), dcol)
    elif path.lower().endswith((".xlsx", ".xls")) and len(pd.ExcelFile(path).sheet_names) > 1:
        for sh in pd.ExcelFile(path).sheet_names:
            v = _quarter(sh)
            if v is not None:
                out[v] = _table(pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sh), dcol)
    else:
        df = read_table(path)
        vc = st["vintage_column"]
        if vc not in df.columns:
            raise ValueError(f"vintage file {path} has no '{vc}' column (oos.macro_vintages.vintage_column)")
        for v, g in df.groupby(vc):
            q = _quarter(v) or to_quarters(pd.Series([v])).iloc[0]
            out[q] = _table(g.drop(columns=[vc]), dcol)
    if out:
        ks = sorted(out)
        log(f"  macro forecast vintages: {len(out)} ({ks[0]}..{ks[-1]}), "
            f"{len(set().union(*[set(t.columns) for t in out.values()]))} series")
    return dict(sorted(out.items()))

def pick(vints, origin, max_age):
    """The latest vintage made at or before the origin and at most max_age quarters old, or None."""
    ok = [v for v in vints if v <= origin and (origin - v).n <= int(max_age)]
    return max(ok) if ok else None

def frame_at(ctx, vints, origin, cfg):
    """The macro frame for forecasting from `origin` with the vintage of the time.

    Quarters up to the origin keep the actual history (the models are estimated on it); later quarters take the
    vintage's forecast, spliced on the actual value at the origin (growth for levels, changes for rates).

    Returns:
        (frame or None, info dict: vintage, age, series covered, series not covered).
    """
    st = settings(cfg)
    v = pick(vints, origin, st["max_age"])
    if v is None:
        return None, {"vintage": None}
    V = vints[v]
    M = ctx.base.copy()                                 # keeps the theme-factor key (attrs)
    fut = M.index[M.index > origin]
    cols = [c for c in V.columns if c in M.columns]
    meta = ctx.meta
    for c in cols:
        vv = V[c].reindex(fut)
        if vv.isna().all():
            continue
        if st["splice"]:
            a0 = M.at[origin, c] if origin in M.index else np.nan
            anchor = V[c].loc[:origin].dropna()
            v0 = anchor.iloc[-1] if len(anchor) else np.nan
            lvl = c in meta.index and str(meta.loc[c, "transform"]) == "dlog" and (V[c].dropna() > 0).all() \
                and pd.notna(a0) and a0 > 0
            if pd.notna(a0) and pd.notna(v0) and (v0 > 0 or not lvl):
                vv = a0 * vv / v0 if lvl else a0 + (vv - v0)
        M.loc[fut, c] = vv.where(vv.notna(), M.loc[fut, c]).values
    # constructed series (data.constructed: real rates, spreads, ...) are rebuilt from the spliced inputs
    built = []
    for item in (cfg["data"].get("constructed") or []):
        nm = item.get("name")
        if nm not in M.columns or nm in cols:
            continue
        try:
            new = M.eval(item["expression"], local_dict={"log": np.log, "exp": np.exp}, engine="python")
            M.loc[fut, nm] = pd.Series(new, index=M.index).loc[fut].values
            built.append(nm)
        except Exception:
            pass
    cols = cols + built
    missing = [c for c in M.columns if c not in cols and not str(c).startswith("FAC.")]
    if st["missing"] == "hold" and origin in M.index:
        for c in missing:
            M.loc[fut, c] = M.at[origin, c]
    return M, {"vintage": str(v), "age_quarters": int((origin - v).n), "covered": cols, "not_covered": missing}

def coverage(model, info):
    """Share of a model's driver series that came from the vintage (1 = all)."""
    from ..impact.analysis import used_codes
    codes = [c for c in used_codes(model, info.get("covered", []) + info.get("not_covered", []))]
    if not codes:
        return np.nan, []
    out = [c for c in codes if c in set(info.get("not_covered", []))]
    return 1 - len(out) / len(codes), out

src/reporting/formula.py

module src.reporting.formula · 16 items
The recommended model as a formula you can use by hand, and its forecast for the next quarters.

Only models that are an explicit equation qualify: ARDL regressions (data-driven, literature, hybrid, auto-ARDL),
the error-correction model, the ARDL in levels and the same-growth rules. Machine learning, networks, regime-switching, combinations and
foundation models have no closed formula; when one of them is the most accurate overall it is reported next to
the best formula model, with its forecast but without an equation.

Outputs (outputs/<run>/formula/):
  formula.md                         the equation with its coefficients and what every symbol means
  1_terms.csv                        coefficient of every term
  2_next_quarters.csv                the next quarters under every scenario, term by term
  3_best_overall_next_quarters.csv   the most accurate model overall (when it is not the formula model)
  recommended_model_calculator.xlsx  the same calculation with live Excel formulas: change a driver's future
                                     value (yellow cells) and the growth and balance update

def choose(ranking, models, col, order=None):
    """The recommended model and the best model with a formula.

    With `order` (model names, best first: the scorecard, src/selection/scorecard.py) the first is the recommended
    model and the first with a formula is the formula model; without it, the most accurate ones.

    Args:
        ranking: table with model, family and the error column. models: dict name -> fitted model.
        col: error column (lower is better), e.g. avg_1_12_pct.

    Returns:
        (best overall row, best formula row or None) as Series.
    """
    r = ranking[(ranking["family"] != "Look-ahead check") & ranking[col].notna()].sort_values(col)
    if r.empty:
        return None, None
    if order:
        pos = {m: i for i, m in enumerate(order)}
        r = r.assign(_o=r["model"].map(pos).fillna(len(pos))).sort_values(["_o", col]).drop(columns="_o")
    best = r.iloc[0]
    f = r[r["model"].map(lambda m: m in models and has_formula(models[m]))]
    return best, (f.iloc[0] if len(f) else None)

def definition(feature, deflator=None):
    """What a feature is, as a formula in the raw series.

    Args:
        feature: "code|transform|Llag". deflator: price index used by real transforms.

    Returns:
        str, e.g. "ln(FHPI.ION(t-1) / FHPI.ION(t-2))".
    """
    code, tr, l = parse_feature(feature)
    X = lambda k: _x(code, l + k)                                   # noqa: E731
    P = lambda k: _x(deflator or "CPI", l + k)                       # noqa: E731
    return {"dlog": f"ln({X(0)} / {X(1)})", "dlog2": f"ln({X(0)} / {X(2)})", "yoy": f"ln({X(0)} / {X(4)})",
            "acc": f"ln({X(0)} / {X(4)}) - ln({X(4)} / {X(8)})",
            "gap": f"ln {X(0)} - average of ln {code} over {_x(code, l)}..{_x(code, l + 11)}",
            "rdlog": f"ln({X(0)} / {X(1)}) - ln({P(0)} / {P(1)})", "ryoy": f"ln({X(0)} / {X(4)}) - ln({P(0)} / {P(4)})",
            "diff": f"{X(0)} - {X(1)}", "diff2": f"{X(0)} - {X(2)}", "diff4": f"{X(0)} - {X(4)}", "lvl": X(0),
            "rgap": f"{X(0)} - average of {code} over {_x(code, l)}..{_x(code, l + 11)}"}.get(tr, _window_def(code, tr, l, feature))

def _window_def(code, tr, l, feature):
    """Definition of a moving-window transform (ma, vol, dma, dvol)."""
    w = window(tr)
    if not w:
        return feature
    rate, kind, k = w
    step = f"{code}(s) - {code}(s-1)" if rate else f"ln({code}(s) / {code}(s-1))"
    rng = f"over the {k} quarters ending {_x(code, l).replace(code + '(', '(')}"
    return f"{'average' if kind == 'ma' else 'standard deviation'} of {step} {rng}"

def _lr_def(item, deflator):

def terms(model, meta):
    """The equation term by term.

    Args:
        model: fitted formula model. meta: metadata (descriptions).

    Returns:
        DataFrame: symbol, term, coefficient, definition, meaning.
    """
    p = model.params
    if getattr(model, "kind", "") == "LevelsARDL":
        return terms_levels(model)
    rows = [{"symbol": "c", "term": "const", "coefficient": float(p.get("const", 0.0)), "definition": "1",
             "meaning": "constant (average quarterly growth not explained by the drivers)"}]
    for i in range(1, n_ylags(p) + 1):
        if f"y_lag{i}" in p:
            rows.append({"symbol": f"g(t-{i})", "term": f"y_lag{i}", "coefficient": float(p[f"y_lag{i}"]),
                         "definition": f"ln(L(t-{i}) / L(t-{i + 1}))",
                         "meaning": "last quarter's target growth" if i == 1 else f"target growth {i} quarters earlier"})
    defl = getattr(model, "deflator", None)
    for i, f in enumerate(model.features, 1):
        if f not in p:
            continue
        code, tr, lag = parse_feature(f)
        desc = meta.loc[code, "description"] if code in meta.index else code
        when = "same quarter" if lag == 0 else f"{lag} quarter{'s' if lag > 1 else ''} earlier"
        rows.append({"symbol": f"x{i}(t)", "term": f, "coefficient": float(p[f]), "definition": definition(f, defl),
                     "meaning": f"{desc}: {tr_desc(tr)}, {when}"})
    if "ect_lag1" in p and getattr(model, "beta", None) is not None:
        rows.append({"symbol": "ect(t-1)", "term": "ect_lag1", "coefficient": float(p["ect_lag1"]),
                     "definition": "ln(L*(t-1) / " + f"{defl}(t-1)) - [b0 + sum of b_k * z_k(t-1)], L* = organic balance "
                                   "(one-off acquisitions and sales removed)",
                     "meaning": "last quarter's gap of the real target from their long-run level (error correction)"})
        rows.append({"symbol": "b0", "term": "long run: constant", "coefficient": float(model.beta[0]),
                     "definition": "1", "meaning": "long-run relation: constant"})
        for k, (item, b) in enumerate(zip(model.long_run, model.beta[1:]), 1):
            rows.append({"symbol": f"z{k}(t)", "term": f"long run: {item['mnemonic']}", "coefficient": float(b),
                         "definition": _lr_def(item, defl), "meaning": f"long-run relation: {item['mnemonic']} "
                                                                       f"({item.get('form', 'log')})"})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def n_ylags(p):
    """Number of lagged-growth terms in a parameter vector (y_lag1, y_lag2, ...)."""
    ks = [int(k[5:]) for k in p.index if str(k).startswith("y_lag") and str(k)[5:].isdigit()]
    return max(ks) if ks else 0

def terms_levels(model):
    """The terms of an ARDL in levels: y*(t) = c + sum a_i y*(t-i) + sum b_jk z_j(t-k).

    Args:
        model: fitted LevelsARDL.

    Returns:
        DataFrame: symbol, term, coefficient, definition, meaning.
    """
    p = model.params
    rows = [{"symbol": "c", "term": "const", "coefficient": float(p.get("const", 0.0)), "definition": "1",
             "meaning": "constant"}]
    for i in range(1, model.p + 1):
        rows.append({"symbol": f"y*(t-{i})", "term": f"ys_lag{i}", "coefficient": float(p.get(f"ys_lag{i}", 0.0)),
                     "definition": (f"ln(L*(t-{i}) / {model.deflator}(t-{i}))" if getattr(model, "real", True)
                                    and tg.is_log() else f"ln L*(t-{i})" if tg.is_log() else f"L*(t-{i})"),
                     "meaning": f"{model.target_label()}, {i} quarter{'s' if i > 1 else ''} earlier"})
    for j, (item, n) in enumerate(zip(model.long_run, model.lr_names), 1):
        for k in range(0, model.q[n] + 1):
            d = _lr_def(item, model.deflator).replace("(t)", f"(t-{k})" if k else "(t)").replace("(t-4)", f"(t-{k + 4})")
            rows.append({"symbol": f"z{j}(t-{k})" if k else f"z{j}(t)", "term": f"{n}|L{k}",
                         "coefficient": float(p.get(f"{n}|L{k}", 0.0)), "definition": d,
                         "meaning": f"{item['mnemonic']} ({item.get('form', 'log')})" + (f", {k} quarter(s) earlier" if k else "")})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def equation_text(model, T):
    """The equation in one line plus the balance identity.

    Args:
        model: fitted formula model. T: terms() table.

    Returns:
        str (several lines).
    """
    def num(v):
        return f"{v:.4g}"
    def join(rows):
        out = ""
        rows = [(sym, v) for sym, v in rows if not (sym == "c" and v == 0 and len(rows) > 1)]
        for k, (sym, v) in enumerate(rows):
            piece = num(abs(v)) if sym in ("c", "b0") else (sym if abs(v) == 1 else f"{num(abs(v))}·{sym}")
            out += (("-" if v < 0 else "") + piece) if k == 0 else ((" - " if v < 0 else " + ") + piece)
        return out
    if getattr(model, "kind", "") == "LevelsARDL":
        if not tg.is_log():
            return "\n".join(["y*(t) = " + join(list(zip(T["symbol"], T["coefficient"]))),
                              "g(t) = y*(t) - y*(t-1)", "L(t) = L(t-1) + g(t)",
                              "y*(t) = L*(t), L* = organic level of the target"])
        return "\n".join(["y*(t) = " + join(list(zip(T["symbol"], T["coefficient"]))),
                          f"g(t) = y*(t) - y*(t-1) + ln({model.deflator}(t) / {model.deflator}(t-1))",
                          "L(t) = L(t-1) × exp(g(t))",
                          f"y*(t) = ln(L*(t) / {model.deflator}(t)), L* = organic level (real terms)"])
    is_lr = T["symbol"].str.match(r"^(b0|z\d)")
    s = "g(t) = " + join(list(zip(T.loc[~is_lr, "symbol"], T.loc[~is_lr, "coefficient"])))
    lines = [s, "L(t) = L(t-1) × exp(g(t))" if tg.is_log() else "L(t) = L(t-1) + g(t)"]
    if is_lr.any():
        z = join(list(zip(T.loc[is_lr, "symbol"], T.loc[is_lr, "coefficient"])))
        lines.append(f"ect(t) = ln(L*(t) / {model.deflator}(t)) - [{z}]   (L* = organic level)" if tg.is_log()
                     else f"ect(t) = L*(t) - [{z}]   (L* = organic level)")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def worked(ctx, model, Q):
    """The next Q quarters under every scenario, term by term (identical to model.forecast).

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: fitted formula model. Q: quarters.

    Returns:
        DataFrame: scenario, date, each driver's value and contribution, growth (log, % q/q, % annualised), balance.
    """
    p = model.params
    if getattr(model, "kind", "") == "LevelsARDL":
        return worked_levels(ctx, model, Q)
    origin = ctx.idx[ctx.end]
    L0 = float(ctx.level.iloc[-1])
    ny = n_ylags(p)
    rows = []
    for name, mdf in ctx.macro.items():
        P = model.panel(ctx, mdf)
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        q = min(Q, len(P) - pos - 1)
        past = list(P["y"].iloc[max(0, pos - max(ny, 1) + 1):pos + 1].values)
        L = L0
        ect, logL = None, None
        if "ect_lag1" in p and getattr(model, "beta", None) is not None:
            logL = float(P["__logL"].iloc[pos])
            z = np.r_[1.0, P[model.lr_names].iloc[pos].values]
            ect = (logL - P["__lcpi"].iloc[pos]) - z @ model.beta
        for h in range(1, q + 1):
            row = P.iloc[pos + h]
            r = {"scenario": name, "date": str(P.index[pos + h]), "constant": float(p.get("const", 0.0))}
            g = r["constant"]
            for i in range(1, ny + 1):
                if f"y_lag{i}" in p:
                    r[f"g(t-{i})"] = past[-i]
                    r[f"contribution g(t-{i})"] = p[f"y_lag{i}"] * past[-i]
                    g += r[f"contribution g(t-{i})"]
            for i, f in enumerate(model.features, 1):
                if f in p:
                    r[f"x{i} = {f}"] = float(row[f])
                    r[f"contribution x{i}"] = float(p[f] * row[f])
                    g += r[f"contribution x{i}"]
            if ect is not None:
                r["ect(t-1)"] = float(ect)
                r["contribution ect(t-1)"] = float(p["ect_lag1"] * ect)
                g += r["contribution ect(t-1)"]
            L = tg.level_after(L, g)
            r.update({"growth_log": g, "growth_pct_qq": tg.pct(g),
                      "growth_pct_annualised": tg.annualised(g), "balance": L})
            rows.append(r)
            past.append(g)
            if ect is not None:
                logL += g
                z = np.r_[1.0, row[model.lr_names].values]
                ect = (logL - row["__lcpi"]) - z @ model.beta
        check = np.asarray(model.forecast(P, origin, q))
        got = np.array([x["growth_log"] for x in rows if x["scenario"] == name])
        if len(check) and np.max(np.abs(check - got)) > 1e-9:
            raise RuntimeError(f"formula table differs from the model's forecast for {model.name} / {name}")
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def worked_levels(ctx, model, Q):
    """The next Q quarters of an ARDL in levels, term by term (identical to model.forecast).

    Args:
        ctx: Context. model: fitted LevelsARDL. Q: quarters.

    Returns:
        DataFrame: scenario, date, contributions, y*, inflation, growth, balance.
    """
    p = model.params
    origin = ctx.idx[ctx.end]
    L0 = float(ctx.level.iloc[-1])
    rows = []
    for name, mdf in ctx.macro.items():
        P = model.panel(ctx, mdf)
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        q = min(Q, len(P) - pos - 1)
        ys = list(P["__ys"].iloc[max(0, pos - model.p + 1):pos + 1].values)
        L = L0
        for h in range(1, q + 1):
            t = pos + h
            r = {"scenario": name, "date": str(P.index[t]), "constant": float(p.get("const", 0.0))}
            v = r["constant"]
            for i in range(1, model.p + 1):
                r[f"contribution y*(t-{i})"] = float(p.get(f"ys_lag{i}", 0.0) * ys[-i])
                v += r[f"contribution y*(t-{i})"]
            for j, n in enumerate(model.lr_names, 1):
                for k in range(0, model.q[n] + 1):
                    r[f"z{j} = {n[3:]} (t-{k})"] = float(P[n].iloc[t - k])
                    r[f"contribution z{j}(t-{k})"] = float(p.get(f"{n}|L{k}", 0.0) * P[n].iloc[t - k])
                    v += r[f"contribution z{j}(t-{k})"]
            infl = float(P["__lcpi"].iloc[t] - P["__lcpi"].iloc[t - 1])
            g = v - ys[-1] + infl
            L = tg.level_after(L, g)
            r.update({"y*": v, "inflation (log)": infl, "growth_log": g, "growth_pct_qq": tg.pct(g),
                      "growth_pct_annualised": tg.annualised(g), "balance": L})
            rows.append(r)
            ys.append(v)
        check = np.asarray(model.forecast(P, origin, q))
        got = np.array([x["growth_log"] for x in rows if x["scenario"] == name])
        if len(check) and np.max(np.abs(check - got)) > 1e-9:
            raise RuntimeError(f"formula table differs from the model's forecast for {model.name} / {name}")
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def _col(i):
    """Excel column letters for a 1-based index."""
    s = ""
    while i:
        i, r = divmod(i - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

def _excel_feature(tr, X, P, r, l):
    """Excel formula for a transform at row r with lag l. X(row) / P(row): cell of the series / deflator.

    Returns:
        formula text without the leading '='.
    """
    a = r - l
    w = window(tr)
    if w:                                    # moving windows over the last k quarters
        rate, kind, k = w
        if kind == "ma":
            return f"({X(a)}-{X(a - k)})/{k}" if rate else f"LN({X(a)}/{X(a - k)})/{k}"
        cur, prev = f"{X(a - k + 1)}:{X(a)}", f"{X(a - k)}:{X(a - 1)}"
        g = f"({cur}-{prev})" if rate else f"LN({cur}/{prev})"
        # SUMPRODUCT works on ranges in every Excel version (no array formula needed); same as pandas std (ddof 1)
        return f"SQRT(SUMPRODUCT(({g}-SUMPRODUCT({g})/{k})^2)/{k - 1})"
    if tr == "dlog":
        return f"LN({X(a)}/{X(a - 1)})"
    if tr == "dlog2":
        return f"LN({X(a)}/{X(a - 2)})"
    if tr == "yoy":
        return f"LN({X(a)}/{X(a - 4)})"
    if tr == "acc":
        return f"LN({X(a)}/{X(a - 4)})-LN({X(a - 4)}/{X(a - 8)})"
    if tr == "rdlog":
        return f"LN({X(a)}/{X(a - 1)})-LN({P(a)}/{P(a - 1)})"
    if tr == "ryoy":
        return f"LN({X(a)}/{X(a - 4)})-LN({P(a)}/{P(a - 4)})"
    if tr == "diff":
        return f"{X(a)}-{X(a - 1)}"
    if tr == "diff2":
        return f"{X(a)}-{X(a - 2)}"
    if tr == "diff4":
        return f"{X(a)}-{X(a - 4)}"
    if tr == "lvl":
        return f"{X(a)}"
    if tr == "gap":
        return f"LN({X(a)})-SUMPRODUCT(LN({X(a - 11)}:{X(a)}))/12"
    if tr == "rgap":
        return f"{X(a)}-AVERAGE({X(a - 11)}:{X(a)})"
    raise ValueError(tr)

def write_calculator(path, ctx, model, T, Q, info, best_other=None):
    """The recommended model as a live Excel calculator: one sheet per scenario.

    Blue cells are data (history and the scenario's future values); yellow cells are the future values to change;
    black cells are formulas. Each sheet rebuilds every driver from the raw series, then growth and the balance.

    Args:
        path: .xlsx to write. ctx: Context. model: fitted formula model. T: terms() table. Q: quarters ahead.
        info: dict of facts for the cover sheet (model, basis, error, window). best_other: optional DataFrame,
        the most accurate model overall when it has no formula (written as values).
    """
    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from openpyxl.comments import Comment
    from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Border, Font, PatternFill, Side
    from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

    F = "Arial"
    BLUE = Font(name=F, color="0000FF")
    BOLD, TITLE = Font(name=F, bold=True), Font(name=F, bold=True, size=14)
    HEAD = Font(name=F, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    HFILL, YELLOW = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F6F8B"), PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFFF00")
    GREY = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="EEF3F6")
    thin = Border(bottom=Side(style="thin", color="C9D3DC"))
    wb = Workbook()
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True                     # Excel computes every formula when the file opens

    # ---- cover / equation
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Equation"
    ws["A1"], ws["A1"].font = f"Recommended model: {model.name}", TITLE
    lines = [f"Why this model: {info['why']}",
             f"Estimated on {info['window']} (quarterly). Balance at {info['origin']}: {info['L0']:,.1f}.",
             "How to use: open a scenario sheet, change the yellow cells (future values of the drivers); growth and "
             "the balance update. Blue = data and estimated coefficients, black = formulas, yellow = values to change."]
    for i, t in enumerate(lines, 2):
        ws.cell(i, 1, t).font = Font(name=F)
    r0 = len(lines) + 3
    ws.cell(r0, 1, "Equation").font = BOLD
    for k, line in enumerate(equation_text(model, T).split("\n"), 1):
        ws.cell(r0 + k, 1, line).font = Font(name="Consolas")
    r1 = r0 + 5
    hdr = ["Symbol", "Coefficient", "Definition", "Meaning", "Term in the code"]
    for j, h in enumerate(hdr, 1):
        c = ws.cell(r1, j, h)
        c.font, c.fill = HEAD, HFILL
    coef_ref = {}
    for i, (_, r) in enumerate(T.iterrows(), r1 + 1):
        ws.cell(i, 1, r["symbol"]).font = Font(name=F)
        c = ws.cell(i, 2, float(r["coefficient"]))
        c.font, c.number_format = BLUE, "0.000000"
        c.comment = Comment(f"Estimated by the pipeline on {info['window']}; change it only to test the formula.", "model")
        ws.cell(i, 3, r["definition"]).font = Font(name=F)
        ws.cell(i, 4, r["meaning"]).font = Font(name=F)
        ws.cell(i, 5, r["term"]).font = Font(name=F, color="808080")
        coef_ref[r["term"]] = f"Equation!$B${i}"
    rn = r1 + len(T) + 2
    notes = (["Symbols: g(t) = ln(L(t) / L(t-1)), quarterly growth of the target (log); L = target level; "
              "X(t-k) = series X, k quarters back; ln = natural log.",
              "Growth in % q/q = exp(g) - 1; annualised = exp(4g) - 1."] if tg.is_log() else
             ["Symbols: g(t) = L(t) - L(t-1), quarterly change of the target, in its own units; L = target level; "
              "X(t-k) = series X, k quarters back; ln = natural log.",
              "Change annualised = 4g."]) + [
             "One-off quarters (dummies) are zero in forecasts. The first lagged growth is the last actual organic growth "
             "(one-off events removed)."]
    for k, t in enumerate(notes):
        ws.cell(rn + k, 1, t).font = Font(name=F, italic=True, color="555555")
    for col, w in zip("ABCDE", (14, 14, 52, 70, 26)):
        ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

    # ---- one sheet per scenario
    p = model.params
    defl = getattr(model, "deflator", None) or ctx.cfg["features"].get("deflator")
    feats = [f for f in model.features if f in p]
    series = []
    for f in feats:
        code, tr, lag = parse_feature(f)
        series.append(code)
        if tr in ("rdlog", "ryoy"):
            series.append(defl)
    ecm = "ect_lag1" in p and getattr(model, "beta", None) is not None
    if ecm:
        series += [i["mnemonic"] for i in model.long_run] + [model.deflator]
    series = list(dict.fromkeys(s_ for s_ in series if s_))
    ny = n_ylags(p)
    look = max([lookback(parse_feature(f)[1]) + parse_feature(f)[2] for f in feats] + [4 if ecm else 1, 1, ny])
    origin = ctx.idx[ctx.end]
    L0 = float(ctx.level.iloc[-1])
    yv = np.asarray(ctx.y.values if hasattr(ctx.y, "values") else ctx.y, dtype=float)
    LOG = tg.is_log()
    G_COL = "g: growth (log)" if LOG else "g: change"
    B_COL = "Level"
    YS_COL = "y* = ln(real organic level)" if LOG else "y* = organic level"
    LN_COL = "ln L" if LOG else "L (organic)"
    QQ_COL = "Growth % q/q" if LOG else "Change q/q"
    ANN_COL = "Growth % annualised" if LOG else "Change annualised (x4)"

    def f_level(b, g, r):                      # level from the previous row and this row's change
        return f"={b}{r - 1}*EXP({g}{r})" if LOG else f"={b}{r - 1}+{g}{r}"

    def f_qq(g, r):
        return f"=EXP({g}{r})-1" if LOG else f"={g}{r}"

    def f_ann(g, r):
        return f"=EXP(4*{g}{r})-1" if LOG else f"=4*{g}{r}"
    PCT = "0.00%" if LOG else "0.0000"
    levels = getattr(model, "kind", "") == "LevelsARDL"
    if levels:
        series = [i["mnemonic"] for i in model.long_run] + [model.deflator]
        series = list(dict.fromkeys(series))
        rr_ = any(i.get("form") == "real_rate" for i in model.long_run)
        look = max(max(model.q.values()) + (4 if rr_ else 0), model.p, 1)

    for sname, mdf in ctx.macro.items():
        sh = wb.create_sheet(re.sub(r"[\[\]\*\?/\\:]", "_", str(sname))[:31])
        sh["A1"], sh["A1"].font = f"{model.name}: {sname}", TITLE
        sh["A2"] = "Change the yellow cells (future values of the drivers). Blue = data, black = formulas."
        sh["A2"].font = Font(name=F, italic=True)
        hr = 4
        cols = ["Quarter", "Actual / forecast"] + [f"{c_} (raw)" for c_ in series]
        xcols = [] if levels else [f"x{model.features.index(f) + 1}: {f}" for f in feats]
        cols += xcols
        if levels:
            cols += [f"z{k}: {i['mnemonic']} ({i.get('form', 'log')})" for k, i in enumerate(model.long_run, 1)]
            cols += [YS_COL]
        if ecm:
            cols += [f"z{k}: {i['mnemonic']} ({i.get('form', 'log')})" for k, i in enumerate(model.long_run, 1)]
            cols += [LN_COL, "ect"]                      # ln L = organic log level of the target
        cols += [G_COL, QQ_COL, ANN_COL, B_COL]
        for j, h in enumerate(cols, 1):
            c = sh.cell(hr, j, h)
            c.font, c.fill = HEAD, HFILL
            c.alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="center")
        cidx = {h: j for j, h in enumerate(cols, 1)}
        P = model.panel(ctx, mdf)
        pos = P.index.get_loc(origin)
        q = min(Q, len(P) - pos - 1)
        quarters = list(mdf.index[mdf.index.get_loc(origin) - look:mdf.index.get_loc(origin) + q + 1])
        first = hr + 1
        orow = first + look                                   # the origin row (last actual quarter)
        for k, qt in enumerate(quarters):
            rr = first + k
            fut = rr > orow
            sh.cell(rr, 1, str(qt)).font = BOLD if rr == orow else Font(name=F)
            sh.cell(rr, 2, "forecast" if fut else "actual").font = Font(name=F, color="808080")
            for s_ in series:
                v = float(mdf.loc[qt, s_]) if s_ in mdf.columns and pd.notna(mdf.loc[qt, s_]) else None
                c = sh.cell(rr, cidx[f"{s_} (raw)"], v)
                c.font, c.number_format = BLUE, "#,##0.0000"
                if fut:
                    c.fill = YELLOW
            if rr % 2 == 0:
                for j in range(1, len(cols) + 1):
                    if sh.cell(rr, j).fill != YELLOW:
                        sh.cell(rr, j).fill = GREY

        def X(code):
            col_ = get_column_letter(cidx[f"{code} (raw)"])
            return lambda row: f"{col_}{row}"
        gcol, bcol = get_column_letter(cidx[G_COL]), get_column_letter(cidx[B_COL])
        # actual growth for the lags the equation needs (origin row and, with several lags, the rows above)
        for i in range(0, max(ny, 1)):
            c = sh.cell(orow - i, cidx[G_COL], float(yv[ctx.end - i]))
            c.font, c.number_format = BLUE, "0.000000"
        sh.cell(orow, cidx[G_COL]).comment = Comment(
            "Actual organic target growth (one-off events removed).", "model")
        c = sh.cell(orow, cidx[B_COL], L0)
        c.font, c.number_format = BLUE, "#,##0.0"
        rows_feat = range(orow + 1, orow + q + 1)
        if levels:
            zc = {}
            Pd = X(model.deflator)
            for k, item in enumerate(model.long_run, 1):
                name_ = f"z{k}: {item['mnemonic']} ({item.get('form', 'log')})"
                zc[model.lr_names[k - 1]] = get_column_letter(cidx[name_])
                Xi = X(item["mnemonic"])
                for rr in range(orow - model.q[model.lr_names[k - 1]], orow + q + 1):
                    form = item.get("form", "log")
                    fml = {"log": f"LN({Xi(rr)})", "log_real": f"LN({Xi(rr)}/{Pd(rr)})", "level": f"{Xi(rr)}",
                           "real_rate": f"{Xi(rr)}-100*LN({Pd(rr)}/{Pd(rr - 4)})"}[form]
                    sh.cell(rr, cidx[name_], "=" + fml).number_format = "0.000000"
            ysc = get_column_letter(cidx[YS_COL])
            for i in range(0, model.p):
                c = sh.cell(orow - i, cidx[YS_COL], float(P["__ys"].iloc[pos - i]))
                c.font, c.number_format = BLUE, "0.000000"
            sh.cell(orow, cidx[YS_COL]).comment = Comment(
                (("ln of the organic balance divided by the price index" if getattr(model, "real", True) else

                " (one-off acquisitions and sales removed).", "model")
            for rr in rows_feat:

                parts += [f"{coef_ref[f'{n}|L{k}']}*{zc[n]}{rr - k}" for n in model.lr_names
                          for k in range(0, model.q[n] + 1)]
                sh.cell(rr, cidx[YS_COL], "=" + "+".join(parts)).number_format = "0.000000"
                sh.cell(rr, cidx[G_COL],
                        f"={ysc}{rr}-{ysc}{rr - 1}" + (f"+LN({Pd(rr)}/{Pd(rr - 1)})"
                                                       if LOG and getattr(model, "real", True) else "")
                        ).number_format = "0.000000"
                sh.cell(rr, cidx[QQ_COL], f_qq(gcol, rr)).number_format = PCT
                sh.cell(rr, cidx[ANN_COL], f_ann(gcol, rr)).number_format = PCT
                sh.cell(rr, cidx[B_COL], f_level(bcol, gcol, rr)).number_format = "#,##0.0000"
        if ecm:
            zc = {}
            for k, item in enumerate(model.long_run, 1):
                name_ = f"z{k}: {item['mnemonic']} ({item.get('form', 'log')})"
                zc[k] = get_column_letter(cidx[name_])
                Xi, Pd = X(item["mnemonic"]), X(model.deflator)
                for rr in range(orow, orow + q + 1):
                    form = item.get("form", "log")
                    fml = {"log": f"LN({Xi(rr)})", "log_real": f"LN({Xi(rr)}/{Pd(rr)})", "level": f"{Xi(rr)}",
                           "real_rate": f"{Xi(rr)}-100*LN({Pd(rr)}/{Pd(rr - 4)})"}[form]
                    sh.cell(rr, cidx[name_], "=" + fml).number_format = "0.000000"
            lnc = get_column_letter(cidx[LN_COL])
            Pd = X(model.deflator)
            lnL0 = float(P["__logL"].iloc[pos])
            c = sh.cell(orow, cidx[LN_COL], lnL0)
            c.font, c.number_format = BLUE, "0.000000"
            c.comment = Comment("Organic log level of the target at the last actual quarter: the log of the first balance plus "
                                "all organic growth since (one-off acquisitions and sales removed), as the model uses it.",
                                "model")
            for rr in range(orow + 1, orow + q + 1):
                sh.cell(rr, cidx[LN_COL], f"={lnc}{rr - 1}+{gcol}{rr}").number_format = "0.000000"
            for rr in range(orow, orow + q + 1):
                lr = "+".join([coef_ref["long run: constant"]] +
                              [f"{coef_ref['long run: ' + it['mnemonic']]}*{zc[k]}{rr}"
                               for k, it in enumerate(model.long_run, 1)])
                sh.cell(rr, cidx["ect"], f"={lnc}{rr}" + (f"-LN({Pd(rr)})" if LOG else "") + f"-({lr})"
                        ).number_format = "0.000000"
        for f, xc in zip(feats, xcols):
            code, tr, lag = parse_feature(f)
            for rr in rows_feat:
                fml = _excel_feature(tr, X(code), X(defl) if defl in series else X(code), rr, lag)
                sh.cell(rr, cidx[xc], "=" + fml).number_format = "0.000000"
        for rr in ([] if levels else rows_feat):
            parts = [coef_ref["const"]]
            for i in range(1, ny + 1):
                if f"y_lag{i}" in p:
                    parts.append(f"{coef_ref[f'y_lag{i}']}*{gcol}{rr - i}")
            for f, xc in zip(feats, xcols):
                parts.append(f"{coef_ref[f]}*{get_column_letter(cidx[xc])}{rr}")
            if ecm:
                parts.append(f"{coef_ref['ect_lag1']}*{get_column_letter(cidx['ect'])}{rr - 1}")
            sh.cell(rr, cidx[G_COL], "=" + "+".join(parts)).number_format = "0.000000"
            sh.cell(rr, cidx[QQ_COL], f_qq(gcol, rr)).number_format = PCT
            sh.cell(rr, cidx[ANN_COL], f_ann(gcol, rr)).number_format = PCT
            sh.cell(rr, cidx[B_COL], f_level(bcol, gcol, rr)).number_format = "#,##0.0000"
        for rr in range(orow, orow + q + 1):
            for j in range(1, len(cols) + 1):
                sh.cell(rr, j).border = thin
        for j in range(1, len(cols) + 1):
            sh.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(j)].width = 12 if j > 2 else (11 if j == 1 else 15)
        sh.row_dimensions[hr].height = 45
        sh.freeze_panes = sh.cell(hr + 1, 3)
        sh.cell(orow + q + 2, 1, "Coefficients come from sheet Equation; the rows above the bold quarter are the "

    if best_other is not None and len(best_other):
        sh = wb.create_sheet("Best overall (no formula)")
        sh["A1"], sh["A1"].font = f"Most accurate overall: {best_other['model'].iloc[0]}", TITLE
        sh["A2"] = ("This model has no closed formula (machine learning, network, regime-switching or combination): its "
                    "forecast is shown as values. To update it, re-run the pipeline or use the saved model (fitted/).")
        sh["A2"].font = Font(name=F, italic=True)
        cols = list(best_other.columns)
        for j, h in enumerate(cols, 1):
            c = sh.cell(4, j, h)
            c.font, c.fill = HEAD, HFILL
        for i, (_, r) in enumerate(best_other.iterrows(), 5):
            for j, h in enumerate(cols, 1):
                v = r[h]
                c = sh.cell(i, j, float(v) if isinstance(v, (int, float, np.floating)) else str(v))
                c.font = BLUE if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)) else Font(name=F)
                if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)):
                    c.number_format = "#,##0.00"
        for j in range(1, len(cols) + 1):
            sh.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(j)].width = 22
    for s_ in wb.worksheets:
        for row in s_.iter_rows():
            for c in row:
                if c.font and c.font.name != F and c.font.name != "Consolas":
                    c.font = Font(name=F, bold=c.font.bold, italic=c.font.italic, color=c.font.color, size=c.font.size)
    wb.save(path)

def write(cfg, ctx, models, ranking, basis, log=print, order=None, why_rec=None):
    """Pick the recommended formula model, write the equation, the next quarters and the Excel calculator.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration. ctx: Context. models: dict name -> fitted model. ranking: model table with the
        error columns (out-of-sample summary or backtest comparison). basis: "out of sample" or "backtest".
        log: message function.

    Returns:
        dict with the chosen models and file paths, or None when no model qualifies.
    """
    cols = sorted([c for c in ranking.columns if c.startswith("avg_1_") and c.endswith("_pct")],
                  key=lambda c: int(c.split("_")[2]))
    if not cols or not models:
        return None
    col = cols[-1]
    hq = int(col.split("_")[2])
    best, fbest = choose(ranking, models, col, order)
    if fbest is None:
        log("  formula: no model with an explicit formula in this run")
        return None
    Q = int((cfg.get("save") or {}).get("formula_quarters", 4) or 4)
    m = models[fbest["model"]]
    out = os.path.join(cfg["out_dir"], "formula")
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    T = terms(m, ctx.meta)
    W = worked(ctx, m, Q)
    start = cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"]
    if order and best is not None and best["model"] == fbest["model"]:
        why = f"the recommended model: {why_rec}" if why_rec else "the recommended model (model scorecard)"
    elif order:
        why = (f"the highest-scoring model with a formula on the model scorecard ({basis}, average balance error over "
               f"1–{hq} quarters {fbest[col]:.2f}%)")
    else:
        why = (f"most accurate model with a formula ({basis}, average balance error over 1–{hq} quarters "
               f"{fbest[col]:.2f}%)")
    other = None
    if best is not None and best["model"] != fbest["model"]:
        why += (f"; the recommended model is {best['model']} ({best[col]:.2f}%), which has no formula" if order else
                f"; the most accurate overall is {best['model']} ({best[col]:.2f}%), which has no formula")
        scen_f = os.path.join(cfg["out_dir"], "comparison", "6_scenario_forecasts.csv")
        if os.path.exists(scen_f):
            S = pd.read_csv(scen_f)
            S = S[S["model"] == best["model"]]
            other = S.groupby("scenario", sort=False).head(Q)[["model", "scenario", "date", "dlog_forecast",
                                                                "balance_forecast"]].copy()
            other["growth_pct_qq"] = tg.pct(other["dlog_forecast"])
            other["growth_pct_annualised"] = tg.annualised(other["dlog_forecast"])
            other = other.rename(columns={"dlog_forecast": "growth_log", "balance_forecast": "balance"})
    info = {"why": why, "window": f"{start} to {ctx.idx[ctx.end]}", "origin": str(ctx.idx[ctx.end]),
            "L0": float(ctx.level.iloc[-1])}
    eq = equation_text(m, T)
    md = [f"# Recommended model with a formula: {m.name}", "", why + ".", "", "```", eq, "```", "",
          "| Symbol | Coefficient | Definition | Meaning |", "|---|---|---|---|"]
    md += [f"| {r.symbol} | {r.coefficient:.6g} | {r.definition} | {r.meaning} |" for r in T.itertuples()]
    md += ["", ("g(t) = ln(L(t)/L(t-1)), quarterly growth (log); L = target level; " if tg.is_log() else
                "g(t) = L(t) - L(t-1), quarterly change; L = target level; ") + "X(t-k) = series X k quarters back.",
           f"Estimated on {info['window']}. Next {Q} quarters: 2_next_quarters.csv; live Excel: "
           "recommended_model_calculator.xlsx."]
    if other is not None:
        md += ["", f"## {'Recommended' if order else 'Most accurate overall'}: {best['model']} (no formula)", "",
               "Its forecast for the same quarters is in 3_best_overall_next_quarters.csv."]
    open(os.path.join(out, "formula.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(md) + "\n")
    T.to_csv(os.path.join(out, "1_terms.csv"), index=False)
    W.to_csv(os.path.join(out, "2_next_quarters.csv"), index=False)
    if other is not None:
        other.to_csv(os.path.join(out, "3_best_overall_next_quarters.csv"), index=False)
    elif os.path.exists(os.path.join(out, "3_best_overall_next_quarters.csv")):
        os.remove(os.path.join(out, "3_best_overall_next_quarters.csv"))
    import json
    json.dump({"formula_model": m.name, "formula_family": m.family, "formula_error_pct": float(fbest[col]),
               "best_model": best["model"], "best_family": best["family"], "best_error_pct": float(best[col]),
               "best_has_formula": best["model"] == fbest["model"], "basis": basis, "horizon_q": hq, "quarters": Q,
               "equation": eq, "why": why, "origin": info["origin"], "window": info["window"]},
              open(os.path.join(out, "recommended.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=1)
    xl = os.path.join(out, "recommended_model_calculator.xlsx")
    try:
        write_calculator(xl, ctx, m, T, Q, info, other)
    except Exception as ex:                                   # the CSV and text outputs are still there
        log(f"  formula: Excel calculator not written ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex})")
        xl = None
    log(f"  formula: {m.name} ({why}) -> {os.path.relpath(out)}")
    return {"formula_model": m.name, "best_model": best["model"], "folder": out, "excel": xl}

src/reporting/process_story.py

module src.reporting.process_story · 83 items
The process story: what happened in a run, step by step, for an audience (not at the code level).

Built from a finished run's output tables (and the config's own data files), so it describes exactly what the run
did and found. Each section has:

    part      the chapter it belongs to
    title     the finding, as a sentence
    takeaway  one line: what the audience should remember
    what      what was done, in plain words
    why       why it is done that way
    result    what happened in this run (with its numbers)
    read      how to read the chart or table
    numbers   a few key figures shown as tiles
    chart     a PNG made here       table  a small DataFrame

The same sections are rendered as a long HTML page (src/reporting/story_html.py) and a PowerPoint deck with the
full text in the speaker notes (src/reporting/story_pptx.py). Entry point: tools/process_story.py.

def tr_words(tr):
    """Plain name and meaning of a transform code (moving windows included)."""
    if tr in TR_WORDS:
        return TR_WORDS[tr]
    m = re.match(r"(d?)(ma|vol)(\d+)$", str(tr))
    if m:
        k = m.group(3)
        if m.group(2) == "ma":
            return (f"{k}-quarter average {'change' if m.group(1) else 'growth'}",
                    f"the average quarterly {'change' if m.group(1) else 'growth'} over the last {k} quarters")
        return (f"{k}-quarter volatility", f"how much quarterly {'changes' if m.group(1) else 'growth'} varied over the last {k} quarters")
    return (str(tr), str(tr))

def apply_theme(name=None):
    """Chart colours from a theme (src/reporting/themes.py); call before Story(...).build()."""
    from . import themes as TH
    t = TH.get(name)
    h = lambda k: "#" + k                                    # noqa: E731
    ch = [h(x) for x in t["chart"]]
    C.update(ink=h(t["ink"]), navy=h(t["title"]), teal=ch[0], gold=ch[1], green=ch[2], red=ch[3], purple=ch[4],
             orange=ch[5], grey=ch[6], sea=ch[7], mid=h(t["mid"]), light=h(t["tile"]), line=h(t["line"]),
             sky=h(t["cover_sub"]), bg=h(t["card"]), box=h(t["head_bg"]), box2=h(t.get("box2", t["kicker"])),
             boxfg=h(t["head_fg"]), boxsub=h(t["cover_sub"]) if TH.is_dark(dict(bg=t["cover_bg"])) else "#DDDDDD",
             hl=h(t["highlight"]))
    FAM_COL.update({"Benchmark": C["grey"], "Data-driven": C["teal"], "Literature": C["gold"], "Hybrid": C["green"],
                    "Machine learning": C["purple"], "AI foundation model": C["red"],
                    "Statistical time series": C["orange"], "Regime switching": C["sea"]})
    _style()
    return t

def parse(f):
    """(code, transform, lag) of a feature name 'CODE|tr|L1'; (f, None, None) otherwise."""
    if isinstance(f, str) and f.count("|") == 2:
        c, t, l = f.split("|")
        try:
            return c, t, int(l.lstrip("L"))
        except ValueError:
            return c, t, None
    return f, None, None

class Story:
    """Reads a run and builds its sections.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration (load_config). out: the run's output folder. charts: folder for the PNGs.
    """

    def __init__(self, cfg, out, charts):
        self.cfg, self.out, self.charts = cfg, out, charts
        os.makedirs(charts, exist_ok=True)
        _style()
        self.sections = []
        self.warnings = []

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- reading
    def read(self, *p):
        f = os.path.join(self.out, *p)
        return pd.read_csv(f) if os.path.exists(f) else pd.DataFrame()

    def add(self, part, title, takeaway="", what=(), why=(), result=(), read="", numbers=(), chart=None,
            table=None, table_note="", kind="content"):
        self.sections.append({"part": part, "title": title, "takeaway": takeaway, "what": list(what),
                              "why": list(why), "result": list(result), "read": read,
                              "numbers": [(str(a), str(b)) for a, b in numbers], "chart": chart, "table": table,
                              "table_note": table_note, "kind": kind})

    def fig(self, name, w=9, h=4.4):
        f, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w, h))
        return f, ax, os.path.join(self.charts, f"{name}.png")

    def save(self, f, path):
        f.tight_layout()
        f.savefig(path, dpi=200, facecolor=C.get("bg", "#FFFFFF"))
        plt.close(f)
        return path

    def label(self, f):
        """Plain label of a feature: 'House price index, Ontario: quarterly growth, 1 quarter earlier'."""
        code, tr, lag = parse(f)
        if tr is None:
            return str(f)
        d = self.meta.loc[code, "description"] if code in self.meta.index else code
        when = "same quarter" if lag == 0 else (f"{lag} quarter earlier" if lag == 1 else f"{lag} quarters earlier")
        if str(code).startswith("FAC.") and tr == "lvl":
            return f"{d}, {when}"
        return f"{d}: {tr_words(tr)[0]}, {when}"

    def short(self, f, n=46):
        code, tr, lag = parse(f)
        if tr is None:
            return str(f)
        d = self.meta.loc[code, "description"] if code in self.meta.index else code
        d = re.sub(r"\s*\(.*?\)", "", d)
        s = f"{d} ({tr_words(tr)[0]}, L{lag})"
        return s if len(s) <= n else s[:n - 1] + "…"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- setup
    def load(self):
        from ..utils.io import Context
        cfg = self.cfg
        self.ctx = ctx = Context(cfg)
        self.meta = ctx.meta
        self.level = ctx.level
        self.form = ctx.target_form
        self.growth_word = "growth" if self.form == "dlog" else "change"
        t = cfg.get("target") or {}
        self.TARGET = str(t.get("label") or str(cfg["data"]["bank"]["target_column"]).replace("_", " "))
        if t.get("display_scale"):
            self.SCALE, self.UNITS = float(t["display_scale"]), str(t.get("display_units") or t.get("units") or "")
        elif t.get("units"):
            self.SCALE, self.UNITS = 1.0, str(t["units"])
        else:
            self.SCALE, self.UNITS = (1000.0, "$ billions") if self.form == "dlog" else (1.0, "units")
        if self.form != "dlog" and self.UNITS == "$ billions" and not t.get("units") is None and t.get("units") != "$ billions":
            self.SCALE, self.UNITS = 1.0, str(t["units"])          # a rate run carrying the example's display units
        s = cfg["sample"]
        self.H = int(s.get("horizon", 12))
        self.HZ = sorted({int(h) for h in s.get("report_horizons", [4, 8, 12]) if int(h) <= self.H} | {self.H})
        self.HM = max(self.HZ)
        self.EU = "%" if self.form == "dlog" else ""       # error unit
        self.MAXV = int((cfg.get("final_model") or {}).get("max_vars", 3))
        R = self.read
        self.comp, self.by_h, self.drv, self.diag = (R("comparison", f) for f in (
            "1_model_comparison.csv", "2_backtest_by_horizon.csv", "3_drivers.csv", "4_diagnostics.csv"))
        self.yearend, self.scen, self.paths, self.mlist = (R("comparison", f) for f in (
            "5_scenario_yearend.csv", "6_scenario_forecasts.csv", "7_coefficient_paths.csv", "9_model_list.csv"))
        self.litstat, self.btf = R("comparison", "10_literature_variables.csv"), R("comparison", "12_backtest_forecasts.csv")
        self.forms = R("common", "stationarity_tests.csv")
        self.a1, self.a2, self.a3, self.a4, self.a5, self.a6 = (R("screen_first", f) for f in (
            "A1_screen_all.csv", "A2_screen_best_per_variable.csv", "A3_clusters.csv", "A4_shortlist.csv",
            "A5_search.csv", "A6_search_rules.csv"))
        self.b1, self.b2, self.b3, self.b4, self.b5 = (R("en_first", f) for f in (
            "B1_en_full_sample.csv", "B2_en_stability.csv", "B3_groups.csv", "B4_search.csv", "B5_search_rules.csv"))
        self.c1, self.c2, self.c3, self.c5, self.c6 = (R("bayes_first", f) for f in (
            "C1_bma_settings.csv", "C2_bma_inclusion.csv", "C3_bma_top_models.csv", "C5_search.csv",
            "C6_search_rules.csv"))
        self.oos, self.oos_h, self.dm, self.picks, self.stab, self.hold = (R("oos", f) for f in (
            "1_oos_summary.csv", "2_oos_by_horizon.csv", "3_dm_tests_vs_benchmark.csv", "4_drivers_by_origin.csv",
            "5_driver_stability.csv", "7_holdout.csv"))
        self.terms, self.nextq = R("formula", "1_terms.csv"), R("formula", "2_next_quarters.csv")
        self.e1, self.e2, self.e3 = (R("factors_first", f) for f in ("E1_factors.csv", "E2_loadings.csv",
                                                                     "E3_best_lag.csv"))
        self.f1, self.f2 = R("stable_first", "F1_selection_probabilities.csv"), R("stable_first", "F2_settings.csv")
        self.d1, self.d2, self.d3 = (R("focus_first", f) for f in (
            "D1_focus_drivers.csv", "D2_double_selection.csv", "D3_settings.csv"))
        self.i_tied, self.i_resp, self.i_sens, self.i_rel, self.i_att, self.i_wi = (R("impact", f) for f in (
            "1_tied_models.csv", "2_responses.csv", "3_sensitivity.csv", "4_reliability.csv", "5_attribution.csv",
            "6_what_if.csv"))
        rc = f"avg_1_{self.HM}_pct"
        if self.comp.empty:
            raise SystemExit(f"No results in {self.out}: run run_pipeline.py with this config first")
        if rc not in self.comp:                       # longest horizon available
            hs = sorted(int(c.split("_")[2]) for c in self.comp.columns if re.match(r"avg_1_\d+_pct", c))
            self.HM = hs[-1]
            self.HZ = [h for h in self.HZ if h <= self.HM] or [self.HM]
        self.HAVE_OOS = not self.oos.empty and f"avg_1_{self.HM}_pct" in self.oos
        rank = (self.oos[self.oos["family"] != "Look-ahead check"] if self.HAVE_OOS else self.comp).copy()
        rank = rank.drop(columns=["drivers"], errors="ignore").merge(self.mlist[["model", "drivers"]], on="model",
                                                                      how="left")
        rank["n_vars"] = rank["drivers"].map(self._n_vars)
        rank["single_equation"] = rank["family"].isin(["Data-driven", "Literature", "Hybrid"]) & rank["n_vars"].notna()
        self.rank = rank.sort_values(f"avg_1_{self.HM}_pct").reset_index(drop=True)
        within = self.rank[self.rank["single_equation"] & self.rank["n_vars"].between(1, self.MAXV)]
        self.REC = (within.iloc[0] if len(within) else self.rank.iloc[0])
        self.SC = R("recommendation", "1_scorecard.csv")
        self.SCJ = {}
        rj = os.path.join(self.out, "recommendation", "recommended.json")
        if os.path.exists(rj):                     # the model scorecard decides (src/selection/scorecard.py)
            self.SCJ = json.load(open(rj, encoding="utf-8"))
            hit = self.rank[self.rank["model"] == self.SCJ.get("model")]
            if len(hit):
                self.REC = hit.iloc[0]
        self.AR = self.rank.set_index("model").loc["AR(1) benchmark"] if "AR(1) benchmark" in set(self.rank["model"]) else None
        self.basis = ("out of sample (drivers re-chosen at every origin)" if self.HAVE_OOS
                      else "rolling backtest (drivers chosen on all the data)")
        self.rec_drivers = [d for d in str(self.REC.get("drivers", "")).split(", ") if "|" in d]
        self.u = (lambda v: f"{v / self.SCALE:,.1f}") if self.form == "dlog" else (lambda v: f"{v / self.SCALE:,.2f}")
        self.ulab = self.UNITS

    @staticmethod
    def _n_vars(s):
        if not isinstance(s, str) or s == "(none)":
            return 0
        if "%" in s:
            return np.nan
        return len({d.replace("long run: ", "").split("|")[0].split(":")[0] for d in s.split(", ")})

    def err(self, v):
        return pct(v) if self.EU == "%" else num(v, 3)

    # ================================================================================================ sections
    def build(self):
        self.load()
        for f in (self.s_title, self.s_question, self.s_impact_headline, self.s_overview, self.s_target, self.s_events, self.s_macro,
                  self.s_signs, self.s_literature, self.s_transforms, self.s_stationarity, self.s_lags,
                  self.s_funnel, self.s_screen, self.s_bestform, self.s_clusters, self.s_shortlist, self.s_en,
                  self.s_stability, self.s_bayes, self.s_factors, self.s_stable, self.s_focus, self.s_search_rules, self.s_search_rank, self.s_search_pick, self.s_families, self.s_twins,
                  self.s_backtest_design, self.s_one_origin, self.s_all_origins, self.s_leaderboard,
                  self.s_by_horizon, self.s_oos_design, self.s_oos_gap, self.s_oos_vintages, self.s_driver_stability, self.s_holdout,
                  self.s_scorecard, self.s_rec_model, self.s_rec_effects, self.s_rec_fit, self.s_coef_paths, self.s_diagnostics,
                  self.s_scen_inputs, self.s_scen_forecast, self.s_contrib, self.s_scen_check,
                  self.s_impact_responses, self.s_impact_reliability, self.s_impact_attribution, self.s_impact_whatif,
                  self.s_limits,
                  self.s_recommend, self.s_glossary, self.s_settings):
            try:
                f()
            except Exception as e:                    # one missing table never stops the story
                self.warnings.append(f"{f.__name__[2:]}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        return self.sections

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- part 0
    def s_title(self):
        c = self.cfg
        self.add("", f"How the {self.TARGET} forecast was built",
                 f"A step-by-step account of run '{c['run_name']}': the data, every choice the process made, how "
                 f"the models were tested and what they forecast.",
                 kind="title",
                 numbers=[("Run", c["run_name"]), ("History", f"{self.ctx.idx[self.ctx.est0]} to {self.ctx.idx[self.ctx.end]}"),
                          ("Horizon", f"{self.H} quarters"), ("Models compared", str(len(self.comp)))])

    def s_question(self):
        L = self.level
        last, q = L.iloc[-1], L.index[-1]
        g1 = (L.iloc[-1] / L.iloc[-5] - 1) * 100 if self.form == "dlog" and len(L) > 4 else None
        scen = list(self.cfg["data"]["macro"]["scenarios"])
        self.add("1. The question", f"We forecast the {self.TARGET} for the next {self.H} quarters under "
                 f"{plural(len(scen), 'scenario')}",
                 f"The model must forecast well, be explainable driver by driver, and respond sensibly to "
                 f"economic scenarios.",
                 what=[f"The target is the {self.TARGET}, observed quarterly. The latest value ({q}) is "
                       f"{self.u(last)} {self.ulab}" + (f", {g1:+.1f}% over the last year." if g1 is not None else "."),
                       f"The forecast runs {self.H} quarters ahead of the last observed quarter, under each of the "
                       f"scenarios provided: {', '.join(scen)}.",
                       "Rather than forecasting the level directly, the model forecasts the quarterly "
                       f"{self.growth_word} and adds it up, quarter after quarter, to get the level."],
                 why=["Three requirements shape every choice in the process:",
                      "Accuracy: the forecast is judged on how close the forecast level comes to the actual level, "
                      "1 to 12 quarters ahead, in tests that only use information available at the time.",
                      "Explainability: the recommended model is a short equation with a few economic drivers, each "
                      "with the sign economic theory expects, so every movement in the forecast can be traced to a driver.",
                      "Scenario readiness: the drivers must be variables that the scenario providers forecast, so the "
                      "model can be run under each scenario."],
                 result=[f"The process compared {len(self.comp)} models from {self.comp['family'].nunique()} "
                         f"families before recommending one."],
                 numbers=[("Latest value", f"{self.u(last)} {self.ulab}"), ("As of", str(q)),
                          ("Forecast", f"{self.H} quarters"), ("Scenarios", str(len(scen)))])

    def s_overview(self):
        n_var = self.forms["mnemonic"].nunique() if not self.forms.empty else len(self.meta)
        n_feat = len(self.a1) if not self.a1.empty else None
        steps = [("Prepare the target", "Organic growth: one-off events removed"),
                 ("Collect macro data", f"{len(self.meta):,} series, expected signs"),
                 ("Build candidates", f"{n_var} variables x forms x lags = {num(n_feat) if n_feat else 'many'} candidates"),
                 ("Choose drivers", "Two independent approaches, same final search"),
                 ("Compete", f"{len(self.comp)} models in {self.comp['family'].nunique()} families"),
                 ("Test", "Backtest and out-of-sample test, 1-12 quarters"),
                 ("Recommend", f"{self.REC['model']}"),
                 ("Forecast", "Every scenario, explained driver by driver")]
        f, ax, p = self.fig("overview", 11, 4.6)
        ax.axis("off")
        ax.grid(False)
        for i, (h, s) in enumerate(steps):
            col_, row = i % 4, i // 4
            x, yb = col_ * 0.25, 0.53 - row * 0.5
            ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x + 0.008, yb), 0.234, 0.42,
                                       color=C.get("box", C["navy"]) if i not in (3, 5) else C.get("box2", C["teal"]),
                                       transform=ax.transAxes))
            ax.text(x + 0.03, yb + 0.33, f"{i + 1}", ha="left", va="center", color=C.get("hl", C["gold"]), fontsize=20,
                    fontweight="bold", transform=ax.transAxes)
            ax.text(x + 0.03, yb + 0.21, h, ha="left", va="center", color=C.get("boxfg", "white"), fontsize=12.5,
                    fontweight="bold", transform=ax.transAxes)
            ax.text(x + 0.03, yb + 0.12, "\n".join(_wrap(s, 30)), ha="left", va="top", color=C.get("boxsub", "#C9DCE6"),
                    fontsize=9.5, transform=ax.transAxes)
        self.add("1. The question", "Eight steps take raw data to a tested, explained forecast",
                 "Each step narrows the possibilities or tests what is left; the rest of this document follows them in order.",
                 what=[f"{i + 1}. {h}: {s}." for i, (h, s) in enumerate(steps)],
                 why=["The process is fully automatic and repeatable: the same data and settings always give the "
