def target_rows(path):
    """The target_names sheet: target, your_name, form, units, label, like, new (True for rows you added)."""
    sh = _sheets(path) if path and is_master(path) else {}
    if TARGET_SHEET not in sh:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["target", "your_name", "form", "units", "label", "like", "new"])
    d = _norm(sh[TARGET_SHEET])
    out = pd.DataFrame({k: (d[k].map(_blank) if k in d else "") for k in
                        ("target", "your_name", "form", "units", "label", "like", "source")})
    out = out[(out["target"] != "") | (out["your_name"] != "")]
    out["target"] = [t or y for t, y in zip(out["target"], out["your_name"])]
    out["new"] = out["source"] != "master"
    return out.drop(columns="source").reset_index(drop=True)

def new_macro(path):
    """Macro series you added to macro_names (rows whose source is not 'master'): one row per series, with
    mnemonic (code, else your_name), description, geography, theme, transform and the signs."""
    sh = _sheets(path) if path and is_master(path) else {}
    if NAMES_SHEET not in sh:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    d = _norm(sh[NAMES_SHEET])
    if "source" not in d:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    d = d[d["source"].map(_blank) != "master"]
    rows = []
    for _, r in d.iterrows():
        code, yn = _blank(r.get("code")), _blank(r.get("your_name"))
        if not (code or yn):
            continue
        rows.append({"mnemonic": code or yn, "description": _blank(r.get("description")) or (code or yn),
                     "geography": _blank(r.get("geography")), "theme": _blank(r.get("theme")) or "Other",
                     "transform": _blank(r.get("transform")) or "dlog",
                     "expected_sign": pd.to_numeric(r.get("expected_sign"), errors="coerce"),
                     "signs_by_target": _blank(r.get("signs_by_target"))})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def _sign_for(row, target):
    for part in re.split(r"[;,]", row["signs_by_target"] or ""):
        if ":" in part:
            t, v = part.split(":", 1)
            if _match([t.strip()], target) or t.strip().lower() == "all":
                try:
                    return int(float(v.strip().replace("+", "")))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
    s = row["expected_sign"]
    return 0 if s is None or pd.isna(s) else int(s)

def extract(path, target, folder, names=None):
    """Write one target's workbook and metadata from the master.

    Args:
        path: the master .xlsx. target: target name. folder: where to write.
        names: {master code: your name} (see name_map); default: the master's macro_names sheet.

    Returns:
        dict workbook=<xlsx or None>, metadata=<csv or None>, target=<the master's name for it>.

    Raises:
        ValueError naming the targets the master has when target is not one of them.
    """
    s = _sheets(path)
    tset = set()
    for n in ("models", "concepts", "metadata"):
        if n in s and "target" in _norm(s[n]):
            tset |= set(_norm(s[n])["target"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip())
    tr = target_rows(path)
    added = {r.target: r for r in tr.itertuples() if r.new and _match(tset, r.target) is None}
    if not target:
        raise ValueError(f"{os.path.basename(path)} is a master file: say which target with literature.target "
                         f"(it has: {', '.join(sorted(tset | set(added)))})")
    t = _match(tset, target)
    like = None
    if t is None:                                    # a target you added in target_names
        t = _match(list(added), target)
        if t is None:
            raise ValueError(f"target '{target}' is not in {os.path.basename(path)}; set literature.target to one "
                             f"of: {', '.join(sorted(tset | set(added)))} (or add it to the target_names sheet)")
        like = _match(tset, added[t].like) if added[t].like else None
        if added[t].like and like is None:
            raise ValueError(f"target_names: '{t}' is like '{added[t].like}', which is not a target of the master")
    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
    names = name_map(path) if names is None else names

    src = like or t                                  # whose rows: the target's own, or those of the one it is like
    generic = t in added and like is None

    def rows(name):
        d = _norm(s[name])
        d = d[d["target"].astype(str).str.strip() == (None if generic else src)].drop(columns="target")
        return d.reset_index(drop=True)

    out = {"workbook": None, "metadata": None, "target": t, "like": like, "generic": generic}
    if "models" in s and "concepts" in s and len(rows("models")):
        wb = {WB_SHEETS[k]: rows(k) for k in WB_SHEETS if k in s and "target" in _norm(s[k])}
        if "concepts" in wb:
            wb["concepts"] = _rename_concepts(wb["concepts"], names)
        if "settings" in wb:
            wb["settings"] = _rename_settings(wb["settings"], names)
        if "how to fill" in wb and "line" in wb["how to fill"]:
            wb["how to fill"] = wb["how to fill"][["line"]].rename(columns={"line": "How to fill this workbook"})
        if "references" in s:
            r = _norm(s["references"])
            if "used_by" in r:
                used = r["used_by"].fillna("").astype(str).str.split(",").map(lambda xs: {x.strip() for x in xs})
                r = r[used.map(lambda u: t in u)].drop(columns="used_by")
            wb["references"] = r.reset_index(drop=True)
        f = os.path.join(folder, f"{t}_literature_workbook.xlsx")
        _write_if_changed(f, wb)
        out["workbook"] = f
    if "metadata" in s and "target" in _norm(s["metadata"]):
        if generic:                                  # no literature: every series of the master, sign free
            m = _norm(s["metadata"]).drop(columns="target").drop_duplicates("mnemonic")
            m = m[[c for c in ("mnemonic", "description", "geography", "theme", "transform") if c in m]]
            m = m.assign(expected_sign=0).reset_index(drop=True)
        else:
            m = rows("metadata")
        m = m[[c for c in m.columns if c in ("mnemonic", "expected_sign") or m[c].notna().any()]]   # other targets' columns
        nm = new_macro(path)
        if len(nm):                                  # series you added in macro_names
            nm = nm.assign(expected_sign=[_sign_for(r, t) for _, r in nm.iterrows()])
            nm = nm[~nm["mnemonic"].isin(set(m["mnemonic"].astype(str)))]
            m = pd.concat([m, nm.drop(columns="signs_by_target")], ignore_index=True)
        m = _rename_meta(m, names)
        if len(m):
            f = os.path.join(folder, f"macro_metadata_{t}.csv")
            text = m.to_csv(index=False)
            if not (os.path.exists(f) and open(f, encoding="utf-8").read() == text):
                with open(f, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
                    fh.write(text)
            out["metadata"] = f
    return out

def _write_if_changed(f, sheets):
    """Write the workbook only when its content changed (keeps the file hash, and so the cache, stable)."""
    if os.path.exists(f):
        try:
            old = pd.read_excel(f, sheet_name=None)
            if set(old) == set(sheets) and all(
                    old[k].fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist() == sheets[k].fillna("").astype(str).values.tolist()
                    and list(old[k].columns) == list(sheets[k].columns) for k in sheets):
                return
        except Exception:
            pass
    with pd.ExcelWriter(f) as w:
        for name, d in sheets.items():
            d.to_excel(w, sheet_name=name, index=False)

def resolve(path, kind, target, folder):
    """path if it is an ordinary file; the target's extracted file if path is a master.

    Args:
        kind: "workbook" or "metadata". target: target name. folder: where extracted files go.
    """
    if not is_master(path):
        return path
    f = extract(path, target, folder)[kind]
    if f is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{os.path.basename(path)} has no {kind} rows for target '{target}'")

def apply(cfg, folder):
    """Resolve literature.master / a master given as literature.workbook or data.metadata.file, in place.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration (paths already absolute). folder: where extracted files go.

    Returns:
        the target name used, or None when no master is involved.
    """
    lit = cfg.setdefault("literature", {})
    md = cfg["data"].setdefault("metadata", {})
    master = lit.get("master")
    if master:
        lit["workbook"] = lit.get("workbook") or master
        md["file"] = md.get("file") or master
    src_master = next((p for p in (master, lit.get("workbook"), md.get("file")) if is_master(p)), None)
    names = name_map(src_master, lit.get("names"))
    if names:
        rename_config(cfg, names)
    if not src_master:
        if names:                                    # plain workbook and metadata: renamed copies
            _rename_plain(cfg, names, folder)
        return None
    target = lit.get("target")
    if not target:                         # not given: the target column's name, else the run name, if the master has it
        src = lit["workbook"] if is_master(lit.get("workbook")) else md["file"]
        tnames = list(targets(src)["target"])
        tc = cfg["data"]["bank"].get("target_column")
        tr = target_rows(src)
        yours = {_blank(y).lower(): t for t, y in zip(tr["target"], tr["your_name"]) if y}
        mapped = ((cfg.get("targets") or {}).get("map") or {}).get(tc) or yours.get(str(tc).strip().lower())
        target = next((x for x in (mapped, tc, cfg.get("run_name")) if x and _match(tnames, x)), mapped or tc)
    used = None
    row = next((r for r in target_rows(src_master).itertuples() if _match([r.target], target or "")), None)
    if row is not None:                              # form, units and label from target_names (the config wins)
        tc_ = cfg.setdefault("target", {})
        if row.form and str(tc_.get("transform", "auto")).lower() in ("auto", "none", ""):
            tc_["transform"] = row.form
        if row.units and not tc_.get("units"):
            tc_["units"] = row.units
        if row.label and not tc_.get("label"):
            tc_["label"] = row.label
    if is_master(lit.get("workbook")):
        x = extract(lit["workbook"], target, folder, names)
        lit["workbook"], used = x["workbook"], x["target"]
        if x.get("generic"):                         # a target you added without 'like': every series, free sign
            cfg.setdefault("features", {})["require_sign_prior"] = False
        if lit["workbook"] is None:                  # metadata only: the theory-based models are off
            m = cfg.setdefault("models", {})
            m["literature"], m["hybrids"], m["same_growth"] = False, False, []
            aa = m.setdefault("auto_ardl", {})
            aa["on"] = [k for k in aa.get("on", ["core", "screen_first"]) if k != "core"] or ["screen_first"]
    if lit["workbook"]:                              # same-growth models: keep the concepts this target has
        ids = set(pd.read_excel(lit["workbook"], sheet_name="concepts")["concept_id"].astype(str).str.strip())
        m = cfg.setdefault("models", {})
        m["same_growth"] = [v for v in (m.get("same_growth") or [])
                            if not isinstance(v, str) or v in ids or "." in v]
    if is_master(md.get("file")):
        x = extract(md["file"], target, folder, names)
        if x["metadata"] is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{os.path.basename(md['file'])} has no metadata rows for target '{x['target']}': "
                             f"give its metadata file as data.metadata.file (the literature still comes from the master)")
        md["file"], used = x["metadata"], x["target"]
        md["sheet"] = None
    return used

def rename_config(cfg, names):
    """Master codes named in the config -> your names: deflator, constructed series, same-growth drivers, follow."""
    fe = cfg.get("features") or {}
    if fe.get("deflator"):
        fe["deflator"] = names.get(fe["deflator"], fe["deflator"])
    for c in (cfg["data"].get("constructed") or []):
        if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("expression"):
            c["expression"] = rename_expr(c["expression"], names)
    m = cfg.get("models") or {}
    if m.get("same_growth"):
        m["same_growth"] = [rename_expr(v, names) if isinstance(v, str) else v for v in m["same_growth"]]
    tr = cfg.get("trace") or {}
    if isinstance(tr.get("follow"), str):
        tr["follow"] = rename_expr(tr["follow"], names)

def _rename_plain(cfg, names, folder):
    """A plain literature workbook and metadata file with the names map applied (written to folder)."""
    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
    lit, md = cfg["literature"], cfg["data"]["metadata"]
    if lit.get("workbook") and os.path.exists(lit["workbook"]):
        wb = pd.read_excel(lit["workbook"], sheet_name=None)
        if "concepts" in wb:
            wb["concepts"] = _rename_concepts(wb["concepts"], names)
        if "settings" in wb:
            wb["settings"] = _rename_settings(wb["settings"], names)
        f = os.path.join(folder, "literature_workbook_renamed.xlsx")
        _write_if_changed(f, wb)
        lit["workbook"] = f
    if md.get("file") and os.path.exists(md["file"]):
        from .io import read_table
        d = read_table(md["file"], md.get("sheet"))
        col = (md.get("columns") or {}).get("mnemonic", "mnemonic")
        if col in d:
            d[col] = d[col].map(lambda v: names.get(str(v).strip(), v))
            f = os.path.join(folder, "macro_metadata_renamed.csv")
            text = d.to_csv(index=False)
            if not (os.path.exists(f) and open(f, encoding="utf-8").read() == text):
                open(f, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(text)
            md["file"], md["sheet"] = f, None

def rename_tree(obj, names, skip=("file", "data", "metadata", "literature", "events", "master", "names", "folder", "output_dir")):
    """Master codes -> your names everywhere in a nested config (strings equal to a code, or expressions
    containing one); path-like keys are left alone."""
    if not names:
        return obj
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: (v if k in skip else rename_tree(v, names, skip)) for k, v in obj.items()}
    if isinstance(obj, list):
        return [rename_tree(v, names, skip) for v in obj]
    if isinstance(obj, str):
        return names.get(obj.strip(), None) or rename_expr(obj, names)
    return obj

def write_names(names, folder):
    """The names map as a CSV (code, your_name), for runs that start from extracted files."""
    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)

    pd.DataFrame({"code": list(names), "your_name": list(names.values())}).to_csv(f, index=False)

src/utils/multi.py

module src.utils.multi · 6 items

Several targets in one data file: which columns can be forecast, and the config for each one.

A data file can hold many target series side by side (date, cre_loans, heloc_balances, stage2_share, ...). With a literature master (literature.master), each column is matched to the master's rows for that target, so every target gets its own literature models and its own expected signs. Used by run_targets.py and the app.

Matching a column to a master target: targets.map in the config first ({column: master target}), then the master's target_names sheet (your_name = the column), then the same name (case, spaces, hyphens and underscores ignored). A column with no match can still run with a metadata file given in the config, without literature models. Targets of target_names whose your_name is not a column of the file are listed as "not in your data"; targets with a blank your_name are the ones you do not have, and are not listed.

The target form (growth or change) is suggested per target: targets.forms in the config first, then 'diff' for rates, ratios, shares, margins and anything that is negative or crosses zero, else 'dlog'.

def columns(cfg):
    """The numeric columns of the target file (the date and bank columns left out).

    Args:
        cfg: configuration (data.bank).

    Returns:
        DataFrame indexed by quarter, one column per series.
    """
    b = cfg["data"]["bank"]
    df = read_table(b["file"], b.get("sheet"))
    dc = b["date_column"]
    skip = {dc, b.get("panel_column")}
    num = [c for c in df.columns if c not in skip and pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce").notna().mean() > 0.5]
    out = df[num].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
    out.index = to_quarters(df[dc])
    return out

def suggest_form(name, series, forms=None):
    """'diff' or 'dlog' for a target.

    Args:
        name: column name. series: its values. forms: {name: form} from the config (wins).
    """
    forms = {_key(k): v for k, v in (forms or {}).items()}
    if _key(name) in forms:
        return forms[_key(name)]
    s = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce").dropna()
    if len(s) and (s <= 0).any():
        return "diff"
    return "diff" if DIFF_WORDS.search(str(name)) else "dlog"

def catalog(cfg, master=None):
    """Every column of the target file with its match in the master, history and suggested form.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration. master: literature master file (default literature.master).

    Returns:
        DataFrame: column, master_target, literature (models in the master), metadata (rows), first, last,
        quarters, form, ready.
    """
    X = columns(cfg)
    master = master or (cfg.get("literature") or {}).get("master")
    T = ms.targets(master) if master and ms.is_master(master) else pd.DataFrame(columns=["target"])
    names = list(T["target"]) if len(T) else []
    tcfg = cfg.get("targets") or {}
    TR = ms.target_rows(master) if master and ms.is_master(master) else ms.target_rows(None)
    sheet = {_key(r.your_name): r for r in TR.itertuples() if r.your_name}
    mp = {k: r.target for k, r in sheet.items()}
    mp.update({_key(k): v for k, v in (tcfg.get("map") or {}).items()})
    mdf = (cfg["data"].get("metadata") or {}).get("file")
    own_meta = bool(mdf) and os.sep + os.path.join("inputs", "master") + os.sep not in str(mdf) and not ms.is_master(mdf)
    rows = []
    forms = dict(tcfg.get("forms") or {})
    for k, r in sheet.items():                       # the sheet's form wins over the guess, the config over both
        if r.form and k not in {_key(x) for x in forms}:
            forms[k] = r.form
    for c in X.columns:
        s = X[c].dropna()
        m = mp.get(_key(c)) or ms._match(names, c)
        m = ms._match(names, m) if m and names else m
        info = T.set_index("target").loc[m] if m in names else None
        sr = sheet.get(_key(c))
        rows.append({"column": c, "master_target": m or "", "literature": int(info["models"]) if info is not None and "models" in info else 0,
                     "metadata": int(info["metadata"]) if info is not None and "metadata" in info else 0,
                     "like": (info.get("like") or "") if info is not None and "like" in info else "",
                     "first": str(s.index[0]) if len(s) else "", "last": str(s.index[-1]) if len(s) else "",
                     "quarters": len(s), "form": suggest_form(c, s, forms),
                     "units": sr.units if sr is not None else "", "label": sr.label if sr is not None else "",
                     "ready": bool(len(s) >= 40 and (info is not None and info.get("metadata", 0) > 0
                                                     or own_meta)), "note": ""})
    have = {_key(c) for c in X.columns}
    for k, r in sheet.items():                       # filled in target_names, but not a column of the file
        if k not in have:
            rows.append({"column": r.your_name, "master_target": r.target, "literature": 0, "metadata": 0, "like": "",
                         "first": "", "last": "", "quarters": 0, "form": r.form, "units": r.units, "label": r.label,
                         "ready": False, "note": "not in your data (check your_name in target_names)"})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def target_config(base, row, run_prefix=None):
    """The config for one target, as a dict (written as YAML by the caller).

    Args:
        base: the raw config dict (as in the YAML file). row: a catalog row. run_prefix: run name prefix.
    """
    c = copy.deepcopy(base)
    col = row["column"]
    c["run_name"] = f"{run_prefix or base.get('run_name', 'run')}_{_key(col)}"
    c.setdefault("data", {}).setdefault("bank", {})["target_column"] = col
    lit = c.setdefault("literature", {})
    if row.get("master_target") and lit.get("master"):
        lit["target"] = row["master_target"]
        lit.pop("workbook", None)                  # the master's rows, not the base config's workbook
        if row.get("metadata", 0) > 0:             # the master's metadata for this target
            c["data"].setdefault("metadata", {}).pop("file", None)
        if row.get("literature", 0) == 0:
            lit["workbook"] = None
    t = c.setdefault("target", {})
    t["transform"] = row["form"]
    t["label"] = (base.get("targets") or {}).get("labels", {}).get(col) or row.get("label") or str(col).replace("_", " ")
    if row["form"] == "diff":
        t["display_scale"], t["display_units"] = None, None
        t["units"] = (base.get("targets") or {}).get("units", {}).get(col) or row.get("units") or ""
    else:
        u = (base.get("targets") or {}).get("units", {}).get(col) or row.get("units")
        if u:
            t["units"], t["display_scale"], t["display_units"] = u, None, None
    if not row.get("master_target") and lit.get("master"):
        lit.pop("master", None)                    # no literature for this column: metadata from the config
    return c

Pre-flight check of a config and its data: finds name, file and date problems in seconds, before a long run.

Every check returns a finding with a level (ok, warn, error), the setting concerned and, for problems, how to fix it. run_pipeline.py and run_oos.py run it first and stop on errors (--skip-check to override); `python tools/check_config.py --config ...` runs it on its own.

class Report:
    """Collects findings and prints them grouped by area."""

    def __init__(self):
        """Start an empty report."""
        self.items = []

    def add(self, level, area, msg, fix=""):
        """Record one finding.

        Args:
            level: ok, warn or error. area: config section or file. msg: what was found. fix: how to fix it.
        """
        self.items.append({"level": level, "area": area, "message": msg, "fix": fix})

    @property
    def errors(self):
        """Findings that stop a run."""
        return [i for i in self.items if i["level"] == ERROR]

    @property
    def warnings(self):
        """Findings worth a look that do not stop a run."""
        return [i for i in self.items if i["level"] == WARN]

    def text(self, show_ok=True):
        """The report as text, grouped by area.

        Args:
            show_ok: include the checks that passed.

        Returns:
            str.
        """
        mark = {OK: "  ok ", WARN: " WARN", ERROR: "ERROR"}
        out, area = [], None
        for i in self.items:
            if i["level"] == OK and not show_ok:
                continue
            if i["area"] != area:
                area = i["area"]
                out.append(f"\n[{area}]")
            out.append(f"  {mark[i['level']]}  {i['message']}")
            if i["fix"] and i["level"] != OK:
                out.append(f"         -> {i['fix']}")
        n_e, n_w = len(self.errors), len(self.warnings)
        out.append(f"\n{n_e} error(s), {n_w} warning(s)" + ("" if n_e else ": ready to run"))
        return "\n".join(out)

def _q(v):
    """A quarter from a config value (None stays None).

    Args:
        v: "2020Q1", a date, or None.

    Returns:
        Period or None.
    """
    if v in (None, "", "null"):
        return None
    return to_quarters([v])[0]

def _gap(a, b):
    """Quarters from b to a (a - b).

    Args:
        a, b: Periods.

    Returns:
        int.
    """
    return a.ordinal - b.ordinal

def _read(path, sheet, rep, area, what):
    """Read a CSV/Excel file, recording an error if it is missing or unreadable.

    Args:
        path: file. sheet: Excel sheet. rep: Report. area: section. what: description for messages.

    Returns:
        DataFrame or None.
    """
    if not path:
        rep.add(ERROR, area, f"no file given for {what}", "set the file name in the config")
        return None
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        rep.add(ERROR, area, f"{what}: file not found: {path}",
                "check the path; relative paths start at the project folder (where run_pipeline.py is)")
        return None
    try:
        return read_table(path, sheet)
    except Exception as e:
        rep.add(ERROR, area, f"{what}: cannot read {path}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}",
                "for Excel give `sheet:`; for CSV check the separator is a comma")
        return None

def _dates(df, col, rep, area, what):
    """Parse a date column into quarters, recording problems.

    Args:
        df: table. col: date column. rep: Report. area: section. what: description.

    Returns:
        PeriodIndex or None.
    """
    if col not in df.columns:
        rep.add(ERROR, area, f"{what}: date column '{col}' not found (columns: {list(df.columns)[:8]} ...)",
                f"set date_column to one of the column names above")
        return None
    try:
        return to_quarters(df[col])
    except Exception as e:
        rep.add(ERROR, area, f"{what}: cannot read dates in '{col}' ({e}); first values: {list(df[col].astype(str)[:3])}",
                "use quarter labels like 2020Q1 or dates like 2020-03-31")
        return None

def check(cfg):
    """Check a loaded config and its input files.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration from load_config.

    Returns:
        Report.
    """
    rep = Report()
    d, s = cfg["data"], cfg["sample"]

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- bank
    b = d["bank"]
    bank = _read(b["file"], b.get("sheet"), rep, "data.bank", "target file")
    level = None
    if bank is not None:
        q = _dates(bank, b["date_column"], rep, "data.bank", "target file")
        if b["target_column"] not in bank.columns:
            rep.add(ERROR, "data.bank", f"target column '{b['target_column']}' not found; columns: {list(bank.columns)}",
                    "set target_column to the balance you want to forecast")
        elif q is not None:
            v = pd.to_numeric(bank[b["target_column"]], errors="coerce")
            v.index = q
            if b.get("frequency", "Q").upper() == "M":
                v = v.groupby(level=0).last()
            elif v.index.duplicated().any():
                rep.add(ERROR, "data.bank", "several rows per quarter", "set frequency: M for monthly data")
            level = v.dropna().sort_index()
            gaps = pd.period_range(level.index[0], level.index[-1], freq="Q").difference(level.index)
            if (level <= 0).any():
                rep.add(ERROR, "data.bank", "the balance has zero or negative values", "the model uses log growth: check the column")
            if len(gaps):
                rep.add(WARN, "data.bank", f"{len(gaps)} missing quarters, e.g. {[str(g) for g in gaps[:3]]}",
                        "fill them, or start the sample after the gap")
            rep.add(OK, "data.bank", f"'{b['target_column']}': {level.index[0]} to {level.index[-1]} ({len(level)} quarters)")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- events
    e = d.get("events") or {}
    if e.get("file"):
        ev = _read(e["file"], e.get("sheet"), rep, "data.events", "events file")
        if ev is not None:
            miss = [c for c in (e["date_column"], e["series_column"], e["amount_column"]) if c not in ev.columns]
            if miss:
                rep.add(ERROR, "data.events", f"columns {miss} not found; columns: {list(ev.columns)}",
                        "fix date_column / series_column / amount_column, or set events.file: null")
            else:
                n = int((ev[e["series_column"]].astype(str) == b["target_column"]).sum())
                rep.add(OK if n else WARN, "data.events", f"{n} event(s) for '{b['target_column']}'",
                        "" if n else f"the series column must contain '{b['target_column']}' for events of the target")
    else:
        rep.add(OK, "data.events", "no events file (no inorganic adjustments)")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- macro
    m = d["macro"]
    macro = {}
    for name, f in (m.get("scenarios") or {}).items():
        df = _read(f, m.get("sheet"), rep, "data.macro", f"scenario '{name}'")
        if df is None:
            continue
        q = _dates(df, m["date_column"], rep, "data.macro", f"scenario '{name}'")
        if q is None:
            continue
        df = df.drop(columns=m["date_column"]).apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
        df.index = q
        macro[name] = df.sort_index()
    if m.get("base_scenario") not in (m.get("scenarios") or {}):
        rep.add(ERROR, "data.macro", f"base_scenario '{m.get('base_scenario')}' is not one of {list((m.get('scenarios') or {}))}",
                "set base_scenario to the name of your baseline scenario")
    base = macro.get(m.get("base_scenario"))
    if base is not None:
        cols = set(base.columns)
        for name, df in macro.items():
            diff = cols ^ set(df.columns)
            if diff:
                rep.add(WARN, "data.macro", f"scenario '{name}' has {len(diff)} column(s) not shared with the base, e.g. {sorted(diff)[:3]}",
                        "all scenario files should have the same variables")
        rep.add(OK, "data.macro", f"{len(macro)} scenario(s); base '{m['base_scenario']}': {base.shape[1]} variables, "
                                  f"{base.index[0]} to {base.index[-1]}")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- metadata
    md = d["metadata"]
    meta = None
    mdf = _read(md["file"], md.get("sheet"), rep, "data.metadata", "metadata file")
    if mdf is not None:
        cmap = md["columns"]
        miss = {k: v for k, v in cmap.items() if v not in mdf.columns}
        if miss:
            rep.add(ERROR, "data.metadata", f"columns not found: {miss}; the file has {list(mdf.columns)}",
                    "under metadata.columns, map each name on the left to YOUR column name")
        else:
            meta = mdf.rename(columns={v: k for k, v in cmap.items()})[list(cmap)]
            meta["mnemonic"] = meta["mnemonic"].astype(str).str.strip()
            dup = meta["mnemonic"][meta["mnemonic"].duplicated()].unique()
            if len(dup):
                rep.add(WARN, "data.metadata", f"{len(dup)} duplicated mnemonic(s), e.g. {list(dup[:3])}", "keep one row per variable")
            meta = meta.drop_duplicates("mnemonic").set_index("mnemonic")
            bad_t = sorted(set(meta["transform"].astype(str).str.strip()) - TRANSFORMS)
            if bad_t:
                rep.add(WARN, "data.metadata", f"transform values not recognised: {bad_t[:5]}",
                        "use dlog for levels and indexes, diff for rates and percentages")
            sg = pd.to_numeric(meta["expected_sign"], errors="coerce")
            if (~sg.isin([-1, 0, 1])).any():
                rep.add(WARN, "data.metadata", f"{int((~sg.isin([-1, 0, 1])).sum())} expected_sign value(s) not -1, 0 or 1",
                        "blank or other values count as 0 (no prior; not selectable)")
            n_sign = int((sg.fillna(0) != 0).sum())
            rep.add(OK if n_sign else ERROR, "data.metadata", f"{len(meta)} variables, {n_sign} with an expected sign",
                    "" if n_sign else "with features.require_sign_prior, variables need a +1/-1 sign to be selected")
            if base is not None:
                lvl_codes = [c for c in meta.index[meta["transform"].astype(str).str.strip() == "dlog"]
                             if c in base.columns]
                nonpos = [c for c in lvl_codes if (pd.to_numeric(base[c], errors="coerce") <= 0).any()]
                if nonpos:
                    rep.add(WARN, "data.metadata",
                            f"{len(nonpos)} series with transform dlog have zero or negative values, e.g. {nonpos[:4]}",
                            "their log growth does not exist in those quarters: such forms are not offered as candidates "
                            "and literature drivers using them are left out. Fix the values, or set the transform to diff")
                no_meta = [c for c in base.columns if c not in meta.index]
                no_data = [c for c in meta.index if c not in base.columns]
                lvl = OK if len(no_meta) < 0.2 * base.shape[1] else WARN
                rep.add(lvl, "data.metadata", f"{base.shape[1] - len(no_meta)} of {base.shape[1]} macro variables have a metadata row"
                        + (f"; missing e.g. {no_meta[:3]}" if no_meta else ""),
                        "variables without a row are ignored: add rows to the metadata file")
                if no_data:
                    rep.add(WARN, "data.metadata", f"{len(no_data)} metadata row(s) with no column in the macro file, e.g. {no_data[:3]}",
                            "names must match exactly (case and dots included)")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- constructed
    for c in d.get("constructed") or []:
        if base is None:
            break
        try:
            base.eval(c["expression"], local_dict={"log": np.log, "exp": np.exp}, engine="python")
            rep.add(OK, "data.constructed", f"{c['name']} = {c['expression']}")
        except Exception as ex:
            rep.add(WARN, "data.constructed", f"{c['name']} cannot be built ({type(ex).__name__}: {ex}); it will be skipped",
                    "rewrite the expression with your variable names (wrap names with dots in backticks), or delete it")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- features
    fe = cfg["features"]
    names = set(base.columns) if base is not None else set()
    names |= {c["name"] for c in d.get("constructed") or []}
    if fe.get("deflator"):
        rep.add(OK if fe["deflator"] in names else ERROR, "features", f"deflator '{fe['deflator']}'"
                + (" found" if fe["deflator"] in names else " not in the macro data"),
                "set features.deflator to your CPI series, or null")
    if meta is not None:
        geos = set(meta["geography"].astype(str))
        themes = set(meta["theme"].astype(str))
        for key, have, what in (("allowed_geographies", geos, "geography"), ("excluded_themes", themes, "theme"),
                                ("real_themes", themes, "theme")):
            vals = fe.get(key) or []
            missing = [v for v in vals if v not in have]
            if missing:
                rep.add(WARN if key != "allowed_geographies" or len(missing) < len(vals) else ERROR, "features",
                        f"{key}: {missing} not found in the metadata {what} column",
                        f"use values from: {sorted(have)[:12]}" + (" ..." if len(have) > 12 else ""))
        for sec in ("screen_first", "en_first"):
            pg = (cfg.get(sec) or {}).get("primary_geography")
            if pg and pg not in geos:
                rep.add(WARN, sec, f"primary_geography '{pg}' not in the metadata geographies",
                        f"use one of {sorted(geos)[:10]} (or null)")
        req = (cfg.get("final_model") or {}).get("required_themes") or []
        if [t for t in req if t not in themes]:
            rep.add(ERROR, "final_model", f"required_themes {[t for t in req if t not in themes]} not in the metadata themes",
                    "use theme names from the metadata, or []")
        keep = meta
        if fe.get("allowed_geographies"):
            keep = keep[keep["geography"].astype(str).isin(fe["allowed_geographies"])]
        keep = keep[~keep["theme"].astype(str).isin(fe.get("excluded_themes") or [])]
        if fe.get("require_sign_prior", True):
            keep = keep[pd.to_numeric(keep["expected_sign"], errors="coerce").fillna(0) != 0]
        rep.add(OK if len(keep) >= 5 else ERROR, "features", f"{len(keep)} variables pass the geography, theme and sign filters",
                "relax allowed_geographies / excluded_themes, or add expected signs" if len(keep) < 5 else "")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- sample
    if level is not None:
        first, last = level.index[0], level.index[-1]
        H = int(s["horizon"])
        he, es = _q(s["hist_end"]), _q(s["estimation_start"])
        if he is None or he not in level.index:
            rep.add(ERROR, "sample", f"hist_end {s['hist_end']} is not a quarter of the target data ({first} to {last})",
                    f"set hist_end: {last}")
            he = last
        if es is None or es not in level.index:
            rep.add(ERROR, "sample", f"estimation_start {s['estimation_start']} is not a quarter of the target data",
                    f"set estimation_start: {first + 9}")
        elif _gap(es, first) < 8:
            rep.add(WARN, "sample", f"estimation_start {es} leaves only {_gap(es, first)} quarters for lags and transforms",
                    f"use {first + 9} or later")
        else:
            rep.add(OK, "sample", f"estimation {es} to {he} ({_gap(he, es) + 1} quarters)")
        bs, be = _q(s["backtest_start"]), _q(s.get("backtest_end"))
        if bs is not None and es is not None:
            if bs <= es + 20:
                rep.add(WARN if bs > es + 8 else ERROR, "sample",
                        f"backtest_start {bs} leaves {_gap(bs, es)} quarters of estimation data before the first origin",
                        f"start the backtest around {es + 40} (10 years of data) if the sample allows")
            be_eff = be or (he - 1)
            if be is not None and be >= he:
                rep.add(ERROR, "sample", f"backtest_end {be} must be before hist_end {he}", f"set backtest_end: null or {he - 1}")
            n_full = max(0, _gap(min(be_eff, he - H), bs) + 1)
            n_all = max(0, _gap(be_eff, bs) + 1)
            if n_all <= 0:
                rep.add(ERROR, "sample", f"no backtest origins between {bs} and {be_eff}", "check backtest_start / backtest_end")
            else:
                rep.add(OK if n_full >= 6 else WARN, "sample",
                        f"{n_all} backtest origins; {n_full} have an actual {H} quarters ahead",
                        f"move backtest_start earlier for more {H}-quarter errors" if n_full < 6 else "")
        out = [q for q in s.get("dummy_quarters") or [] if not (first <= _q(q) <= he)]
        if out:
            rep.add(WARN, "sample", f"dummy_quarters outside the sample: {out}", "remove them (they would do nothing)")
        if base is not None:
            if base.index[0] > (es or first):
                rep.add(ERROR, "sample", f"macro history starts {base.index[0]}, after estimation_start {es}",
                        f"set estimation_start to {base.index[0] + 9} or later")
            need = he + H
            for name, df in macro.items():
                if df.index[-1] < need:
                    rep.add(WARN, "data.macro", f"scenario '{name}' ends {df.index[-1]}: forecasts stop before {need} (hist_end + horizon)",
                            "extend the scenario files, or shorten sample.horizon")
        o = cfg.get("oos") or {}
        fo = _q(o.get("first_origin"))
        if fo is not None and es is not None:
            if fo <= es + 20 or fo >= he:
                rep.add(ERROR if fo >= he else WARN, "oos", f"first_origin {fo}: the first re-selection has "
                        f"{_gap(fo, es)} quarters of data", f"set oos.first_origin around {es + 40}")
            else:
                rep.add(OK, "oos", f"out-of-sample origins from {fo} every {o.get('step', 4)} quarters")
        if int(o.get("holdout_quarters") or 0) >= _gap(he, es or first) // 2:
            rep.add(WARN, "oos", f"holdout_quarters {o['holdout_quarters']} is more than half the sample", "use 8-12")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- same-growth models and models.only
    mcfg = cfg.get("models") or {}
    for item in mcfg.get("same_growth") or []:
        var = str(item.get("variable", "") if isinstance(item, dict) else item).strip()
        if not var:
            continue
        code = var
        try:
            from ..models.literature import load as _load_lit
            tbl = _load_lit(cfg) if (cfg.get("literature") or {}).get("table") else None
            if tbl is not None and var in tbl.index:
                code = tbl.loc[var, "mnemonic"] if tbl.loc[var, "active"] else None
        except Exception:
            pass
        if not code or code not in names:
            rep.add(WARN, "models", f"same_growth: '{var}' is not a series in the data (or its concept is not mapped): "
                                    "its models are skipped", "use a literature concept that is mapped, or a series name")
    only = [str(x) for x in (mcfg.get("only") or [])]
    if only:
        rep.add(OK, "models", f"only these models run (plus the AR(1) benchmark): {', '.join(only)}")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- yes/no written where a list is expected
    from .config import SWITCH_NOTES
    for n in SWITCH_NOTES:
        rep.add(WARN, "config", n, "write a list (e.g. [arimax, theta]) or [] to be explicit")
    for sec, key in (("features", "allowed_geographies"), ("screen_first", "primary_geography"),
                     ("en_first", "primary_geography"), ("features", "excluded_themes")):
        v = (cfg.get(sec) or {}).get(key)
        if isinstance(v, bool) or (isinstance(v, list) and any(isinstance(x, bool) for x in v)):
            rep.add(ERROR, "config", f"{sec}.{key} contains {v}: YAML reads ON / YES / NO / OFF / TRUE as true or false",
                    "put the name in quotes, e.g. primary_geography: \"ON\" or allowed_geographies: [\"ON\", \"CA\"]")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- literature
    lit = cfg.get("literature") or {}
    if lit.get("workbook"):
        wb = lit["workbook"]
        if not os.path.exists(wb):
            rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"workbook not found: {wb}", "point literature.workbook to the .xlsx, or set it to null")
        else:
            try:
                from ..models.literature import read_workbook
                models, conc = read_workbook(wb)
                cids = set(conc["concept_id"].astype(str)) if "concept_id" in conc else set()
                ok_tr = set(cfg["features"]["transforms_level"]) | set(cfg["features"]["transforms_rate"]) | {"rdlog", "ryoy"}
                rep.add(OK if models else ERROR, "literature", f"workbook: {len(models)} model(s), {len(conc)} concept(s)",
                        "" if models else "add at least one model to sheet 'models'")
                if models and not any(m_.get("core") for m_ in models):
                    rep.add(WARN, "literature", "no model is marked core = yes", "mark the rows of one model core = yes: it feeds the hybrids, regime and deep models")
                for m_ in models:
                    for f in m_["features"]:
                        v, tr, lg = f.split("|")
                        if v not in cids and v not in names:
                            rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"model '{m_['name']}': '{v}' is neither a concept in sheet 'concepts' nor a series in the data",
                                    "use a concept_id from sheet 'concepts' or an exact series name")
                        from ..features.transforms import window as _win
                        if tr not in ok_tr and not _win(tr):
                            rep.add(WARN, "literature", f"model '{m_['name']}': transform '{tr}' of {v} is not among the transforms tried",
                                    f"use one of {sorted(ok_tr)}")
                        if m_.get("signs") and m_["signs"].get(f) not in (-1, 0, 1):
                            rep.add(WARN, "literature", f"model '{m_['name']}': expected_sign of {v} is {m_['signs'].get(f)}",
                                    "use 1, -1 or 0 (0 = no sign rule)")
                from ..models.literature import clean_settings
                raw_ = read_workbook(wb, full=True)["settings"]
                st_ = clean_settings(raw_)
                if not raw_:
                    rep.add(WARN, "literature", "the workbook has no 'settings' sheet: defaults are used",
                            "re-create it with python tools/literature_template.py (keeps your models and concepts)")
                defl = st_.get("ecm_deflator") or "inflation"
                if st_["ecm_enabled"] and defl not in cids and defl not in names:
                    rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"settings: ecm_deflator '{defl}' is neither a concept nor a series",
                            "use a concept_id (e.g. inflation) or your CPI series name")
                thr_raw = str(raw_.get("regime_threshold", "") or "").strip()
                thr = st_["regime_threshold"]
                if thr_raw and thr_raw.lower() != "nan" and not thr:
                    rep.add(WARN, "literature", f"settings: regime_threshold '{thr_raw}' is not variable|transform|Llag: the default is used",
                            "write e.g. house_prices|dlog|L1, or leave it empty")
                elif thr and thr.split("|")[0] not in cids and thr.split("|")[0] not in names:
                    rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"settings: regime_threshold '{thr}' cannot be resolved",
                            "use a concept_id or one of your series, e.g. house_prices|dlog|L1")
                for key in ("channels", "ecm_short_run"):
                    if isinstance(st_[key], list):
                        unk = [x for x in st_[key] if x.split("|")[0] not in cids | set(names)]
                        if unk:
                            rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"settings: {key} has unknown variables {unk}",
                                    "use 'table' / 'core', or a comma list of concepts")
                lr = st_["ecm_long_run"]
                if lr != "table":
                    bad = [x for x in lr if x.split(":")[0] not in cids | set(names)]
                    if bad:
                        rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"settings: ecm_long_run has unknown variables {bad}",
                                "use 'table' or a comma list of concepts / series")
            except Exception as ex:
                rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"workbook cannot be read: {ex}", "use the template: python tools/literature_template.py")
    if lit.get("table"):
        if not os.path.exists(lit["table"]):
            rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"table not found: {lit['table']}", "point literature.table to the CSV, or set it to null")
        else:
            if lit["table"].endswith(".csv"):
                t = pd.read_csv(lit["table"])
            else:
                sh = pd.read_excel(lit["table"], sheet_name=None)
                t = next((v for k, v in sh.items() if k.strip().lower() == "concepts"), next(iter(sh.values())))
            if "moodys_name" in t.columns and "series_name" not in t.columns:   # older workbooks
                t = t.rename(columns={"moodys_name": "series_name"})
            t["series_name"] = t["series_name"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
            inc = t["include"].astype(str).str.lower().isin(["yes", "y", "true", "1"])
            core = t.get("core", pd.Series("no", index=t.index)).astype(str).str.lower().isin(["yes", "y", "true", "1"])
            for _, r in t[inc].iterrows():
                nm, cid = r["series_name"], r["concept_id"]
                is_core = bool(core.loc[_])
                if not nm and not is_core:
                    rep.add(OK, "literature", f"{cid}: not mapped (the models that use it go without it)")
                elif not nm:
                    rep.add(ERROR, "literature", f"concept '{cid}'{' (core)' if is_core else ''} has no series_name",
                            "put your series name in the series_name column, or include = no")
                elif nm not in names:
                    rep.add(ERROR if is_core else WARN, "literature", f"concept '{cid}' -> '{nm}' is not in the macro data",
                            "fix the name in series_name (it must match a macro column exactly)")
                else:
                    rep.add(OK, "literature", f"{cid} -> {nm}" + (" (core)" if is_core else ""))
    return rep

def preflight(cfg, log=print, strict=True):
    """Run the check at the start of a run: print problems and stop on errors.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration. log: message function. strict: raise SystemExit on errors.

    Returns:
        Report.
    """
    rep = check(cfg)
    if rep.errors or rep.warnings:
        log("Pre-flight check of the config and data:" + rep.text(show_ok=False))
    if rep.errors and strict:
        log("\nStopped before running: fix the errors above (or run with --skip-check).")
        raise SystemExit(2)
    return rep

def save_fitted(out_dir, fitted, log=print):
    """Write the fitted models of a run to fitted/models.pkl.

    Args:
        out_dir: the run's output folder. fitted: dict model name -> pickle bytes (None = not stored).
        log: message function.

    Returns:
        path of the file, or None if nothing could be stored.
    """
    keep = {k: v for k, v in fitted.items() if v is not None}
    if not keep:
        return None
    d = os.path.join(out_dir, "fitted")
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    path = os.path.join(d, "models.pkl")
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump(keep, f)
    plain = {}
    for k, b in keep.items():
        try:
            m = pickle.loads(b)
        except Exception:
            continue
        pm = portable(m)
        if pm:
            plain[k] = pm
    with open(os.path.join(d, "formula_models.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(plain, f, indent=1)
    skipped = sorted(k for k, v in fitted.items() if v is None)
    with open(os.path.join(d, "README.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("models.pkl            every model as estimated on all history, keyed by model name\n"
                "formula_models.json   the regressions as plain numbers (any computer, any package version)\n"
                "coefficients.csv      every coefficient with standard error, t and p value\n"
                "fit_statistics.csv    observations, R2, AIC, BIC, residual std. dev. per model\n"
                "fitted_values.csv     in-sample one-step fit of every model: actual, fitted, residual, levels\n"
                "panels/               the data each model was estimated on\n"
                "backtest_models/      each model as re-estimated at every backtest origin {origin: model}\n"
                "data/target.csv       the target level and its organic change\n"
                "manifest.json         what was saved\n\n"
                "Read them with:\n"
                "  from src.utils.saved import load_models, load_origin_models\n"
                "  models = load_models('<run folder>')                        # {name: model}\n"
                "  by_origin = load_origin_models('<run folder>', '<model name>') # {origin: model}\n"
                "Each model has the usual interface: panel(ctx, mdf), forecast(P, origin, H), params (regressions).\n"
                "Out-of-sample models are in oos/fitted_models/<origin>.pkl (load_origin_models(file)).\n")
        if skipped:
            f.write("\nNot stored (cannot be pickled, or pretrained and downloaded again when needed):\n  "
                    + "\n  ".join(skipped) + "\n")
    log(f"  fitted models: {len(keep)} saved to {os.path.relpath(path)}"
        + (f" ({len(skipped)} not stored: {', '.join(skipped)})" if skipped else ""))
    return path

def _slug(name):
    """A model name as a safe file name."""
    import re
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._+-]+", "_", str(name)).strip("_")[:80] or "model"

def save_all(out_dir, ev, ctx, log=print):
    """Everything estimated in a run, next to models.pkl (fitted/):

        models.pkl                    every model estimated on all history (load_models())
        formula_models.json           regressions as plain numbers (any computer, any package version)
        coefficients.csv              every coefficient: estimate, standard error, t, p value (regressions),
                                      or weights / parameters for the other model types
        fit_statistics.csv            observations, R², adjusted R², AIC, BIC, residual std. dev. per model
        fitted_values.csv             in-sample one-step fit of every model: actual, fitted, residual, levels
        panels/<model>.csv            the data each model was estimated on (history and baseline scenario)
        backtest_models/<model>.pkl   the model as re-estimated at every backtest origin {origin: model}
                                      (load_origin_models())
        data/target.csv               the target: level, organic change in the model's form, cumulated level
        manifest.json                 what was saved, the target form and the file of each model

    Args:
        out_dir: the run's output folder. ev: model name -> evaluate() output. ctx: Context. log: message function.

    Returns:
        the fitted/ folder.
    """
    import pandas as pd
    from . import target as tg
    d = os.path.join(out_dir, "fitted")
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    save_fitted(out_dir, {k: v.get("fitted") for k, v in ev.items()}, log)
    man = {"target_form": tg.form(), "target_units": tg.units(), "models": {}}

    def cat(key):
        parts = [v.get(key) for v in ev.values() if isinstance(v.get(key), pd.DataFrame) and len(v.get(key))]
        return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True) if parts else None
    for key, fname in (("coefficients", "coefficients.csv"), ("fitted_values", "fitted_values.csv")):
        T = cat(key)
        if T is not None:
            T.to_csv(os.path.join(d, fname), index=False)
    st = [v.get("fit_statistics") for v in ev.values() if v.get("fit_statistics")]
    if st:
        pd.DataFrame(st).to_csv(os.path.join(d, "fit_statistics.csv"), index=False)
    pdir, bdir = os.path.join(d, "panels"), os.path.join(d, "backtest_models")
    n_orig = 0
    for k, v in ev.items():
        info = {"in_models_pkl": v.get("fitted") is not None}
        P = v.get("panel")
        if isinstance(P, pd.DataFrame):
            os.makedirs(pdir, exist_ok=True)
            f = os.path.join(pdir, _slug(k) + ".csv")
            P.rename_axis("date").reset_index().assign(date=lambda x: x["date"].astype(str)).to_csv(f, index=False)
            info["panel"] = os.path.relpath(f, d)
        om = {o: b for o, b in (v.get("origin_models") or {}).items() if b is not None}
        if om:
            os.makedirs(bdir, exist_ok=True)
            f = os.path.join(bdir, _slug(k) + ".pkl")
            with open(f, "wb") as fh:
                pickle.dump(om, fh)
            info["backtest_models"] = os.path.relpath(f, d)
            info["backtest_origins"] = sorted(om)
            n_orig += len(om)
        man["models"][k] = info
    dd = os.path.join(d, "data")
    os.makedirs(dd, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame({"date": [str(q) for q in ctx.level.index], "level": ctx.level.values,
                  "organic_change": ctx.y.reindex(ctx.level.index).values,
                  "organic_state": ctx.logL.reindex(ctx.level.index).values}).to_csv(os.path.join(dd, "target.csv"),
                                                                                     index=False)
    with open(os.path.join(d, "manifest.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(man, f, indent=1)
    log(f"  fitted results: coefficients, fit statistics, fitted values, {len(man['models'])} panels and "
        f"{n_orig} backtest re-estimations saved to {os.path.relpath(d) if not os.path.relpath(d).startswith('..') else d}")
    return d

def save_origin_models(folder, store, log=print):
    """Out-of-sample models: {origin: {model name: pickle bytes}} -> folder/<origin>.pkl, one file per origin."""
    if not store:
        return
    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
    n = 0
    for origin, mods in store.items():
        keep = {k: b for k, b in mods.items() if b is not None}
        if keep:
            with open(os.path.join(folder, f"{origin}.pkl"), "wb") as f:
                pickle.dump(keep, f)
            n += len(keep)
    log(f"  out-of-sample fitted models: {n} (model, origin) pairs saved to {folder}")

def load_origin_models(path_or_run, model=None):
    """Models re-estimated at each origin.

    Args:
        path_or_run: a backtest_models/<model>.pkl file, an oos/fitted_models/<origin>.pkl file, or a run folder
            (then `model` names the model, and its backtest file is read).

    Returns:
        dict origin (or model name) -> fitted model.
    """
    p = path_or_run
    if os.path.isdir(p):
        p = os.path.join(p, "fitted", "backtest_models", _slug(model) + ".pkl")
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        raw = pickle.load(f)
    out = {}
    for k, b in raw.items():
        try:
            out[k] = pickle.loads(b)
        except Exception:
            continue
    return out

def portable(model):
    """A regression, error-correction or same-growth model as plain numbers (None for other model types).

    Args:
        model: fitted model.

    Returns:
        dict (JSON-ready) or None.
    """
    kind = type(model).__name__
    if kind not in ("ARDL", "ECM", "SameGrowth", "AutoARDL", "LevelsARDL") or getattr(model, "params", None) is None:
        return None
    if kind == "LevelsARDL":
        return {"class": kind, "name": model.name, "family": model.family, "long_run": model.long_run,
                "deflator": model.deflator, "real": bool(getattr(model, "real", True)), "p": int(model.p), "q": {k: int(v) for k, v in model.q.items()},
                "max_p": model.max_p, "max_q": model.max_q, "ic": model.ic,
                "params": {k: float(v) for k, v in model.params.items()},
                "bounds": {k: (float(v) if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else v) for k, v in (model.bounds or {}).items()}}
    d = {"class": kind, "name": model.name, "family": model.family, "features": list(model.features),
         "params": {k: float(v) for k, v in model.params.items()}, "ar": bool(getattr(model, "ar", True)),
         "signs": dict(getattr(model, "signs", {}) or {})}
    if kind == "ECM":
        d.update(long_run=model.long_run, deflator=model.deflator,
                 beta=[float(b) for b in (model.beta if model.beta is not None else [])])
    if kind == "SameGrowth":
        d["gap"] = bool(model.gap)
    if kind == "AutoARDL":
        d.update(bases=model.bases, p=int(model.p), q={k: int(v) for k, v in model.q.items()}, max_p=model.max_p,
                 max_q=model.max_q, ic=model.ic, base_signs=model.base_signs)
    return d

def rebuild(d):
    """The model back from portable(): ready to forecast and to write its formula (no standard errors).

    Args:
        d: dict from portable().

    Returns:
        model.
    """
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd
    from ..modelling.ardl import ARDL
    from ..models.ecm import ECM
    from ..models.simple import SameGrowth
    from ..models.autoardl import AutoARDL, LevelsARDL
    if d["class"] == "LevelsARDL":
        m = LevelsARDL(d["name"], d["long_run"], d["deflator"], d["max_p"], d["max_q"], d["ic"], family=d["family"],
                       real=d.get("real", True))
        m.p, m.q, m.params, m.bounds, m.frozen = d["p"], d["q"], pd.Series(d["params"]), d.get("bounds"), True
        return m
    if d["class"] == "AutoARDL":
        m = AutoARDL(d["name"], [f"{b}|L0" for b in d["bases"]], d["max_p"], d["max_q"], d["ic"], family=d["family"],
                     signs=d.get("base_signs"))
        m.p, m.q, m.features, m.frozen = d["p"], d["q"], d["features"], True
        m.params = pd.Series(d["params"])
        m.signs = d.get("signs") or {}
        return m
    if d["class"] == "SameGrowth":
        m = SameGrowth(d["name"], d["features"][0], gap=d.get("gap", False), family=d["family"])
    elif d["class"] == "ECM":
        m = ECM(d["name"], d["features"], d["long_run"], d["deflator"], ar=d.get("ar", True), family=d["family"])
        m.beta = np.array(d["beta"])
    else:
        m = ARDL(d["name"], d["features"], ar=d.get("ar", True), family=d["family"])
    m.params = pd.Series(d["params"])
    m.signs = d.get("signs") or {}
    return m

def load_models(run_dir):
    """The fitted models of a run (or of a saved run folder).

    Models that cannot be unpickled on this computer (other package versions) are rebuilt from
    fitted/formula_models.json when they are regressions, error-correction or same-growth models.

    Args:
        run_dir: outputs/<run> or one of its saved_runs/<...> folders.

    Returns:
        dict model name -> fitted model ({} if the run has no saved models).
    """
    out = {}
    path = os.path.join(run_dir, "fitted", "models.pkl")
    if os.path.exists(path):
        try:
            with open(path, "rb") as f:
                raw = pickle.load(f)
        except Exception:
            raw = {}
        for k, b in raw.items():
            try:
                out[k] = pickle.loads(b)
            except Exception:                  # e.g. other pandas version, or a deep-learning package missing
                continue
    jp = os.path.join(run_dir, "fitted", "formula_models.json")
    if os.path.exists(jp):
        for k, d in json.load(open(jp, encoding="utf-8")).items():
            if k not in out:
                try:
                    out[k] = rebuild(d)
                except Exception:
                    continue
    return out

def snapshot(cfg, script, log=print):
    """Copy the run's current results into saved_runs/<date_time>_<script>/ and keep the newest save.keep_runs.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration (out_dir, config_file, literature.workbook, save.keep_runs). script: "pipeline" or "oos".
        log: message function.

    Returns:
        the snapshot folder, or None when saving is switched off.
    """
    keep_n = int((cfg.get("save") or {}).get("keep_runs", 20) or 0)
    if keep_n <= 0:
        return None
    out = cfg["out_dir"]
    stamp = _dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    dst = os.path.join(out, "saved_runs", f"{stamp}_{script}")
    os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
    for k in KEEP:
        src = os.path.join(out, k)
        if os.path.isdir(src):
            shutil.copytree(src, os.path.join(dst, k), dirs_exist_ok=True)
        elif os.path.isfile(src):
            shutil.copy2(src, dst)
    inputs = os.path.join(dst, "inputs")
    os.makedirs(inputs, exist_ok=True)
    for f in (cfg.get("config_file"), (cfg.get("literature") or {}).get("workbook")):
        if f and os.path.exists(f):
            shutil.copy2(f, inputs)
    info = {"saved": stamp, "script": script, "run_name": cfg["run_name"],
            "config_file": os.path.basename(cfg.get("config_file") or "")}
    best = _best(dst)
    if best:
        info.update(best)
    with open(os.path.join(dst, "saved_run.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(info, f, indent=1)
    runs = list_snapshots(out)
    for old in runs[keep_n:]:
        shutil.rmtree(old["path"], ignore_errors=True)
    log(f"Saved a copy of these results: {os.path.relpath(dst)} (open it later in the app, ⑤ Results)")
    return dst

def _best(folder):
    """The most accurate model of a saved run (out of sample if available), for the run list.

    Args:
        folder: a saved run folder.

    Returns:
        dict with best_model, best_error_pct and basis, or {}.
    """
    import pandas as pd
    for sub, f, basis in (("oos", "1_oos_summary.csv", "out of sample"), ("comparison", "1_model_comparison.csv", "backtest")):
        p = os.path.join(folder, sub, f)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            d = pd.read_csv(p)
            d = d[d["family"] != "Look-ahead check"]
            col = sorted([c for c in d.columns if c.startswith("avg_1_") and c.endswith("_pct")],
                         key=lambda c: int(c.split("_")[2]))[-1:]
            if col and len(d):
                r = d.sort_values(col[0]).iloc[0]
                return {"best_model": r["model"], "best_error_pct": round(float(r[col[0]]), 3), "basis": basis,
                        "horizon": col[0]}
    return {}

def list_snapshots(out_dir):
    """Saved runs of one run name, newest first.

    Args:
        out_dir: outputs/<run>.

    Returns:
        list of dicts: path, name, saved, script, best_model, best_error_pct, basis.
    """
    root = os.path.join(out_dir, "saved_runs")
    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        return []
    rows = []
    for n in sorted(os.listdir(root), reverse=True):
        p = os.path.join(root, n)
        if not os.path.isdir(p):
            continue
        info = {}
        try:
            info = json.load(open(os.path.join(p, "saved_run.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            pass
        rows.append({"path": p, "name": n, **info})
    return rows

src/utils/target.py

module src.utils.target · 19 items
How the target series is modelled: one place for the transform, the rebuilt level and the error measure.

Two forms (config: target.transform):

    dlog   y_t = ln(L_t) - ln(L_{t-1})                 balances, deposits, investment, prices: anything > 0
           level after h quarters: L_0 * exp(sum of y)  error: forecast level / actual level - 1   (a fraction)
    diff   y_t = L_t - L_{t-1}                         interest rates, spreads, rates of change, anything that
           level after h quarters: L_0 + sum of y         can be zero or negative
           error: (forecast level - actual level) / 100 (so that "x 100" gives the error in the target's units,
           e.g. percentage points for a rate; the *_pct columns then hold units, not percent)
    auto   dlog when every value is positive, else diff  (set diff yourself for a rate, which is positive too)

The pipeline uses one target per process, so the form is held here once Context has read the data.
Every function works on numpy arrays or pandas objects.

def resolve(requested, level):
    """The form to use: 'dlog', 'diff', or auto (dlog if every value is positive).

    Args:
        requested: config value (dlog, diff, auto or None). level: the target series.
    """
    r = (requested or "auto").lower()
    if r == "auto":
        return "dlog" if float(np.nanmin(np.asarray(level, float))) > 0 else "diff"
    if r == "dlog" and float(np.nanmin(np.asarray(level, float))) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("target.transform is dlog but the target has values <= 0: use diff")
    return r

def path(L0, changes):
    """Level after each quarter, starting from L0 and adding up the changes."""
    c = np.cumsum(np.asarray(changes, float))
    return L0 * np.exp(c) if is_log() else L0 + c

    """Level error from cumulated changes: a fraction for dlog, units / 100 for diff (see the module note)."""

    return np.exp(d) - 1 if is_log() else d / 100.0

def target_deflator(mdf, deflator, index):
    """ln(price index) used to put the target in real terms in long-run relations (ECM, levels ARDL).

    A diff target (a rate) is not deflated: the column is 0, so the long run is in the target's own units.
    """
    import pandas as pd
    if not is_log() or not deflator or deflator not in mdf.columns:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=index)
    return np.log(mdf[deflator]).reindex(index)

src/utils/trace.py

module src.utils.trace · 25 items
Detailed run trace: records every call to a function in the project while the pipeline runs.

Nothing in the pipeline has to be marked up. At start-up `install()` wraps
  - every function and method defined under src/ (and the names the entry script imported from it);
  - the entry script's own functions (for example run() in run_pipeline.py);
  - functions defined inside other functions, and lambdas, when they are passed to a traced call
    (for example the work a cached step does);
  - a list of library routines that do the actual numerical work (statsmodels OLS and ADF, the
    scikit-learn Elastic Net, scipy clustering, numpy least squares, pandas file reading). These are
    shown as "library" calls; what happens inside them is not traced.
So a function you add or change later is traced automatically on the next run.

For each call it records:
  - the function, its file and line, its docstring and its source code as it was at run time;
  - which call it came from (the call tree), how long it took, and the log messages it printed;
  - a summary of every argument (type, shape, column names, value) and of the return value;
  - the local variables at the end of the call (what a debugger shows), with small table previews;
  - a preview of every table it returned, with the full table saved as CSV (optional);
  - for regressions, the coefficient table (coef, s.e., t, p);
  - the error, traceback and local variables if it failed.

Functions called many times from the same place (one regression per candidate, one fit per backtest
origin) are recorded in detail the first `detail_calls` times; the rest are listed with their label and
time only. Calls whose first text argument differs (a step name such as 'screen_first', a folder) count as
different calls, up to `distinct_labels` of them, so each pipeline step gets its own entry.

Output, in outputs/<run_name>/trace/<date_time>/ (one folder per run; the newest `keep_runs` are kept):
  trace.json   everything above (read by tools/trace_to_html.py)
  trace.log    the same as an indented text log
  tables/      full CSVs of returned tables
  trace.html   the clickable page (written at the end of the run)

def _cell(v):
    """Make a table cell JSON-safe (rounded floats, NaN -> None, numpy scalars -> Python).

    Args:
        v: value.

    Returns:
        JSON-serialisable value.
    """
    if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)):
        return None if np.isnan(v) else float(f"{v:.6g}")
    if isinstance(v, (bool, np.bool_)):
        return bool(v)
    if isinstance(v, np.integer):
        return int(v)
    if isinstance(v, (int, str)) or v is None:
        return v
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        return ", ".join(map(str, v))[:200]
    return str(v)[:200]

        bool.
    """
    return hasattr(v, "params") and hasattr(v, "tvalues") and hasattr(v, "bse")

def summarize(v):
    """One-line description of any value: type, size, and a short look inside.

    Args:
        v: any value.
    """
    try:
        if isinstance(v, pd.DataFrame):
            cols = [str(c) for c in v.columns[:6]]
            idx = f"; index {v.index[0]} … {v.index[-1]}" if len(v) and not isinstance(v.index, pd.RangeIndex) else ""
            return {"type": "DataFrame", "size": f"{v.shape[0]} × {v.shape[1]}",
                    "detail": "columns: " + ", ".join(cols) + (" …" if v.shape[1] > 6 else "") + idx}
        if isinstance(v, pd.Series):
            idx = f"{v.index[0]} … {v.index[-1]}" if len(v) else ""
            d = f"name {v.name!s}; index {idx}"
            if len(v) and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(v) and not pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(v):
                d += f"; mean {v.mean():.4g}, min {v.min():.4g}, max {v.max():.4g}"
            return {"type": "Series", "size": str(len(v)), "detail": d}
        if isinstance(v, pd.Index):
            return {"type": type(v).__name__, "size": str(len(v)),
                    "detail": (f"{v[0]} … {v[-1]}" if len(v) else "")}
        if isinstance(v, np.ndarray):
            d = ""
            if v.size and np.issubdtype(v.dtype, np.number):
                d = f"min {np.nanmin(v):.4g}, max {np.nanmax(v):.4g}" if v.size > 1 else f"value {v.ravel()[0]:.6g}"
            elif v.size and v.dtype == bool:
                d = f"{int(v.sum())} True"
            return {"type": "ndarray", "size": " × ".join(map(str, v.shape)), "detail": f"{v.dtype}; {d}"}
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            keys = list(v)[:8]
            return {"type": "dict", "size": f"{len(v)} keys",
                    "detail": ", ".join(map(str, keys)) + (" …" if len(v) > 8 else "")}
        if isinstance(v, (list, tuple, set)):
            v2 = list(v)
            inner = ", ".join(summarize(x)["type"] if not isinstance(x, (str, int, float)) else repr(x)
                              for x in v2[:6])
            return {"type": type(v).__name__, "size": f"{len(v2)} items", "detail": inner[:240] + (" …" if len(v2) > 6 else "")}
        if isinstance(v, str):
            return {"type": "str", "size": "", "detail": repr(v[:200]) + ("…" if len(v) > 200 else "")}
        if isinstance(v, (bool, np.bool_, int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) or v is None:
            return {"type": type(v).__name__, "size": "", "detail": str(_cell(v))}
        if isinstance(v, pd.Period):
            return {"type": "Period", "size": "", "detail": str(v)}
        if _is_fit_result(v):                                        # statsmodels results
            m = getattr(v, "model", None)
            names = list(getattr(m, "exog_names", []) or [])
            return {"type": "regression results", "size": f"{int(getattr(v, 'nobs', 0))} obs",
                    "detail": f"{getattr(m, 'endog_names', 'y')} ~ {' + '.join(names[:8])}{' …' if len(names) > 8 else ''}; "
                              f"R² {getattr(v, 'rsquared', float('nan')):.3f}"}
        if hasattr(v, "exog_names") and hasattr(v, "endog"):          # statsmodels model before fitting
            names = list(v.exog_names or [])
            return {"type": type(v).__name__, "size": f"{len(v.endog)} obs",
                    "detail": f"{getattr(v, 'endog_names', 'y')} ~ {' + '.join(names[:8])}{' …' if len(names) > 8 else ''}"}
        if hasattr(v, "coef_") and hasattr(v, "get_params"):         # fitted scikit-learn model
            c = np.ravel(v.coef_)
            p = v.get_params()
            return {"type": type(v).__name__, "size": f"{len(c)} coefs",
                    "detail": f"{int((c != 0).sum())} non-zero; alpha {p.get('alpha', '')}, l1_ratio {p.get('l1_ratio', '')}"}
        if hasattr(v, "get_params"):
            p = v.get_params()
            return {"type": type(v).__name__, "size": "", "detail": ", ".join(f"{k}={p[k]}" for k in list(p)[:6])}
        if callable(v):
            return {"type": "function", "size": "", "detail": getattr(v, "__qualname__", str(v))[:120]}
        return {"type": type(v).__name__, "size": "", "detail": ""}
    except Exception as e:                                   # never let tracing break the run
        return {"type": type(v).__name__, "size": "", "detail": f"(could not summarise: {e})"}

def table_json(df, rows):
    """First rows of a table in the trace's JSON format.

    Args:
        df: DataFrame or Series. rows: rows to keep.

    Returns:
        dict with columns, rows, n and n_cols.
    """
    if isinstance(df, pd.Series):
        df = df.to_frame(df.name if df.name is not None else "value")
    show_index = not isinstance(df.index, pd.RangeIndex)
    d = df.iloc[:rows, :40].copy()
    if show_index:
        nm = str(d.index.name) if d.index.name is not None else "index"
        d.index.name = nm if nm not in map(str, d.columns) else f"{nm} (index)"
        d = d.reset_index()
        d.columns = [str(c) for c in d.columns]
    return {"columns": [str(c) for c in d.columns], "rows": [[_cell(x) for x in r] for r in d.itertuples(index=False)],
            "n": int(len(df)), "n_cols": int(df.shape[1])}

def tables_in(v, label="result", depth=0):
    """(label, table) pairs for every DataFrame/Series in a return value (looks one level into dicts/tuples).

    Args:
        v: return value. label: name of v. depth: nesting level.
    """
    if isinstance(v, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series)):
        return [(label, v)] if len(v) else []
    if _is_fit_result(v):
        try:
            return [(f"{label} coefficients", coef_table(v))]
        except Exception:
            return []
    out = []
    if depth < 2 and isinstance(v, dict):
        for k, x in list(v.items())[:12]:
            out += tables_in(x, f"{label}['{k}']" if label != "result" else f"['{k}']", depth + 1)
    elif depth < 2 and isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) and len(v) <= 8:
        for i, x in enumerate(v):
            out += tables_in(x, f"{label}[{i}]", depth + 1)
    return out

def compact(v):
    """Very short description of an argument, for the list of repeated calls.

    Args:
        v: any value.
    """
    try:
        if isinstance(v, pd.Series):
            return f"{v.name}" if v.name is not None else f"Series[{len(v)}]"
        if isinstance(v, pd.DataFrame):
            return f"DataFrame {v.shape[0]}×{v.shape[1]}" + (f" [{', '.join(map(str, v.columns[:3]))}{'…' if v.shape[1] > 3 else ''}]" if v.shape[1] <= 6 else "")
        if isinstance(v, np.ndarray):
            return f"array {'×'.join(map(str, v.shape))}"
        if isinstance(v, (str, int, float, np.integer, np.floating, bool)) or v is None:
            return repr(_cell(v))[:60]
        if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
            return f"[{', '.join(compact(x) for x in list(v)[:3])}{'…' if len(v) > 3 else ''}]"
        if hasattr(v, "exog_names") and hasattr(v, "exog"):
            n = list(v.exog_names or [])
            return f"OLS on {len(n)} regressors, last '{n[-1] if n else ''}' (mean {np.mean(v.exog[:, -1]):.4g})"
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            return f"dict({len(v)})"
        if hasattr(v, "get_params"):
            p = v.get_params()
            return f"{type(v).__name__}(alpha={_cell(p.get('alpha'))})" if "alpha" in p else type(v).__name__
        return type(v).__name__
    except Exception:
        return "?"

def _project_function(x):
    """A plain function or lambda written in this project (not a library, not this file).

    Args:
        x: any object.
    """
    if not inspect.isfunction(x) or getattr(x, "__traced__", False):
        return False
    f = os.path.abspath(x.__code__.co_filename)
    return f.startswith(ROOT + os.sep) and f != THIS and "site-packages" not in f
