class Tracer:
    """Records every call of the project's functions (arguments, results, local variables, logs, time)
    and writes trace.json, trace.log and trace.html.
    """
    def __init__(self, folder, title, preview_rows=20, save_tables=True, detail_calls=1, distinct_labels=8,
                 max_table_cells=200_000, local_variables=True, local_preview_rows=8, max_repeats_listed=500):
        """Create a tracer writing to folder; the settings come from the trace: section of the config.

        Args:
            folder: output folder. title: page title. preview_rows: table rows shown. save_tables: save
            returned tables as CSV. detail_calls: repeated calls recorded in full. distinct_labels: calls with
            different text arguments shown separately. max_table_cells: larger tables are not saved.
            local_variables: record local variables. local_preview_rows: rows per local table.
            max_repeats_listed: repeated calls listed per node.
        """
        self.folder = folder
        self.preview_rows, self.save_tables, self.detail_calls = preview_rows, save_tables, max(1, int(detail_calls))
        self.distinct_labels = max(1, int(distinct_labels))
        self.max_table_cells = int(max_table_cells)
        self.local_variables, self.local_preview_rows = bool(local_variables), int(local_preview_rows)
        self.max_repeats_listed = int(max_repeats_listed)
        self.t0 = time.perf_counter()
        self.started = dt.datetime.now()
        self.nodes = [{"id": 0, "parent": None, "fn": title, "calls": 1, "time": 0.0, "start": 0.0, "args": [],
                       "logs": [], "children": [], "depth": 0}]
        self.stack, self.suppress = [0], 0
        self.seen = {}              # (parent id, function key) -> {first string argument: [node ids]}
        self.functions = {}         # function key -> file, line, doc, source
        self.wrapped = {}           # id(original) -> wrapper (long-lived functions only)
        self.examples = {}          # function key -> first call seen only inside a folded call (for docs/)
        self.story = None           # the data story (src/reporting/story.py), shown as its own view
        self.paused = False         # while True, calls are not recorded (used while the story is built)
        self.example_keys = set()   # functions that already have a recorded call
        self.n_wrapped, self.n_library = 0, 0
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(folder, "tables"), exist_ok=True)

    # ---- registration
    def _register(self, fn, library=False, display=None):
        """Add a function to the trace's function list (file, line, docstring, source).

        Args:
            fn: function. library: True for a library routine. display: name to show.

        Returns:
            the function's key.
        """
        key = ("lib:" if library else "") + f"{fn.__module__}.{fn.__qualname__}"
        if key not in self.functions:
            file, src, line = "", "", 0
            if not library:
                try:
                    lines, line = inspect.getsourcelines(fn)
                    src = "".join(lines)
                except (OSError, TypeError):
                    pass
                file = inspect.getsourcefile(fn) or ""
                file = os.path.relpath(file, ROOT) if file else ""
                if fn.__module__ == "__main__":
                    file = os.path.relpath(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[0]), ROOT)
            doc = inspect.getdoc(fn) or ""
            if library and len(doc) > 1500:
                doc = doc[:1500].rsplit("\n", 1)[0] + "\n…"
            self.functions[key] = {"name": display or fn.__qualname__,
                                   "module": file.replace(".py", "").replace(os.sep, ".") if fn.__module__ == "__main__" else fn.__module__,
                                   "file": file, "line": line, "doc": doc, "source": src, "library": library}
        return key

    def wrap(self, fn, library=False, display=None, cache=True):
        """Wrap a function so each call is recorded as a node of the call tree.

        Args:
            fn: function. library: library routine. display: name to show. cache: reuse an existing wrapper.

        Returns:
            the wrapper.
        """
        if cache and id(fn) in self.wrapped:
            return self.wrapped[id(fn)]
        key = self._register(fn, library, display)
        try:
            sig = inspect.signature(fn)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            sig = None
        tr = self

        @functools.wraps(fn)
        def wrapper(*a, **k):
            if tr.paused:
                return fn(*a, **k)
            if tr.suppress:
                if library or key in tr.example_keys:
                    return fn(*a, **k)
                return tr._example_call(key, sig, fn, a, k)
            parent = tr.stack[-1]
            lab = next((x for x in list(a) + list(k.values()) if isinstance(x, str)), None)
            ent = tr.seen.setdefault((parent, key), {"labels": {}, "last": None})
            ids = ent["labels"].get(lab)
            detailed = (len(ids) < tr.detail_calls) if ids is not None else (len(ent["labels"]) < tr.distinct_labels)
            if ids is None and not detailed:
                ent["overflow"] = True
            if not detailed:                                       # repeated call: listed, timed
                node = tr.nodes[ent["last"]]
                node["calls"] += 1
                tr.suppress += 1
                t = time.perf_counter()
                err = None
                try:
                    return fn(*a, **k)
                except Exception as e:
                    node["errors"] = node.get("errors", 0) + 1
                    err = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                    raise
                finally:
                    el = time.perf_counter() - t
                    node["time"] += el
                    tr.suppress -= 1
                    rep = node.setdefault("repeats", [])
                    if len(rep) < tr.max_repeats_listed:
                        desc = ", ".join(compact(x) for x in list(a)[:4] + list(k.values())[:2]
                                         if not (isinstance(x, dict) and "sample" in x) and type(x).__name__ != "Context")
                        rep.append([node["calls"], lab, round(t - tr.t0, 4), round(el, 5), err, desc[:200]])
            nid = len(tr.nodes)
            node = {"id": nid, "parent": parent, "fn": key, "calls": 1, "time": 0.0,
                    "start": round(time.perf_counter() - tr.t0, 4), "depth": tr.nodes[parent]["depth"] + 1,
                    "args": tr._safe(tr._args, sig, a, k) or [], "logs": [], "children": []}
            if lab is not None:
                node["label"] = lab[:60]
            tr.nodes.append(node)
            tr.example_keys.add(key)
            tr.nodes[parent]["children"].append(nid)
            ent["labels"].setdefault(lab, []).append(nid)
            ent["last"] = nid
            if library:                                            # leaf: nothing inside is traced
                tr.suppress += 1
                t = time.perf_counter()
                try:
                    r = fn(*a, **k)
                except Exception as e:
                    node["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                    raise
                finally:
                    node["time"] += time.perf_counter() - t
                    tr.suppress -= 1
                tr._safe(tr._result, node, r)
                return r
            # pass inner functions / lambdas through the tracer too
            a = tuple(tr.wrap(x, cache=False) if _project_function(x) else x for x in a)
            k = {n: (tr.wrap(x, cache=False) if _project_function(x) else x) for n, x in k.items()}
            tr.stack.append(nid)
            box = {}
            if tr.local_variables:
                def grab(frame, event, arg):                     # first Python frame entered = fn itself
                    if event == "call":
                        box["f"] = frame
                        sys.setprofile(None)
                sys.setprofile(grab)
            t = time.perf_counter()
            try:
                r = fn(*a, **k)
            except Exception as e:
                node["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                node["traceback"] = traceback.format_exc()
                raise
            finally:
                node["time"] += time.perf_counter() - t
                if tr.local_variables:
                    sys.setprofile(None)
                tr.stack.pop()
                if "f" in box:
                    tr._safe(tr._locals, node, box.pop("f"))
            tr._safe(tr._result, node, r)
            return r

        wrapper.__traced__ = True
        if cache:
            self.wrapped[id(fn)] = wrapper
        if library:
            self.n_library += 1
        else:
            self.n_wrapped += 1
        return wrapper

    @staticmethod
    def _safe(f, *a):
        """Call f, returning None instead of raising (tracing must never break a run).

        Args:
            f: function. a: its arguments.
        """
        try:
            return f(*a)
        except Exception:                           # tracing must never break the run
            return None

    def _args(self, sig, a, k):
        """Summaries of a call's arguments (name, type, size, detail) and their table previews.

        Args:
            sig: inspect.Signature or None. a, k: positional and keyword arguments.

        Returns:
            list of {name, type, size, detail}.
        """
        try:
            b = sig.bind_partial(*a, **k) if sig else None
            items = list(b.arguments.items()) if b else [(f"arg{i}", v) for i, v in enumerate(a)] + list(k.items())
        except TypeError:
            items = [(f"arg{i}", v) for i, v in enumerate(a)] + list(k.items())
        out = []
        for name, v in items:
            if name == "cfg" and isinstance(v, dict):
                out.append({"name": name, "type": "dict", "size": f"{len(v)} keys", "detail": "the run configuration"})
                continue
            if name in ("args", "kwargs") and isinstance(v, (tuple, dict)):
                vals = v.items() if isinstance(v, dict) else enumerate(v)
                out += [{"name": f"{name}[{i}]", **summarize(x)} for i, x in list(vals)[:8]]
                continue
            out.append({"name": name, **summarize(v)})
        return out

    def _example_call(self, key, sig, fn, a, k):
        """Run a call inside a folded (repeated) call and keep its arguments and result as the function's example.

        Only the first such call of each function is kept, so functions that only ever run inside repeated calls
        (e.g. evaluate inside cached steps) still get an example in the function reference.

        Args:
            key: function key. sig: its signature. fn: the original function. a, k: the call's arguments.

        Returns:
            the function's return value.
        """
        self.example_keys.add(key)
        ex = {"args": self._safe(self._args, sig, a, k) or [], "start": round(time.perf_counter() - self.t0, 4)}
        t = time.perf_counter()
        r = fn(*a, **k)
        ex["time"] = round(time.perf_counter() - t, 4)
        tmp = {"id": 0, "fn": key}
        keep, self.save_tables = self.save_tables, False
        try:
            self._safe(self._result, tmp, r)
        finally:
            self.save_tables = keep
        ex["result"] = tmp.get("result")
        ex["tables"] = [{k2: v for k2, v in t2.items() if k2 != "file"} for t2 in tmp.get("tables", [])[:2]]
        self.examples[key] = ex
        return r

    def _locals(self, node, frame):
        """Variables in the function's frame when it returned (or failed).

        Args:
            node: call node. frame: the function's frame.
        """
        loc = frame.f_locals
        argnames = {a["name"] for a in node["args"]}
        code = frame.f_code
        params = set(code.co_varnames[:code.co_argcount + code.co_kwonlyargcount])
        out, prevs = [], []
        for name, v in loc.items():
            if name.startswith("__") or inspect.ismodule(v) or (inspect.isfunction(v) and name in ("tr", "grab")):
                continue
            if name in params and name in argnames and not isinstance(v, (int, float, str)):
                continue                                         # unchanged input, already listed
            s = summarize(v)
            out.append({"name": name, **s})
            if isinstance(v, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series)) and len(v) and len(prevs) < 6:
                prevs.append({"label": name, **table_json(v, self.local_preview_rows)})
            elif _is_fit_result(v) and len(prevs) < 6:
                try:
                    prevs.append({"label": f"{name} coefficients", **table_json(coef_table(v), 30)})
                except Exception:
                    pass
        node["locals"] = out
        if prevs:
            node["local_tables"] = prevs

    def _result(self, node, r):
        """Store a summary and table previews of a call's return value on its node.

        Args:
            node: call node. r: return value.
        """
        node["result"] = summarize(r)
        prev = []
        for label, t in tables_in(r)[:8]:
            entry = {"label": label, **table_json(t, self.preview_rows)}
            if self.save_tables and t.size > self.max_table_cells:
                entry["file"] = None
                entry["not_saved"] = f"not saved: {t.size:,} cells is above trace.max_table_cells"
            elif self.save_tables:
                safe = "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "_" for c in f"{node['id']:04d}_{node['fn'].split('.')[-1]}_{label}")
                path = os.path.join(self.folder, "tables", safe.strip("_")[:120] + ".csv")
                try:
                    t.to_csv(path)
                    entry["file"] = os.path.relpath(path, ROOT)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            prev.append(entry)
        if prev:
            node["tables"] = prev

    def log(self, msg):
        """Attach a progress message to the call currently running.

        Args:
            msg: text.
        """
        if not self.suppress:
            self.nodes[self.stack[-1]]["logs"].append(str(msg))

    # ---- install into the code
    def install(self, extra_namespaces=(), library=None):
        """Wrap every function/method defined in src/ in every module that refers to it, the entry script's
        own functions, and the listed library routines.

        Args:
            extra_namespaces: namespaces of the entry script (globals()). library: library routines to trace
            (None = defaults).
        """
        mods = [m for n, m in list(sys.modules.items()) if (n == "src" or n.startswith("src.")) and m is not None]
        mods = [m for m in mods if m.__name__ != __name__]
        originals = {}
        for m in mods:
            for name, obj in list(vars(m).items()):
                if inspect.isfunction(obj) and (obj.__module__ or "").startswith("src.") and obj.__module__ != __name__:
                    originals[id(obj)] = obj
                elif inspect.isclass(obj) and (obj.__module__ or "").startswith("src.") and obj.__module__ == m.__name__:
                    for an, av in list(vars(obj).items()):
                        if inspect.isfunction(av) and (not an.startswith("__") or an == "__init__"):
                            setattr(obj, an, self.wrap(av))
        log_fn = next((o for o in originals.values() if o.__name__ == "log" and o.__module__ == "src.utils.io"), None)
        tr = self

        def traced_log(msg):
            log_fn(msg)
            tr.log(msg)

        # library routines: replace them where they are defined and wherever they were imported by name
        libs = {}
        for spec in (LIBRARY if library is None else library):
            try:
                modname, attr = spec.split(":")
                mod = importlib.import_module(modname)
                if "." in attr:
                    cls_name, meth = attr.split(".")
                    cls = getattr(mod, cls_name)
                    fn = vars(cls)[meth]
                    setattr(cls, meth, self.wrap(fn, library=True, display=f"{modname.split('.')[0]}: {cls_name}.{meth}"))
                else:
                    fn = getattr(mod, attr)
                    w = self.wrap(fn, library=True, display=f"{modname.split('.')[0]}: {attr}")
                    setattr(mod, attr, w)
                    libs[id(fn)] = w
            except Exception:
                continue                                         # library not installed / renamed: skip it

        spaces = [vars(m) for m in mods] + list(extra_namespaces)
        for ns in spaces:
            for name, obj in list(ns.items()):
                if id(obj) in originals:
                    o = originals[id(obj)]
                    ns[name] = traced_log if o is log_fn else self.wrap(o)
                elif id(obj) in libs:
                    ns[name] = libs[id(obj)]
        for ns in extra_namespaces:                              # the entry script's own functions
            for name, obj in list(ns.items()):
                if inspect.isfunction(obj) and obj.__module__ == "__main__" and name != "main" \
                        and not getattr(obj, "__traced__", False):
                    ns[name] = self.wrap(obj)
        return self

    # ---- write
    def _tidy(self):
        """Fold groups that ran out of distinct labels (helpers called with many different strings) into one
        entry, then renumber the nodes that are still in the tree."""
        for ent in self.seen.values():
            if not ent.get("overflow"):
                continue
            ids = sorted(i for v in ent["labels"].values() for i in v)
            keep = self.nodes[ids[0]]
            rep = keep.setdefault("repeats", [])
            for i in ids[1:]:
                n = self.nodes[i]
                keep["calls"] += n["calls"]
                keep["time"] += n["time"]
                if len(rep) < self.max_repeats_listed:
                    rep.append([None, n.get("label"), n["start"], round(n["time"], 5), n.get("error"),
                                ", ".join(f"{x['name']}={x['detail'][:40] if x['type'] == 'str' else x['type']}" for x in n["args"][:3])])
                rep.extend(n.get("repeats", [])[:max(0, self.max_repeats_listed - len(rep))])
                kids = self.nodes[n["parent"]]["children"]
                if i in kids:
                    kids.remove(i)
            rep.sort(key=lambda r: r[2])
            for j, r in enumerate(rep):
                r[0] = j + 2
        new, order = {}, []

        def walk(i):
            new[i] = len(order)
            order.append(i)
            for c in self.nodes[i]["children"]:
                walk(c)
        walk(0)
        kept_fns = {self.nodes[i]["fn"] for i in order}
        for n in self.nodes:                         # calls folded away: keep one example per function (docs/)
            if n["id"] not in new and n["fn"] not in kept_fns and n["fn"] not in self.examples and "result" in n:
                self.examples[n["fn"]] = {"args": n.get("args", []), "result": n.get("result"), "time": n.get("time"),
                                          "start": n.get("start"), "label": n.get("label", ""),
                                          "tables": [{k: v for k, v in t.items() if k != "file"}
                                                     for t in n.get("tables", [])[:2]]}
        nodes = []
        for i in order:
            n = dict(self.nodes[i])
            n["id"] = new[i]
            n["parent"] = new.get(n["parent"]) if n["parent"] is not None else None
            n["children"] = [new[c] for c in n["children"]]
            nodes.append(n)
        self.nodes = nodes

    def write(self, meta=None):
        """Write trace.json, trace.log and trace.html and remove old trace folders.

        Args:
            meta: extra run information (command, config).

        Returns:
            path of trace.html.
        """
        self.nodes[0]["time"] = time.perf_counter() - self.t0
        self._tidy()
        for n in self.nodes:
            n["time"] = round(n["time"], 4)
        git = ""
        try:
            git = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", ROOT, "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                 timeout=5).stdout.strip()
            dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", ROOT, "status", "--porcelain"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                   timeout=5).stdout.strip()
            git += " (with uncommitted changes)" if git and dirty else ""
        except Exception:
            pass
        info = {"started": self.started.isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "seconds": round(self.nodes[0]["time"], 2),
                "command": " ".join([os.path.basename(sys.argv[0])] + sys.argv[1:]), "python": platform.python_version(),
                "platform": platform.platform(terse=True), "git": git, "functions_traced": self.n_wrapped,
                "library_functions_traced": self.n_library, "calls_recorded": len(self.nodes) - 1,
                "calls_total": int(sum(n["calls"] for n in self.nodes[1:])), **(meta or {})}
        with open(os.path.join(self.folder, "trace.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({"info": info, "nodes": self.nodes, "functions": self.functions, "examples": self.examples,
                       "story": self.story}, f, default=_cell)
        with open(os.path.join(self.folder, "trace.log"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"# {info['command']}  started {info['started']}  ({info['seconds']}s)\n")
            self._text(0, f)
        return info

    def _text(self, nid, f):
        """Write one call (and its children) to the plain-text trace.log.

        Args:
            nid: node id. f: open file.
        """
        n = self.nodes[nid]
        if nid:
            fn = self.functions[n["fn"]]
            pad = "  " * (n["depth"] - 1)
            rep = f" ×{n['calls']}" if n["calls"] > 1 else ""
            lab = f" '{n['label'][:40]}'" if n.get("label") else ""
            where = "library" if fn.get("library") else f"{fn['file']}:{fn['line']}"
            f.write(f"{pad}{fn['name']}(){lab}{rep}  [{n['time']:.3f}s]  {where}\n")
            for a in n["args"]:
                f.write(f"{pad}    in  {a['name']}: {a['type']} {a['size']} {a['detail']}\n")
            for a in n.get("locals", []):
                f.write(f"{pad}    var {a['name']}: {a['type']} {a['size']} {a['detail']}\n")
            if "result" in n:
                r = n["result"]
                f.write(f"{pad}    out {r['type']} {r['size']} {r['detail']}\n")
            for t in n.get("tables", []):
                f.write(f"{pad}    table {t['label']} {t['n']}×{t['n_cols']}" + (f" -> {t['file']}" if t.get("file") else "") + "\n")
            for m in n["logs"]:
                f.write(f"{pad}    log {m.strip()}\n")
            if n.get("error"):
                f.write(f"{pad}    ERROR {n['error']}\n")
        for c in n["children"]:
            self._text(c, f)

    def __init__(self, folder, title, preview_rows=20, save_tables=True, detail_calls=1, distinct_labels=8,
                 max_table_cells=200_000, local_variables=True, local_preview_rows=8, max_repeats_listed=500):
        """Create a tracer writing to folder; the settings come from the trace: section of the config.

        Args:
            folder: output folder. title: page title. preview_rows: table rows shown. save_tables: save
            returned tables as CSV. detail_calls: repeated calls recorded in full. distinct_labels: calls with
            different text arguments shown separately. max_table_cells: larger tables are not saved.
            local_variables: record local variables. local_preview_rows: rows per local table.
            max_repeats_listed: repeated calls listed per node.
        """
        self.folder = folder
        self.preview_rows, self.save_tables, self.detail_calls = preview_rows, save_tables, max(1, int(detail_calls))
        self.distinct_labels = max(1, int(distinct_labels))
        self.max_table_cells = int(max_table_cells)
        self.local_variables, self.local_preview_rows = bool(local_variables), int(local_preview_rows)
        self.max_repeats_listed = int(max_repeats_listed)
        self.t0 = time.perf_counter()
        self.started = dt.datetime.now()
        self.nodes = [{"id": 0, "parent": None, "fn": title, "calls": 1, "time": 0.0, "start": 0.0, "args": [],
                       "logs": [], "children": [], "depth": 0}]
        self.stack, self.suppress = [0], 0
        self.seen = {}              # (parent id, function key) -> {first string argument: [node ids]}
        self.functions = {}         # function key -> file, line, doc, source
        self.wrapped = {}           # id(original) -> wrapper (long-lived functions only)
        self.examples = {}          # function key -> first call seen only inside a folded call (for docs/)
        self.story = None           # the data story (src/reporting/story.py), shown as its own view
        self.paused = False         # while True, calls are not recorded (used while the story is built)
        self.example_keys = set()   # functions that already have a recorded call
        self.n_wrapped, self.n_library = 0, 0
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(folder, "tables"), exist_ok=True)

    def _register(self, fn, library=False, display=None):
        """Add a function to the trace's function list (file, line, docstring, source).

        Args:
            fn: function. library: True for a library routine. display: name to show.

        Returns:
            the function's key.
        """
        key = ("lib:" if library else "") + f"{fn.__module__}.{fn.__qualname__}"
        if key not in self.functions:
            file, src, line = "", "", 0
            if not library:
                try:
                    lines, line = inspect.getsourcelines(fn)
                    src = "".join(lines)
                except (OSError, TypeError):
                    pass
                file = inspect.getsourcefile(fn) or ""
                file = os.path.relpath(file, ROOT) if file else ""
                if fn.__module__ == "__main__":
                    file = os.path.relpath(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[0]), ROOT)
            doc = inspect.getdoc(fn) or ""
            if library and len(doc) > 1500:
                doc = doc[:1500].rsplit("\n", 1)[0] + "\n…"
            self.functions[key] = {"name": display or fn.__qualname__,
                                   "module": file.replace(".py", "").replace(os.sep, ".") if fn.__module__ == "__main__" else fn.__module__,
                                   "file": file, "line": line, "doc": doc, "source": src, "library": library}
        return key

    def wrap(self, fn, library=False, display=None, cache=True):
        """Wrap a function so each call is recorded as a node of the call tree.

        Args:
            fn: function. library: library routine. display: name to show. cache: reuse an existing wrapper.

        Returns:
            the wrapper.
        """
        if cache and id(fn) in self.wrapped:
            return self.wrapped[id(fn)]
        key = self._register(fn, library, display)
        try:
            sig = inspect.signature(fn)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            sig = None
        tr = self

        @functools.wraps(fn)
        def wrapper(*a, **k):
            if tr.paused:
                return fn(*a, **k)
            if tr.suppress:
                if library or key in tr.example_keys:
                    return fn(*a, **k)
                return tr._example_call(key, sig, fn, a, k)
            parent = tr.stack[-1]
            lab = next((x for x in list(a) + list(k.values()) if isinstance(x, str)), None)
            ent = tr.seen.setdefault((parent, key), {"labels": {}, "last": None})
            ids = ent["labels"].get(lab)
            detailed = (len(ids) < tr.detail_calls) if ids is not None else (len(ent["labels"]) < tr.distinct_labels)
            if ids is None and not detailed:
                ent["overflow"] = True
            if not detailed:                                       # repeated call: listed, timed
                node = tr.nodes[ent["last"]]
                node["calls"] += 1
                tr.suppress += 1
                t = time.perf_counter()
                err = None
                try:
                    return fn(*a, **k)
                except Exception as e:
                    node["errors"] = node.get("errors", 0) + 1
                    err = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                    raise
                finally:
                    el = time.perf_counter() - t
                    node["time"] += el
                    tr.suppress -= 1
                    rep = node.setdefault("repeats", [])
                    if len(rep) < tr.max_repeats_listed:
                        desc = ", ".join(compact(x) for x in list(a)[:4] + list(k.values())[:2]
                                         if not (isinstance(x, dict) and "sample" in x) and type(x).__name__ != "Context")
                        rep.append([node["calls"], lab, round(t - tr.t0, 4), round(el, 5), err, desc[:200]])
            nid = len(tr.nodes)
            node = {"id": nid, "parent": parent, "fn": key, "calls": 1, "time": 0.0,
                    "start": round(time.perf_counter() - tr.t0, 4), "depth": tr.nodes[parent]["depth"] + 1,
                    "args": tr._safe(tr._args, sig, a, k) or [], "logs": [], "children": []}
            if lab is not None:
                node["label"] = lab[:60]
            tr.nodes.append(node)
            tr.example_keys.add(key)
            tr.nodes[parent]["children"].append(nid)
            ent["labels"].setdefault(lab, []).append(nid)
            ent["last"] = nid
            if library:                                            # leaf: nothing inside is traced
                tr.suppress += 1
                t = time.perf_counter()
                try:
                    r = fn(*a, **k)
                except Exception as e:
                    node["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                    raise
                finally:
                    node["time"] += time.perf_counter() - t
                    tr.suppress -= 1
                tr._safe(tr._result, node, r)
                return r
            # pass inner functions / lambdas through the tracer too
            a = tuple(tr.wrap(x, cache=False) if _project_function(x) else x for x in a)
            k = {n: (tr.wrap(x, cache=False) if _project_function(x) else x) for n, x in k.items()}
            tr.stack.append(nid)
            box = {}
            if tr.local_variables:
                def grab(frame, event, arg):                     # first Python frame entered = fn itself
                    if event == "call":
                        box["f"] = frame
                        sys.setprofile(None)
                sys.setprofile(grab)
            t = time.perf_counter()
            try:
                r = fn(*a, **k)
            except Exception as e:
                node["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                node["traceback"] = traceback.format_exc()
                raise
            finally:
                node["time"] += time.perf_counter() - t
                if tr.local_variables:
                    sys.setprofile(None)
                tr.stack.pop()
                if "f" in box:
                    tr._safe(tr._locals, node, box.pop("f"))
            tr._safe(tr._result, node, r)
            return r

        wrapper.__traced__ = True
        if cache:
            self.wrapped[id(fn)] = wrapper
        if library:
            self.n_library += 1
        else:
            self.n_wrapped += 1
        return wrapper

    def _args(self, sig, a, k):
        """Summaries of a call's arguments (name, type, size, detail) and their table previews.

        Args:
            sig: inspect.Signature or None. a, k: positional and keyword arguments.

        Returns:
            list of {name, type, size, detail}.
        """
        try:
            b = sig.bind_partial(*a, **k) if sig else None
            items = list(b.arguments.items()) if b else [(f"arg{i}", v) for i, v in enumerate(a)] + list(k.items())
        except TypeError:
            items = [(f"arg{i}", v) for i, v in enumerate(a)] + list(k.items())
        out = []
        for name, v in items:
            if name == "cfg" and isinstance(v, dict):
                out.append({"name": name, "type": "dict", "size": f"{len(v)} keys", "detail": "the run configuration"})
                continue
            if name in ("args", "kwargs") and isinstance(v, (tuple, dict)):
                vals = v.items() if isinstance(v, dict) else enumerate(v)
                out += [{"name": f"{name}[{i}]", **summarize(x)} for i, x in list(vals)[:8]]
                continue
            out.append({"name": name, **summarize(v)})
        return out

    def _example_call(self, key, sig, fn, a, k):
        """Run a call inside a folded (repeated) call and keep its arguments and result as the function's example.

        Only the first such call of each function is kept, so functions that only ever run inside repeated calls
        (e.g. evaluate inside cached steps) still get an example in the function reference.

        Args:
            key: function key. sig: its signature. fn: the original function. a, k: the call's arguments.

        Returns:
            the function's return value.
        """
        self.example_keys.add(key)
        ex = {"args": self._safe(self._args, sig, a, k) or [], "start": round(time.perf_counter() - self.t0, 4)}
        t = time.perf_counter()
        r = fn(*a, **k)
        ex["time"] = round(time.perf_counter() - t, 4)
        tmp = {"id": 0, "fn": key}
        keep, self.save_tables = self.save_tables, False
        try:
            self._safe(self._result, tmp, r)
        finally:
            self.save_tables = keep
        ex["result"] = tmp.get("result")
        ex["tables"] = [{k2: v for k2, v in t2.items() if k2 != "file"} for t2 in tmp.get("tables", [])[:2]]
        self.examples[key] = ex
        return r

    def _locals(self, node, frame):
        """Variables in the function's frame when it returned (or failed).

        Args:
            node: call node. frame: the function's frame.
        """
        loc = frame.f_locals
        argnames = {a["name"] for a in node["args"]}
        code = frame.f_code
        params = set(code.co_varnames[:code.co_argcount + code.co_kwonlyargcount])
        out, prevs = [], []
        for name, v in loc.items():
            if name.startswith("__") or inspect.ismodule(v) or (inspect.isfunction(v) and name in ("tr", "grab")):
                continue
            if name in params and name in argnames and not isinstance(v, (int, float, str)):
                continue                                         # unchanged input, already listed
            s = summarize(v)
            out.append({"name": name, **s})
            if isinstance(v, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series)) and len(v) and len(prevs) < 6:
                prevs.append({"label": name, **table_json(v, self.local_preview_rows)})
            elif _is_fit_result(v) and len(prevs) < 6:
                try:
                    prevs.append({"label": f"{name} coefficients", **table_json(coef_table(v), 30)})
                except Exception:
                    pass
        node["locals"] = out
        if prevs:
            node["local_tables"] = prevs

    def install(self, extra_namespaces=(), library=None):
        """Wrap every function/method defined in src/ in every module that refers to it, the entry script's
        own functions, and the listed library routines.

        Args:
            extra_namespaces: namespaces of the entry script (globals()). library: library routines to trace
            (None = defaults).
        """
        mods = [m for n, m in list(sys.modules.items()) if (n == "src" or n.startswith("src.")) and m is not None]
        mods = [m for m in mods if m.__name__ != __name__]
        originals = {}
        for m in mods:
            for name, obj in list(vars(m).items()):
                if inspect.isfunction(obj) and (obj.__module__ or "").startswith("src.") and obj.__module__ != __name__:
                    originals[id(obj)] = obj
                elif inspect.isclass(obj) and (obj.__module__ or "").startswith("src.") and obj.__module__ == m.__name__:
                    for an, av in list(vars(obj).items()):
                        if inspect.isfunction(av) and (not an.startswith("__") or an == "__init__"):
                            setattr(obj, an, self.wrap(av))
        log_fn = next((o for o in originals.values() if o.__name__ == "log" and o.__module__ == "src.utils.io"), None)
        tr = self

        def traced_log(msg):
            log_fn(msg)
            tr.log(msg)

        # library routines: replace them where they are defined and wherever they were imported by name
        libs = {}
        for spec in (LIBRARY if library is None else library):
            try:
                modname, attr = spec.split(":")
                mod = importlib.import_module(modname)
                if "." in attr:
                    cls_name, meth = attr.split(".")
                    cls = getattr(mod, cls_name)
                    fn = vars(cls)[meth]
                    setattr(cls, meth, self.wrap(fn, library=True, display=f"{modname.split('.')[0]}: {cls_name}.{meth}"))
                else:
                    fn = getattr(mod, attr)
                    w = self.wrap(fn, library=True, display=f"{modname.split('.')[0]}: {attr}")
                    setattr(mod, attr, w)
                    libs[id(fn)] = w
            except Exception:
                continue                                         # library not installed / renamed: skip it

        spaces = [vars(m) for m in mods] + list(extra_namespaces)
        for ns in spaces:
            for name, obj in list(ns.items()):
                if id(obj) in originals:
                    o = originals[id(obj)]
                    ns[name] = traced_log if o is log_fn else self.wrap(o)
                elif id(obj) in libs:
                    ns[name] = libs[id(obj)]
        for ns in extra_namespaces:                              # the entry script's own functions
            for name, obj in list(ns.items()):
                if inspect.isfunction(obj) and obj.__module__ == "__main__" and name != "main" \
                        and not getattr(obj, "__traced__", False):
                    ns[name] = self.wrap(obj)
        return self

    def _tidy(self):
        """Fold groups that ran out of distinct labels (helpers called with many different strings) into one
        entry, then renumber the nodes that are still in the tree."""
        for ent in self.seen.values():
            if not ent.get("overflow"):
                continue
            ids = sorted(i for v in ent["labels"].values() for i in v)
            keep = self.nodes[ids[0]]
            rep = keep.setdefault("repeats", [])
            for i in ids[1:]:
                n = self.nodes[i]
                keep["calls"] += n["calls"]
                keep["time"] += n["time"]
                if len(rep) < self.max_repeats_listed:
                    rep.append([None, n.get("label"), n["start"], round(n["time"], 5), n.get("error"),
                                ", ".join(f"{x['name']}={x['detail'][:40] if x['type'] == 'str' else x['type']}" for x in n["args"][:3])])
                rep.extend(n.get("repeats", [])[:max(0, self.max_repeats_listed - len(rep))])
                kids = self.nodes[n["parent"]]["children"]
                if i in kids:
                    kids.remove(i)
            rep.sort(key=lambda r: r[2])
            for j, r in enumerate(rep):
                r[0] = j + 2
        new, order = {}, []

        def walk(i):
            new[i] = len(order)
            order.append(i)
            for c in self.nodes[i]["children"]:
                walk(c)
        walk(0)
        kept_fns = {self.nodes[i]["fn"] for i in order}
        for n in self.nodes:                         # calls folded away: keep one example per function (docs/)
            if n["id"] not in new and n["fn"] not in kept_fns and n["fn"] not in self.examples and "result" in n:
                self.examples[n["fn"]] = {"args": n.get("args", []), "result": n.get("result"), "time": n.get("time"),
                                          "start": n.get("start"), "label": n.get("label", ""),
                                          "tables": [{k: v for k, v in t.items() if k != "file"}
                                                     for t in n.get("tables", [])[:2]]}
        nodes = []
        for i in order:
            n = dict(self.nodes[i])
            n["id"] = new[i]
            n["parent"] = new.get(n["parent"]) if n["parent"] is not None else None
            n["children"] = [new[c] for c in n["children"]]
            nodes.append(n)
        self.nodes = nodes

    def write(self, meta=None):
        """Write trace.json, trace.log and trace.html and remove old trace folders.

        Args:
            meta: extra run information (command, config).

        Returns:
            path of trace.html.
        """
        self.nodes[0]["time"] = time.perf_counter() - self.t0
        self._tidy()
        for n in self.nodes:
            n["time"] = round(n["time"], 4)
        git = ""
        try:
            git = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", ROOT, "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                 timeout=5).stdout.strip()
            dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", ROOT, "status", "--porcelain"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                   timeout=5).stdout.strip()
            git += " (with uncommitted changes)" if git and dirty else ""
        except Exception:
            pass
        info = {"started": self.started.isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "seconds": round(self.nodes[0]["time"], 2),
                "command": " ".join([os.path.basename(sys.argv[0])] + sys.argv[1:]), "python": platform.python_version(),
                "platform": platform.platform(terse=True), "git": git, "functions_traced": self.n_wrapped,
                "library_functions_traced": self.n_library, "calls_recorded": len(self.nodes) - 1,
                "calls_total": int(sum(n["calls"] for n in self.nodes[1:])), **(meta or {})}
        with open(os.path.join(self.folder, "trace.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({"info": info, "nodes": self.nodes, "functions": self.functions, "examples": self.examples,
                       "story": self.story}, f, default=_cell)
        with open(os.path.join(self.folder, "trace.log"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"# {info['command']}  started {info['started']}  ({info['seconds']}s)\n")
            self._text(0, f)
        return info

    def _text(self, nid, f):
        """Write one call (and its children) to the plain-text trace.log.

        Args:
            nid: node id. f: open file.
        """
        n = self.nodes[nid]
        if nid:
            fn = self.functions[n["fn"]]
            pad = "  " * (n["depth"] - 1)
            rep = f" ×{n['calls']}" if n["calls"] > 1 else ""
            lab = f" '{n['label'][:40]}'" if n.get("label") else ""
            where = "library" if fn.get("library") else f"{fn['file']}:{fn['line']}"
            f.write(f"{pad}{fn['name']}(){lab}{rep}  [{n['time']:.3f}s]  {where}\n")
            for a in n["args"]:
                f.write(f"{pad}    in  {a['name']}: {a['type']} {a['size']} {a['detail']}\n")
            for a in n.get("locals", []):
                f.write(f"{pad}    var {a['name']}: {a['type']} {a['size']} {a['detail']}\n")
            if "result" in n:
                r = n["result"]
                f.write(f"{pad}    out {r['type']} {r['size']} {r['detail']}\n")
            for t in n.get("tables", []):
                f.write(f"{pad}    table {t['label']} {t['n']}×{t['n_cols']}" + (f" -> {t['file']}" if t.get("file") else "") + "\n")
            for m in n["logs"]:
                f.write(f"{pad}    log {m.strip()}\n")
            if n.get("error"):
                f.write(f"{pad}    ERROR {n['error']}\n")
        for c in n["children"]:
            self._text(c, f)

def add_story(builder, log=print):
    """Build the data story with the running tracer paused (its own calls are not part of the run) and keep it
    for trace.html. Does nothing when tracing is off; a failure is reported and never stops the run.

    Args:
        builder: function returning {"steps": [...], ...} (see src/reporting/story.py). log: message function.
    """
    tr = _ACTIVE
    if tr is None:
        return
    tr.paused = True
    try:
        tr.story = builder()
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        log(f"Data story not built: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        tr.story = {"error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "traceback": traceback.format_exc(), "steps": []}
    finally:
        tr.paused = False

def start(cfg, title, namespace, enabled=True):
    """Create and install a tracer from the config's `trace:` section. Returns None when tracing is off.

    Args:
        title: page title. namespace: the script's globals(). enabled: False = no trace.
    """
    t = cfg.get("trace", {})
    if not enabled or not t.get("enabled", True):
        return None
    base = os.path.join(cfg["out_dir"], t.get("folder", "trace"))
    os.makedirs(base, exist_ok=True)
    old = sorted(d for d in os.listdir(base) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(base, d)) and d[:2] == "20")
    for d in old[:max(0, len(old) - int(t.get("keep_runs", 10)) + 1)]:      # keep the newest keep_runs traces
        shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(base, d), ignore_errors=True)
    folder = os.path.join(base, dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"))
    tr = Tracer(folder, title, t.get("preview_rows", 20), t.get("save_tables", True), t.get("detail_calls", 1),
                t.get("distinct_labels", 8), t.get("max_table_cells", 200_000), t.get("local_variables", True),
                t.get("local_preview_rows", 8))
    lib = t.get("library_functions")
    global _ACTIVE
    _ACTIVE = tr
    return tr.install([namespace], library=None if lib in (None, "default") else (lib or []))

def finish(tracer, meta=None, log=print):
    """Write trace.json / trace.log and build trace.html.

    Args:
        tracer: from start (None does nothing).
    """
    if tracer is None:
        return
    info = tracer.write(meta)
    try:
        sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "tools"))
        from trace_to_html import build
        page = build(os.path.join(tracer.folder, "trace.json"))
        log(f"Trace: {info['calls_total']} calls of {info['functions_traced']} project functions and "
            f"{info['library_functions_traced']} library routines -> {page}")
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"Trace written to {tracer.folder} (HTML not built: {e})")

def main():
    """Command line entry."""
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--config", default=os.path.join(HERE, "config", "example_config.yaml"))
    ap.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="also list the checks that passed")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    try:
        cfg = load_config(a.config)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"The config cannot be loaded: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        sys.exit(2)
    rep = check(cfg)
    print(f"Checking {a.config}" + rep.text(show_ok=a.all or not (rep.errors or rep.warnings)))
    sys.exit(2 if rep.errors else 0)

tools/fetch_statcan.py

module tools.fetch_statcan · 13 items
Real example data from Statistics Canada: download, build the files the project reads, write the config.

    python tools/fetch_statcan.py                              # uses config/statcan_series.yaml
    python tools/fetch_statcan.py --spec my_series.yaml
    python tools/fetch_statcan.py --describe 14100287          # a table's dimensions and members
    python run_targets.py --config config/statcan.yaml --list  # then run, e.g. --all

Statistics Canada's Web Data Service (https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/wds/rest/) is free and needs no key. For each
series in the spec, the tool reads the table's metadata (getCubeMetadata), turns the member names into the
coordinate, and downloads the series (getDataFromCubePidCoordAndLatestNPeriods). Monthly data become quarterly.
Downloads are cached in data/<name>/raw/, so a re-run works offline; --refresh downloads again.

Writes, in data/<name>/:
    targets.csv             date + one column per target (household mortgage debt, consumer credit, ...)
    scenarios/<name>.csv    one file per scenario: the actual history, then the scenario path
    macro_metadata.csv      description, theme, geography, transform and expected sign of every series
    sources.csv             table, coordinate, vector and title of every series, with the download date
and config/<name>.yaml, a run_targets.py-ready config (from config/example_config.yaml, with the dates set from the
data). The scenarios are illustrative, built from simple rules (see the spec); replace them with a provider's or your
own for real use. Statistics Canada data: Statistics Canada Open Licence (https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/terms-conditions/open-licence).

Needs internet access to www150.statcan.gc.ca (behind a corporate proxy, set HTTPS_PROXY); no extra packages.

def post(method, body, tries=4):
    """POST to the Web Data Service; returns the parsed JSON (retries on network errors and rate limits).
    Standard library only; the HTTPS_PROXY environment variable is honoured."""
    import urllib.error
    import urllib.request
    data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(WDS + method, data=data, method="POST",
                                         headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "macroforecast"})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
                return json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            if e.code == 429 and i < tries - 1:
                time.sleep(2 + 2 * i)
                continue
            if i == tries - 1:
                raise SystemExit(f"Statistics Canada answered {e.code} to {method}: {e.reason}")
        except Exception as e:
            if i == tries - 1:
                raise SystemExit(f"Statistics Canada did not answer {method}: {e}\n"
                                 "Check the internet connection (and HTTPS_PROXY behind a corporate proxy).")
        time.sleep(1 + i)

def cached(path, refresh, fetch):
    if os.path.exists(path) and not refresh:
        return json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
    out = fetch()
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    json.dump(out, open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8"))
    return out

def find_member(dim, want):
    """The member of a dimension named by `want` (exact name, else every word of a string or list contained)."""
    mem = dim["member"]
    if want is None:
        return mem[0], f"first member '{mem[0]['memberNameEn']}'"
    if isinstance(want, int):
        hit = [m for m in mem if m["memberId"] == want]
        if hit:
            return hit[0], None
    names = [m["memberNameEn"] for m in mem]
    exact = [m for m in mem if _words(m["memberNameEn"]) == _words(want)] if isinstance(want, str) else []
    if exact:
        return exact[0], None
    words = [_words(w) for w in (want if isinstance(want, list) else [want])]
    hit = [m for m in mem if all(w in _words(m["memberNameEn"]) for w in words)]
    if not hit:
        raise SystemExit(f"'{dim['dimensionNameEn']}': no member matches {want}. Members:\n  - " + "\n  - ".join(names[:80])
                         + ("\n  ..." if len(names) > 80 else ""))
    hit.sort(key=lambda m: len(m["memberNameEn"]))
    note = (f"'{want}' matched {len(hit)} members; using the shortest, '{hit[0]['memberNameEn']}'" if len(hit) > 1 else None)
    return hit[0], note

def coordinate(meta, members):
    """Coordinate string ('1.2.0...') from member names per dimension; notes on the choices made."""
    dims = sorted(meta["dimension"], key=lambda d: d["dimensionPositionId"])
    given = {_words(k): v for k, v in (members or {}).items()}
    unknown = set(given) - {_words(d["dimensionNameEn"]) for d in dims}
    if unknown:
        raise SystemExit(f"table {meta['productId']}: no dimension named {sorted(unknown)}; dimensions: "
                         f"{[d['dimensionNameEn'] for d in dims]}")
    ids, notes, labels = [], [], []
    for d in dims:
        m, note = find_member(d, given.get(_words(d["dimensionNameEn"])))
        ids.append(str(m["memberId"]))
        labels.append(m["memberNameEn"])
        if note:
            notes.append(f"{d['dimensionNameEn']}: {note}")
    return ".".join(ids + ["0"] * (10 - len(ids))), notes, labels

def download(pid, coord, raw, refresh=False, n=800):
    res = cached(os.path.join(raw, f"data_{pid}_{coord.replace('.', '-')}.json"), refresh,
                 lambda: post("getDataFromCubePidCoordAndLatestNPeriods",
                              [{"productId": int(pid), "coordinate": coord, "latestN": n}]))
    r = res[0] if isinstance(res, list) else res
    if r.get("status") != "SUCCESS":
        raise SystemExit(f"table {pid}, coordinate {coord}: {r.get('object') or r}")
    o = r["object"]
    pts = o.get("vectorDataPoint") or []
    s = pd.Series({p["refPer"]: (float(p["value"]) if p.get("value") not in (None, "") else np.nan) for p in pts},
                  dtype=float)
    s.index = pd.to_datetime(s.index)
    sf = SCALE.get(int(pts[0].get("scalarFactorCode", 0) or 0), 1) if pts else 1
    return s.sort_index(), o.get("vectorId"), sf

def quarterly(s, agg):
    q = s.groupby(s.index.to_period("Q"))
    out = q.last() if agg == "last" else q.mean()
    n = q.size()
    full = n >= n.mode().iloc[0] if len(n) else n                 # drop a quarter with missing months at the end
    return out[full]

def scenario_paths(H, spec, codes, transforms, hist_end, horizon):
    """Each scenario: history, then the baseline path plus the scenario's shock (see the spec)."""
    fut = pd.period_range(hist_end + 1, periods=horizon, freq="Q")
    base = {}
    for c in codes:
        x = H[c].dropna()
        if transforms[c] == "dlog":
            g = np.log(x).diff().tail(20).mean()
            base[c] = x.iloc[-1] * np.exp(g * np.arange(1, horizon + 1))
        else:
            base[c] = np.repeat(x.iloc[-1], horizon)
    out = {}
    for name, sc in (spec or {"Baseline": {}}).items():
        sc = sc or {}
        peak = int(sc.get("peak", 4))
        t = np.arange(1, horizon + 1)
        shape = np.where(t <= peak, t / peak, 1 - 0.5 * (t - peak) / max(horizon - peak, 1))
        P = {}
        for c in codes:
            s = float((sc.get("shocks") or {}).get(c, 0.0))
            P[c] = base[c] * (1 + s / 100 * shape) if transforms[c] == "dlog" else base[c] + s * shape
        F = pd.DataFrame(P, index=fut)
        out[name] = pd.concat([H[codes].loc[:hist_end], F])
    return out

def build(spec_file, refresh=False, log=print):
    spec = yaml.safe_load(open(spec_file, encoding="utf-8"))
    name = spec.get("name", "statcan")
    folder = os.path.join(HERE, "data", name)
    raw = os.path.join(folder, "raw")
    start = pd.Period(spec.get("start", "1995Q1"), freq="Q")
    series, src = {}, []
    for role in ("targets", "macro"):
        for it in spec.get(role) or []:
            meta = metadata(it["table"], raw, refresh)
            coord, notes, labels = coordinate(meta, it.get("members"))
            s, vec, sf = download(it["table"], coord, raw, refresh)
            if s.dropna().empty:
                raise SystemExit(f"{it['code']}: no data at coordinate {coord} of table {it['table']} ({labels})")
            freq = "monthly" if s.index.to_series().diff().dt.days.median() < 40 else "quarterly"
            q = quarterly(s, it.get("agg", "last" if role == "targets" else "mean"))
            series[it["code"]] = q.loc[start:]
            src.append({"code": it["code"], "role": role, "table": it["table"], "title": meta.get("cubeTitleEn"),
                        "coordinate": coord, "vector": f"v{vec}" if vec else "", "members": " | ".join(labels),
                        "frequency": freq, "scalar_factor": sf, "first": str(q.index[0]), "last": str(q.index[-1]),
                        "downloaded": dt.date.today().isoformat()})
            log(f"  {it['code']:<28s} table {it['table']} v{vec}  {q.index[0]}-{q.index[-1]}  " + "; ".join(notes))
    H = pd.DataFrame(series).sort_index()
    tcodes = [t["code"] for t in spec["targets"]]
    mcodes = [m["code"] for m in spec["macro"]]
    hist_end = min(H[c].last_valid_index() for c in mcodes)          # every driver observed
    t_end = min(H[c].last_valid_index() for c in tcodes)
    hist_end = min(hist_end, t_end)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(folder, "scenarios"), exist_ok=True)
    T = H[tcodes].loc[:hist_end]
    T.insert(0, "date", [str(q) for q in T.index])
    T.to_csv(os.path.join(folder, "targets.csv"), index=False)
    M = H[mcodes].ffill(limit=1)                                    # a missing last value (late release): carried
    tr = {m["code"]: m.get("transform", "dlog") for m in spec["macro"]}
    paths = scenario_paths(M, spec.get("scenarios"), mcodes, tr, hist_end, int(spec.get("horizon", 12)))
    for nm, P in paths.items():
        P = P.copy()
        P.insert(0, "date", [str(q) for q in P.index])
        P.to_csv(os.path.join(folder, "scenarios", f"{nm}.csv"), index=False)
    md = pd.DataFrame([{"mnemonic": m["code"], "description": m["description"], "geography": m.get("geography", "Canada"),
                        "theme": m.get("theme", "Other"), "transform": tr[m["code"]], "expected_sign": int(m.get("sign", 0))}
                       for m in spec["macro"]])
    md.to_csv(os.path.join(folder, "macro_metadata.csv"), index=False)
    pd.DataFrame(src).to_csv(os.path.join(folder, "sources.csv"), index=False)
    cfg = write_config(spec, name, folder, paths, hist_end, log)
    log(f"\n{len(tcodes)} targets and {len(mcodes)} drivers, {H.index[0]} to {hist_end}; "
        f"{len(paths)} scenarios to {hist_end + int(spec.get('horizon', 12))}")
    log(f"Files in {folder}; config {cfg}")
    return cfg

def write_config(spec, name, folder, paths, hist_end, log=print):
    """config/<name>.yaml through the set-up tool (tools/new_data_setup.py): dates from the data, the literature
    concepts mapped to these series, the example's comments kept; plus a targets block for run_targets.py."""
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(HERE, "tools"))
    import new_data_setup as setup
    tcodes = [t["code"] for t in spec["targets"]]
    files = {k: os.path.join(folder, "scenarios", f"{k}.csv") for k in paths}
    P = setup.propose(os.path.join(folder, "targets.csv"), files, os.path.join(folder, "macro_metadata.csv"), None,
                      None, tcodes[0], "Canada", name, log=lambda m: None)
    P["dates"]["dummies"] = list(spec.get("dummy_quarters") or [])
    cfg, lit = setup.write_config(P, name, {"target.units": setup.yq("$ millions"),
                                            "target.display_scale": "1000", "target.display_units": setup.yq("$ billions"),
                                            "features.allowed_geographies":
                                                setup.yq(sorted({m.get("geography", "Canada") for m in spec["macro"]}))},
                                  fast=True, log=log)
    block = {"targets": {"run": tcodes, "labels": {t["code"]: t.get("description", t["code"]) for t in spec["targets"]}}}
    with open(cfg, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n# Every target in data/" + name + "/targets.csv (python run_targets.py --config " +
                os.path.relpath(cfg, HERE).replace(os.sep, "/") + " --list)\n" + yaml.safe_dump(block, sort_keys=False))
    with open(cfg, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        txt = f.read()
    with open(cfg, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("# Data: Statistics Canada (Statistics Canada Open Licence), downloaded by tools/fetch_statcan.py.\n"
                "# The scenarios are illustrative rule-based paths (config/statcan_series.yaml), not forecasts.\n" + txt)
    return cfg

module tools.impact · 4 items
How the economy affects the target, from a finished run: sensitivities, what-if shocks, historical episodes,
scenario attribution and how far each effect can be trusted. run_pipeline.py runs it at the end of every run;
use this to try other shocks without re-running anything.

    python tools/impact.py --config config/my.yaml
    python tools/impact.py --config config/my.yaml --shock unemployment:+2:4 --shock FRBOC.IC:+1:2
    python tools/impact.py --config config/my.yaml --shock "Recession=unemployment:+2:4,FRMORT5Y.IC:-1:2"
    python tools/impact.py --config config/my.yaml --episode 2008Q3:2009Q4 --episode 2022Q1:2023Q2

--shock VARIABLE:SIZE[:QUARTERS[:START]]   VARIABLE = literature concept, series name or feature; SIZE in points
    for rates (+1 = one percentage point) and in percent of the level for prices, income and other levels;
    QUARTERS = build-up (default 1); START = first forecast quarter hit (default 1). The shift is permanent.
    NAME=SHOCK,SHOCK,... combines several shocks into one what-if.
--episode START:END   replay the changes of a historical period on top of the base scenario.

Writes outputs/<run>/impact/ (see src/impact/analysis.py).

def parse_shock(text):
    """'unemployment:+2:4' -> {'variable': 'unemployment', 'size': 2.0, 'quarters': 4}."""
    p = [x.strip() for x in text.split(":")]
    if len(p) < 2:
        raise ValueError(f"shock '{text}': write VARIABLE:SIZE[:QUARTERS[:START]]")
    out = {"variable": p[0], "size": float(p[1])}
    if len(p) > 2 and p[2]:
        out["quarters"] = int(p[2])
    if len(p) > 3 and p[3]:
        out["start"] = int(p[3])
    return out

def parse_what_if(texts):
    """--shock arguments -> impact.what_if entries."""
    out = []
    for t in texts or []:
        name, _, body = t.partition("=") if "=" in t else ("", "", t)
        shocks = [parse_shock(x) for x in body.split(",") if x.strip()]
        out.append({"name": name or ", ".join(f"{s['variable']} {s['size']:+g}" for s in shocks), "shocks": shocks})
    return out

def make(config, run_dir=None, what_if=None, episodes=None, log=print):
    """Run the impact analysis on a finished run.

    Args:
        config: config file. run_dir: the run folder (default outputs/<run_name>).
        what_if: list of {name, shocks}; episodes: list of {name, start, end}; None = the config's.

    Returns:
        dict of tables.
    """
    cfg = load_config(config)
    run_dir = run_dir or cfg["out_dir"]
    models = load_models(run_dir)
    if not models:
        raise SystemExit(f"No fitted models in {run_dir}: run run_pipeline.py first (with save.fitted_models: true).")
    ctx = Context(cfg)
    return analysis.run(cfg, ctx, models, run_dir, log, what_if=what_if, episodes=episodes)

    """pairs: {target: (workbook or None, metadata or None)}. Writes the master."""
    S = {k: [] for k in ("models", "concepts", "settings", "how_to_fill", "metadata")}
    refs = {}
    for t, (wb, md) in pairs.items():
        if wb:
            x = {k.strip().lower(): v for k, v in pd.read_excel(wb, sheet_name=None).items()}
            for k in ("models", "concepts", "settings"):
                if k in x:
                    S[k].append(x[k].assign(target=t))
            if "how to fill" in x:
                h = x["how to fill"]
                S["how_to_fill"].append(pd.DataFrame({"target": t, "line": h.iloc[:, 0].values}))
            if "references" in x:
                for r in x["references"].fillna("").itertuples(index=False):
                    refs.setdefault(tuple(r), set()).add(t)
        if md:
            S["metadata"].append(pd.read_csv(md).assign(target=t))
    sheets = {}
    tg = []
    for t, (wb, md) in pairs.items():
        mo = [d for d in S["models"] if d["target"].iloc[0] == t]
        core = sorted(set(mo[0].loc[mo[0]["core"].astype(str).str.lower() == "yes", "model"])) if mo else []
        tg.append({"target": t, "has_workbook": bool(wb), "has_metadata": bool(md),
                   "models": int(mo[0]["model"].nunique()) if mo else 0, "core_model": "; ".join(core)})
    sheets["targets"] = pd.DataFrame(tg)
    for k in ("concepts", "models", "settings"):
        if S[k]:
            d = pd.concat(S[k], ignore_index=True)
            sheets[k] = d[["target"] + [c for c in d.columns if c != "target"]]
    if refs:
        ref_cols = ["short", "reference", "link"]
        sheets["references"] = pd.DataFrame([dict(zip(ref_cols, k), used_by=", ".join(sorted(v)))
                                             for k, v in refs.items()])
    if S["metadata"]:
        d = pd.concat(S["metadata"], ignore_index=True)
        sheets["metadata"] = d[["target"] + [c for c in d.columns if c != "target"]]
        sm = d.pivot_table(index=["mnemonic"], columns="target", values="expected_sign", aggfunc="first")
        desc = d.drop_duplicates("mnemonic").set_index("mnemonic")["description"]
        sm.insert(0, "description", desc.reindex(sm.index))
        sheets["sign_matrix"] = sm.reset_index()
    if S["how_to_fill"]:
        sheets["how_to_fill"] = pd.concat(S["how_to_fill"], ignore_index=True)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), exist_ok=True)
    with pd.ExcelWriter(out) as w:
        for k, d in sheets.items():
            d.to_excel(w, sheet_name=k, index=False)
    return out

def merge(base, pairs, out):
    """Add per-target files to an existing master; a target already in it is replaced. Returns (out, added, replaced)."""
    import tempfile
    tmp = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "new.xlsx")
    build(tmp, pairs)
    old = pd.read_excel(base, sheet_name=None)
    new = pd.read_excel(tmp, sheet_name=None)
    names = set(pairs)
    key = lambda x: str(x).strip().lower().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")
    replaced = sorted(t for t in names if any(key(t) in set(old[k]["target"].map(key))
                                             for k in ("models", "metadata", "concepts") if k in old and "target" in old[k]))
    sheets = {}
    for k in list(old) + [k for k in new if k not in old]:
        if k in ("sign_matrix",):
            continue
        o, n = old.get(k), new.get(k)
        if k == "references":
            r = pd.concat([x for x in (o, n) if x is not None], ignore_index=True).fillna("")
            r["used_by"] = r["used_by"].astype(str)
            keep = [c for c in ("short", "reference", "link") if c in r]
            r = r.groupby(keep, sort=False, as_index=False)["used_by"].agg(
                lambda v: ", ".join(sorted({t.strip() for x in v for t in x.split(",") if t.strip()})))
            sheets[k] = r
        elif o is not None and "target" in o:
            o = o[~o["target"].map(key).isin({key(t) for t in names})]
            sheets[k] = pd.concat([o, n], ignore_index=True) if n is not None else o
        else:
            sheets[k] = o if o is not None else n
    if "metadata" in sheets:
        d = sheets["metadata"]
        sm = d.pivot_table(index="mnemonic", columns="target", values="expected_sign", aggfunc="first")
        desc = d.drop_duplicates("mnemonic").set_index("mnemonic")["description"]
        sm.insert(0, "description", desc.reindex(sm.index))
        sheets["sign_matrix"] = sm.reset_index()
    order = [k for k in ("README", "targets", "concepts", "models", "settings", "references", "metadata", "sign_matrix",
                         "how_to_fill") if k in sheets] + [k for k in sheets if k not in (
        "README", "targets", "concepts", "models", "settings", "references", "metadata", "sign_matrix", "how_to_fill")]
    with pd.ExcelWriter(out) as w:
        for k in order:
            sheets[k].to_excel(w, sheet_name=k, index=False)
    return out, sorted(names - set(replaced)), replaced

def _tokens(x):
    import re as _re
    stop = {"the", "of", "and", "in", "for", "a", "index", "total", "rate", "sa", "saar", "nsa", "ratio", "level"}
    return {w for w in _re.findall(r"[a-z0-9+&]+", str(x).lower()) if w not in stop and (len(w) > 1 or w.isdigit())}

def names_sheet(master, macro=None, macro_meta=None, out=None, log=print, accept=None):
    """Add or refresh the macro_names sheet (keeps every your_name already filled in). Returns the sheet."""
    sh = pd.read_excel(master, sheet_name=None)
    md = sh["metadata"]
    md = md[md["mnemonic"].notna()]
    g = md.groupby("mnemonic")
    rows = pd.DataFrame({"code": list(g.groups)})
    first = md.drop_duplicates("mnemonic").set_index("mnemonic")
    for c in ("description", "geography", "theme", "transform"):
        if c in first:
            rows[c] = rows["code"].map(first[c])
    sign = md[pd.to_numeric(md["expected_sign"], errors="coerce").fillna(0) != 0].groupby("mnemonic")["target"].nunique()
    rows["targets_with_a_sign"] = rows["code"].map(sign).fillna(0).astype(int)
    con = sh.get("concepts")
    lit = {}
    scol = next((c for c in ("series_name", "moodys_name") if con is not None and c in con), None)
    if scol:
        for t, cid, v in zip(con["target"], con["concept_id"], con[scol]):
            if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
                lit.setdefault(v.strip(), set()).add(f"{t}:{cid}")
        extra = sorted(set(lit) - set(rows["code"]))
        if extra:                                   # named by a concept but not in any metadata
            rows = pd.concat([rows, pd.DataFrame({"code": extra})], ignore_index=True)
    rows["literature_uses"] = rows["code"].map(lambda c: len(lit.get(c, ()))).astype(int)
    rows["source"] = "master"
    old = sh.get("macro_names")
    keep = dict(zip(old["code"].astype(str), old["your_name"])) if old is not None and "your_name" in old else {}
    mine = pd.DataFrame()
    if old is not None:                              # series you added (source empty): kept as they are
        o = old.copy()
        src_ = o["source"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip() if "source" in o else pd.Series("master", index=o.index)
        mine = o[(src_ != "master") & ~o["code"].astype(str).isin(set(rows["code"]))
                 & (o["code"].notna() | o["your_name"].notna())]
        mine = mine.drop(columns=[c for c in ("in_your_data", "suggestion", "suggestion_score") if c in mine])
    rows["your_name"] = rows["code"].map(lambda c: keep.get(c, ""))
    rows["your_name"] = rows["your_name"].fillna("")
    if macro:
        from src.utils.io import read_table
        cols = [str(c) for c in read_table(macro, None).columns]
        low = {c.lower(): c for c in cols}
        name = rows.apply(lambda r: r["your_name"] or r["code"], axis=1)
        rows["in_your_data"] = name.map(lambda n: "yes" if n in cols else ("case differs: " + low[n.lower()]
                                                                           if n.lower() in low else "no"))
        if macro_meta:
            from src.utils.io import read_table as rt
            mm = rt(macro_meta, None)
            cc = {c.lower(): c for c in mm.columns}
            mcol = cc.get("mnemonic") or cc.get("code") or cc.get("name") or mm.columns[0]
            dcol = cc.get("description") or cc.get("label") or mm.columns[1]
            cand = [(str(a), _tokens(b), str(b)) for a, b in zip(mm[mcol], mm[dcol])]
            sug, score = [], []
            for r in rows.itertuples():
                if r.in_your_data == "yes" or not isinstance(r.description, str):
                    sug.append(""), score.append(None)
                    continue
                t = _tokens(str(r.description) + " " + str(getattr(r, "geography", "")))
                best = max(cand, key=lambda x: len(t & x[1]) / (len(t | x[1]) or 1), default=None)
                sc = len(t & best[1]) / (len(t | best[1]) or 1) if best else 0
                sug.append(f"{best[0]} ({best[2]})" if best and sc >= 0.3 else ""), score.append(round(sc, 2) if best else None)
            rows["suggestion"], rows["suggestion_score"] = sug, score
            if accept is not None:                      # fill your_name from good suggestions (review them!)
                ok = (rows["your_name"] == "") & (rows["suggestion_score"].fillna(0) >= accept) & (rows["suggestion"] != "")
                rows.loc[ok, "your_name"] = rows.loc[ok, "suggestion"].str.split(" ").str[0]
                log(f"  your_name filled from {int(ok.sum())} suggestions with a score of at least {accept}: review them")
                name = rows.apply(lambda r: r["your_name"] or r["code"], axis=1)
                rows["in_your_data"] = name.map(lambda n: "yes" if n in cols else "no")
    rows = rows.sort_values(["literature_uses", "targets_with_a_sign", "code"], ascending=[False, False, True])
    for c in ("expected_sign", "signs_by_target"):
        rows[c] = ""
    if len(mine):
        rows = pd.concat([rows, mine], ignore_index=True)
    lead = ["code", "your_name"] + [c for c in ("in_your_data", "suggestion", "suggestion_score") if c in rows]
    tail = ["expected_sign", "signs_by_target", "source"]
    rows = rows[lead + [c for c in rows.columns if c not in lead + tail] + tail]
    sh["macro_names"] = rows
    sh["target_names"] = target_names_sheet(sh)
    sh["README"] = readme(sh.get("README"))
    order = ["README", "target_names", "macro_names"] + [k for k in sh if k not in ("README", "target_names", "macro_names")]
    with pd.ExcelWriter(out or master) as w:
        for k in order:
            if k in sh:
                sh[k].to_excel(w, sheet_name=k, index=False)
    add_views(out or master)
    style_inputs(out or master)
    if macro:
        miss = rows[(rows["in_your_data"] != "yes")]
        lm = miss[miss["literature_uses"] > 0]
        log(f"macro_names: {len(rows)} series; {len(rows) - len(miss)} found in your data; "
            f"{len(miss)} not found ({len(lm)} of them used by literature models)")
    else:
        log(f"macro_names: {len(rows)} series ({int((rows['literature_uses'] > 0).sum())} used by literature models)")
    return rows

def target_names_sheet(sh, data=None):
    """The target_names sheet: one row per target of the master (source = master), your_name kept from the old
    sheet, and the rows you added (source empty) kept at the bottom."""
    import re as _re
    tg = sh.get("targets")
    if tg is None:
        tg = pd.DataFrame({"target": sorted(set(sh["metadata"]["target"].dropna().astype(str)))})
    rows = pd.DataFrame({"target": tg["target"].astype(str)})
    lab = tg["label"].astype(str) if "label" in tg else pd.Series("", index=tg.index)
    rows["label"] = lab.str.replace(r",\s*quarterly.*$", "", regex=True).str.replace(r"\s*\(workbook not.*$", "", regex=True)
    rows["form"] = lab.map(lambda x: "diff" if "(diff)" in x else "dlog" if "(dlog)" in x else "")
    rows["units"] = lab.map(lambda x: (_re.search(r"\(([^()]*%[^()]*|pp)\)", x) or [None, ""])[1])
    rows["literature"] = (tg["has_workbook"].astype(str) if "has_workbook" in tg else "").map(
        lambda v: "yes" if v == "yes" else "no")
    rows["like"] = ""
    rows["source"] = "master"
    old = sh.get("target_names")
    if old is not None and "your_name" in old:
        o = old.copy()
        o["target"] = o["target"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
        keep = {t: v for t, v in zip(o["target"], o["your_name"]) if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip()}
        rows["your_name"] = rows["target"].map(keep).fillna("")
        for c in ("form", "units", "label"):          # your own entries win over the defaults
            if c in o:
                mine = {t: v for t, v in zip(o["target"], o[c]) if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip()}
                rows[c] = [mine.get(t, v) for t, v in zip(rows["target"], rows[c])]
        src_ = o["source"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip() if "source" in o else pd.Series("master", index=o.index)
        added = o[(src_ != "master") & ~o["target"].isin(set(rows["target"])) & (o["target"] != "")]
        if len(added):
            rows = pd.concat([rows, added[[c for c in added.columns if c in
                                           ("target", "your_name", "label", "form", "units", "like", "notes")]]],
                             ignore_index=True)
    else:
        rows["your_name"] = ""
    for c in ("your_name", "like", "source", "notes"):
        if c not in rows:
            rows[c] = ""
    return rows[["target", "your_name", "form", "units", "label", "literature", "like", "notes", "source"]].fillna("")

def readme(old):
    """The README sheet: the 'your data' instructions first, then the master's own description."""
    col = "literature_master.xlsx - how to use"
    lines = [] if old is None else [str(x) for x in old.iloc[:, 0].tolist()]
    if old is not None:
        col = str(old.columns[0])
    if README_TOP[0] in lines:                       # refresh: drop the old block
        i = lines.index(README_TOP[0])
        lines = lines[:i] + lines[i + len(README_TOP):]
    lines = [x for x in lines if not x.strip().lower().startswith("macro_names") or "your_name" not in x]
    return pd.DataFrame({col: README_TOP + lines})
