def panel_components(cfg, levels, events):
    """Fingerprint components of a panel run: one entry per chosen bank, plus settings, files and code."""
    s = _canon(_settings(cfg))
    comps = {f"bank {b}": hash_obj(v) for b, v in _bank_data(levels, events).items()}
    comps["macro and metadata files"] = hash_obj(s.get("data"))
    comps["literature"] = hash_obj(s.get("literature"))
    comps["settings"] = hash_obj({k: v for k, v in s.items() if k not in ("data", "literature")})
    comps["code"] = code_hash()
    return comps

def bank_components(cfg, bank, series, events):
    """Fingerprint components of one bank's own full single-series run."""
    s = _canon(_settings(cfg))
    s.pop("panel", None)
    return {"bank data": hash_frame(series),
            "events": hash_obj({str(q): a for q, a in (events or {}).items()}),
            "macro and metadata files": hash_obj(s.get("data")),
            "literature": hash_obj(s.get("literature")),
            "settings": hash_obj({k: v for k, v in s.items() if k not in ("data", "literature")}),
            "code": code_hash()}

def compare(new, path, need_oos=False):
    """(reusable, reason) against the fingerprint saved at `path`."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return False, "no earlier run"
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        old = json.load(f)
    oc = old.get("components") or {}
    if need_oos and not old.get("oos"):
        return False, "earlier run had no out-of-sample test"
    changed = [k for k in new if oc.get(k) != new[k]] + [k for k in oc if k not in new]
    if changed:
        added = [k[5:] for k in new if k.startswith("bank ") and k not in oc]
        removed = [k[5:] for k in oc if k.startswith("bank ") and k not in new]
        bits = []
        if added:
            bits.append("added " + ", ".join(added))
        if removed:
            bits.append("removed " + ", ".join(removed))
        other = [k for k in changed if not (k.startswith("bank ") and (k[5:] in added or k[5:] in removed))]
        if other:
            bits.append("changed: " + ", ".join(other))
        return False, "; ".join(bits)
    return True, f"unchanged since {old.get('time', 'the last run')}"

def save(path, components, oos, extra=None):
    import datetime as dt
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"time": dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "oos": bool(oos),
                   "components": components, **(extra or {})}, f, indent=1)

def own_run_banks(cfg, available):
    """Banks that get their own full single-series run: panel.per_bank_full = true (all) or a list of names."""
    v = (cfg.get("panel") or {}).get("per_bank_full")
    if v is True or str(v).lower() == "true":
        return list(available)
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        return [b for b in available if b in {str(x) for x in v}]
    return []

def status(cfg, oos=False):
    """What a run would reuse, bank by bank: a DataFrame for the app (and the log)."""
    import pandas as pd
    from .data import bank_events, load_long
    levels = load_long(cfg)
    events = {b: bank_events(cfg, b) for b in levels}
    out = cfg["out_dir"]
    ok, why = compare(panel_components(cfg, levels, events), panel_path(out), need_oos=oos)
    own = set(own_run_banks(cfg, levels))
    rows = []
    for b in levels:
        r = {"bank": b, "panel": "reuse" if ok else "re-estimate", "panel reason": why}
        if b in own:
            ok_b, why_b = compare(bank_components(cfg, b, levels[b], events[b]), bank_path(out, b), need_oos=oos)
            r.update({"own run": "reuse" if ok_b else "run", "own run reason": why_b})
        else:
            r.update({"own run": "not requested", "own run reason": ""})
        rows.append(r)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def build_models(cfg, pn, sets):
    """The competing panel models for each driver set, plus the AR(1) benchmark."""
    p = cfg["panel"]
    out = [PanelModel("ar1", [], "AR(1) benchmark (each bank)", p["min_obs"], p["dk_lags"])]
    for label, feats in sets.items():
        if not feats:
            continue
        for kind in p["models"]:
            if kind == "topdown" and not tg.is_log():
                continue                          # shares of a total only make sense for balances
            out.append(PanelModel(kind, feats, f"{KINDS[kind]}: {label}", p["min_obs"], p["dk_lags"]))
    return out

def _covid(cfg, dates, o, h):
    dq = [pd.Period(q, freq="Q") for q in cfg["sample"]["dummy_quarters"]]
    if not dq:
        return False
    w = dates[o + 1:o + h + 1]
    return bool(((w >= min(dq)) & (w <= max(dq))).any())

def forecast_rows(cfg, pn, m, X, o, H, store_rows, label="backtest"):
    """Forecast every active bank from position o and append error rows."""
    q0 = pn.dates[o]
    for b in pn.active(q0):
        if b not in m.coef or (m.kind == "topdown" and b not in m.share):
            continue
        yh = _hist(pn, b, o)
        if np.isnan(yh["bank"]):
            continue
        last = min(H, len(pn.dates) - o - 1)
        fc = m.forecast(pn, X, b, o, last, yh)
        y = pn.ys[b]
        L0 = float(pn.levels[b].loc[q0])
        cf = ca = 0.0
        for h in range(1, len(fc) + 1):
            q = pn.dates[o + h]
            a = y.get(q, np.nan)
            if pd.isna(a):
                break
            cf += fc[h - 1]
            ca += a
            e = float(tg.error(cf, ca))
            store_rows.append({"model": m.name, "kind": m.kind, "bank": b, "origin": str(q0), "date": str(q),
                               "horizon_q": h, "forecast_change": float(tg.growth_display(fc[h - 1])),
                               "actual_change": float(tg.growth_display(a)), "level_at_origin": L0,
                               "forecast_level": float(tg.level_after(L0, cf)),
                               "actual_level_organic": float(tg.level_after(L0, ca)),
                               "error_pct": e * 100, "covid_window": _covid(cfg, pn.dates, o, h), "test": label})

def summarise(E, H, hz, weights):
    """Errors -> by-horizon table, leaderboard by bank, overall leaderboard."""
    if E.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame(), f"avg_1_{max(hz)}_pct"
    Ex = E[~E["covid_window"]]
    by_h = (Ex.assign(abs_err=Ex["error_pct"].abs()).groupby(["bank", "model", "kind", "horizon_q"], sort=False)
            .agg(MAPE_exCOVID_pct=("abs_err", "mean"), bias_exCOVID_pct=("error_pct", "mean"),
                 n_origins=("error_pct", "size")).reset_index())
    rows = []
    for (b, m, k), d in by_h.groupby(["bank", "model", "kind"], sort=False):
        d = d.set_index("horizon_q")["MAPE_exCOVID_pct"]
        r = {"bank": b, "model": m, "kind": k}
        for h in hz:
            r[f"avg_1_{h}_pct"] = d.loc[:h].mean() if h in d.index else np.nan
        rows.append(r)
    LB = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    # rank on the longest horizon that has errors (few origins, or dummy windows, can leave the longest empty)
    have = [h for h in hz if LB[f"avg_1_{h}_pct"].notna().any()]
    col = f"avg_1_{max(have) if have else max(hz)}_pct"
    LB["rank_in_bank"] = LB.groupby("bank")[col].rank(method="min")
    ar = LB[LB["kind"] == "ar1"].set_index("bank")[col]
    LB["vs_AR_pct"] = (1 - LB[col] / LB["bank"].map(ar)) * 100
    g = LB.groupby(["model", "kind"], sort=False)
    O = g[[f"avg_1_{h}_pct" for h in hz]].mean()
    O["median_" + col] = g[col].median()
    O["size_weighted_" + col] = g.apply(lambda d: np.average(d[col], weights=d["bank"].map(weights).fillna(0) + 1e-12))
    O["banks_won"] = g["rank_in_bank"].apply(lambda r: int((r == 1).sum()))
    O["banks"] = g.size()
    O["banks_better_than_AR"] = g["vs_AR_pct"].apply(lambda v: int((v > 0).sum()))
    O = O.reset_index().sort_values(col).reset_index(drop=True)
    O.insert(0, "rank", range(1, len(O) + 1))
    O["ranked_on"] = col
    return by_h, LB.sort_values(["bank", col]).reset_index(drop=True), O, col

def backtest(cfg, pn, models, FF, log=print):
    """Rolling backtest of every panel model (same origins and re-estimation schedule as the single-series run)."""
    H = int(cfg["sample"]["horizon"])
    origins = backtest_origins(pn.base)
    flags = refit_flags(pn.base, origins)
    rows, coefs, at = [], [], {}
    save = (cfg.get("save") or {}).get("origin_models", True)
    for m in models:
        X = _arr(FF, m.features, pn)
        for o, fl in zip(origins, flags):
            if fl:
                try:
                    m.fit(pn, X, cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], pn.dates[o])
                except Exception as ex:
                    log(f"  {m.name}: not estimated at {pn.dates[o]} ({ex})")
                    continue
                coefs += [{**r, "origin": str(pn.dates[o])} for r in m.coefficient_rows()]
                if save:
                    at.setdefault(str(pn.dates[o]), {})[m.name] = pickle.dumps(m)
            forecast_rows(cfg, pn, m, X, o, H, rows)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows), pd.DataFrame(coefs), at

def scenarios(cfg, pn, models, FF):
    """Forecast every scenario with every model estimated on all history."""
    out = []
    hist_end = pd.Period(cfg["sample"]["hist_end"], freq="Q")
    defl = cfg["features"].get("deflator")
    for name, mdf in pn.base.macro.items():
        if hist_end not in mdf.index:
            continue
        o = mdf.index.get_loc(hist_end)
        for m in models:
            feats = m.features
            X = feature_matrix(mdf, feats, defl).values if feats else np.zeros((len(mdf), 0))
            for b in pn.active(hist_end):
                if b not in m.coef or (m.kind == "topdown" and b not in m.share):
                    continue
                yh = {"bank": float(pn.ys[b].loc[hist_end]), "total": float(pn.base.y.loc[hist_end])}
                fc = m.forecast(pn, X, b, o, len(mdf) - o - 1, yh)
                lv = tg.path(float(pn.levels[b].loc[hist_end]), fc)
                out += [{"model": m.name, "kind": m.kind, "bank": b, "scenario": name, "date": str(mdf.index[o + h]),
                         "change_forecast": float(f), "level_forecast": float(l)}
                        for h, (f, l) in enumerate(zip(fc, lv), 1)]
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

def fitted_values(cfg, pn, models, FF):
    """In-sample one-step fit of every bank in every model estimated on all history."""
    rows = []
    a = pn.pos(cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"])
    z = pn.pos(cfg["sample"]["hist_end"])
    for m in models:
        X = _arr(FF, m.features, pn)
        for b in m.coef:
            y = pn.ys[b]
            for t in range(max(a, 1), z + 1):
                q = pn.dates[t]
                if q not in y.index or pd.isna(y.loc[q]) or pd.isna(y.get(q - 1, np.nan)):
                    continue
                f = m.fitted(pn, X, b, t)
                rows.append({"model": m.name, "bank": b, "date": str(q), "actual": float(y.loc[q]), "fitted": f,
                             "residual": float(y.loc[q]) - f if pd.notna(f) else np.nan})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def run_oos(cfg, pn, F, core, log=print):
    """Out-of-sample test: at every origin the drivers are re-selected on all banks with data up to the origin,
    every model is re-estimated, then forecasts 1..H quarters for every bank."""
    o_ = cfg["oos"]
    H = int(o_.get("horizon") or cfg["sample"]["horizon"])
    first = pd.Period(o_["first_origin"], freq="Q")
    end = pn.pos(cfg["sample"]["hist_end"])
    origins = [i for i, q in enumerate(pn.dates) if q >= first and i < end][::int(o_.get("step", 4))]
    workers = _workers(cfg, len(origins))
    if workers > 1:
        from joblib import Parallel, delayed
        log(f"  {len(origins)} origins on {workers} processes ...")
        parts = Parallel(n_jobs=workers, backend="loky")(delayed(_oos_origin)(cfg, pn, F, core, o, H, None, tg.form())
                                                         for o in origins)
    else:
        parts = [_oos_origin(cfg, pn, F, core, o, H, log) for o in origins]
    rows, picks, at = [], [], {}
    for r, pick, a, msgs in parts:                   # in origin order, whatever order they finished in
        rows += r
        picks.append(pick)
        at.update(a)
        if workers > 1:
            for m in msgs:
                log(m)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows), pd.DataFrame(picks), at

def _workers(cfg, n):
    """panel.workers: 'auto' (the CPU cores, at most one per origin), or a number (1 = no parallel processes)."""
    w = (cfg.get("panel") or {}).get("workers", "auto")
    if str(w).lower() == "auto":
        w = max(1, min(os.cpu_count() or 1, n, 8))
    return max(1, int(w))

def _oos_origin(cfg, pn, F, core, o, H, log=None, form=None):
    """One origin of the out-of-sample test: re-select, re-estimate, forecast. Returns (rows, pick, models, log).
    In a separate process the target form (a module setting) is set again from `form`."""
    if form is not None:
        tg.set_form(form)
    msgs = []
    say = log or msgs.append
    lab = pn.dates[o]
    defl = cfg["features"].get("deflator")
    sel = select(cfg, pn, F, cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], lab, lambda *_: None)
    sets = {"panel drivers": sel["features"], "literature core": core}
    models = build_models(cfg, pn, sets)
    pick = {"origin": str(lab), "panel drivers": ", ".join(sel["features"]) or "(none)"}
    cols = list(dict.fromkeys(sel["features"] + core))
    FF = F.reindex(columns=[c for c in cols if c in F.columns])
    if any(c not in F.columns for c in cols):
        FF = pd.concat([FF, feature_matrix(pn.base.hist, [c for c in cols if c not in F.columns], defl)], axis=1)
    rows, at = [], {}
    for m in models:
        X = _arr(FF, m.features, pn)
        try:
            m.fit(pn, X, cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], lab)
        except Exception as ex:
            say(f"  oos {lab}: {m.name} not estimated ({ex})")
            continue
        at.setdefault(str(lab), {})[m.name] = pickle.dumps(m)
        forecast_rows(cfg, pn, m, X, o, H, rows, "oos")
    say(f"  oos origin {lab}: panel drivers {sel['features']}")
    return rows, pick, at, msgs

def _charts(out, O, scen, pn, best_by_bank, col):
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 0.42 * len(O) + 1.2))
    d = O.iloc[::-1]
    colors = {"ar1": "#9a9a9a", "separate": "#3b5ba5", "pooled": "#0f8a8a", "partial": "#c0504d", "topdown": "#8a6d3b"}
    ax.barh(d["model"], d[col], color=[colors.get(k, "#555") for k in d["kind"]])
    ax.set_xlabel(f"Average error over 1-{col.split('_')[2]} quarters, mean across banks ({tg.units()})")
    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(out, "panel_leaderboard.png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)
    if scen.empty:
        return
    banks = list(best_by_bank)
    n = len(banks)
    cols_ = min(3, n)
    rows_ = int(np.ceil(n / cols_))
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(rows_, cols_, figsize=(4.2 * cols_, 2.8 * rows_), squeeze=False)
    for ax, b in zip(axs.ravel(), banks):
        h = pn.levels[b].iloc[-24:]
        ax.plot(h.index.to_timestamp(), h.values, color="#222", lw=1.6)
        d = scen[(scen["bank"] == b) & (scen["model"] == best_by_bank[b])]
        for sc, g in d.groupby("scenario", sort=False):
            ax.plot(pd.PeriodIndex(g["date"], freq="Q").to_timestamp(), g["level_forecast"].values, lw=1.1, label=sc)
        ax.set_title(f"{b}: {best_by_bank[b]}", fontsize=8, loc="left")
        ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)
        ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    for ax in axs.ravel()[n:]:
        ax.axis("off")
    axs.ravel()[0].legend(fontsize=6, frameon=False)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(out, "panel_forecasts.png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)

def run(cfg, out_dir, oos=True, log=print, force=False):
    """The whole panel analysis.

    Args:
        cfg: configuration with data.bank.panel_column. out_dir: outputs/<run>. oos: also the out-of-sample test.
        force: re-estimate even when nothing changed since the last run.

    Returns:
        dict with the leaderboards and the panel folder (and reused=True when the earlier results were kept).
    """
    from . import reuse
    from .data import bank_events, load_long
    p = settings(cfg)
    out = os.path.join(out_dir, "panel")
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    lv0 = load_long(copy.deepcopy(cfg))
    comps = reuse.panel_components(copy.deepcopy(cfg), lv0, {b: bank_events(cfg, b) for b in lv0})
    fp_path = reuse.panel_path(out_dir)
    ok, why = reuse.compare(comps, fp_path, need_oos=oos)
    if ok and not force and os.path.exists(os.path.join(out, "1_leaderboard_overall.csv")):
        log(f"Panel: nothing changed ({why}) - reusing the earlier results in {out} "
            f"(use --force to re-estimate)")
        res = _reused(out, oos)
        _re_evaluate(cfg, out, res, log)
        return res
    log(f"Panel: estimating ({'forced' if force else why}) ...")
    log("Panel: loading the banks ...")
    pn = Panel(cfg, out, log)
    H = int(cfg["sample"]["horizon"])
    hz = cfg["sample"]["report_horizons"]
    col = f"avg_1_{max(hz)}_pct"
    log("Panel: candidate features ...")
    forms = candidate_forms(cfg, pn.base.hist, pn.base.meta)
    F = all_features(cfg, pn.base, forms)
    log(f"  {F.shape[1]} candidate features")
    log("Panel: selecting drivers on all banks together ...")
    sel = select(cfg, pn, F, cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], cfg["sample"]["hist_end"], log)
    log(f"  panel drivers: {sel['features'] or '(none passed the rules)'}")
    # ---- which credit unions to estimate on (panel.sample: auto compares all / weighted / comparable / active)
    from . import sample as smp
    s_name, s_banks, s_w, s_tab, s_info = smp.choose(cfg, pn, F, sel["features"], out, log)
    s_tab.round(4).to_csv(os.path.join(out, "0_sample_choice.csv"), index=False)
    s_info.round(6).to_csv(os.path.join(out, "0_banks.csv"), index=False)
    active_banks = list(s_info.loc[s_info["active"], "bank"])
    log(f"Panel: estimation sample: {smp.LABELS[s_name]} ({len(s_banks)} of {len(pn.banks)} banks; "
        f"{s_tab.loc[s_tab['chosen'], 'reason'].iloc[0]})")
    if s_name != "all":
        if set(s_banks) != set(pn.banks):
            pn = Panel(smp.restrict(cfg, s_banks), out, log)
        pn.wrow = smp.weights(pn, s_info) if s_w else None
        sel = select(cfg, pn, F, cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], cfg["sample"]["hist_end"], log)
        log(f"  panel drivers on the chosen sample: {sel['features'] or '(none passed the rules)'}")
    core = []
    if "core" in p["driver_sets"]:
        from ..models import zoo
        lit = zoo.literature_models(cfg, pn.base, lambda *_: None)
        spec = next((m for m in lit if m.get("core")), None)
        core = list(spec["features"]) if spec else []
        log(f"  literature core: {core or '(no literature workbook / no core model)'}")
    sets = {}
    if "panel" in p["driver_sets"]:
        sets["panel drivers"] = sel["features"]
    sets["literature core"] = core
    cols = list(dict.fromkeys([f for v in sets.values() for f in v]))
    defl = cfg["features"].get("deflator")
    FF = F.reindex(columns=[c for c in cols if c in F.columns])
    missing = [c for c in cols if c not in F.columns]
    if missing:
        FF = pd.concat([FF, feature_matrix(pn.base.hist, missing, defl)], axis=1)
    models = build_models(cfg, pn, sets)
    log(f"Panel: backtest of {len(models)} models on {len(pn.banks)} banks ...")
    E, coef_paths, at = backtest(cfg, pn, models, FF, log)
    weights = {b: float(pn.levels[b].iloc[-1]) for b in pn.banks}
    by_h, LB, O, col = summarise(E, H, hz, weights)
    log("Panel: estimating on all history, scenarios, fitted values ...")
    fitted = {}
    for m in models:
        X = _arr(FF, m.features, pn)
        m.fit(pn, X, cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], cfg["sample"]["hist_end"])
        fitted[m.name] = m
    coefs = pd.DataFrame([r for m in models for r in m.coefficient_rows()])
    shrink = pd.concat([m.weights.assign(model=m.name) for m in models if m.weights is not None], ignore_index=True) \
        if any(m.weights is not None for m in models) else pd.DataFrame()
    scen = scenarios(cfg, pn, models, FF)
    fv = fitted_values(cfg, pn, models, FF)
    tables = dict(sel["tables"])
    tables.update({"1_leaderboard_overall": O.round(4), "2_leaderboard_by_bank": LB.round(4),
                   "3_backtest_by_horizon": by_h.round(4), "4_backtest_forecasts": E.round(6),
                   "5_coefficients": coefs, "6_shrinkage": shrink, "7_scenario_forecasts": scen,
                   "8_fitted_values": fv, "9_coefficients_by_origin": coef_paths})
    for k, v in tables.items():
        if isinstance(v, pd.DataFrame):
            v.to_csv(os.path.join(out, f"{k}.csv"), index=False)
    fdir = os.path.join(out, "fitted")
    os.makedirs(fdir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(fdir, "models.pkl"), "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump({k: pickle.dumps(m) for k, m in fitted.items()}, f)
    if at:
        with open(os.path.join(fdir, "backtest_models.pkl"), "wb") as f:
            pickle.dump(at, f)
    from . import compare
    ev_cfg = compare.settings(cfg)
    ev = compare.evaluate(E, **ev_cfg, active=active_banks) if len(E) else None
    if ev is not None:
        compare.write(ev, out)
    best_by_bank = (ev["by_bank"].groupby("bank").head(1).set_index("bank")["model"].to_dict() if ev is not None
                    else LB.sort_values(col).groupby("bank").head(1).set_index("bank")["model"].to_dict() if len(LB) else {})
    res = {"overall": O, "by_bank": LB, "best_by_bank": best_by_bank, "panel_drivers": sel["features"],
           "core": core, "folder": out}
    if oos:
        log("Panel: out-of-sample test (drivers re-selected at every origin) ...")
        Eo, picks, at_o = run_oos(cfg, pn, F, core, log)
        bo, LBo, Oo, col_o = summarise(Eo, H, hz, weights)
        od = os.path.join(out, "oos")
        os.makedirs(od, exist_ok=True)
        for k, v in {"1_leaderboard_overall": Oo.round(4), "2_leaderboard_by_bank": LBo.round(4),
                     "3_by_horizon": bo.round(4), "4_forecasts": Eo.round(6), "5_drivers_by_origin": picks}.items():
            v.to_csv(os.path.join(od, f"{k}.csv"), index=False)
        with open(os.path.join(fdir, "oos_models.pkl"), "wb") as f:
            pickle.dump(at_o, f)
        res.update(oos_overall=Oo, oos_by_bank=LBo)
        if len(Eo):
            evo = compare.evaluate(Eo, **ev_cfg, active=active_banks)
            compare.write(evo, od)
            res["oos_evaluation"] = evo["overall"]
            res["best_by_bank"] = evo["by_bank"].groupby("bank").head(1).set_index("bank")["model"].to_dict()
            col = col_o
    if ev is not None:
        res["evaluation"] = ev["overall"]
    _charts(out, res.get("oos_overall", O) if len(res.get("oos_overall", [])) else O, scen, pn, res["best_by_bank"], col)
    res["sample"] = {"name": s_name, "table": s_tab, "active": active_banks}
    _summary(out, cfg, pn, res, col)
    with open(os.path.join(fdir, "manifest.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        from .data import DROPPED
        json.dump({"banks": pn.banks, "active_banks": active_banks, "sample": s_name, "sample_weighted": bool(s_w),
                   "left_out_exited": dict(DROPPED), "target_form": tg.form(),

                   "models": [m.name for m in models], "best_by_bank": res["best_by_bank"],
                   "backtest_origins": sorted(at), "oos": bool(oos)}, f, indent=1)
    reuse.save(fp_path, comps, oos, {"banks": pn.banks})
    log(f"Panel results in {out}")
    return res

def _re_evaluate(cfg, out, res, log=print):
    """The evaluation is cheap and depends only on the saved errors: redo it with the current settings."""
    from . import compare
    ev_cfg = compare.settings(cfg)
    act = None
    try:
        act = json.load(open(os.path.join(out, "fitted", "manifest.json"), encoding="utf-8")).get("active_banks")
    except Exception:
        pass
    for sub, key in (("", "evaluation"), ("oos", "oos_evaluation")):
        try:
            E = compare.load_errors(out, oos=bool(sub))
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
        ev = compare.evaluate(E, **ev_cfg, active=act)
        compare.write(ev, os.path.join(out, sub) if sub else out)
        res[key] = ev["overall"]
        res["best_by_bank"] = ev["by_bank"].groupby("bank").head(1).set_index("bank")["model"].to_dict()
    sm = os.path.join(out, "summary.md")
    if os.path.exists(sm) and ("evaluation" in res or "oos_evaluation" in res):   # refresh its ranking block
        txt = open(sm, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
        i = next((k for k, x in enumerate(txt) if x.startswith("## Ranked on")), None)
        j = next((k for k, x in enumerate(txt) if x.startswith("## Best model for each bank")), len(txt))
        basis = "out of sample" if "oos_evaluation" in res else "backtest"
        block = _eval_lines(cfg, res.get("oos_evaluation", res.get("evaluation")), basis)[1:] + [""]
        best = ["## Best model for each bank", ""] + [f"- {b}: {m}" for b, m in res["best_by_bank"].items()]
        head = txt[:i - 1] if i is not None else txt[:j]
        open(sm, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(head + [""] + block + best) + "\n")
    log(f"Panel: evaluation redone on the saved errors ({compare.describe(ev_cfg['metric'], ev_cfg['tail_share'], ev_cfg['penalty'])})")

def _reused(out, oos):
    """The results of an earlier, still valid, panel run."""
    res = {"folder": out, "reused": True}
    for key, f in (("overall", "1_leaderboard_overall.csv"), ("by_bank", "2_leaderboard_by_bank.csv"),
                   ("oos_overall", os.path.join("oos", "1_leaderboard_overall.csv")),
                   ("oos_by_bank", os.path.join("oos", "2_leaderboard_by_bank.csv"))):

            res[key] = pd.read_csv(fp)
    mf = os.path.join(out, "fitted", "manifest.json")

        with open(mf, encoding="utf-8") as f:

        res.update(best_by_bank=m.get("best_by_bank", {}), panel_drivers=m.get("panel_drivers", []),
                   core=m.get("core", []))

def _sample_lines(smp):
    """The estimation-sample block of summary.md."""
    if not smp:
        return []
    from .sample import LABELS
    T = smp["table"]
    L = [f"Estimation sample: **{LABELS[smp['name']]}**. {T.loc[T['chosen'], 'reason'].iloc[0]}.", ""]
    if len(T) > 1:
        L += ["| Sample | Banks | Exited included | Weighted | Error for the active banks |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
        for r in T.itertuples():
            L.append(f"| {r.label}{' (chosen)' if r.chosen else ''} | {r.banks} | {getattr(r, 'exited_included', '')} | "
                     f"{'yes' if getattr(r, 'weighted', False) else 'no'} | {getattr(r, 'score_active', float('nan')):.3f} |")
        L.append("")
    L += [f"Active banks (reporting at the end of history): {len(smp['active'])}.", ""]
    return L

def _eval_lines(cfg, ev, basis):
    """The 'Ranked on ...' block of summary.md."""
    if ev is None or not len(ev):
        return []
    from . import compare
    e = compare.settings(cfg)
    L = ["", f"## Ranked on the {compare.describe(e['metric'], e['tail_share'], e['penalty'])} ({basis}; "
         f"{'every bank' if e['banks'] in (None, 'all', []) else ', '.join(map(str, e['banks']))}, "
         f"{e['weighting']} weights)", "",
         "| Rank | Model | Score | MAPE | RMSE | Worst-tail avg | Largest | Banks won |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in ev.itertuples():
        L.append(f"| {r.rank} | {r.model} | {r.score:.3f} | {r.mape:.3f} | {r.rmse:.3f} | {r.cvar:.3f} | "
                 f"{r.worst:.3f} | {r.banks_won}/{r.banks} |")
    return L + ["", "Other metrics, other banks or one bank: `python tools/panel_compare.py --run <outputs/run> "
                    "--metric rmse --banks ... --bank ...` (no re-estimation), or ⑤ in the app."]

def _summary(out, cfg, pn, res, col):
    basis = "out of sample" if "oos_overall" in res else "backtest"
    O = res.get("oos_overall", res["overall"])
    L = [f"# Panel run: {cfg['run_name']}", "",
         f"{len(pn.banks)} banks: {', '.join(pn.banks)}. Target form: {tg.describe()}.", "",
         *(["Left out because they stopped reporting (panel.drop_exited): "
            + ", ".join(f"{k} (last {v})" for k, v in __import__('src.panel.data', fromlist=['DROPPED']).DROPPED.items()), ""]
           if (cfg.get("panel") or {}).get("drop_exited") else []),
         *_sample_lines(res.get("sample")),
         f"Panel drivers (chosen on the estimation sample): {', '.join(res['panel_drivers']) or 'none'}",
         f"Literature core: {', '.join(res['core']) or 'none'}", "",
         f"## Models ({basis}; average error over 1-{col.split('_')[2]} quarters, mean across banks)", "",
         "| Rank | Model | Mean | Banks won | Better than AR(1) |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in O.itertuples():
        L.append(f"| {r.rank} | {r.model} | {getattr(r, col):.3f} | {r.banks_won}/{r.banks} | "
                 f"{r.banks_better_than_AR}/{r.banks} |")
    L += _eval_lines(cfg, res.get("oos_evaluation", res.get("evaluation")), basis)
    L += ["", "## Best model for each bank", ""] + [f"- {b}: {m}" for b, m in res["best_by_bank"].items()]
    open(os.path.join(out, "summary.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(L) + "\n")

src/panel/sample.py

module src.panel.sample · 5 items
Which credit unions the panel is estimated on, chosen by the data (panel.sample: auto).

A panel of credit unions is usually very unbalanced: a few dozen still report, hundreds stopped (most merged
into others). Pooling them all lets hundreds of small, exited institutions decide the coefficients used to
forecast the active ones. Four estimation samples are compared:

    all          every credit union, each bank-quarter counts the same
    weighted     every credit union, bank-quarters weighted by the institution's size (its average share of
                 the total balance over the quarters it reported), so large ones count more
    comparable   the active credit unions, plus the exited ones of comparable size (relative size at least the
                 comparable_pct percentile of the active ones)
    active       only the credit unions still reporting at the end of history

For each, the drivers are chosen on that sample (the same panel selection), and the pooled fixed-effects model
with them is backtested at every backtest origin; only the ACTIVE credit unions' forecasts are scored (they are the ones to forecast), on the
panel.evaluation metric over 1..h quarters. The best sample is used for everything that follows (driver
selection, every model, the out-of-sample test), unless 'all' is within sample_tolerance of it: then all is kept,
since it uses the most information. The comparison is written to 0_sample_choice.csv and the summary.

Relative size of a bank: the median over its quarters of its balance divided by the median balance of all banks
reporting in that quarter (so a bank from 2005 and one from 2024 are compared with their own peers).

def describe(levels, end):
    """Per bank: active (reports at `end`), first and last quarter, relative size, size share (weight)."""
    df = pd.DataFrame(levels)
    med = df.median(axis=1)
    rel = df.div(med, axis=0).median(axis=0)
    share = df.div(df.sum(axis=1), axis=0).mean(axis=0)
    endq = pd.Period(end, freq="Q")
    rows = [{"bank": b, "active": bool(endq in s.index), "first": str(s.index[0]), "last": str(s.index[-1]),
             "quarters": len(s), "relative_size": float(rel[b]), "size_share": float(share[b])}
            for b, s in levels.items()]
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("relative_size", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

def candidates(info, pc):
    """The candidate samples that differ from each other: {name: (banks, weighted)}."""
    allb = list(info["bank"])
    active = list(info.loc[info["active"], "bank"])
    out = {"all": (allb, False)}
    if info["size_share"].nunique() > 1:
        out["weighted"] = (allb, True)
    if 0 < len(active) < len(allb):
        cut = np.percentile(info.loc[info["active"], "relative_size"], float(pc.get("comparable_pct", 25)))
        comp = list(info.loc[info["active"] | (info["relative_size"] >= cut), "bank"])
        if len(active) < len(comp) < len(allb):
            out["comparable"] = (comp, False)
        if len(active) >= 2:
            out["active"] = (active, False)
    return out

def weights(pn, info):
    """Row weights of a panel: each bank-quarter gets its bank's size share, scaled to mean 1 over the rows."""
    sh = info.set_index("bank")["size_share"]
    w = np.array([sh[pn.banks[c]] for c in pn.B], float)
    return w / w.mean()

def choose(cfg, pn, F, feats, out, log=print):
    """Compare the samples and return (name, banks, weighted, table).

    pn: the panel of all credit unions; feats: the drivers chosen on it.
    """
    from .compare import settings as ev_settings
    from .data import Panel
    from .select import quick_error, select
    pc = cfg.get("panel") or {}
    mode = str(pc.get("sample", "auto")).lower()
    if mode not in CHOICES:
        raise ValueError(f"panel.sample must be one of {CHOICES}")
    info = describe(pn.levels, cfg["sample"]["hist_end"])
    cands = candidates(info, pc)
    active = set(info.loc[info["active"], "bank"])
    if mode != "auto":
        if mode not in cands:
            log(f"  panel.sample: {mode} is the same as all here (no exited banks or equal sizes) - using all")
            mode = "all"
        b, w = cands[mode]
        return mode, b, w, pd.DataFrame([{"sample": mode, "label": LABELS[mode], "banks": len(b), "chosen": True,
                                          "reason": "set in the config (panel.sample)"}]), info
    if len(cands) == 1:
        return "all", cands["all"][0], False, pd.DataFrame([{"sample": "all", "label": LABELS["all"],
                                                             "banks": len(cands["all"][0]), "chosen": True,
                                                             "reason": "only one sample possible"}]), info
    metric = ev_settings(cfg)["metric"]
    rows = []
    for name, (banks, wtd) in cands.items():
        p_ = pn if (name in ("all", "weighted")) else Panel(restrict(cfg, banks), out, lambda *_: None)
        p_.wrow = weights(p_, info) if wtd else None
        try:
            f_ = feats if name == "all" else select(cfg, p_, F, cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"],
                                                    cfg["sample"]["hist_end"], lambda *_: None)["features"]
            err = quick_error(cfg, p_, F, f_, cfg["sample"]["hist_end"], banks=active, metric=metric)
        except Exception as ex:                       # e.g. too few banks for the drivers
            err, f_ = np.nan, []
            log(f"  sample {name}: not scored ({ex})")
        p_.wrow = None
        log(f"  sample {name}: {len(banks)} banks, drivers {f_}, error for the active banks {err * 100:.3f}")
        rows.append({"sample": name, "label": LABELS[name], "banks": len(banks),
                     "exited_included": len([b for b in banks if b not in active]), "weighted": wtd,
                     "drivers": ", ".join(f_), "score_active": err * 100, "_drivers": f_})
    T = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    tol = float(pc.get("sample_tolerance", 0.02))
    ok = T.dropna(subset=["score_active"])
    if ok.empty:
        best = "all"
        reason = "no sample could be scored - all kept"
    else:
        best = ok.sort_values("score_active").iloc[0]["sample"]
        s_all = T.loc[T["sample"] == "all", "score_active"].iloc[0]
        s_best = ok["score_active"].min()
        if best != "all" and np.isfinite(s_all) and s_all <= s_best * (1 + tol):
            reason = f"all is within {tol:.0%} of the best ({best}): all kept, as it uses the most information"
            best = "all"
        else:
            reason = (f"lowest error for the active credit unions" +
                      (f" ({(1 - s_best / s_all) * 100:.1f}% below all)" if best != "all" and np.isfinite(s_all) else ""))
    T["chosen"] = T["sample"] == best
    T["reason"] = np.where(T["chosen"], reason, "")
    b, w = cands[best]
    T.attrs["drivers"] = T.loc[T["chosen"], "_drivers"].iloc[0]
    return best, b, w, T.drop(columns="_drivers"), info

src/panel/select.py

module src.panel.select · 19 items
Driver selection on the pooled panel: the same steps as "screen first", with every regression run on all banks.

1. Screen: each candidate alone in a fixed-effects regression with every bank's lagged change and the dummies
   (Frisch-Waugh: the controls are partialled out once). Driscoll-Kraay t statistics; the sign must match.
2. Best form and lag of each variable; correlated variables grouped (same clustering as screen first); one per
   group, up to shortlist_max.
3. Search: every combination of min_vars..max_vars shortlisted drivers that passes the final_model rules
   (|t_DK| >= t_min, expected signs, VIF <= vif_max, at most one per theme). The candidates with the lowest
   pooled BIC are backtested on all banks; the simplest model within selection_tolerance of the best error wins.

class BankFeatures:
    """Candidate features, some of which may differ by bank.

    common: DataFrame on pn.dates (macro features, the same for every bank).
    bank: optional array (banks, dates, k) of bank-specific features named bank_names (e.g. each bank's own
    mortgage rate change in a system), with their metadata (mnemonic, description, geography, theme,
    expected_sign) in bank_meta.
    Correlations and VIFs of bank-specific features use their average across banks.
    """

    def __init__(self, common, bank=None, bank_names=(), bank_meta=None):
        self.common = common
        self.bank = bank
        self.bank_names = list(bank_names)
        self.bank_meta = bank_meta
        self.columns = list(common.columns) + self.bank_names
        self._bi = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(self.bank_names)}

    def array(self, cols, nb=None):
        """(dates, k) if every column is common, else (banks, dates, k)."""
        cols = list(cols)
        if not any(c in self._bi for c in cols):
            return self.common[cols].values if cols else np.zeros((len(self.common), 0))
        nb = self.bank.shape[0]
        out = np.empty((nb, len(self.common), len(cols)))
        for j, c in enumerate(cols):
            out[:, :, j] = self.bank[:, :, self._bi[c]] if c in self._bi else self.common[c].values[None, :]
        return out

    def stacked(self, pn, cols):
        from .estimate import stacked as _st
        return _st(pn, self.array(cols))

    def frame(self, cols):
        """Dates x cols (bank-specific columns averaged across banks)."""
        d = {}
        for c in cols:
            d[c] = self.common[c] if c in self.common.columns else \
                pd.Series(np.nanmean(self.bank[:, :, self._bi[c]], axis=0), index=self.common.index)
        return pd.DataFrame(d, index=self.common.index)

    def meta(self, base):
        if self.bank_meta is None or not len(self.bank_meta):
            return base
        bm = self.bank_meta.set_index("mnemonic")
        return pd.concat([base, bm[[c for c in base.columns if c in bm.columns]]])

def _controls(pn, m):
    """Bank intercepts, every bank's lagged change and the dummies, for the rows in mask m."""
    Bm = pn.B[m]
    ok = sorted(set(Bm))
    F = np.column_stack([(Bm == c).astype(float) for c in ok])
    D = pn.Dm[pn.T[m]]
    dk = D.std(axis=0) > 0 if D.shape[1] else np.zeros(0, bool)
    return np.column_stack([F, pn.YL[m], D[:, dk]])

def screen(pn, F, start, end, lags=4):
    """Univariate pooled screen of every candidate feature.

    Args:
        pn: Panel. F: candidate features on pn.dates (DataFrame). start, end: window labels.

    Returns:
        DataFrame: feature, mnemonic, transform, lag, coef, t_dk, p_dk, expected_sign, sign_ok, theme, geography.
    """
    F = _fs(F)
    Xall = F.stacked(pn, F.columns)
    m = pn.window(start, end)
    rows = []
    C = _controls(pn, m)
    y = pn.Y[m]
    X = Xall[m]
    sw = sqrt_w(pn, m)
    if sw is not None:                                # size-weighted rows
        C, y, X = C * sw[:, None], y * sw, X * sw[:, None]
    yr = y - C @ np.linalg.lstsq(C, y, rcond=None)[0]
    okc = ~np.isnan(X).any(axis=0) & (np.nanstd(X, axis=0) > 0)
    cols = np.where(okc)[0]
    Xr = X[:, cols] - C @ np.linalg.lstsq(C, X[:, cols], rcond=None)[0]
    xx = (Xr ** 2).sum(axis=0)
    b = (Xr * yr[:, None]).sum(axis=0) / np.where(xx > 0, xx, np.nan)
    E = yr[:, None] - Xr * b
    T = pn.T[m]
    ut = np.unique(T)
    idx = np.searchsorted(ut, T)
    G = np.zeros((len(ut), len(cols)))
    np.add.at(G, idx, Xr * E)
    S = (G ** 2).sum(axis=0)
    pos = {u: k for k, u in enumerate(ut)}
    for l in range(1, lags + 1):
        j = np.array([pos.get(u - l, -1) for u in ut])
        k = j >= 0
        S += 2 * (1 - l / (lags + 1)) * (G[k] * G[j[k]]).sum(axis=0)
    n, p = Xr.shape[0], C.shape[1] + 1
    se = np.sqrt(np.clip(S, 0, None) / xx ** 2 * (n - 1) / max(n - p, 1) * len(ut) / max(len(ut) - 1, 1))
    t = b / se
    pv = 2 * stats.t.sf(np.abs(t), df=max(len(ut) - 1, 1))
    meta = F.meta(pn.base.meta)
    for jj, c in enumerate(cols):
        f = F.columns[c]
        code, tr, lag = parse_feature(f)
        es = int(feature_sign(meta, f)) if code in meta.index else 0
        rows.append({"feature": f, "mnemonic": code, "transform": tr, "lag": lag, "coef": b[jj], "t_dk": t[jj],
                     "p_dk": pv[jj], "expected_sign": es,
                     "sign_ok": es == 0 or np.sign(b[jj]) == es,
                     "theme": meta.loc[code, "theme"] if code in meta.index else "",
                     "geography": meta.loc[code, "geography"] if code in meta.index else "",
                     "description": meta.loc[code, "description"] if code in meta.index else code})
    sc = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    sc["abs_t"] = sc["t_dk"].abs()
    return sc

def shortlist(cfg, pn, F, sc, start, end):
    """Best form of each variable among those that pass, grouped by correlation, one per group."""
    s = cfg["screen_first"]
    F = _fs(F)
    passed = sc[sc["sign_ok"] & (sc["p_dk"] < s["screen_p"])]
    if passed.empty:
        return passed.assign(cluster=[], is_representative=[])
    best = passed.sort_values("abs_t", ascending=False).groupby("mnemonic").head(1).set_index("feature", drop=False)
    W = F.frame(best.index).loc[pd.Period(start, freq="Q"):pd.Period(end, freq="Q")]
    best["cluster"] = cluster(W, s["cluster_corr"]).reindex(best.index).values
    rep = representatives(best, "abs_t", s.get("primary_geography"), s.get("rep_tolerance", 0.75))
    return rep[rep["is_representative"]].sort_values("abs_t", ascending=False).head(s["shortlist_max"])

def pooled_fit(pn, F, feats, start, end, lags=4):
    """Pooled FE regression of the combination: (beta, Driscoll-Kraay t, BIC, n)."""
    X = _fs(F).stacked(pn, feats)
    m = pn.window(start, end, X)
    C = _controls(pn, m)
    Z = np.column_stack([C, X[m]])
    yv = pn.Y[m]
    sw = sqrt_w(pn, m)
    if sw is not None:
        Z, yv = Z * sw[:, None], yv * sw
    b, e, XtXi = ols(Z, yv)
    V = driscoll_kraay(Z, e, pn.T[m], XtXi, lags)
    k = len(feats)
    se = np.sqrt(np.clip(np.diag(V)[-k:], 0, None))
    n = int(m.sum())
    bic = n * np.log(max(e @ e, 1e-300) / n) + Z.shape[1] * np.log(n)
    return b[-k:], b[-k:] / np.where(se > 0, se, np.nan), bic, n

class _FastPooled:
    """Pooled FE regressions of many driver combinations on the same window, fast and with identical results.

    The stacked data are built once. The controls (bank intercepts, lagged change, dummies) are partialled out of
    the target and of every driver once per estimation sample (Frisch-Waugh), so each combination is a small
    regression of residuals on residuals: the same slopes, residuals, BIC and Driscoll-Kraay covariance as the full
    regression (the small-sample correction is given the full number of regressors).
    """

    def __init__(self, pn, F, feats, start, end):
        self.pn, self.feats = pn, list(feats)
        self.col = {f: j for j, f in enumerate(self.feats)}
        self.X = F.stacked(pn, self.feats)
        self.base = pn.window(start, end)
        self.valid = ~np.isnan(self.X)
        self.cache = {}

    def _sample(self, idx):
        m = self.base & self.valid[:, idx].all(axis=1)
        key = np.packbits(m).tobytes()
        if key not in self.cache:
            ok = self.valid[m].all(axis=0)              # drivers complete on this sample
            C = _controls(self.pn, m)
            Xm = np.where(ok[None, :], self.X[m], 0.0)
            YX = np.column_stack([self.pn.Y[m], Xm])
            sw = sqrt_w(self.pn, m)
            if sw is not None:                        # size-weighted rows
                C, YX = C * sw[:, None], YX * sw[:, None]
            B = np.linalg.lstsq(C, YX, rcond=None)[0]
            R = YX - C @ B
            self.cache[key] = (R[:, 0], R[:, 1:], self.pn.T[m], C.shape[1], int(m.sum()))
        return self.cache[key]

    def slopes(self, combo):
        idx = [self.col[f] for f in combo]
        ry, RX, T, pc, n = self._sample(idx)
        Xt = RX[:, idx]
        if n <= pc + len(idx):
            return None
        b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xt, ry, rcond=None)
        return b, Xt, ry - Xt @ b, T, pc, n

    def tstats(self, combo, got, lags):
        b, Xt, e, T, pc, n = got
        try:
            XtXi = np.linalg.inv(Xt.T @ Xt)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            XtXi = np.linalg.pinv(Xt.T @ Xt)
        V = driscoll_kraay(Xt, e, T, XtXi, lags, p=pc + len(combo))
        se = np.sqrt(np.clip(np.diag(V), 0, None))
        bic = n * np.log(max(e @ e, 1e-300) / n) + (pc + len(combo)) * np.log(n)
        return b / np.where(se > 0, se, np.nan), bic, n

def search(cfg, pn, F, short, start, end, log=print):
    """Every valid combination of shortlisted drivers, ranked by pooled BIC, then the best few backtested.

    Returns:
        (chosen features, table of valid combinations with their BIC and backtest error).
    """
    fm = cfg["final_model"]
    pc = cfg.get("panel") or {}
    feats = list(short["feature"])
    if not feats:
        return [], pd.DataFrame()
    themes = short.set_index("feature")["theme"].to_dict()
    signs = short.set_index("feature")["expected_sign"].to_dict()
    F = _fs(F)
    W = F.frame(feats).loc[pd.Period(start, freq="Q"):pd.Period(end, freq="Q")]
    lags = int(pc.get("dk_lags", 4))
    fit = _FastPooled(pn, F, feats, start, end)
    t_min, vif_max = float(fm.get("t_min", 1.96)), float(fm.get("vif_max", 5))
    rows = []
    for k in range(int(fm.get("min_vars", 1)), int(fm.get("max_vars", 3)) + 1):
        for combo in itertools.combinations(feats, k):
            if fm.get("one_per_theme", True) and len({themes[f] for f in combo}) < k:
                continue
            if fm.get("required_themes") and not set(fm["required_themes"]) <= {themes[f] for f in combo}:
                continue
            # cheapest checks first: the slopes and their signs (plain least squares), then the VIF, then the
            # Driscoll-Kraay t statistics only for the combinations still in (the same rules, in a cheaper order)
            got = fit.slopes(combo)
            if got is None:
                continue
            b = got[0]
            if any(signs[f] != 0 and np.sign(bv) != signs[f] for f, bv in zip(combo, b)):
                continue
            if k > 1 and np.nanmax(vif(W[list(combo)])) > vif_max:
                continue
            t, bic, n = fit.tstats(combo, got, lags)
            if np.any(np.abs(t) < t_min) or np.any(~np.isfinite(t)):
                continue
            rows.append({"features": list(combo), "k": k, "bic": bic, "min_abs_t": float(np.min(np.abs(t))), "n": n})
    if not rows:
        return [], pd.DataFrame()
    R = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("bic").reset_index(drop=True)
    top = R.head(int(pc.get("n_search_candidates", 20))).copy()
    errs = []
    for f in top["features"]:
        try:
            errs.append(quick_error(cfg, pn, F, f, end))
        except Exception:
            errs.append(np.nan)
    top["backtest_error_pct"] = np.array(errs) * 100
    top = top.dropna(subset=["backtest_error_pct"])
    if top.empty:
        return list(R.iloc[0]["features"]), R
    best = top["backtest_error_pct"].min()
    tol = float(fm.get("selection_tolerance", 0.05))
    ok = top[top["backtest_error_pct"] <= best * (1 + tol)].sort_values(["k", "backtest_error_pct"])
    chosen = list(ok.iloc[0]["features"])
    R = R.merge(top[["bic", "backtest_error_pct"]], on="bic", how="left")
    R["chosen"] = R["features"].apply(lambda f: list(f) == chosen)
    R["features"] = R["features"].apply(", ".join)
    return chosen, R

def quick_error(cfg, pn, F, feats, end, banks=None, metric=None):
    """Average absolute level error over 1..H quarters, all banks and backtest origins up to `end`, of the
    pooled model with these drivers (dummy windows left out). banks: only these banks' forecasts are scored;
    metric: a panel.evaluation metric instead of the average (src.panel.compare)."""
    H = int(cfg["sample"]["horizon"])
    X = _fs(F).array(feats)
    origins = [o for o in backtest_origins(pn.base) if o + 1 < len(pn.dates) and pn.dates[o] <= pd.Period(end, freq="Q")]
    if not origins:
        return np.nan
    flags = refit_flags(pn.base, origins)
    m = PanelModel("pooled", feats, min_obs=int((cfg.get("panel") or {}).get("min_obs", 20)))
    errs = []
    start = cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"]
    endp = pn.pos(end)
    dq = [pd.Period(q, freq="Q") for q in cfg["sample"]["dummy_quarters"]]
    lo, hi = (min(dq), max(dq)) if dq else (None, None)
    for o, fl in zip(origins, flags):
        if fl:
            m.fit(pn, X, start, pn.dates[o])
        for b in pn.active(pn.dates[o]):
            if banks is not None and b not in banks:
                continue
            y = pn.ys[b]
            q0 = pn.dates[o]
            if b not in m.coef or pd.isna(y.get(q0, np.nan)):
                continue
            hmax = min(H, endp - o)
            fc = m.forecast(pn, X, b, o, hmax, {"bank": float(y.loc[q0])})
            act = np.array([y.get(pn.dates[o + h], np.nan) for h in range(1, len(fc) + 1)])
            for h in range(1, len(fc) + 1):
                win = pn.dates[o + 1:o + h + 1]
                if lo is not None and ((win >= lo) & (win <= hi)).any():
                    continue
                if np.isnan(act[:h]).any():
                    break
                errs.append(float(tg.error(fc[:h].sum(), act[:h].sum())))
    if not errs:
        return np.nan
    if metric:
        from .compare import _one
        return _one(np.array(errs), 0.10, 0.5)[metric]
    return float(np.mean(np.abs(errs)))

def select(cfg, pn, F, start, end, log=print):
    """Screen, shortlist and search on the window start..end.

    Returns:
        dict: features (chosen), tables (P1_panel_screen, P2_shortlist, P3_search).
    """
    lags = int((cfg.get("panel") or {}).get("dk_lags", 4))
    sc = screen(pn, F, start, end, lags)
    short = shortlist(cfg, pn, F, sc, start, end)
    chosen, R = search(cfg, pn, F, short, start, end, log)
    return {"features": chosen, "tables": {"P1_panel_screen": sc.sort_values("abs_t", ascending=False),
                                           "P2_shortlist": short.reset_index(drop=True), "P3_search": R}}

Several related targets analysed as one system: loans, deposits and the bank's own rates.

run.py   the chain (every target selected and estimated with the full single-target project, the outputs of
         earlier targets offered as drivers of later ones), the joint backtest and out-of-sample test with
         the chain forecasting itself, the BVARX challenger, reconciliation to identities, ratio checks
         and joint scenario paths.

src/system/joint.py

module src.system.joint · 25 items
Joint estimators for the system: SUR estimation of the chain, and a VECM challenger.

SUR chain
    The same equations as the chain (each target's chosen drivers, its own last-quarter change, constant and
    dummies), estimated jointly by feasible GLS (Zellner): OLS for each equation, then the covariance of their
    residuals, then GLS on all equations stacked. Uses the correlation of the targets' surprises (the same
    shocks hit loans, deposits and rates in the same quarter): more precise coefficients, and joint uncertainty.
    Forecasts run the chain in order (earlier targets' forecasts feed the later ones). Fan charts: shocks drawn
    from the estimated residual covariance, so the targets move together as they did in history.

VECM challenger
    Every target's change, with error-correction terms for long-run relations given in the config:
        ratio   ln(sum of numerator levels) - ln(sum of denominator levels), e.g. loan-to-deposit
        against a target regressed on macro series in levels (Engle-Granger), e.g. own mortgage rate on the 5Y yield
    dy_i,t = c_i + sum_k alpha_ik ect_k,t-1 + sum_j a_ij dy_j,t-1 + b_i' x_t + e_i,t
    Cross-target lags are shrunk towards 0 as in the BVARX; the error-correction and macro terms are not.
    Each relation is tested for stationarity (ADF; Engle-Granger critical values for estimated relations), and
    the targets' levels get a Johansen trace test of the number of long-run relations.

def _step(form, L, g):

def _path(form, L0, g):
    c = np.cumsum(g)
    return L0 * np.exp(c) if form == "dlog" else L0 + c

def mdf_with(m, base, upstream, origin):
    """A member's macro data with the earlier targets replaced by `upstream` level paths after the origin."""
    mdf = base.copy()
    for name, path in upstream.items():
        col = "SYS." + str(name).upper()
        if col in mdf.columns:
            p = path[path.index > origin]
            common = p.index.intersection(mdf.index)
            mdf.loc[common, col] = p.loc[common].values
    scen, _ = add_constructed(m.cfg, {"x": mdf}, m.ctx.meta.copy())
    return scen["x"]

def drivers_of(m):
    """The drivers of a member's chosen model; for a model without drivers, those of 'Screen first'."""
    f = list(getattr(m.model, "features", []) or [])
    if not f:
        sf = m.models.get("Screen first")
        f = list(getattr(sf, "features", []) or []) if sf is not None else []
    out = []
    for x in f:
        try:
            parse_feature(x)
            out.append(x)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return out

class SURChain:
    name = "SUR chain"

    def __init__(self, members):
        self.members = members
        self.feats = {m.name: drivers_of(m) for m in members}
        self.F = {m.name: feature_matrix(m.ctx.base, self.feats[m.name], m.cfg["features"].get("deflator"))
                  if self.feats[m.name] else pd.DataFrame(index=m.ctx.base.index) for m in members}

    def _design(self, m, rows):
        y = m.ctx.y.reindex(rows).values
        yl = m.ctx.y.shift(1).reindex(rows).values
        X = self.F[m.name].reindex(rows).values
        D = m.ctx.dummies.reindex(rows).fillna(0).values
        return y, np.column_stack([np.ones(len(rows)), yl, X, D]), list(m.ctx.dummies.columns)

    def fit(self, start, end):
        """Feasible GLS on the quarters start..end where every equation has data."""
        idx = self.members[0].ctx.y.index
        rows = idx[(idx >= start) & (idx <= end)]
        des = {m.name: self._design(m, rows) for m in self.members}
        ok = np.ones(len(rows), bool)
        for y, X, _ in des.values():
            ok &= ~np.isnan(y) & ~np.isnan(X).any(1)
        rows = rows[ok]
        self.rows = rows
        Ys, Xs, names, keep = [], [], {}, {}
        for m in self.members:
            y, X, dn = des[m.name]
            y, X = y[ok], X[ok]
            k = (X.std(0) > 0)
            k[0] = True                                    # constant
            keep[m.name] = k
            Xs.append(X[:, k])
            Ys.append(y)
            names[m.name] = (["constant", "lag of own change"] + self.feats[m.name] + dn)
            names[m.name] = [n for n, f in zip(names[m.name], k) if f]
        T, n = len(rows), len(self.members)
        E = np.column_stack([y - X @ np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0] for y, X in zip(Ys, Xs)])
        S = E.T @ E / T
        Si = np.linalg.inv(S)
        sizes = [X.shape[1] for X in Xs]
        off = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(sizes)]
        K = off[-1]
        XtOX, XtOy = np.zeros((K, K)), np.zeros(K)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                XtOX[off[i]:off[i + 1], off[j]:off[j + 1]] = Si[i, j] * Xs[i].T @ Xs[j]
            XtOy[off[i]:off[i + 1]] = sum(Si[i, j] * Xs[i].T @ Ys[j] for j in range(n))
        V = np.linalg.inv(XtOX)
        b = V @ XtOy
        self.coef, self.se, self.keep, self.names = {}, {}, keep, names
        res = []
        for i, m in enumerate(self.members):
            bi = b[off[i]:off[i + 1]]
            full = np.zeros(len(keep[m.name]))
            full[keep[m.name]] = bi
            self.coef[m.name] = full
            self.se[m.name] = np.sqrt(np.clip(np.diag(V)[off[i]:off[i + 1]], 0, None))
            res.append(Ys[i] - Xs[i] @ bi)
        R = np.column_stack(res)
        self.Sigma = R.T @ R / T
        self.ols_Sigma = S
        return self

    def forecast(self, origin, H, base_of=None, shocks=None):
        """The chain from `origin`: {name: (changes, level path Series)}.

        Args:
            origin: quarter. H: quarters. base_of: {name: macro DataFrame} (default: each member's history).
            shocks: optional array (H, n) added to the changes (fan charts).
        """
        out, paths = {}, {}
        for i, m in enumerate(self.members):
            base = base_of[m.name] if base_of else m.ctx.base
            if origin not in base.index or origin not in m.ctx.level.index:
                continue
            if m.uses:
                mdf = mdf_with(m, base, {u: paths[u] for u in m.uses if u in paths}, origin)
                F = feature_matrix(mdf, self.feats[m.name], m.cfg["features"].get("deflator")) \
                    if self.feats[m.name] else pd.DataFrame(index=mdf.index)
            else:
                F = self.F[m.name] if base_of is None else \
                    (feature_matrix(base, self.feats[m.name], m.cfg["features"].get("deflator"))
                     if self.feats[m.name] else pd.DataFrame(index=base.index))
            p = F.index.get_loc(origin)
            h = min(H, len(F) - p - 1)
            if h <= 0:
                continue
            c = self.coef[m.name]
            k = len(self.feats[m.name])
            yl = float(m.ctx.y.loc[origin])
            g = np.zeros(h)
            for s in range(h):
                x = F.iloc[p + 1 + s].values if k else np.zeros(0)
                yl = c[0] + c[1] * yl + (x @ c[2:2 + k] if k else 0.0)
                if shocks is not None:
                    yl += shocks[s, i]
                g[s] = yl
            dates = F.index[p + 1:p + 1 + h]
            lv = pd.Series(_path(m.form, float(m.ctx.level.loc[origin]), g), index=dates)
            paths[m.name] = pd.concat([m.ctx.level.loc[:origin], lv])
            out[m.name] = (g, lv)
        return out

    def table(self):
        rows = []
        for m in self.members:
            k = self.keep[m.name]
            for nm, b, se in zip(self.names[m.name], self.coef[m.name][k], self.se[m.name]):
                rows.append({"equation": m.name, "term": nm, "coef": b, "std_err": se,
                             "t": b / se if se > 0 else np.nan})
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)

    def correlation(self):
        d = np.sqrt(np.diag(self.Sigma))
        C = self.Sigma / np.outer(d, d)
        nm = [m.name for m in self.members]
        return pd.DataFrame(C, index=nm, columns=nm)

                     if self.feats[m.name] else pd.DataFrame(index=base.index))
            p = F.index.get_loc(origin)
            h = min(H, len(F) - p - 1)
            if h <= 0:
                continue
            c = self.coef[m.name]
            k = len(self.feats[m.name])
            yl = float(m.ctx.y.loc[origin])
            g = np.zeros(h)
            for s in range(h):
                x = F.iloc[p + 1 + s].values if k else np.zeros(0)
                yl = c[0] + c[1] * yl + (x @ c[2:2 + k] if k else 0.0)
                if shocks is not None:
                    yl += shocks[s, i]
                g[s] = yl
            dates = F.index[p + 1:p + 1 + h]
            lv = pd.Series(_path(m.form, float(m.ctx.level.loc[origin]), g), index=dates)
            paths[m.name] = pd.concat([m.ctx.level.loc[:origin], lv])
            out[m.name] = (g, lv)
        return out

def _res_rows(members, out, origin, method, test, covid, rows_fn):
    res = {}
    for m in members:
        if m.name not in out:
            continue
        g, lv = out[m.name]
        o = m.ctx.y.index.get_loc(origin)
        act = m.ctx.y.iloc[o + 1:o + 1 + len(g)].values.astype(float)
        n = len(act)                           # a backtest path stops where the history ends
        if n == 0:
            continue
        res[m.name] = (g[:n], act, float(m.ctx.level.loc[origin]), lv.iloc[:n], m.form)
    return rows_fn(res, origin, method, test, covid)

def sur_backtest(members, H, covid, rows_fn, keep=None):
    c0 = members[0].ctx
    pos = backtest_origins(c0)
    origins, flags = [c0.idx[o] for o in pos], refit_flags(c0, pos)
    start = pd.Period(members[0].cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], freq="Q")
    sur = SURChain(members)
    rows = []
    for o, fl in zip(origins, flags):
        if fl:
            sur.fit(start, o)
            if keep is not None:
                keep[str(o)] = {"coef": {k: v.copy() for k, v in sur.coef.items()}, "Sigma": sur.Sigma.copy()}
        rows += _res_rows(members, sur.forecast(o, H), o, "SUR chain", "backtest", covid, rows_fn)
    sur.fit(start, c0.idx[c0.end])
    return pd.DataFrame(rows), sur

def sur_scenarios(members, sur, n_sims=300, seed=7):
    """Point paths and fan-chart percentiles of every target under every scenario."""
    c0 = members[0]
    hist_end = c0.ctx.idx[c0.ctx.end]
    pts, fan = [], []
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    Lc = np.linalg.cholesky(sur.Sigma + 1e-12 * np.eye(len(members)))
    for sc in c0.ctx.macro:
        base_of = {m.name: m.ctx.macro[sc] for m in members}
        out = sur.forecast(hist_end, 10 ** 6, base_of)
        for nm, (g, lv) in out.items():
            pts += [{"target": nm, "method": "SUR chain", "scenario": sc, "date": str(q), "level": float(v)}
                    for q, v in lv.items()]
        H = max(len(v[0]) for v in out.values()) if out else 0
        if not H or n_sims <= 0:
            continue
        sims = {m.name: [] for m in members}
        for _ in range(int(n_sims)):
            sh = rng.standard_normal((H, len(members))) @ Lc.T
            o2 = sur.forecast(hist_end, H, base_of, sh)
            for nm, (g, lv) in o2.items():
                sims[nm].append(lv.values)
        for nm, arr in sims.items():
            if not arr:
                continue
            A = np.array(arr)
            dates = out[nm][1].index
            q = np.percentile(A, [5, 25, 50, 75, 95], axis=0)
            fan += [{"target": nm, "scenario": sc, "date": str(d), "p5": q[0, t], "p25": q[1, t], "p50": q[2, t],
                     "p75": q[3, t], "p95": q[4, t]} for t, d in enumerate(dates)]
    return pd.DataFrame(pts), pd.DataFrame(fan)

def _against(rel):
    """Macro series a target is regressed on in a relation ('against'; YAML reads a bare 'on:' key as True)."""
    v = rel.get("against", rel.get("on", rel.get(True)))
    return v if isinstance(v, list) else [v]

class VECM:
    name = "VECM (all targets)"

    def __init__(self, members, relations, exog, lam=0.2):
        relations = [{**r, "against": _against(r)} if not r.get("numerator") else r for r in relations]
        self.members, self.relations, self.exog, self.lam = members, list(relations), list(exog), float(lam)
        self.names = [m.name for m in members]
        self.forms = {m.name: m.form for m in members}

    def _levels(self, base=None):
        return pd.DataFrame({m.name: m.ctx.level for m in self.members})

    def _ect(self, L, macro, rel, beta=None):
        """Value of one relation over the quarters of L (levels) and macro (levels)."""
        if rel.get("numerator"):
            return np.log(L[rel["numerator"]].sum(axis=1)) - np.log(L[rel["denominator"]].sum(axis=1)), None
        on = _against(rel)
        y = L[rel["target"]]
        Z = macro[on].reindex(L.index)
        if beta is None:
            ok = y.notna() & Z.notna().all(axis=1)
            A = np.column_stack([np.ones(ok.sum()), Z[ok].values])
            beta = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y[ok].values, rcond=None)[0]
        return y - (beta[0] + Z.values @ beta[1:]), beta

    def fit(self, Y, X, macro, start, end):
        L = self._levels()
        rows = Y.loc[start:end].index
        self.beta, ects = {}, {}
        for r in self.relations:
            e, b = self._ect(L.loc[:end], macro.loc[:end], r)
            self.beta[r["name"]] = b
            ects[r["name"]] = e - e.loc[start:end].mean()
        self.ect_mean = {r["name"]: float(self._ect(L.loc[:end], macro.loc[:end], r, self.beta[r["name"]])[0]
                                          .loc[start:end].mean()) for r in self.relations}
        E = pd.DataFrame(ects).reindex(Y.index)
        n, k = len(self.names), len(self.relations)
        Yv = Y.loc[rows].values
        Yl = Y.shift(1).loc[rows].values
        El = E.shift(1).loc[rows].values
        Xv = X.reindex(rows).values if len(self.exog) else np.zeros((len(rows), 0))
        ok = ~np.isnan(Yv).any(1) & ~np.isnan(Yl).any(1) & ~np.isnan(El).any(1) & ~np.isnan(Xv).any(1)
        Yv, Yl, El, Xv = Yv[ok], Yl[ok], El[ok], Xv[ok]
        s = np.array([np.std(Yv[:, i] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(Yl[:, i], Yv[:, i], 1), Yl[:, i])) for i in range(n)])
        Z = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(Yv)), El, Yl, Xv])
        self.c, self.alpha = np.zeros(n), np.zeros((n, k))
        self.A, self.B = np.zeros((n, n)), np.zeros((n, Xv.shape[1]))
        for i in range(n):
            pen = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
            for j in range(n):
                if j != i:
                    pen[1 + k + j] = (s[i] ** 2) / max((self.lam * s[i] / max(s[j], 1e-12)) ** 2, 1e-18)
            co = np.linalg.solve(Z.T @ Z + np.diag(pen) + 1e-10 * np.eye(Z.shape[1]), Z.T @ Yv[:, i])
            self.c[i], self.alpha[i] = co[0], co[1:1 + k]
            self.A[i], self.B[i] = co[1 + k:1 + k + n], co[1 + k + n:]
        self.n_obs = len(Yv)
        return self

    def forecast(self, Y, X, macro, origin, H):
        """{name: (changes, level path Series)} from `origin` with exogenous X and macro levels (scenario)."""
        L = self._levels()
        idx = X.index if len(self.exog) else macro.index
        if origin not in idx:
            return {}
        p = idx.get_loc(origin)
        h = min(H, len(idx) - p - 1)
        if h <= 0:
            return {}
        dates = idx[p + 1:p + 1 + h]
        lev = {nm: float(L[nm].loc[origin]) for nm in self.names}
        y = Y.loc[origin].values.astype(float)
        out = {nm: [] for nm in self.names}
        for s, q in enumerate(dates):
            ect = []
            prev_q = idx[p + s]
            for r in self.relations:
                if r.get("numerator"):
                    v = np.log(sum(lev[a] for a in r["numerator"])) - np.log(sum(lev[a] for a in r["denominator"]))
                else:
                    on = _against(r)
                    b = self.beta[r["name"]]
                    v = lev[r["target"]] - (b[0] + macro.loc[prev_q, on].values @ b[1:])
                ect.append(v - self.ect_mean[r["name"]])
            x = X.loc[q].values if len(self.exog) else np.zeros(0)
            y = self.c + self.alpha @ np.array(ect) + self.A @ y + self.B @ x
            for i, nm in enumerate(self.names):
                lev[nm] = _step(self.forms[nm], lev[nm], y[i])
                out[nm].append(y[i])
        res = {}
        for nm in self.names:
            g = np.array(out[nm])
            res[nm] = (g, pd.Series(_path(self.forms[nm], float(L[nm].loc[origin]), g), index=dates))
        return res

    def table(self):
        rows = []
        for i, nm in enumerate(self.names):
            rows.append({"equation": nm, "term": "constant", "coef": self.c[i]})
            rows += [{"equation": nm, "term": f"error correction: {r['name']}", "coef": self.alpha[i, k]}
                     for k, r in enumerate(self.relations)]
            rows += [{"equation": nm, "term": f"{self.names[j]} (lag 1)", "coef": self.A[i, j], "cross": j != i}
                     for j in range(len(self.names))]
            rows += [{"equation": nm, "term": f, "coef": self.B[i, k]} for k, f in enumerate(self.exog)]
        for r in self.relations:
            b = self.beta.get(r["name"])
            if b is not None:
                on = _against(r)
                rows.append({"equation": f"long run: {r['name']}", "term": "constant", "coef": b[0]})
                rows += [{"equation": f"long run: {r['name']}", "term": o, "coef": v} for o, v in zip(on, b[1:])]
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def cointegration_tests(vecm, macro, start, end):
    """ADF on each relation (Engle-Granger critical values when the relation is estimated) and a Johansen trace
    test on the targets' levels (log for balances, level for rates)."""
    from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller
    rows = []
    L = vecm._levels()
    for r in vecm.relations:
        e, _ = vecm._ect(L.loc[:end], macro.loc[:end], r, vecm.beta.get(r["name"]))
        e = e.loc[start:end].dropna()
        stat, p, *_ = adfuller(e.values, regression="c", autolag="AIC")
        n_on = 0 if r.get("numerator") else len(_against(r))
        crit = {0: -2.86, 1: -3.34, 2: -3.74, 3: -4.10}.get(n_on, -4.4)     # 5%, Engle-Granger (MacKinnon)
        rows.append({"test": "ADF on the relation", "relation": r["name"], "statistic": stat,
                     "p_value": p if n_on == 0 else np.nan, "crit_5pct": crit,
                     "stationary_5pct": bool(stat < crit),
                     "note": "fixed vector" if n_on == 0 else "estimated vector: Engle-Granger critical value"})
    try:
        from statsmodels.tsa.vector_ar.vecm import coint_johansen
        S = pd.DataFrame({nm: (np.log(L[nm]) if vecm.forms[nm] == "dlog" else L[nm]) for nm in vecm.names})
        S = S.loc[start:end].dropna()
        j = coint_johansen(S.values, det_order=0, k_ar_diff=1)
        rank = 0
        for r_ in range(len(vecm.names)):
            ok = j.lr1[r_] > j.cvt[r_, 1]
            rows.append({"test": "Johansen trace", "relation": f"rank <= {r_}", "statistic": j.lr1[r_],
                         "crit_5pct": j.cvt[r_, 1], "stationary_5pct": None,
                         "note": "reject: more relations than this" if ok else "not rejected"})
            if ok:
                rank = r_ + 1
            else:
                break
        rows.append({"test": "Johansen trace", "relation": "estimated number of long-run relations",
                     "statistic": rank, "note": "among the targets' levels (5%)"})
    except Exception as ex:
        rows.append({"test": "Johansen trace", "relation": "not run", "note": str(ex)})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def vecm_backtest(members, relations, lam, H, covid, rows_fn, Y, X, exog, keep=None):
    c0 = members[0].ctx
    macro = c0.base
    pos = backtest_origins(c0)
    origins, flags = [c0.idx[o] for o in pos], refit_flags(c0, pos)
    start = pd.Period(members[0].cfg["sample"]["estimation_start"], freq="Q")
    vm = VECM(members, relations, exog, lam)
    rows = []
    for o, fl in zip(origins, flags):
        if fl:
            vm.fit(Y, X, macro, start, o)
            if keep is not None:
                import pickle
                keep[str(o)] = pickle.dumps(vm)
        rows += _res_rows(members, vm.forecast(Y, X, macro, o, H), o, "VECM", "backtest", covid, rows_fn)
    vm.fit(Y, X, macro, start, c0.idx[c0.end])
    return pd.DataFrame(rows), vm

def vecm_scenarios(members, vm, Y):
    c0 = members[0]
    hist_end = c0.ctx.idx[c0.ctx.end]
    out = []
    for sc, mdf in c0.ctx.macro.items():
        Xs = feature_matrix(mdf, vm.exog, c0.cfg["features"].get("deflator")) if vm.exog else pd.DataFrame(index=mdf.index)
        res = vm.forecast(Y, Xs, mdf, hist_end, 10 ** 6)
        for nm, (g, lv) in res.items():
            out += [{"target": nm, "method": "VECM", "scenario": sc, "date": str(q), "level": float(v)}
                    for q, v in lv.items()]
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

src/system/panel.py

module src.system.panel · 15 items
System with panel: every bank has the same chain of targets (own rates -> loans -> deposits), and every
target's equation is estimated across all banks with the panel models.

How it works

1. Order. As in the system: each target comes after the targets it uses.
2. Each target is a panel. Candidate drivers: the macro features (the same for every bank) plus the earlier
   targets of the SAME bank ("SYS.<NAME>", or a spread over a market rate), with the signs from the config.
   Drivers are chosen on all banks together (pooled Driscoll-Kraay screen and search, as in run_panel.py).
   Competing panel models: separate (each bank alone), pooled fixed effects, partial pooling (shrinkage) and
   the AR(1) benchmark, with the panel drivers and with the literature core. The most accurate across banks
   (backtest, mean of the banks' errors) is the target's model in the chain.
3. Joint backtest. From each origin, every bank's chain forecasts itself: the bank's own forecast rates feed
   its loan equations, its forecast loans and rates feed its deposit equation ("Panel chain"); next to it the
   same models with the actual values of the earlier targets ("Panel chain, actual inputs").
4. Scenarios: every bank, every target, every scenario, chained. Ratios (e.g. loan-to-deposit) per bank
   against the bank's own historical range.
5. Links: the pooled coefficient of each earlier target in each equation (Driscoll-Kraay t) and every bank's
   own (partial pooling) coefficient, next to each other.

Outputs: outputs/<run>/system_panel/ (tables, charts, summary.md, fitted/) and one folder per target with its
panel selection, leaderboards, coefficients and shrinkage.

def _target_cfg(base_cfg, scfg, t, data_file, pc, out_t):
    """The full config of one target (written next to its results and loaded with the project defaults)."""
    import macroforecast as mf
    from ..utils.config import load_config
    c = copy.deepcopy(base_cfg)
    c = mf.api._merge(c, mf.parse_options(scfg.get("hyperparameters")))
    c = mf.api._merge(c, mf.parse_options(t.get("hyperparameters")))
    c["run_name"] = t["name"]
    c["output_dir"] = os.path.dirname(out_t)
    c["data"]["bank"].update(file=data_file, target_column=t["column"], date_column=scfg.get("date_column", "date"),
                             sheet=None, frequency="Q", panel_column=pc)
    ev = t.get("events") or scfg.get("events")
    c["data"]["events"].update(file=ev, bank_column=pc if ev else None)
    c["data"]["metadata"]["file"] = t["metadata"]
    c.setdefault("literature", {})["workbook"] = t.get("literature")
    c.setdefault("target", {}).update(transform=t.get("transform", "auto"), label=t.get("label") or t["name"])
    c.setdefault("panel", {})
    c["panel"]["models"] = [k for k in (c["panel"].get("models") or ["separate", "pooled", "partial"]) if k != "topdown"]
    c["panel"]["driver_sets"] = ["panel", "core"] if t.get("literature") else ["panel"]
    given = (mf.parse_options(scfg.get("hyperparameters")).get("sample") or {})
    for k in ("hist_end", "estimation_start", "backtest_start"):
        if k not in given:
            c["sample"].pop(k, None)
    if "backtest_end" not in given:
        c["sample"]["backtest_end"] = None
    if "first_origin" not in (mf.parse_options(scfg.get("hyperparameters")).get("oos") or {}):
        c.setdefault("oos", {})["first_origin"] = None
    miss = [k for k in ("hist_end", "estimation_start", "backtest_start") if k not in c["sample"]]
    if miss:
        g = mf.infer_dates(c)
        for k in miss:
            c["sample"][k] = g[k]
    os.makedirs(out_t, exist_ok=True)
    f = os.path.join(out_t, "target_config.yaml")
    with open(f, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        yaml.safe_dump(c, fh, sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
    return load_config(f)

def sys_names(t, up, max_lag):
    """Candidate feature names for an earlier target `up` used by target t."""
    out = []
    for u in t.get("uses") or []:
        if u["target"] != up["name"]:
            continue
        if u.get("spread_over"):
            base, trs = sysname(up["name"]) + "_SPREAD", SYS_TRS["diff"]
        else:
            base, trs = sysname(up["name"]), SYS_TRS[up["form"]]
        out += [f"{base}|{tr}|L{l}" for tr in trs for l in range(0, max_lag + 1)]
    return out

def bank_sys_frame(index, macro, levels, t, done, deflator):
    """One bank's system series (earlier targets' levels, and spreads) on `index`, ready for feature_matrix."""
    df = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
    for u in t.get("uses") or []:
        up = done[u["target"]]
        lv = levels.get(up["name"])
        s = lv.reindex(index) if lv is not None else pd.Series(np.nan, index=index)
        df[sysname(up["name"])] = s.values
        if u.get("spread_over"):
            df[sysname(up["name"]) + "_SPREAD"] = s.values - macro[u["spread_over"]].reindex(index).values
    return df

def sys_cube(pn, t, done, uplevels, names, deflator, index=None, macro=None):
    """Bank-specific system features: (banks, dates, k) on `index` (default: the panel's dates)."""
    index = pn.dates if index is None else index
    macro = pn.base.base if macro is None else macro
    cube = np.full((len(pn.banks), len(index), len(names)), np.nan)
    for i, b in enumerate(pn.banks):
        df = bank_sys_frame(index, macro, {k: v.get(b) for k, v in uplevels.items()}, t, done, deflator)
        if len(df.columns):
            cube[i] = feature_matrix(df, names, deflator).reindex(index).values
    return cube

def sys_meta(t, done):

                     + (f" minus {u['spread_over']}" if u.get("spread_over") else "") + " (system)",
                     "geography": "Ontario", "theme": f"System: {up['name']}", "expected_sign": int(u.get("sign", 0)),

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
